Require Import Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes String.

Open Scope string_scope.

Declare Scope tree_scope.
Global Open Scope tree_scope.

Inductive Tree:  Set :=
  | Ref : string -> Tree
  | Node : Tree
  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)
                 then S1 (star x M1) @ (star x M2)
                 else K@ (M1 @ M2)
  end.

Notation "\" := star : tree_scope.

Definition wait2 M N x :=  S1 (S1 (S1 (K @ M) @ (K @ N)) @ (K @ x)) @ I.

Definition omega21 := K @ (△ @ (△ @ I)).

Definition omega22 :=  \ "w" (\ "f" (wait2 (Ref "w") (Ref "w") (Ref "f"))).
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.

Definition omega22_ty := program_type omega22.

Definition omega2_ty := (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty).

Definition eval_ty := quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Asf (Var 0))).

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                          subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| sub_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| sub_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| sub_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| sub_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)

| sub_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subtype omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| sub_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
| sub_to_asf: forall ty, subtype ty (Asf ty)
| sub_from_asf: forall uty vty, subtype (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
| sub_bffs: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty)) (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty))
| sub_bfff : forall uty vty wty, subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
                                         (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty))
.
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Inductive derive: list (string * dtype) -> Tree -> dtype -> Prop :=
| derive_ref : forall gamma x uty ty, get x gamma = Some uty -> subtype uty ty -> derive gamma (Ref x) ty
| derive_node : forall gamma uty, subtype Leaf uty -> derive gamma Node uty
| derive_app: forall gamma M N ty u, derive gamma M (Funty u ty) -> derive gamma N u -> derive gamma (M@N) ty
.

## Task

Show that a one-step reduct of a tree-calculus program has the same type under the same context.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `reduction_preserves_typing`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: none beyond the Rocq standard library.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.

- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->

| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->

| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    This is used everywhere: it lets us replace a type by a supertype. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd.
  induction Hd as [gamma x uty ty0 Hget Hsub
                 | gamma uty Hsub
                 | gamma M N ty0 u0 HM HN IHm IHn];
    intros Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty. exact Hget.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + apply IHm.
      (* Funty u0 ty0 <= Funty u0 ty  needs contravariance on u0 (sub_zero) *)
      eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hsub2 | ].
      (* Goal: subtype (Funty u0 ty0) (Funty u0 ty) -- wait orientation *)
Abort.

(* Let me check the orientation of sub_funty carefully. *)
Check sub_funty.
(* sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2,
     subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
     subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2) *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd.
  induction Hd as [gamma x uty ty0 Hget Hsub
                 | gamma uty Hsub
                 | gamma M N ty0 u0 HM HN IHm IHn];
    intros Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact Hget | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u0).
    + apply IHm.
      (* need: subtype (Funty u0 ty0) (Funty u0 ty) *)
      eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hsub2 | ].
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + exact HN.
Qed.

(* Sanity check of the elimination direction. *)
Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare (S k) (1 + n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      * f_equal. lia.
      * lia.
      * lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      * lia.
      * lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof.
  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
  (* subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 ; apply the general lemma with k = 0 *)
  change (subst_rec (lift_rec a (S 0) 1) u (S 0) = a).
  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_gen.
Qed.

(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof.
  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0.
Qed.

(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
Qed.

| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S T H. induction H; intros a r ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_mono; [ exact H | apply IHH2; reflexivity ].
  - (* sub_stem *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_quant_inst; eauto.
  - (* sub_lift *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst.
    apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst.
    apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) inversion ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S T H. induction H; intros a r ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_mono; [ exact H | apply IHH2; reflexivity ].
  - (* sub_stem *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_quant_inst; eauto.
  - (* sub_lift *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst.
    apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst.
    apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) inversion ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) inversion ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Fixpoint PL (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  | Asf X => PL X
  | Quant X => PL X
  | Stem X => False
  | Fork X Y => False
  | Var i => False

Lemma PL_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> PL T -> PL U.

  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHH2. apply IHH1. assumption.
  - (* sub_stem *) simpl in *. contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork *) simpl in *. contradiction.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.

  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)); HF : derive ((Node@w)@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HJ : Node : Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HK : w : u4 ; HI : x : u5 *)
  inversion HB as [| gamma7 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HS2? naming; HS3 : Leaf <= u (third Node type) *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HB : derive (Node @ z) u ; invert it *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| gamma8 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HI : x : u5 ; HM : z : u3 *)
  destruct (inv_stem u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3 HS1 HS3) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HB : derive (Node @ z1 @ z2) u *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  inversion HN as [| gamma9 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HO : z1 : u6 ; HM : z2 : u7 *)
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->

    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->

    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->

Fixpoint PL (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  | Asf X => PL X
  | Quant X => PL X
  | Stem X => False
  | Fork X Y => False
  | Var i => False

Lemma PL_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> PL T -> PL U.
Proof.
  intros T U H. induction H; intros HP.
  - (* sub_zero *) assumption.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHH2. apply IHH1. assumption.
  - (* sub_stem *) simpl in *. contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork *) simpl in *. contradiction.
  - (* sub_asf *) simpl in *. apply IHsubtype. assumption.
  - (* sub_funty *) simpl in *. unfold PL in *. simpl in *.
    eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_stem; eassumption | ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ eassumption | assumption ].
  - (* sub_quant *) simpl in *. apply IHsubtype. assumption.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) simpl in *. contradiction.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) simpl in *. contradiction.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) simpl in *. assumption.
  - (* sub_dist *) simpl in *. destruct uty; simpl in *; try contradiction; try assumption.

    revert HP. generalize dependent u. induction ty; simpl in *; intros.

(* 5. Target-only predicate architecture (coordinator's plan).        *)

(* P_leaf is defined by structural recursion on the TARGET type:      *)

Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False

Proof.

Proof.

(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_var : forall i, subtype Leaf (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros i H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.
  unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
From Triage Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* Scratch exploration: App strong soundness for a Leaf-reachable source,
   assuming the L1 inversion and the corresponding quant/dist target fact. *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  induction HA in T, a, r, Hleaf |- *.
  - (* app_leaf *)
    assumption.
  - (* app_stem *)
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf.
      * exact H0.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *)
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_fork_stem *)
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *)
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *)
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *)
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_quant_inst *)
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *)
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_recursion *)
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_tree *)
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_asf_fun *)

    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf.
    + apply sub_from_asf.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
From Triage Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* Scratch exploration: App strong soundness for a Leaf-reachable source,
   assuming the L1 inversion and the corresponding quant/dist target fact. *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a r Hsub Hleaf. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X a r Hsub Hleaf.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X Y a r H1 H2 Hleaf.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X a r Hsub Hleaf.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u v w a r H1 H2 Hleaf.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u v w a r H1 H2 Hleaf.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u v1 v2 w a r H1 H2 Hleaf.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u v w1 w2 w3 a r H1 H2 Hleaf.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty u a r H Hleaf.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X Y Hleaf.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k u v Hleaf.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty uty Hcov Hleaf.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X Y Hleaf.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S T a r Hsub HA IH Hleaf.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf | exact Hsub ].
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB Scratch9.
Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Fixpoint PL (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => PL T'
  | Quant T' => PL T'
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  end.

Section Stability.
Variable subst_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (u : dtype) (k : nat),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k).
Variable lift_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (j : nat),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (lift_rec x j 1)) (lift_rec y j 1).

Lemma PL_subst_rec : forall T u k, PL T -> PL (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply subst_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma PL_lift_rec : forall T j, PL T -> PL (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros j HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply lift_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma PL_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> PL T -> PL U.

  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.

Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ---------- relocate helpers ---------- *)

Lemma relocate_ge : forall i k n, k <= i -> relocate i k n = n + i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; auto. lia.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lt : forall i k n, k > i -> relocate i k n = i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; auto. lia.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift : forall i p k n,
  p <= i ->
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n Hp.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt]. (* p <= i, since not -> i < p *)
  - rewrite relocate_ge by lia.
    rewrite relocate_ge by lia.
    rewrite relocate_ge by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_same : forall i p k,
  p <= i -> relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) 0 = relocate i p k.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite relocate_lift_lift by lia. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k n HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := n). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := n). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := n). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists ty u, covariant ty = true /\ covariant (subst ty u) = false.
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split; reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :

Lemma insert_Var_lt : forall N i k, i < k -> insert_Var N i k = Var i.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB Scratch9.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Fixpoint PL (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => PL T'
  | Quant T' => PL T'
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  end.

Section Stability.
Variable subst_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (u : dtype) (k : nat),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k).
Variable lift_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (j : nat),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (lift_rec x j 1)) (lift_rec y j 1).

Lemma PL_subst_rec : forall T u k, PL T -> PL (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply subst_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma PL_lift_rec : forall T j, PL T -> PL (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros j HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply lift_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma PL_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> PL T -> PL U.
Proof.
  intros T U H. induction H; intros HP; simpl in *.
  - assumption.
  - apply IHsubtype2. apply IHsubtype1. assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - apply IHsubtype. assumption.
  - eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_stem; eassumption | ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ eassumption | assumption ].
  - apply IHsubtype. assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - assumption.
  - (* dist *) apply eq_quant. assumption.
  - (* inst *) apply PL_subst_rec. assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply PL_lift_rec. assumption.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H. apply (PL_mono Leaf (Funty a r) H Logic.I).
Qed.

End Stability.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ---------- relocate helpers ---------- *)

Lemma relocate_ge : forall i k n, k <= i -> relocate i k n = n + i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; [reflexivity | exfalso; lia].
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lt : forall i k n, k > i -> relocate i k n = i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; [exfalso; lia | reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift : forall i p k n,
  p <= i ->
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n Hp.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt]. (* p <= i, since not -> i < p *)
  - rewrite (relocate_ge i p k Hle); try reflexivity.
    rewrite (relocate_ge (k+i) (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_ge i p (k+n)) by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_same : forall i p k,
  p <= i -> relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) 0 = relocate i p k.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite relocate_lift_lift by lia. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift2 : forall i p k n,
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt].
  - rewrite (relocate_ge i p k Hle).
    rewrite (relocate_ge (k+i) (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_ge i p (k+n)) by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i p k Hi).
    rewrite (relocate_lt i (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i p (k+n)) by lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_gen : forall a p k n,
  lift_rec (lift_rec a p k) (p + k) n = lift_rec a p (k + n).
Proof.
  induction a; intros; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_lift2.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_le_gen : forall a p K q d,
  p <= q -> q <= p + K ->

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule. *)
Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma9 uty9 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)); HF : derive (Node@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| gamma4 uty HS | ]; subst.
  (* HS : Leaf <= Funty u3 u2 ; HI : derive x u3 ;
     HD : y : u1 ; HB : z : u *)
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ; HF : derive ((Node@w)@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HJ : Node : Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HK : w : u4 ; HI : x : u5 *)
  inversion HB as [| gamma7 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HS2? naming; HS3 : Leaf <= u (third Node type) *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z) u ; invert it *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| gamma8 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HI : x : u5 ; HM : z : u3 *)
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z1 @ z2) u *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  inversion HN as [| gamma9 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HO : z1 : u6 ; HM : z2 : u7 *)
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.

Require Import Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes String.

Open Scope string_scope.

Declare Scope tree_scope.
Global Open Scope tree_scope.

Inductive Tree:  Set :=
  | Ref : string -> Tree
  | Node : Tree
  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)
                 then S1 (star x M1) @ (star x M2)
                 else K@ (M1 @ M2)
  end.

Notation "\" := star : tree_scope.

Definition wait2 M N x :=  S1 (S1 (S1 (K @ M) @ (K @ N)) @ (K @ x)) @ I.

Definition omega21 := K @ (△ @ (△ @ I)).

Definition omega22 :=  \ "w" (\ "f" (wait2 (Ref "w") (Ref "w") (Ref "f"))).

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Inductive derive: list (string * dtype) -> Tree -> dtype -> Prop :=
| derive_ref : forall gamma x uty ty, get x gamma = Some uty -> subtype uty ty -> derive gamma (Ref x) ty
| derive_node : forall gamma uty, subtype Leaf uty -> derive gamma Node uty
| derive_app: forall gamma M N ty u, derive gamma M (Funty u ty) -> derive gamma N u -> derive gamma (M@N) ty
.

  lift_rec (lift_rec ty 1 1) (S (S j)) 1 = lift_rec (lift_rec ty (S j) 1) 1 1.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* substitution / lift commutation                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma relocate_eqb : forall n k j, k < j -> (k =? relocate n j 1) = (k =? n).
Proof.
  intros. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test j n) as [Hjn|Hjn].
  - destruct (k =? n) eqn:E1; destruct (k =? (1 + n)) eqn:E2.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply Nat.eqb_eq in E1. apply Nat.eqb_neq in E2. lia.
    + exfalso. apply Nat.eqb_eq in E2. lia.
    + reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma insert_lift_comm : forall u i k j,
  insert_Var (lift_rec u j 1) (relocate i (k + S j) 1) k
  = lift_rec (insert_Var u i k) (k + j) 1.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, relocate, lift.
  destruct (compare k i) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt].
  - destruct (test (k + S j) i) as [H1|H1].
    + destruct (compare k (1 + i)) as [[Hc1|Hc2]|Hc3].
      * cbn [lift_rec]. unfold relocate.

        -- exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + destruct (compare k i) as [[Hc1|Hc2]|Hc3].
      * cbn [lift_rec]. unfold relocate.
        destruct (test (k + j) (Nat.pred i)) as [H2|H2].
        -- exfalso; lia.
        -- reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.

    + destruct (compare k i) as [[Hc1|Hc2]|Hc3].

      * rewrite (lift_lift_rec_zero u k j). reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
  - destruct (test (k + S j) i) as [H1|H1].

    + cbn [lift_rec]. unfold relocate.

      * destruct (compare k i) as [[Hc1|Hc2]|Hc3].

Lemma lift_subst_rec_gen : forall t u k j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec t (k + S j) 1) (lift_rec u j 1) k
  = lift_rec (subst_rec t u k) (k + j) 1.
Proof.
  induction t; intros u k j; simpl.
  - apply insert_lift_comm.
  - f_equal. apply (IHt u (S k) j).
  - f_equal.
    + apply (IHt1 u k j).
    + apply (IHt2 u k j).
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHt u k j).
  - f_equal.
    + apply (IHt1 u k j).
    + apply (IHt2 u k j).
  - f_equal. apply (IHt u k j).
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_comm : forall t u j,
  lift_rec (subst_rec t u 0) j 1
  = subst_rec (lift_rec t (S j) 1) (lift_rec u j 1) 0.
Proof.
  intros. symmetry. exact (lift_subst_rec_gen t u 0 j).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* covariance under lifting                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma variant_lift : forall ty pos k j, k < j ->
  variant pos k (lift_rec ty j 1) = variant pos k ty.
Proof.
  induction ty; intros pos k j Hlt; simpl.
  - rewrite relocate_eqb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply (IHty pos (S k) (S j)). lia.
  - rewrite (IHty1 (negb pos) k j Hlt), (IHty2 pos k j Hlt). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHty pos k j Hlt). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHty1 pos k j Hlt), (IHty2 pos k j Hlt). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHty pos k j Hlt). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma covariant_lift : forall ty j, covariant ty -> covariant (lift_rec ty (S j) 1).
Proof.
  intros. unfold covariant in *.
  rewrite (variant_lift ty true 0 (S j)) by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* ground types and omega2_ty                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint ground (ty : dtype) : Prop :=
  match ty with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem t => ground t
  | Fork t1 t2 => ground t1 /\ ground t2
  | Funty t1 t2 => ground t1 /\ ground t2
  | Quant t => ground t
  | Asf t => ground t
  end.

Lemma ground_lift : forall ty j, ground ty -> lift_rec ty j 1 = ty.
Proof.
  induction ty; intros j Hg; simpl in *; try reflexivity.
  - destruct Hg.
  - f_equal. apply (IHty (S j) Hg).
  - destruct Hg as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHty1 j H1), (IHty2 j H2). reflexivity.
  - apply (IHty j Hg).
  - destruct Hg as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHty1 j H1), (IHty2 j H2). reflexivity.
  - apply (IHty j Hg).
Qed.

Lemma program_type_ground : forall p, ground (program_type p).
Proof.
  induction p; simpl.
  - split; exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (program_type p1) eqn:E.
    + split; exact I.
    + split; exact I.
    + split; exact I.
    + simpl in *. split. exact I. apply IHp2.
    + simpl in *. split. exact IHp1. apply IHp2.
    + simpl in *. destruct IHp1 as [G1 G2]. split. exact G1. apply IHp2.
    + split; exact I.
Qed.

Lemma lift_omega21_ty : forall j, lift_rec omega21_ty j 1 = omega21_ty.
Proof. intros. apply ground_lift. apply program_type_ground. Qed.

Lemma lift_omega22_ty : forall j, lift_rec omega22_ty j 1 = omega22_ty.
Proof. intros. apply ground_lift. apply program_type_ground. Qed.

Lemma lift_omega2_ty : forall j, lift_rec omega2_ty j 1 = omega2_ty.
Proof.
  intros. unfold omega2_ty. simpl.
  rewrite lift_omega21_ty, lift_omega22_ty. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* closed types used by the bffs/bfff rules                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma lift_eval_ty : forall j, lift_rec eval_ty j 1 = eval_ty.
Proof. intros. unfold eval_ty. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_eager_ty : forall j, lift_rec eager_ty j 1 = eager_ty.
Proof. intros. unfold eager_ty. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_bfff_aug : forall uty j,
  lift_rec (bfff_aug uty) j 1 = bfff_aug (lift_rec uty j 1).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bfff_aug. simpl. rewrite lift_eval_ty. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_bffs_aug : forall uty j,
  lift_rec (bffs_aug uty) j 1 = bffs_aug (lift_rec uty j 1).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bffs_aug. simpl.
  rewrite lift_eager_ty, lift_bfff_aug. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* the source shape of sub_tree                                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition tree_ty (ty : dtype) : dtype :=
  Fork
    (Fork
       (subst ty Leaf)
       (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
    (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
       (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))).

Lemma tree_ty_lift : forall ty j,
  lift_rec (tree_ty ty) j 1 = tree_ty (lift_rec ty (S j) 1).
Proof.
  intros. unfold tree_ty. simpl.
  rewrite (lift_subst_comm ty Leaf j).
  rewrite (lift_subst_comm (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0)) (S j)).
  rewrite (lift_subst_comm (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)) (S (S j))).
  rewrite lift_lift_one1, lift_lift_one2.
  reflexivity.
Qed.
