Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A concrete counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.
   The term is the k-redex (((Node @ Node) @ Node) @ Node); it has type
   Fork Leaf Leaf, but its one-step reduct Node has no such type. *)

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ △.

Definition T0 : dtype := Fork Leaf Leaf.

Lemma d00 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Funty Leaf T0).
Proof.
  unfold T0.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact d00.
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dK1 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) T0.
Proof.
  unfold T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK1.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_fork : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_fork]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

Lemma lift_var : forall i j d, lift_rec (Var i) j d = Var (relocate i j d).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ---------- commuting lift and substitution ---------- *)

Lemma lift_subst_comm_gen : forall a N K d j,
  j <= K ->
  subst_rec (lift_rec a j d) N (K + d) = lift_rec (subst_rec a N K) j d.
Proof.
  induction a; intros N K d j Hj; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n j) as [[Hnj | Hnj] | Hnj].
    + assert (HnK : n < K) by lia.
      rewrite (relocate_lt n j d) by lia.
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n (K + d)) by lia.
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n K) by lia.
      rewrite lift_var.
      rewrite (relocate_lt n j d) by lia.
      reflexivity.
    + subst n.
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec j K) as [[HjK | HjK] | HjK].
      * rewrite (relocate_ge j j d) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N (d + j) (K + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N j K) by lia.
        rewrite lift_var.
        rewrite (relocate_ge j j d) by lia.
        reflexivity.
      * subst K.
        rewrite (relocate_ge j j d) by lia.
        replace (j + d) with (d + j) by lia.
        rewrite insert_Var_eq by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_eq N j j) by lia.
        unfold lift.
        assert (Hll : lift_rec (lift_rec N 0 j) (0 + j) d = lift_rec N 0 (j + d))
          by apply lift_lift_gen.
        simpl in Hll. rewrite Hll.
        f_equal. lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + assert (HnKj : j < n) by lia.
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n K) as [[HnK | HnK] | HnK].
      * rewrite (relocate_ge n j d) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N (d + n) (K + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n K) by lia.
        rewrite lift_var.
        rewrite (relocate_ge n j d) by lia.
        reflexivity.
      * subst K.
        rewrite (relocate_ge n j d) by lia.
        replace (n + d) with (d + n) by lia.
        rewrite insert_Var_eq by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_eq N n n) by lia.
        unfold lift.
        assert (Hll : lift_rec (lift_rec N 0 n) (0 + j) d = lift_rec N 0 (n + d))
          by (apply lift_lift_le_gen; lia).
        simpl in Hll. rewrite Hll.
        f_equal. lia.
      * rewrite (relocate_ge n j d) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_gt N (d + n) (K + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_gt N n K) by lia.
        rewrite lift_var.
        rewrite (relocate_ge (pred n) j d) by lia.
        replace (pred (d + n)) with (d + pred n) by lia.
        reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *)
    change (Quant (subst_rec (lift_rec a (S j) d) N (S K + d)) =
            Quant (lift_rec (subst_rec a N (S K)) (S j) d)).
    rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
  - (* Funty *)
    rewrite IHa1 by lia. rewrite IHa2 by lia. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHa1 by lia. rewrite IHa2 by lia. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- substituting inside a lifted term ---------- *)

Lemma subst_lift_succ_gen : forall a N d m j,
  d < m ->
  subst_rec (lift_rec a j m) N (d + j) = lift_rec a j (m - 1).
Proof.
  induction a; intros N d m j Hdm; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    destruct (le_lt_dec j n) as [Hjn | Hnj].
    + rewrite (relocate_ge n j m Hjn).
      rewrite (insert_Var_gt N (m + n) (d + j)) by lia.
      rewrite (relocate_ge n j (m - 1)) by lia.
      replace (pred (m + n)) with (m - 1 + n) by lia.
      reflexivity.
    + assert (Hnj' : n < j) by lia.
      rewrite (relocate_lt n j m Hnj').
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n (d + j)) by lia.
      rewrite (relocate_lt n j (m - 1)) by lia.
      reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *)
    replace (S (d + j)) with (d + S j) by lia.
    rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1 by lia. rewrite IHa2 by lia. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1 by lia. rewrite IHa2 by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- substitution composition (generalized) ---------- *)

Lemma subst_subst_gen : forall a u N k d,
  subst_rec (subst_rec a u d) N (k + d) =
  subst_rec (subst_rec a N (k + d + 1)) (subst_rec u N k) d.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u N k d; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n d) as [[Hnd | Hnd] | Hnd].
    + (* n < d *)
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt u n d) by lia.
      cbn [subst_rec].
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n (k + d)) by lia.
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n (k + d + 1)) by lia.
      cbn [subst_rec].
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt (subst_rec u N k) n d) by lia.
      reflexivity.
    + (* n = d *)
      subst n.
      rewrite (insert_Var_eq u d d) by lia.
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt N d (k + d + 1)) by lia.
      cbn [subst_rec].
      rewrite (insert_Var_eq (subst_rec u N k) d d) by lia.
      unfold lift.
      rewrite (lift_subst_comm_gen u N k d 0) by lia.
      reflexivity.
    + (* n > d *)
      assert (Hnd' : d < n) by lia.
      destruct n as [| n']; [exfalso; lia |].
      rewrite (insert_Var_gt u (S n') d) by lia.
      change (insert_Var N n' (k + d) =
              subst_rec (insert_Var N (S n') (k + d + 1)) (subst_rec u N k) d).
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n' (k + d)) as [[Hnk | Hnk] | Hnk].
      * rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n' (k + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N (S n') (k + d + 1)) by lia.
        cbn [subst_rec].
        rewrite (insert_Var_gt (subst_rec u N k) (S n') d) by lia.
        reflexivity.
      * subst n'.
        rewrite (insert_Var_eq N (k + d) (k + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_eq N (S (k + d)) (k + d + 1)) by lia.
        unfold lift.
        assert (Hsl : subst_rec (lift_rec N 0 (k + d + 1)) (subst_rec u N k) (d + 0)
                      = lift_rec N 0 (k + d + 1 - 1))
          by (apply (subst_lift_succ_gen N (subst_rec u N k) d (k + d + 1) 0); lia).
        rewrite Nat.add_0_r in Hsl.
        replace (k + d + 1 - 1) with (k + d) in Hsl by lia.
        rewrite Hsl.
        reflexivity.
      * rewrite (insert_Var_gt N n' (k + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_gt N (S n') (k + d + 1)) by lia.
        change (Var (pred n') = insert_Var (subst_rec u N k) n' d).
        rewrite (insert_Var_gt (subst_rec u N k) n' d) by lia.
        reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *)
    replace (S (k + d)) with (k + S d) by lia.
    replace (S (k + d + 1)) with (k + S d + 1) by lia.
    rewrite (IHa u N k (S d)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1. rewrite IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1. rewrite IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- variance is preserved by substitution at level >= 1 ---------- *)

Lemma variant_lift_gen : forall M pos k j L,
  (j = 0 \/ k >= j) -> k < j + L ->
  variant pos k (lift_rec M j L) = true.
Proof.
  induction M; intros pos k j L Hcond Hlt; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    destruct (le_lt_dec j n) as [Hjn | Hnj].
    + rewrite (relocate_ge n j L Hjn).
      unfold variant.
      destruct (k =? (L + n)) eqn:E; [exfalso | reflexivity].
  subst_rec (bffs_aug uty) N k = bffs_aug (subst_rec uty N k).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bffs_aug. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* The composition identity in the form suggested for sub_inst. *)
Lemma subst_subst : forall a u N k,
  subst_rec (subst_rec a u 0) N k =
  subst_rec (subst_rec a N (S k)) (subst_rec u N k) 0.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (H := subst_subst_gen a u N k 0).
  rewrite Nat.add_0_r in H.
  replace (k + 1) with (S k) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* Lift/substitution commutation specializations used by sub_lift and sub_tree. *)
Lemma lift_subst_comm_01 : forall a N k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) N (S k) = lift_rec (subst_rec a N k) 0 1.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (H := lift_subst_comm_gen a N k 1 0 (le_0_n k)).
  replace (k + 1) with (S k) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_comm_11 : forall a N k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 1 1) N (S (S k)) =
  lift_rec (subst_rec a N (S k)) 1 1.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (H := lift_subst_comm_gen a N (S k) 1 1 (le_n_S 0 k (le_0_n k))).
  replace (S k + 1) with (S (S k)) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_comm_12 : forall a N k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 1 2) N (S (S (S k))) =
  lift_rec (subst_rec a N (S k)) 1 2.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (H := lift_subst_comm_gen a N (S k) 2 1 (le_n_S 0 k (le_0_n k))).
  replace (S k + 2) with (S (S (S k))) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* Covariance is preserved when the substitution level is positive. *)
Lemma covariant_subst : forall ty N k,
  covariant ty -> covariant (subst_rec ty N (S k)).
Proof.
  intros ty N k Hcov. unfold covariant in *.
  assert (H := variant_subst_pos ty true 0 N (S k) (le_n_S 0 k (le_0_n k))).
  replace (S k + 0) with (S k) in H by lia.
  rewrite H. exact Hcov.
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_subtype : forall A B, subtype A B ->
  forall N k, subtype (subst_rec A N k) (subst_rec B N k).
Proof.
  intros A B H. induction H; intros N kk; simpl.
  - (* sub_zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply sub_trans; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_stem *) apply sub_stem; apply IHsubtype.
  - (* sub_fork *) eapply sub_fork; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_asf *) apply sub_asf; apply IHsubtype.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_funty; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply sub_quant; apply (IHsubtype N (S kk)).
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) apply sub_quant_stem.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) apply sub_quant_fork.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) apply sub_quant_asf.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    unfold subst.
    rewrite subst_subst.
    apply sub_inst.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    unfold lift.
    rewrite lift_subst_comm_01.
    apply sub_lift.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + cbn [lift_rec]. unfold relocate.
      destruct (test (k + j) i) as [H2|H2].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * destruct (compare k i) as [[Hc1|Hc2]|Hc3].
        -- exfalso; lia.
        -- exfalso; lia.
        -- reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_rec_gen : forall t u k j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec t (k + S j) 1) (lift_rec u j 1) k
  = lift_rec (subst_rec t u k) (k + j) 1.
Proof.
  induction t; intros u k j; simpl.
  - apply insert_lift_comm.
  - f_equal. apply (IHt u (S k) j).
  - f_equal.
    + apply (IHt1 u k j).
    + apply (IHt2 u k j).
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHt u k j).
  - f_equal.
    + apply (IHt1 u k j).
    + apply (IHt2 u k j).
  - f_equal. apply (IHt u k j).
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_comm : forall t u j,
  lift_rec (subst_rec t u 0) j 1
  = subst_rec (lift_rec t (S j) 1) (lift_rec u j 1) 0.
Proof.
  intros. symmetry. exact (lift_subst_rec_gen t u 0 j).
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst : forall t u j,
  lift_rec (subst t u) j 1 = subst (lift_rec t (S j) 1) (lift_rec u j 1).
Proof. intros. unfold subst. apply lift_subst_comm. Qed.

Lemma lift_fork_vars : forall j,
  lift_rec (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)) (S (S j)) 1 = Fork (Var 1) (Var 0).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* covariance under lifting                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma variant_lift : forall ty pos k j, k < j ->
  variant pos k (lift_rec ty j 1) = variant pos k ty.
Proof.
  induction ty; intros pos k j Hlt; simpl.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A concrete counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.
   The term is the k-redex (((Node @ Node) @ Node) @ Node); it has type
   Fork Leaf Leaf, but its one-step reduct Node has no such type. *)

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ △.

Definition T0 : dtype := Fork Leaf Leaf.

Lemma hsub0 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf T0)).
Proof.
  unfold T0.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf T0)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. exact hsub0.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK1 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) (Funty Leaf T0).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK1.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_fork : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_fork]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A concrete counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.
   The term is the k-redex (((Node @ Node) @ Node) @ Node); it has type
   Fork Leaf Leaf, but its one-step reduct Node has no such type. *)

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ △.

Definition T0 : dtype := Fork Leaf Leaf.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK1 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_sub.
    + exact dK1.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_fork : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_fork]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A concrete counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.
   The term (((Node @ Node) @ Node) @ (Node @ Node)) is a k-redex.
   It has type Stem Leaf, but its reduct Node has no such type. *)

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △).

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dK.
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dKy :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dKy_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dKy.
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dKy_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Fixpoint PL (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  | Asf X => PL X
  | Quant X => PL X
  | Stem X => False
  | Fork X Y => False
  | Var i => False
  end.

Section Stability.
Variable subst_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (u : dtype) (k : nat),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k).
Variable lift_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (j : nat),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (lift_rec x j 1)) (lift_rec y j 1).
Variable eq_quant : forall (x y : dtype),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).

Lemma PL_subst_rec : forall T u k, PL T -> PL (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply subst_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma PL_lift_rec : forall T j, PL T -> PL (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros j HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply lift_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma PL_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> PL T -> PL U.
Proof.
  intros T U H. induction H; intros HP; simpl in *.
  - assumption.
  - apply IHsubtype2. apply IHsubtype1. assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - apply IHsubtype. assumption.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_stem; eassumption | ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ eassumption | assumption ].
  - apply IHsubtype. assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - (* quant_asf: PL (Quant (Asf uty)) -> PL (Asf (Quant uty)) *) assumption.
  - (* dist: PL (Quant (Funty uty vty)) -> PL (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty)) *)
    apply eq_quant. assumption.
  - (* inst *) apply PL_subst_rec. assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply PL_lift_rec. assumption.
  - (* leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - (* to_asf *) assumption.
  - (* from_asf *) assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
Qed.


Lemma L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H. apply (PL_mono Leaf (Funty a r) H Logic.I).
Qed.

End Stability.

(* 6. A structural "head/safety" invariant Q that is unconditionally   *)
(*    monotone along subtype and stable under substitution and lift.   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Q forbids Fork at the head and recursively under Quant, and forbids *)
(* Var.  This is exactly the guard needed for the substitution lemma:  *)
(* the rules with Fork sources (sub_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,        *)
(* sub_bfff) and sub_recursion become vacuous, while all other rules   *)
(* preserve Q.                                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint Q (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => True
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => Q T'
  end.

Proof.

  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.

  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.

(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty

    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov

    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];

  - (* zero *) exact HR.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 8. Strong soundness of App for a Leaf-reachable source.             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* All Stem/Fork/recursion/tree source cases are eliminated by the      *)
(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :
  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_funty_fork :
  forall a b Y Z, subtype (Funty a b) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a b Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Funty a b) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma9 uty9 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| gamma4 uty HS | ]; subst.
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  inversion HB as [| gamma7 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| gamma8 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.

  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.

  inversion HN as [| gamma9 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_conditional :
  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->

  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros IK IS IL IST IF gamma M ty D.
  induction D; intros N HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR as [M' HR1 | M' N' HR2 | y z | x y z | w x y | w x y z | w x y z1 z2]; subst.
    + eapply derive_app; [ apply IHD1; exact HR1 | exact D2 ].
    + eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | apply IHD2; exact HR2 ].

    + (* leaf_red *) eapply red_leaf. eapply derive_app; eauto.
    + (* stem_red *) eapply red_stem. eapply derive_app; eauto.
    + (* fork_red *) eapply red_fork. eapply derive_app; eauto.

(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).
Proof.
  intros x y H.
  assert (HQ : subtype (Quant (lift_rec x 1 1)) x).
  { eapply sub_trans.
    - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
    - unfold subst. rewrite subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero. }
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem (Quant x)).
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_quant. eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_stem. exact HQ.
      * exact H.
    + apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* 10. Discharging the dist obligation of P_leaf unconditionally.      *)

(* P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) is definitionally subtype (Stem u) v;   *)

(* following closed lemma supplies exactly that, so the Hdist         *)
(* hypothesis of P_leaf_mono is no longer needed.                     *)

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_quant_dist : forall x y,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).
Proof.
  intros x y H.
  assert (HQ : subtype (Quant (lift_rec x 1 1)) x).

    - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
    - unfold subst. rewrite subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero. }
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem (Quant x)).
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_quant. eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_stem. exact HQ.
      * exact H.
    + apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma P_leaf_mono_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule. *)
Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma9 uty9 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)); HF : derive (Node@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| gamma4 uty HS | ]; subst.
  (* HS : Leaf <= Funty u3 u2 ; HI : derive x u3 ;
     HD : y : u1 ; HB : z : u *)
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ; HF : derive ((Node@w)@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HJ : Node : Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HK : w : u4 ; HI : x : u5 *)
  inversion HB as [| gamma7 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HS2? naming; HS3 : Leaf <= u (third Node type) *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z) u ; invert it *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| gamma8 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HI : x : u5 ; HM : z : u3 *)
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z1 @ z2) u *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  inversion HN as [| gamma9 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HO : z1 : u6 ; HM : z2 : u7 *)
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_skeleton :
  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros IK IS IL IST IF gamma M ty D.
  induction D; intros N HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR as [M' HR1 | M' N' HR2 | y z | x y z | w x y | w x y z | w x y z1 z2]; subst.
    + eapply derive_app. apply IHD1; eauto. exact D2.
    + eapply derive_app. exact D1. apply IHD2; eauto.
    + (* k *) eapply red_k; eauto. eapply derive_app; eauto. 
      (* Actually M = (M1@M2)@N; k pattern requires M1=Node@Node etc. inversion already gave M'? *)
      admit.
    + admit. + admit. + admit. + admit.
Admitted.

(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.

  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.

  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.

(* 5. Target-only predicate architecture (coordinator's plan).        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf is defined by structural recursion on the TARGET type:      *)
(*   Funty a r  |-> subtype (Stem a) r                               *)
(*   Leaf       |-> True                                              *)
(*   Asf T      |-> P_leaf T                                          *)

(*                                                                    *)

(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => P_leaf T'
  | Quant T' => P_leaf T'
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  end.

Lemma P_leaf_mono
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_trans; [ apply sub_stem; exact Hs1 | exact HP ] | exact H ].
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) apply Hdist. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst. exact HP.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift. exact HP.
  - (* leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

(* L1: from a subtype Leaf (Funty a r) obtain subtype (Stem a) r.      *)
(* This is the target inversion used by k_head_case.                  *)

Lemma P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> P_leaf T.
Proof.
  intros T H.
  remember Leaf as S eqn:ES.
  revert ES.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros ES.
  - (* zero *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* trans *) subst. eapply P_leaf_mono; eauto.
  - (* stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* funty *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* dist *) discriminate ES.
  - (* inst *) discriminate ES.
  - (* lift *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* leaf_fun *) simpl. apply sub_zero.
  - (* stem_fun *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_leaf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in ES. discriminate ES.
  - (* tree *) discriminate ES.
  - (* to_asf *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* from_asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* bffs *) discriminate ES.
  - (* bfff *) discriminate ES.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H.
  exact (P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype Hdist Hlift Hinst (Funty a r) H).
Qed.

(* sub_bfff) and sub_recursion become vacuous, while all other rules   *)
(* preserve Q.                                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint Q (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => True
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => Q T'
  end.

Lemma Q_subst_rec : forall T u k, Q T -> Q (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_lift_rec : forall T k n, Q T -> Q (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> Q T -> Q U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HQ.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply Q_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HQ.
  - (* lift *) apply Q_lift_rec with (k := 0) (n := 1). exact HQ.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HQ. cbn in HQ. destruct HQ.
  - (* tree *) destruct HQ.
  - (* to_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HQ.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HQ.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_var : forall i, subtype Leaf (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros i H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.
  unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 8. Strong soundness of App for a Leaf-reachable source.             *)
(*                                                                    *)
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_quant_dist : forall x y,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).
Proof.
  intros x y H.
  assert (HQ : subtype (Quant (lift_rec x 1 1)) x).
  { eapply sub_trans.
    - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
    - unfold subst. rewrite subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero. }
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem (Quant x)).
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_quant. eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_stem. exact HQ.
      * exact H.
    + apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* P_leaf_mono with the dist case supplied by the closed lemma above. *)
Lemma P_leaf_mono_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  apply P_leaf_mono.
  - intros u v HP. simpl in HP. simpl.
    apply subtype_stem_quant_dist. exact HP.
  - exact Hlift.
  - exact Hinst.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H.
  exact (P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype
           (fun u v HP => subtype_stem_quant_dist u v HP)
           Hlift Hinst (Funty a r) H).
Qed.

(* Lift obligation of P_leaf, specialized to lifting by exactly one.     *)
(* The hypothesis is exactly the n = 1 instance of the specialized lift *)
(* fact for Stem sources.                                              *)
Lemma P_leaf_lift_one
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall T k, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift1. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

(* Assembly of L1 from the two remaining specialized facts only.       *)
(* Hsub must be the generalized statement at EVERY substitution level k, *)
(* because P_leaf recurses through Quant and substitution under a       *)
(* Quant increments the level.  Hlift only needs its k-parametric,      *)
(* n = 1 instance.                                                     *)
Lemma L1_of_specialized_stem_facts
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  apply L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst.
  - intros T HP. exact (P_leaf_lift_one Hlift1 T 0 HP).
  - intros T u HP.
    exact (specialized_subst_implies_P_inst Hsub T u 0 HP).
Qed.
