(*                                                                    *)
(* All Stem/Fork/recursion/tree source cases are eliminated by the      *)
(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :
  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_funty_fork :
  forall a b Y Z, subtype (Funty a b) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a b Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Funty a b) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 10. Discharging the dist obligation of P_leaf unconditionally.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) is definitionally subtype (Stem u) v;   *)
(* the dist target is subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant v).  The        *)
(* following closed lemma supplies exactly that, so the Hdist         *)
(* hypothesis of P_leaf_mono is no longer needed.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_quant_dist : forall x y,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).

(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 10. Discharging the dist obligation of P_leaf unconditionally.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) is definitionally subtype (Stem u) v;   *)
(* the dist target is subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant v).  The        *)
(* following closed lemma supplies exactly that, so the Hdist         *)
(* hypothesis of P_leaf_mono is no longer needed.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_quant_dist : forall x y,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).
Proof.
  intros x y H.
  assert (HQ : subtype (Quant (lift_rec x 1 1)) x).
  { eapply sub_trans.
    - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
    - unfold subst. rewrite subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero. }
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem (Quant x)).
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_quant. eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_stem. exact HQ.
      * exact H.
    + apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* P_leaf_mono with the dist case supplied by the closed lemma above. *)
Lemma P_leaf_mono_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  apply P_leaf_mono.
  - intros u v HP. simpl in HP. simpl.
    apply subtype_stem_quant_dist. exact HP.
  - exact Hlift.
  - exact Hinst.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H.
  exact (P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype
           (fun u v HP => subtype_stem_quant_dist u v HP)
           Hlift Hinst (Funty a r) H).
Qed.

(* Lift obligation of P_leaf, specialized to lifting by exactly one.     *)
(* The hypothesis is exactly the n = 1 instance of the specialized lift *)
(* fact for Stem sources.                                              *)
Lemma P_leaf_lift_one
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall T k, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift1. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

(* Assembly of L1 from the two remaining specialized facts only.       *)
(* Hsub must be the generalized statement at EVERY substitution level k, *)
(* because P_leaf recurses through Quant and substitution under a       *)
(* Quant increments the level.  Hlift only needs its k-parametric,      *)
(* n = 1 instance.                                                     *)
Lemma L1_of_specialized_stem_facts
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  apply L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst.
  - intros T HP. exact (P_leaf_lift_one Hlift1 T 0 HP).
  - intros T u HP.
    exact (specialized_subst_implies_P_inst Hsub T u 0 HP).
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.

                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.

    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->

    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty HS | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [gamma4 x0 uty2 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty2 HS2 | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma9 x0 uty9 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma9 uty9 HS0 | gamma9 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [gamma4 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty HS | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.

  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->

Proof.

  inversion HJ as [gamma6 x0 uty6 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma6 uty6 HS1 | gamma6 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.

    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->

    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros IK IS IL IST IF gamma M ty D.
  induction D; intros Nred HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR as [y z | x y z | w x y | w x y z | w x y z1 z2 | M0 M0' N0 H0 | M1 N1 N1' H1]; subst.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.

Lemma stem_subst_subtype : forall (x y u : dtype) (k : nat),
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k).
Proof.
  intros x y u k H.
  change (subtype (subst_rec (Stem x) u k) (subst_rec y u k)).
  apply AgentC.subst_rec_subtype. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma stem_lift_subtype_one : forall (x y : dtype) (j : nat),
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (lift_rec x j 1)) (lift_rec y j 1).
Proof.
  intros x y j H.
  change (subtype (lift_rec (Stem x) j 1) (lift_rec y j 1)).
  apply AgentD.lift_rec_subtype. exact H.
Qed.

Proof.

  - exact stem_subst_subtype.

(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.

  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.

(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)

(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.

Lemma hsub0 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. exact hsub0.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.

Lemma dK1 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.

  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.

Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK1.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H. inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].

(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)

(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_var : forall i, subtype Leaf (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros i H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.
  unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Proof.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A concrete counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.
   The term (((Node @ Node) @ Node) @ (Node @ Node)) is a k-redex.
   It has type Stem Leaf, but its reduct Node has no such type. *)

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △).

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dK.
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dKy :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dKy_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dKy.
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dKy_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty HS | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [gamma4 x0 uty2 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty2 HS2 | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma9 x0 uty9 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma9 uty9 HS0 | gamma9 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [gamma4 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty HS | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma5 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma5 uty HS1 | gamma5 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HB) as HS3.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma6 x0 uty6 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma6 uty6 HS1 | gamma6 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HL) as HS3.
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma6 x0 uty6 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma6 uty6 HS1 | gamma6 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HN) as HS3.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_conditional :
  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros IK IS IL IST IF gamma M ty D.
  induction D; intros Nred HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR as [y z | x y z | w x y | w x y z | w x y z1 z2 | M' HR1 | M' N' HR2]; subst.
Show.
eapply red_k.
Show.
eapply derive_app.
Show.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
From Triage Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.

(* Scratch exploration: App strong soundness for a Leaf-reachable source,
   assuming the L1 inversion and the corresponding quant/dist target fact. *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.

Definition omega22_ty := program_type omega22.

Definition omega2_ty := (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty).

Definition eval_ty := quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Asf (Var 0))).

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                          subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| sub_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| sub_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| sub_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| sub_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)

| sub_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subtype omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| sub_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
| sub_to_asf: forall ty, subtype ty (Asf ty)
| sub_from_asf: forall uty vty, subtype (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
| sub_bffs: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty)) (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty))
| sub_bfff : forall uty vty wty, subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
                                         (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty))

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* Does the proposed general L2

   hold?  The following is a concrete premise instance obtained by
   stem_fun, a funty covariance step, sub_lift and sub_dist. *)

Lemma stem_leaf_funty_depth2 :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma funty_lift_depth2 :
  subtype (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))
          (Quant (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))).
Proof.
  change (subtype (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))
                  (Quant (lift 1 (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))))).
  apply sub_lift.
Qed.

Lemma L2_premise_instance :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + exact stem_leaf_funty_depth2.
    + exact funty_lift_depth2.
  - eapply sub_dist.
Qed.

(* If L2 as stated were available, it would give *)

Lemma L2_would_give :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.
  apply (fun H => H Leaf (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))
                   L2_premise_instance).
Qed.

Admitted.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof. intros a u. unfold subst, lift. apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0. Qed.

(* Generalized: subst at level k of lift_rec a (S k) 1 with Var 0 gives a. *)
Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen0 : forall a k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare k (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + (* n <= k *)
      unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare k n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia; try reflexivity.
      * (* k = n *) f_equal. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
        destruct (test 0 0) as [h0|h0]; simpl; f_equal; lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (IHa (S k)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_rec_1_1 : forall a,
  subst (lift_rec a 1 1) (Var 0) = a.
Proof. intros a. unfold subst. apply subst_rec_lift_rec_gen0 with (k:=0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a, subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

Lemma subtype_QS : forall w, subtype (Stem (Quant w)) (Quant (Stem w)).
Proof.
  intros w.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift.
  - apply sub_quant.
    apply sub_stem.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
    + rewrite subst_lift_rec_1_1. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_QS_cons : forall u v, subtype (Stem u) v ->
  subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros u v H.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply subtype_QS.
  - apply sub_quant. assumption.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Inductive derive: list (string * dtype) -> Tree -> dtype -> Prop :=
| derive_ref : forall gamma x uty ty, get x gamma = Some uty -> subtype uty ty -> derive gamma (Ref x) ty
| derive_node : forall gamma uty, subtype Leaf uty -> derive gamma Node uty
| derive_app: forall gamma M N ty u, derive gamma M (Funty u ty) -> derive gamma N u -> derive gamma (M@N) ty
.
--- terms.v ---
Require Import Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes String.

Open Scope string_scope.

Declare Scope tree_scope.
Global Open Scope tree_scope.

Inductive Tree:  Set :=
  | Ref : string -> Tree
  | Node : Tree
  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)
                 then S1 (star x M1) @ (star x M2)
                 else K@ (M1 @ M2)
  end.

Notation "\" := star : tree_scope.

Definition wait2 M N x :=  S1 (S1 (S1 (K @ M) @ (K @ N)) @ (K @ x)) @ I.

Definition omega21 := K @ (△ @ (△ @ I)).

Definition omega22 :=  \ "w" (\ "f" (wait2 (Ref "w") (Ref "w") (Ref "f"))).

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i

--- L1_assembly.v ---
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB Scratch9.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Fixpoint PL (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => PL T'
  | Quant T' => PL T'
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  end.

Section Stability.
Variable subst_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (u : dtype) (k : nat),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k).
Variable lift_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (j : nat),
    subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (lift_rec x j 1)) (lift_rec y j 1).

Lemma PL_subst_rec : forall T u k, PL T -> PL (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply subst_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma PL_lift_rec : forall T j, PL T -> PL (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros j HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply lift_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma PL_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> PL T -> PL U.
Proof.
  intros T U H. induction H; intros HP; simpl in *.
  - assumption.
  - apply IHsubtype2. apply IHsubtype1. assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - apply IHsubtype. assumption.
  - eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_stem; eassumption | ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ eassumption | assumption ].
  - apply IHsubtype. assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - assumption.
  - (* dist *) apply eq_quant. assumption.
  - (* inst *) apply PL_subst_rec. assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply PL_lift_rec. assumption.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H. apply (PL_mono Leaf (Funty a r) H Logic.I).
Qed.

End Stability.

  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.

Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* de Bruijn/quant helpers                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_S : forall d t, quant (S d) t = quant d (Quant t).
Proof. intros d t. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma quant_Quant : forall d t, quant d (Quant t) = Quant (quant d t).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intro t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma quant_mono : forall d A B, subtype A B -> subtype (quant d A) (quant d B).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros A B H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) *)
Lemma quant_lift_intro : forall d a,
  subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a, used for the reverse direction *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_one : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_onek : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a.
Proof.
  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite AgentA_probe.subst_lift_rec_1_1. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a) *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim : forall d a,
  subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a. apply quant_mono. apply quant_lift_elim_one.
Qed.

(* (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) is below (quant d (Fork a b)) *)
Lemma quant_fork_inv : forall d a b,
  subtype (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) (quant d (Fork a b)).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros a b; simpl.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - (* Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))
       <= Quant (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + (* reverse quant_fork inside *)
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))).
      * (* Quant (lift (Fork (Quant qa) (Quant qb)))
           = Quant (Fork (Quant (quant (S d) a)) (Quant (quant (S d) b))) *)
        change (subtype
          (Quant (Fork (Quant (quant (S d) a)) (Quant (quant (S d) b))))
          (Quant (Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))))).
        apply sub_quant.
        apply sub_fork.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ rewrite AgentA_probe.subst_lift_rec_1_1. apply sub_zero.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ rewrite AgentA_probe.subst_lift_rec_1_1. apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_quant. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Good predicate.                                                *)
(*   Good d x (Stem y)      = subtype x (quant d y)                    *)
(*   Good d x (Funty a r)   = subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) *)
(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

(* The two algebraic obligations, isolated.  The leafy hypothesis         *)
(* (subtype Leaf x) is kept because it is available in the applications  *)
(* and is needed for the Quant/lift corner cases.                        *)
Definition Good_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> Good d x T ->
    Good d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

Definition Good_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> Good (S d) x T ->
    Good d x (subst T u).

Lemma Good_mono
  (Hlift : Good_lift_obligation)
  (Hinst : Good_inst_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype Leaf x -> subtype T U ->
      Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hleaf Hsub.
  revert d x Hleaf.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x Hleaf HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtype2 with (x := x) (d := d).
    + exact Hleaf.
    + apply IHsubtype1 with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) apply IHsubtype with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
      * exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs2.
  - (* quant *) apply IHsubtype with (x := x) (d := S d); assumption.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * exact HP.
      * apply sub_zero.
    + apply quant_fork_inv.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. cbn in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) destruct HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

Print Assumptions Good_mono.
EOF
