Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
---
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.

Definition omega22_ty := program_type omega22.

Definition omega2_ty := (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty).

Definition eval_ty := quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Asf (Var 0))).

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                          subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| sub_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| sub_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| sub_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| sub_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)

| sub_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subtype omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| sub_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
| sub_to_asf: forall ty, subtype ty (Asf ty)
| sub_from_asf: forall uty vty, subtype (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
| sub_bffs: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty)) (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty))
| sub_bfff : forall uty vty wty, subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))

Lemma subst_rec_subtype : forall A B, subtype A B ->
  forall N k, subtype (subst_rec A N k) (subst_rec B N k).
Proof.
  intros A B H. induction H; intros N kk; simpl.
  - (* sub_zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply sub_trans; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_stem *) apply sub_stem; apply IHsubtype.
  - (* sub_fork *) eapply sub_fork; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_asf *) apply sub_asf; apply IHsubtype.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_funty; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply sub_quant; apply (IHsubtype N (S kk)).
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) apply sub_quant_stem.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) apply sub_quant_fork.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) apply sub_quant_asf.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    unfold subst.
    rewrite subst_subst.
    apply sub_inst.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    unfold lift.
    rewrite lift_subst_comm_01.
    apply sub_lift.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_leaf_fun.

Lemma lift_rec_subtype : forall A B, subtype A B -> forall j,
  subtype (lift_rec A j 1) (lift_rec B j 1).
Proof.
  intros A B H. induction H; intros j.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - eapply sub_trans; [ exact (IHsubtype1 j) | exact (IHsubtype2 j) ].
  - apply sub_stem. exact (IHsubtype j).
  - apply sub_fork; [ exact (IHsubtype1 j) | exact (IHsubtype2 j) ].
  - apply sub_asf. exact (IHsubtype j).
  - apply sub_funty; [ exact (IHsubtype1 j) | exact (IHsubtype2 j) ].
  - apply sub_quant. exact (IHsubtype (S j)).
  - simpl. apply sub_quant_stem.
  - simpl. apply sub_quant_fork.

| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf

intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_trans; [ apply sub_stem; exact Hs1 | exact HP ] | exact H ].
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) apply Hdist. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst. exact HP.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift. exact HP.
  - (* leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

(* L1: from a subtype Leaf (Funty a r) obtain subtype (Stem a) r.      *)
(* This is the target inversion used by k_head_case.                  *)

Lemma P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> P_leaf T.
Proof.
  intros T H.
  remember Leaf as S eqn:ES.
  revert ES.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros ES.
  - (* zero *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* trans *) subst. eapply P_leaf_mono; eauto.
  - (* stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* funty *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* dist *) discriminate ES.
  - (* inst *) discriminate ES.
  - (* lift *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* leaf_fun *) simpl. apply sub_zero.
  - (* stem_fun *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_leaf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in ES. discriminate ES.
  - (* tree *) discriminate ES.
  - (* to_asf *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* from_asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* bffs *) discriminate ES.
  - (* bfff *) discriminate ES.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H.
  exact (P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype Hdist Hlift Hinst (Funty a r) H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :
  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_funty_fork :
  forall a b Y Z, subtype (Funty a b) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a b Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Funty a b) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 10. Discharging the dist obligation of P_leaf unconditionally.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) is definitionally subtype (Stem u) v;   *)
(* the dist target is subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant v).  The        *)
(* following closed lemma supplies exactly that, so the Hdist         *)
(* hypothesis of P_leaf_mono is no longer needed.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_quant_dist : forall x y,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).
Proof.
  intros x y H.
  assert (HQ : subtype (Quant (lift_rec x 1 1)) x).
  { eapply sub_trans.
    - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
    - unfold subst. rewrite subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero. }
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem (Quant x)).
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_quant. eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_stem. exact HQ.
      * exact H.
    + apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* P_leaf_mono with the dist case supplied by the closed lemma above. *)
Lemma P_leaf_mono_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  apply P_leaf_mono.
  - intros u v HP. simpl in HP. simpl.
    apply subtype_stem_quant_dist. exact HP.
  - exact Hlift.
  - exact Hinst.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H.
  exact (P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype
           (fun u v HP => subtype_stem_quant_dist u v HP)
           Hlift Hinst (Funty a r) H).
Qed.

(* Lift obligation of P_leaf, specialized to lifting by exactly one.     *)

Lemma P_leaf_lift_one
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,

      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall T k, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift1. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

(* Hsub must be the generalized statement at EVERY substitution level k, *)
(* because P_leaf recurses through Quant and substitution under a       *)

Proof.

  - intros T HP. exact (P_leaf_lift_one Hlift1 T 0 HP).

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* de Bruijn/quant helpers                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_S : forall d t, quant (S d) t = quant d (Quant t).
Proof. intros d t. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma quant_Quant : forall d t, quant d (Quant t) = Quant (quant d t).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intro t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma quant_mono : forall d A B, subtype A B -> subtype (quant d A) (quant d B).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros A B H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) *)
Lemma quant_lift_intro : forall d a,
  subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a, used for the reverse direction *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_one : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  exact AgentB.subtype_quant_lift_elim.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_onek : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a.
Proof.
  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a) *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim : forall d a,
  subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
  apply quant_mono. apply quant_lift_elim_one.
Qed.

(* (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) is below (quant d (Fork a b)) *)
Lemma quant_fork_inv : forall d a b,
  subtype (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) (quant d (Fork a b)).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros a b; simpl.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - (* Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))
       <= Quant (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + (* reverse quant_fork inside *)
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))).
      * (* Quant (lift (Fork (Quant qa) (Quant qb)))
           = Quant (Fork (Quant (quant (S d) a)) (Quant (quant (S d) b))) *)
        change (subtype
          (Quant (Fork (Quant (quant (S d) a)) (Quant (quant (S d) b))))
          (Quant (Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))))).
        apply sub_quant.
        apply sub_fork.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_quant. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Good predicate.                                                *)
(*   Good d x (Stem y)      = subtype x (quant d y)                    *)
(*   Good d x (Funty a r)   = subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) *)
(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

(* The two algebraic obligations, isolated.  The leafy hypothesis         *)
(* (subtype Leaf x) is kept because it is available in the applications  *)
(* and is needed for the Quant/lift corner cases.                        *)
Definition Good_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> Good d x T ->
    Good d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

Definition Good_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> Good (S d) x T ->
    Good d x (subst T u).

Lemma Good_mono
  (Hlift : Good_lift_obligation)
  (Hinst : Good_inst_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype Leaf x -> subtype T U ->
      Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hleaf Hsub.
  revert d x Hleaf.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x Hleaf HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtype2 with (x := x) (d := d).
    + exact Hleaf.
    + apply IHsubtype1 with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) apply IHsubtype with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
      * exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs2.
  - (* quant *) apply IHsubtype with (x := x) (d := S d); assumption.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * exact HP.
      * apply sub_zero.
    + apply quant_fork_inv.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. cbn in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) destruct HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

Print Assumptions Good_mono.

(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

(* The two algebraic obligations, isolated.  The leafy hypothesis         *)
(* (subtype Leaf x) is kept because it is available in the applications  *)
(* and is needed for the Quant/lift corner cases.                        *)
Definition Good_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> Good d x T ->
    Good d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

Definition Good_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> Good (S d) x T ->
    Good d x (subst T u).

  - (* fork *) destruct HP.

  - (* quant *) apply IHsubtype with (x := x) (d := S d); assumption.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.

(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v

    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.

Fixpoint Q (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => True
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => Q T'
  end.

Lemma Q_subst_rec : forall T u k, Q T -> Q (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_lift_rec : forall T k n, Q T -> Q (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> Q T -> Q U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty

    | uty1 uty2 Hs

(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_var : forall i, subtype Leaf (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros i H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentA_probe AgentC AgentD Integration1.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype x (quant d Y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

Lemma quant_mono : forall d a b, subtype a b -> subtype (quant d a) (quant d b).
Proof.
  induction d; intros a b H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IHd. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_intro : forall d a, subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a. change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

Lemma Q_elim : forall d a, subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a. change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
  apply quant_mono. apply subtype_quant_lift_elim.
Qed.

Lemma Good_stem_self : forall x, Good 0 x (Stem x).
Proof. intro x. simpl. apply sub_zero. Qed.

(* stem source -> L2 with leafy *)
Lemma Good_mono_leafy :
  forall x, subtype Leaf x ->
  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d, Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  intros x Hleaf T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2 IH1 IH2
    | u1 u2 Hs IH1
    | u1 u2 v1 v2 Hs1 Hs2 IH1 IH2
    | u1 u2 Hs IH1
    | u1 u2 v1 v2 Hs1 Hs2 IH1 IH2
    | v1 v2 Hs IH1
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d HG; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HG.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) apply sub_trans with (y := quant d u1); [ exact HG | apply quant_mono; exact Hs ].
  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* asf *) apply IH1. exact HG.
  - (* funty *) eapply sub_trans.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | apply quant_mono; exact Hs1 ].
      * exact HG.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs2.
  - (* quant *) apply IH1. exact HG.
  - (* quant_stem *) simpl. exact HG.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* quant_asf *) simpl. exact HG.
  - (* dist *) simpl in *. simpl. exact HG.
  - (* inst *) simpl in *. simpl. admit.
  - (* lift *) simpl in *. simpl. admit.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
  - (* stem_fun *) simpl. eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork; [ exact HG | apply sub_zero ].
    + (* goal Fork (quant d u) (quant d v) <: quant d (Fork u v) *) admit.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* recursion *) destruct HG.
  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentA_probe AgentC AgentD Integration1.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype x (quant d Y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

Lemma quant_mono : forall d a b, subtype a b -> subtype (quant d a) (quant d b).
Proof.
  induction d; intros a b H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IHd. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_intro : forall d a, subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a. change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

Lemma Q_elim : forall d a, subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a. change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
  apply quant_mono. apply subtype_quant_lift_elim.
Qed.

Lemma Good_stem_self : forall x, Good 0 x (Stem x).
Proof. intro x. simpl. apply sub_zero. Qed.

(* stem source -> L2 with leafy *)
Lemma Good_mono_leafy :
  forall x, subtype Leaf x ->
  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d, Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  intros x Hleaf T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2 IH1 IH2
    | u1 u2 Hs IH1
    | u1 u2 v1 v2 Hs1 Hs2 IH1 IH2
    | u1 u2 Hs IH1
    | u1 u2 v1 v2 Hs1 Hs2 IH1 IH2
    | v1 v2 Hs IH1
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d HG; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HG.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) apply sub_trans with (y := quant d u1); [ exact HG | apply quant_mono; exact Hs ].
  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* asf *) apply IH1. exact HG.
  - (* funty *) eapply sub_trans.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | apply quant_mono; exact Hs1 ].
      * exact HG.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs2.
  - (* quant *) apply IH1. exact HG.
  - (* quant_stem *) simpl. exact HG.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* quant_asf *) simpl. exact HG.
  - (* dist *) simpl in *. simpl. exact HG.
  - (* inst *) simpl in *. simpl. admit.
  - (* lift *) simpl in *. simpl. admit.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
  - (* stem_fun *) simpl. eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork; [ exact HG | apply sub_zero ].
    + (* goal Fork (quant d u) (quant d v) <: quant d (Fork u v) *) admit.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* recursion *) destruct HG.
  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.

| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with

    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=

  end.

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf

  end.

  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y

.

  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ---------- relocate helpers ---------- *)

Lemma relocate_ge : forall i k n, k <= i -> relocate i k n = n + i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; [reflexivity | exfalso; lia].
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lt : forall i k n, k > i -> relocate i k n = i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; [exfalso; lia | reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift : forall i p k n,
  p <= i ->
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n Hp.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt]. (* p <= i, since not -> i < p *)
  - rewrite (relocate_ge i p k Hle); try reflexivity.
    rewrite (relocate_ge (k+i) (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_ge i p (k+n)) by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_same : forall i p k,
  p <= i -> relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) 0 = relocate i p k.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite relocate_lift_lift by lia. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift2 : forall i p k n,
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt].
  - rewrite (relocate_ge i p k Hle).
    rewrite (relocate_ge (k+i) (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_ge i p (k+n)) by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i p k Hi).
    rewrite (relocate_lt i (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i p (k+n)) by lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_gen : forall a p k n,
  lift_rec (lift_rec a p k) (p + k) n = lift_rec a p (k + n).
Proof.
  induction a; intros; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_lift2.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_le_gen : forall a p K q d,
  p <= q -> q <= p + K ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec a p K) q d = lift_rec a p (K + d).
Proof.
  induction a; intros; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - (* Var *)
    destruct (le_lt_dec p n) as [Hpi | Hip].
    + rewrite (relocate_ge n p K Hpi).
      rewrite (relocate_ge (K+n) q d) by lia.
      rewrite (relocate_ge n p (K+d)) by lia.
      f_equal. lia.
    + assert (Hn : n < p) by lia.
      rewrite (relocate_lt n p K Hn).
      rewrite (relocate_lt n q d) by lia.
      rewrite (relocate_lt n p (K+d)) by lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1 by lia. rewrite IHa2 by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1 by lia. rewrite IHa2 by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- insert_Var behaviour ---------- *)

Lemma insert_Var_lt : forall N i k, i < k -> insert_Var N i k = Var i.
Proof.
  intros N i k H. unfold insert_Var.
  destruct (compare k i) as [[Hlt | Heq] | Hgt]; try (exfalso; lia).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma insert_Var_eq : forall N i k, i = k -> insert_Var N i k = lift k N.
Proof.
  intros N i k H. subst i. unfold insert_Var.
  destruct (compare k k) as [[Hlt | Heq] | Hgt]; try (exfalso; lia).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma insert_Var_gt : forall N i k, i > k -> insert_Var N i k = Var (pred i).
Proof.
  intros N i k H. unfold insert_Var.
  destruct (compare k i) as [[Hlt | Heq] | Hgt]; try (exfalso; lia).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_var : forall i j d, lift_rec (Var i) j d = Var (relocate i j d).

    simpl.
    apply (sub_recursion k (subst_rec uty N (kk + k)) (subst_rec vty N (kk + k))).
  - (* sub_tree *)
    set (ty' := subst_rec ty N (S kk)).
    assert (Hcov' : covariant ty').
    { unfold ty'. apply covariant_subst. assumption. }
    assert (E1 : subst_rec (subst ty Leaf) N kk = subst ty' Leaf).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. simpl. reflexivity. }
    assert (E2 : subst_rec (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))) N (S kk)

    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. rewrite lift_subst_comm_11.

    assert (E3 : subst_rec (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0))) N (S (S kk))

    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. rewrite lift_subst_comm_12.
      simpl. reflexivity. }
    assert (E4 : subst_rec (subst ty uty) N kk = subst ty' (subst_rec uty N kk)).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. reflexivity. }
    rewrite E1, E2, E3, E4.
    apply (sub_tree ty' (subst_rec uty N kk) Hcov').
  - (* sub_to_asf *) apply sub_to_asf.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* sub_bffs *)
    apply (sub_bffs (subst_rec uty N kk) (subst_rec vty N kk)).
  - (* sub_bfff *)
    apply (sub_bfff (subst_rec uty N kk) (subst_rec vty N kk) (subst_rec wty N kk)).
Qed.

Corollary subst_stem_subtype : forall x y u,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst x u)) (subst y u).
Proof.
  intros x y u H.
  change (subtype (subst_rec (Stem x) u 0) (subst_rec y u 0)).
  apply subst_rec_subtype. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma subst_subst : forall a u N k,

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Hlift of the coordinator's Good predicate, proved unconditionally. *)
(* Good d x (Quant U) is definitionally Good (S d) x U, so the        *)
(* obligation is the following shift-and-lift statement.              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma Good_shift_lift :
  forall T d x, Good d x T -> Good (S d) x (lift 1 T).
Proof.
  induction T as
    [ n
    | T IH
    | a IH1 r IH2
    |
    | y IH
    | a IH1 b IH2
    | T IH ];
    intros d x HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exact HP.
  - (* Quant *)
    fold (Good d x (Quant T)) in HP.
    apply (IH (S d) x). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * apply quant_lift_elim.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * exact HP.
      * apply quant_lift_intro.
  - (* Leaf *) exact HP.
  - (* Stem *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_lift_intro.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *)
    apply IH. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma Good_lift_obligation_holds : Good_lift_obligation.
Proof.
  intros d x T Hleaf HP.
  apply Good_shift_lift. exact HP.
Qed.

(* Good_mono with the lift obligation discharged; only the inst        *)
(* obligation remains.                                                 *)
Lemma Good_mono_lift_closed
  (Hinst : Good_inst_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype Leaf x -> subtype T U ->
      Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  apply Good_mono.
  - exact Good_lift_obligation_holds.
  - exact Hinst.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Sanity check on the earlier L2 concern: the Quant-headed codomain  *)
(* instance IS derivable, by sub_lift + sub_quant + sub_fork +        *)
(* sub_inst.  This refutes the idea that full L2 fails there.         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_var_succ_inst : forall n, subtype (Quant (Var (S n))) (Var n).
Proof.
  intro n.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var n).
  - unfold subst. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_quant_body :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 1))) (Fork Leaf (Var 0)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_fork.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - apply quant_var_succ_inst.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_into_quant :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_quant.
    change (subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 1))) (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
    apply fork_quant_quant_body.
Qed.

Lemma L2_quant_codomain_premise :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant (Var 0)) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Funty (Var 0) (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (Stem Leaf)).
    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem Leaf).
    + apply sub_quant. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply sub_dist.
Qed.

(* So assuming L2 here would produce a true conclusion, not a
   contradiction. *)
Lemma L2_would_give_derivable_conclusion :
  (forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                 subtype (Fork X a) r) ->
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
Proof.
  intro L2.
  exact (L2 Leaf (Quant (Var 0)) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))
           L2_quant_codomain_premise).
Qed.

Print Assumptions Good_shift_lift.
Print Assumptions Good_mono_lift_closed.
Print Assumptions fork_quant_into_quant.

  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.

  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.

    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.

  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Hlift of the coordinator's Good predicate, proved unconditionally. *)
(* Good d x (Quant U) is definitionally Good (S d) x U, so the        *)
(* obligation is the following shift-and-lift statement.              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma Good_shift_lift :
  forall T d x, Good d x T -> Good (S d) x (lift 1 T).
Proof.
  induction T as
    [ n
    | T IH
    | a IH1 r IH2
    |
    | y IH
    | a IH1 b IH2
    | T IH ];
    intros d x HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exact HP.
  - (* Quant *)
    fold (Good d x (Quant T)) in HP.
    apply (IH (S d) x). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * apply quant_lift_elim.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * exact HP.
      * apply quant_lift_intro.
  - (* Leaf *) exact HP.
  - (* Stem *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_lift_intro.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *)
    apply IH. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma Good_lift_obligation_holds : Good_lift_obligation.
Proof.
  intros d x T Hleaf HP.
  apply Good_shift_lift. exact HP.
Qed.

(* Good_mono with the lift obligation discharged; only the inst        *)
(* obligation remains.                                                 *)
Lemma Good_mono_lift_closed
  (Hinst : Good_inst_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype Leaf x -> subtype T U ->
      Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  apply Good_mono.
  - exact Good_lift_obligation_holds.
  - exact Hinst.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Sanity check on the earlier L2 concern: the Quant-headed codomain  *)
(* instance IS derivable, by sub_lift + sub_quant + sub_fork +        *)
(* sub_inst.  This refutes the idea that full L2 fails there.         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_var_succ_inst : forall n, subtype (Quant (Var (S n))) (Var n).
Proof.
  intro n.
  change (subtype (Quant (Var (S n))) (subst (Var (S n)) (Var n))).
  apply sub_inst.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_quant_body :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 1))) (Fork Leaf (Var 0)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_fork.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - apply quant_var_succ_inst.
Qed.

  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_quant.
    change (subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 1))) (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
    apply fork_quant_quant_body.

  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant (Var 0)) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Funty (Var 0) (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (Stem Leaf)).
    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem Leaf).
    + apply sub_quant. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply sub_dist.

  (forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                 subtype (Fork X a) r) ->
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
Proof.
  intro L2.
  exact (L2 Leaf (Quant (Var 0)) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))
           L2_quant_codomain_premise).
Qed.

Print Assumptions Good_shift_lift.
Print Assumptions Good_mono_lift_closed.
Print Assumptions fork_quant_into_quant.

(*                                                                    *)
(* Take d = 0, x = Leaf, T = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf),        *)

(*   subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).   *)

(*                       (subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0)))           *)
(* = subtype (Fork Leaf (Var 0)) (Funty Leaf Leaf),                   *)
(* because subst (Var 0) (Var 0) = Var 0 and                        *)
(* subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0) = Funty Leaf Leaf.                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The latter is NOT derivable.  I checked it in the closure model of *)
(* the subtype rules at size 6 over Var 0 (4424 types): the source    *)
(* Fork Leaf (Var 0) has no path to Funty Leaf Leaf, while the above  *)
(* premise is reachable.  The only subtype rules omitted from that     *)
(* model are those whose source has a Stem/Fork in its first          *)
(* component (sub_fork_stem, sub_fork_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,     *)
(* sub_bfff, sub_recursion); none of these sources is reachable from  *)

(* Leaf <: Fork, which is false (AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem/fork).  *)
(*                                                                    *)

(* variant.  The premise proof below is closed and compiles.          *)

Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_leaf_leaf : subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_var0_leaf : subst (Var 0) Leaf = Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_funty_leaf_leaf : lift 1 (Funty Leaf Leaf) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma good_inst_counter_premise :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0)))
          (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * rewrite <- subst_var0_leaf.
        apply sub_inst.
    + rewrite <- lift_funty_leaf_leaf.
      apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* The premise in Good form, exactly as required by Hinst. *)
Lemma good_inst_counter_premise_Good :
  Good 1 Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  simpl. exact good_inst_counter_premise.
Qed.

(* The conclusion Hinst would demand, simplified. *)
Lemma good_inst_counter_conclusion_shape :
  Good 0 Leaf
       (Funty (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))
              (subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0)))
  = subtype (Fork Leaf (Var 0)) (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof.
  rewrite subst_var0_var0, subst_leaf_leaf. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* This is the negated conclusion; it is NOT proved in Coq here (it is
   supported by the size-6 closure model described above).  Do not add
   it to a merged file without a closed proof/invariant. *)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.

  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma9 x0 uty9 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma9 uty9 HS0 | gamma9 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.

Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=

  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.

  induction H as

  - (* asf *) eauto.

  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.

  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.

(* 8. Strong soundness of App for a Leaf-reachable source.             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* All Stem/Fork/recursion/tree source cases are eliminated by the      *)
(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].

Qed.

  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.

  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_fork.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * exact subtype_quant_leaf_leaf.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans
      with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))).
    + apply sub_lift.
    + vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* that the instance provides no disproof of L2.                       *)
Lemma naive_L2_instance_consistent
  (L2 : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                      subtype (Fork X a) r)
  : subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.
  exact (L2 Leaf (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))
           L2_premise_instance).
Qed.

(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.

  assert (H := variant_subst_pos ty true 0 N (S k) (le_n_S 0 k (le_0_n k))).

Lemma subst_rec_subtype : forall A B, subtype A B ->
  forall N k, subtype (subst_rec A N k) (subst_rec B N k).
Proof.
  intros A B H. induction H; intros N kk; simpl.
  - (* sub_zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply sub_trans; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_stem *) apply sub_stem; apply IHsubtype.
  - (* sub_fork *) eapply sub_fork; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_asf *) apply sub_asf; apply IHsubtype.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_funty; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply sub_quant; apply (IHsubtype N (S kk)).
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) apply sub_quant_stem.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) apply sub_quant_fork.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) apply sub_quant_asf.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    unfold subst.
    rewrite subst_subst.
    apply sub_inst.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    unfold lift.
    rewrite lift_subst_comm_01.
    apply sub_lift.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) apply sub_stem_fun.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) apply sub_fork_stem.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
  - (* sub_recursion *)
    replace (subst_rec (quant k (Funty uty vty)) N kk)
      with (quant k (subst_rec (Funty uty vty) N (kk + k)))
      by (symmetry; apply (subst_rec_quant k (Funty uty vty) N kk)).
    simpl.
    apply (sub_recursion k (subst_rec uty N (kk + k)) (subst_rec vty N (kk + k))).
  - (* sub_tree *)
    set (ty' := subst_rec ty N (S kk)).
    assert (Hcov' : covariant ty').
    { unfold ty'. apply covariant_subst. assumption. }
    assert (E1 : subst_rec (subst ty Leaf) N kk = subst ty' Leaf).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. simpl. reflexivity. }
    assert (E2 : subst_rec (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))) N (S kk)
                 = subst (lift_rec ty' 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. rewrite lift_subst_comm_11.
      simpl. reflexivity. }
    assert (E3 : subst_rec (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0))) N (S (S kk))
                 = subst (lift_rec ty' 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0))).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. rewrite lift_subst_comm_12.
      simpl. reflexivity. }
    assert (E4 : subst_rec (subst ty uty) N kk = subst ty' (subst_rec uty N kk)).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. reflexivity. }
    rewrite E1, E2, E3, E4.
    apply (sub_tree ty' (subst_rec uty N kk) Hcov').
  - (* sub_to_asf *) apply sub_to_asf.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* sub_bffs *)
    apply (sub_bffs (subst_rec uty N kk) (subst_rec vty N kk)).
  - (* sub_bfff *)
    apply (sub_bfff (subst_rec uty N kk) (subst_rec vty N kk) (subst_rec wty N kk)).
Qed.

Corollary subst_stem_subtype : forall x y u,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst x u)) (subst y u).
Proof.
  intros x y u H.
  change (subtype (subst_rec (Stem x) u 0) (subst_rec y u 0)).
  apply subst_rec_subtype. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma stem_leaf_funty_depth2 :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.

Lemma funty_lift_depth2 :
  subtype (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))
          (Quant (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))).
Proof.

  apply sub_lift.
Qed.

Lemma L2_premise_instance :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + exact stem_leaf_funty_depth2.
    + exact funty_lift_depth2.

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.

Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,

  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem (Quant x)).

  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
