Lemma lift_var : forall i j d, lift_rec (Var i) j d = Var (relocate i j d).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ---------- commuting lift and substitution ---------- *)

Lemma lift_subst_comm_gen : forall a N K d j,
  j <= K ->
  subst_rec (lift_rec a j d) N (K + d) = lift_rec (subst_rec a N K) j d.
Proof.
  induction a; intros N K d j Hj; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n j) as [[Hnj | Hnj] | Hnj].
    + assert (HnK : n < K) by lia.
      rewrite (relocate_lt n j d) by lia.
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n (K + d)) by lia.
      rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n K) by lia.
      rewrite lift_var.
      rewrite (relocate_lt n j d) by lia.
      reflexivity.
    + subst n.
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec j K) as [[HjK | HjK] | HjK].
      * rewrite (relocate_ge j j d) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N (d + j) (K + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N j K) by lia.
        rewrite lift_var.
        rewrite (relocate_ge j j d) by lia.
        reflexivity.
      * subst K.
        rewrite (relocate_ge j j d) by lia.
        replace (j + d) with (d + j) by lia.
        rewrite insert_Var_eq by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_eq N j j) by lia.
        unfold lift.
        assert (Hll : lift_rec (lift_rec N 0 j) (0 + j) d = lift_rec N 0 (j + d))
          by apply lift_lift_gen.
        simpl in Hll. rewrite Hll.
        f_equal. lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + assert (HnKj : j < n) by lia.
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n K) as [[HnK | HnK] | HnK].
      * rewrite (relocate_ge n j d) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N (d + n) (K + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_lt N n K) by lia.
        rewrite lift_var.
        rewrite (relocate_ge n j d) by lia.
        reflexivity.
      * subst K.
        rewrite (relocate_ge n j d) by lia.
        replace (n + d) with (d + n) by lia.
        rewrite insert_Var_eq by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_eq N n n) by lia.
        unfold lift.
        assert (Hll : lift_rec (lift_rec N 0 n) (0 + j) d = lift_rec N 0 (n + d))
          by (apply lift_lift_le_gen; lia).
        simpl in Hll. rewrite Hll.
        f_equal. lia.
      * rewrite (relocate_ge n j d) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_gt N (d + n) (K + d)) by lia.
        rewrite (insert_Var_gt N n K) by lia.
        rewrite lift_var.
        rewrite (relocate_ge (pred n) j d) by lia.
        replace (pred (d + n)) with (d + pred n) by lia.
        reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *)
    change (Quant (subst_rec (lift_rec a (S j) d) N (S K + d)) =
            Quant (lift_rec (subst_rec a N (S K)) (S j) d)).
    rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
  - (* Funty *)
    rewrite IHa1 by lia. rewrite IHa2 by lia. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHa1 by lia. rewrite IHa2 by lia. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHa by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_succ_gen : forall a N d m j,
  d < m ->
  subst_rec (lift_rec a j m) N (d + j) = lift_rec a j (m - 1).
Proof.

(* ---------- relocate helpers ---------- *)

Lemma relocate_ge : forall i k n, k <= i -> relocate i k n = n + i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; [reflexivity | exfalso; lia].
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lt : forall i k n, k > i -> relocate i k n = i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; [exfalso; lia | reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift : forall i p k n,
  p <= i ->
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n Hp.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt]. (* p <= i, since not -> i < p *)
  - rewrite (relocate_ge i p k Hle); try reflexivity.
    rewrite (relocate_ge (k+i) (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_ge i p (k+n)) by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_same : forall i p k,
  p <= i -> relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) 0 = relocate i p k.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite relocate_lift_lift by lia. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift2 : forall i p k n,
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt].
  - rewrite (relocate_ge i p k Hle).
    rewrite (relocate_ge (k+i) (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_ge i p (k+n)) by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i p k Hi).
    rewrite (relocate_lt i (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i p (k+n)) by lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* GoodC: the coordinator's substitution-closure repair.               *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Difference from the proposal: the Funty case also keeps the base    *)
(* conjunct subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r).  The base        *)
(* conjunct is needed for the proposed L2 reduction: the forall k u    *)
(* closure alone does not contain the instance k = 0, u = anything     *)
(* with subst_rec a u 0 = a (there is no uniform such u).              *)
(* Keeping the base conjunct is harmless for the monotonicity cases.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodC (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Funty a r =>
      subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) /\
      (forall k u,
          subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst_rec a u k)))
                  (quant d (subst_rec r u k)))
  | Asf T' => GoodC d x T'
  | Quant T' => GoodC (S d) x T'
  end.

Definition GoodC_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, GoodC (S d) x T -> GoodC d x (subst T u).

(* Direction obstruction for the Funty case of the obligation above.
   The source gives, at the base instance k = 0 and after unfolding
   quant (S d) a = quant d (Quant a),

     subtype (Fork x (quant d (Quant a))) (quant d (Quant r)) .

   The target base demands

     subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst a u))) (quant d (subst r u)) .

   The only available comparison of the inner arguments is
   [sub_inst] : Quant a <: subst a u.  It makes the target source
   (subst a u) LARGER than the source source (Quant a), so the source
   hypothesis concerns a smaller left argument and does not imply the
   target.  The all-k closure has exactly the same orientation for
   every k (with subst_rec a u k in place of a).  Thus the Funty part
   of GoodC_inst_obligation is not discharged by subst_subst_gen; it
   remains a genuine obligation. *)

Definition GoodC_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, GoodC d x T -> GoodC d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

(* The sub_stem_fun case is NOT derivable from the all-k Funty closure.
   It is isolated here as a third obligation; a forced instance below
   shows why it is problematic. *)
Definition GoodC_stem_fun_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x uty vty,
    GoodC d x (Stem uty) -> GoodC d x (Funty vty (Fork uty vty)).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural monotonicity.  Every case except sub_inst, sub_lift and  *)
(* sub_stem_fun is discharged outright.  Those three are the isolated  *)
(* obligations below; the sub_stem_fun obligation is in fact false.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodC_mono
  (Hinst : GoodC_inst_obligation)
  (Hlift : GoodC_lift_obligation)
  (Hstemfun : GoodC_stem_fun_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype T U -> GoodC d x T -> GoodC d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hsub.
  revert d x.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *)
    destruct HP as [Hbase Hclos]. split.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- apply sub_fork.
           ++ apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
        -- exact Hbase.
      * apply quant_mono. exact Hsub1.
    + intros k u.
      eapply sub_trans.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- apply sub_fork.
           ++ apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply quant_mono. apply (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ Hs1 u k).
        -- apply Hclos.
      * apply quant_mono. apply (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ Hsub1 u k).
  - (* quant *) apply IHHs. exact HP.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *)
    destruct HP as [Hbase Hclos]. split.
    + change (subtype (Fork x (quant (S d) uty)) (quant (S d) vty)).
      exact Hbase.
    + intros k u.
      change (subtype (Fork x (quant (S d) (subst_rec uty u (S k))))
                       (quant (S d) (subst_rec vty u (S k)))).

(* with subst_rec a u 0 = a (there is no uniform such u).              *)
(* Keeping the base conjunct is harmless for the monotonicity cases.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodC (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Funty a r =>
      subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) /\
      (forall k u,
          subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst_rec a u k)))
                  (quant d (subst_rec r u k)))
  | Asf T' => GoodC d x T'
  | Quant T' => GoodC (S d) x T'
  end.

Definition GoodC_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, GoodC (S d) x T -> GoodC d x (subst T u).

(* Direction obstruction for the Funty case of the obligation above.
   The source gives, at the base instance k = 0 and after unfolding
   quant (S d) a = quant d (Quant a),

     subtype (Fork x (quant d (Quant a))) (quant d (Quant r)) .

   The target base demands

     subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst a u))) (quant d (subst r u)) .

   The only available comparison of the inner arguments is
   [sub_inst] : Quant a <: subst a u.  It makes the target source
   (subst a u) LARGER than the source source (Quant a), so the source
   hypothesis concerns a smaller left argument and does not imply the
   target.  The all-k closure has exactly the same orientation for
   every k (with subst_rec a u k in place of a).  Thus the Funty part
   of GoodC_inst_obligation is not discharged by subst_subst_gen; it
   remains a genuine obligation. *)

Definition GoodC_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, GoodC d x T -> GoodC d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

   It is isolated here as a third obligation; a forced instance below
   shows why it is problematic. *)
Definition GoodC_stem_fun_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x uty vty,
    GoodC d x (Stem uty) -> GoodC d x (Funty vty (Fork uty vty)).

(* Structural monotonicity.  Every case except sub_inst, sub_lift and  *)
(* sub_stem_fun is discharged outright.  Those three are the isolated  *)

  - (* trans *) eauto.

  - (* fork *) destruct HP.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The coordinator's substitution-closed predicate, without the extra  *)
(* base conjunct (so this is exactly the predicate tested in the      *)
(* finite closure model).                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint GoodC0 (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype x (quant d Y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r =>
      forall k u,
        subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst_rec a u k)))
                (quant d (subst_rec r u k))
  | Asf T' => GoodC0 d x T'
  | Quant T' => GoodC0 (S d) x T'
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Stem cases requested by the coordinator.                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Inst: x <: quant (S d) Y  ==>  x <: quant d (subst Y u).
   quant (S d) Y is definitionally quant d (Quant Y), and
   Quant Y <: subst Y u by sub_inst, so quant_mono finishes.         *)
Lemma GoodC0_stem_inst :
  forall d x Y u,
    GoodC0 (S d) x (Stem Y) ->
    GoodC0 d x (Stem (subst Y u)).
Proof.
  intros d x Y u H.
  simpl in *.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact H.
  - change (subtype (quant d (Quant Y)) (quant d (subst Y u))).
    apply quant_mono.
    apply sub_inst.
Qed.

(* Lift: x <: quant d Y  ==>  x <: quant (S d) (lift 1 Y).
   This is quant_lift_intro, proved from sub_lift and quant_mono.    *)
Lemma GoodC0_stem_lift :
  forall d x Y,
    GoodC0 d x (Stem Y) ->
    GoodC0 (S d) x (Stem (lift 1 Y)).
Proof.
  intros d x Y H.
  simpl in *.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact H.
  - change (subtype (quant d Y) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 Y)))).
    apply quant_mono.
    apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* The Stem monotonicity step, included for completeness.             *)
Lemma GoodC0_stem_mono :
  forall d x Y Y',
    subtype Y Y' ->
    GoodC0 d x (Stem Y) ->
    GoodC0 d x (Stem Y').
Proof.
  intros d x Y Y' Hsub HG.
  simpl in *.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact HG.
  - apply quant_mono. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* The lift_rec 1 1 subcase, stated explicitly.  If the Quant has     *)
(* already been pushed inside GoodC0, lifting at cutoff 1 must be      *)
(* compared with the one-level-lower quantifier.  The Stem version of *)
(* this shape is exactly GoodC0_stem_lift after change; the general   *)
(* Funty version is not proved here.                                  *)
Lemma GoodC0_stem_lift_rec_one_one :
  forall d x Y,
    GoodC0 (S d) x (Stem Y) ->
    GoodC0 (S (S d)) x (Stem (lift_rec Y 1 1)).
Proof.
  intros d x Y H.
  (* GoodC0 (S d) x (Stem Y) is x <: quant (S d) Y.  A subtype-level
     comparison with quant (S (S d)) (lift_rec Y 1 1) is not available
     from the rules used above (the available lift rule has cutoff 0),
     so this shape is recorded as a lemma with an explicit additional
     hypothesis. *)
Abort.

Check GoodC0_stem_mono.

(* A size-annotated version of the subtype relation, used for well-founded

Inductive subtype_size : dtype -> dtype -> nat -> Prop :=

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).

    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.

  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].

  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.

Lemma subtype_size_exists :
  forall S T (H : subtype S T), exists n, subtype_size H n.
Proof.
  intros S T H.
  induction H;
    try (eexists; econstructor; eauto; fail);
    try (destruct IHH as [n IHn];
         eexists; econstructor; eauto; fail);
    try (destruct IHH1 as [n1 IH1];
         destruct IHH2 as [n2 IH2];
         eexists; econstructor; eauto; fail).
Qed.

Lemma nat_lex_rect (P : nat -> nat -> Prop)
  (H : forall n m,
      (forall n' m', n' < n -> P n' m') ->
      (forall m', m' < m -> P n m) ->
      P n m) :
  forall n m, P n m.
Proof.
  intros n.
  apply (well_founded_ind lt_wf (fun n => forall m, P n m)).
  intros n IHn m.
  apply (well_founded_ind lt_wf (fun m => P n m)).
  intros m IHm.
  apply H.
  - intros n' m' Hlt. apply IHn. exact Hlt.
  - intros m' Hlt. apply IHm. exact Hlt.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty HS | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [gamma4 x0 uty2 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty2 HS2 | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma9 x0 uty9 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma9 uty9 HS0 | gamma9 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_conditional :
  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->

    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->

  induction D; intros Nred HR.

  - inversion HR.

    + eapply derive_app; [ apply IHD1; exact H0 | exact D2 ].
    + eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | apply IHD2; exact H1 ].

  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall T k, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k 1).

10	Definition lexR (p q : {n : nat & nat}) : Prop :=
11	  @lexprod nat (fun _ : nat => nat) lt (fun (_:nat) (x y:nat) => lt x y) p q.

13	Lemma lexR_wf : well_founded lexR.
14	Proof.
15	  unfold lexR.
16	  apply @wf_lexprod with (A:=nat) (B:=fun _:nat=>nat) (leA:=lt) (leB:=fun (_:nat) (x y:nat)=>lt x y).
17	  - apply Nat.lt_wf_0.
18	  - intro; apply Nat.lt_wf_0.

31	    p = Mpair (nK + nH + 1) nH ->

35	    (fun p => forall S a r X nH nK,
36	      subtype_size S (Funty a r) nH ->

66	    | ty
67	    | u v
68	    | u v
69	    | u v w ];
70	    intros aa rr ET.
71	  - (* szs_zero: S = ty, target ty = Funty aa rr *)
72	    subst. (* S = Funty a0 r0, nH=1 *)
73	    (* K : subtype_size (Fork Leaf X) (Funty aa rr) nK.  Analyse K. *)

78	      | a1 b1 c1 m1 m2 K1 K2
79	      | u1 u2 m0 Kpre
80	      | u1 u2 v1 v2 m1 m2 K1 K2
81	      | u1 u2 m0 Kpre

83	      | v1 v2 m0 Kpre

107	         nK = m1+m2+1.  Recursive call with H'=K2, K'=K1. *)
108	      eapply (IH (Mpair (m1 + m2 + 1) m2)).
109	      * unfold lexR. apply left_lex. simpl. lia.

151	  - (* szs_funty: source Funty a0 c0, target Funty b0 d0 = Funty a r. K: Fork Leaf X<:Funty a0 c0. Let's use the two-derivation call with H'=K (target Funty a0 c0) and reachability szs_zero from Fork Leaf X to itself, obtaining X<:c0, then trans with Hs2: c0<:d0=r. *)
152	    (* new pair: H' = K (nK), K' = szs_zero (Fork Leaf X) (1). *)

155	      * unfold lexR. apply left_lex. simpl. lia.
156	      * exact HK.
157	      * apply szs_zero.
158	      * simpl. f_equal. lia.
159	    + (* Hs2 : c0 <: d0 = r *) exact Hs2.

165	  - (* szs_inst target subst ty u = Funty: need analyze K, but as a first approximation discriminate ET? No, ET is subst ty u = Funty a r, not contradictory. *) admit.

167	  - (* szs_leaf_fun source Leaf, target Funty u (Stem u). K: Fork Leaf X<:Leaf. Need X<:Stem u. K impossible: Fork Leaf X<:Leaf has no rule. Use K analysis? *)
168	    admit.
169	  - (* szs_stem_fun source Stem u, target Funty v (Fork u v). K: Fork Leaf X<:Stem u, impossible. *) admit.

171	    admit.
172	  - (* szs_fork_stem source Fork (Stem..).., target Funty. K: Fork Leaf X<:Fork (Stem..)..; first premise Leaf<:Stem, impossible. *) admit.
173	  - (* szs_fork_fork_leaf *) admit.
174	  - (* szs_fork_fork_stem *) admit.
175	  - (* szs_fork_fork_fork *) admit.

177	  - (* szs_tree source Fork (Fork..).., target Funty. K: Fork Leaf X<:Fork(Fork..)..; impossible. *) admit.

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
2	Require Import terms types subtypes.
3	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
4	Open Scope string_scope.
5	Open Scope nat_scope.
6	Open Scope tree_scope.
7	
8	(* A size-annotated version of the subtype relation, used for well-founded
9	   recursion on pairs of derivations.  It mirrors subtypes.v exactly. *)
10	Inductive subtype_size : dtype -> dtype -> nat -> Prop :=
11	| szs_zero : forall ty, subtype_size ty ty 1
12	| szs_trans : forall a b c n m,
13	    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size b c m ->
14	    subtype_size a c (n + m + 1)
15	| szs_stem : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
16	    subtype_size (Stem a) (Stem b) (S n)
17	| szs_fork : forall a b c d n m,
18	    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size c d m ->
19	    subtype_size (Fork a c) (Fork b d) (n + m + 1)
20	| szs_asf : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
21	    subtype_size (Asf a) (Asf b) (S n)
22	| szs_funty : forall a b c d n m,
23	    subtype_size b a n -> subtype_size c d m ->
24	    subtype_size (Funty a c) (Funty b d) (n + m + 1)
25	| szs_quant : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
26	    subtype_size (Quant a) (Quant b) (S n)
27	| szs_quant_stem : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Stem u)) (Stem (Quant u)) 1
28	| szs_quant_fork : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Fork u v)) (Fork (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
29	| szs_quant_asf : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Asf u)) (Asf (Quant u)) 1
30	| szs_dist : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Funty u v)) (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
31	| szs_inst : forall ty u, subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) 1
32	| szs_lift : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) 1
33	| szs_leaf_fun : forall u, subtype_size Leaf (Funty u (Stem u)) 1
34	| szs_stem_fun : forall u v, subtype_size (Stem u) (Funty v (Fork u v)) 1
35	| szs_fork_leaf : forall u v, subtype_size (Fork Leaf u) (Funty v u) 1
36	| szs_fork_stem : forall u v w,
37	    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) (Funty u w) 1
38	| szs_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w,
39	    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) w) (Funty Leaf u) 1
40	| szs_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w,
41	    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) (Funty (Stem v1) v2) 1
42	| szs_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3,
43	    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) (Funty (Fork w1 w2) w3) 1
44	| szs_recursion : forall k u v,
45	    subtype_size omega2_ty
46	      (Funty omega2_ty
47	        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
48	               (quant k (Funty u v)))) 1
49	| szs_tree : forall ty uty,
50	    covariant ty ->
51	    subtype_size
52	      (Fork
53	         (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
54	               (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
55	         (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
56	               (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
57	      (Funty uty (subst ty uty)) 1
58	| szs_to_asf : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Asf ty) 1
59	| szs_from_asf : forall u v, subtype_size (Asf (Funty u v)) (Funty u v) 1
60	| szs_bffs : forall u v,
61	    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug u)) (Asf v)) (Asf (Fork (Stem u) v)) 1
62	| szs_bfff : forall u v w,
63	    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Asf v)) (bfff_aug w)) (Asf (Fork (Fork u v) w)) 1.
64	
65	Lemma subtype_size_sound : forall S T n, subtype_size S T n -> subtype S T.
66	Proof.
67	  intros S T n H. induction H; eauto using subtype.
68	Qed.
69	
70	Lemma subtype_has_size : forall S T, subtype S T -> exists n, subtype_size S T n.
71	Proof.
72	  intros S T H. induction H.
73	  - exists 1. apply szs_zero.
74	  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
75	    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_trans; eauto.
76	  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_stem. exact Hs.
77	  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
78	    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_fork; eauto.
79	  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_asf. exact Hs.
80	  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
81	    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_funty; eauto.
82	  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_quant. exact Hs.
83	  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_stem.
84	  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_fork.
85	  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_asf.
86	  - exists 1. apply szs_dist.
87	  - exists 1. apply szs_inst.
88	  - exists 1. apply szs_lift.
89	  - exists 1. apply szs_leaf_fun.
90	  - exists 1. apply szs_stem_fun.
91	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_leaf.
92	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_stem.
93	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_leaf.
94	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_stem.
95	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_fork.
96	  - exists 1. apply szs_recursion.
97	  - exists 1. eapply szs_tree; eauto.
98	  - exists 1. apply szs_to_asf.
99	  - exists 1. apply szs_from_asf.
100	  - exists 1. apply szs_bffs.
101	  - exists 1. apply szs_bfff.
102	Qed.

192	Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
193	Proof.

195	  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
196	  revert a r ET.

225	  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
226	  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
227	  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
228	  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
229	  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.

237	  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

(* A size-annotated version of the subtype relation, used for well-founded
   recursion on pairs of derivations.  It mirrors subtypes.v exactly. *)
Inductive subtype_size : dtype -> dtype -> nat -> Prop :=
| szs_zero : forall ty, subtype_size ty ty 1
| szs_trans : forall a b c n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size b c m ->
    subtype_size a c (n + m + 1)
| szs_stem : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Stem a) (Stem b) (S n)
| szs_fork : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Fork a c) (Fork b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_asf : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Asf a) (Asf b) (S n)
| szs_funty : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size b a n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Funty a c) (Funty b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_quant : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Quant a) (Quant b) (S n)
| szs_quant_stem : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Stem u)) (Stem (Quant u)) 1
| szs_quant_fork : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Fork u v)) (Fork (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_quant_asf : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Asf u)) (Asf (Quant u)) 1
| szs_dist : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Funty u v)) (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_inst : forall ty u, subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) 1
| szs_lift : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) 1
| szs_leaf_fun : forall u, subtype_size Leaf (Funty u (Stem u)) 1
| szs_stem_fun : forall u v, subtype_size (Stem u) (Funty v (Fork u v)) 1
| szs_fork_leaf : forall u v, subtype_size (Fork Leaf u) (Funty v u) 1
| szs_fork_stem : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) (Funty u w) 1
| szs_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) w) (Funty Leaf u) 1
| szs_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) (Funty (Stem v1) v2) 1
| szs_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) (Funty (Fork w1 w2) w3) 1
| szs_recursion : forall k u v,
    subtype_size omega2_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))

| szs_tree : forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->

Proof.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof.
  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0.
Qed.

(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)

  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.

(*                                                                    *)

    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.

    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A size-annotated version of the subtype relation, used for well-founded
   recursion on pairs of derivations.  It mirrors subtypes.v exactly. *)
Inductive subtype_size : dtype -> dtype -> nat -> Prop :=
| szs_zero : forall ty, subtype_size ty ty 1
| szs_trans : forall a b c n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size b c m ->
    subtype_size a c (n + m + 1)
| szs_stem : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Stem a) (Stem b) (S n)
| szs_fork : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Fork a c) (Fork b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_asf : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Asf a) (Asf b) (S n)
| szs_funty : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size b a n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Funty a c) (Funty b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_quant : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Quant a) (Quant b) (S n)
| szs_quant_stem : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Stem u)) (Stem (Quant u)) 1
| szs_quant_fork : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Fork u v)) (Fork (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_quant_asf : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Asf u)) (Asf (Quant u)) 1
| szs_dist : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Funty u v)) (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_inst : forall ty u, subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) 1
| szs_lift : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) 1
| szs_leaf_fun : forall u, subtype_size Leaf (Funty u (Stem u)) 1
| szs_stem_fun : forall u v, subtype_size (Stem u) (Funty v (Fork u v)) 1
| szs_fork_leaf : forall u v, subtype_size (Fork Leaf u) (Funty v u) 1
| szs_fork_stem : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) (Funty u w) 1
| szs_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) w) (Funty Leaf u) 1
| szs_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) (Funty (Stem v1) v2) 1
| szs_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) (Funty (Fork w1 w2) w3) 1
| szs_recursion : forall k u v,
    subtype_size omega2_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))) 1
| szs_tree : forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype_size
      (Fork
         (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
               (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
         (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
               (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
      (Funty uty (subst ty uty)) 1
| szs_to_asf : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Asf ty) 1
| szs_from_asf : forall u v, subtype_size (Asf (Funty u v)) (Funty u v) 1
| szs_bffs : forall u v,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug u)) (Asf v)) (Asf (Fork (Stem u) v)) 1
| szs_bfff : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Asf v)) (bfff_aug w)) (Asf (Fork (Fork u v) w)) 1.

Lemma subtype_size_sound : forall S T n, subtype_size S T n -> subtype S T.
Proof.
  intros S T n H. induction H; eauto using subtype.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_has_size : forall S T, subtype S T -> exists n, subtype_size S T n.
Proof.
  intros S T H. induction H.
  - exists 1. apply szs_zero.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_trans; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_stem. exact Hs.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_fork; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_asf. exact Hs.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_funty; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_quant. exact Hs.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_fork.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_dist.
  - exists 1. apply szs_inst.
  - exists 1. apply szs_lift.
  - exists 1. apply szs_leaf_fun.
  - exists 1. apply szs_stem_fun.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_leaf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_leaf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_fork.
  - exists 1. apply szs_recursion.
  - exists 1. eapply szs_tree; eauto.
  - exists 1. apply szs_to_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_from_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_bffs.
  - exists 1. apply szs_bfff.
Qed.

21	| sz_stem : forall u1 u2 (H : subtype u1 u2) n,
22	    subtype_size u1 u2 H n ->

280	Lemma nat_lex_rect (P : nat -> nat -> Prop)
281	  (H : forall n m,
282	      (forall n' m', n' < n -> P n' m') ->
283	      (forall m', m' < m -> P n m') ->
284	      P n m) :
285	  forall n m, P n m.
286	Proof.
287	  intros n.
288	  induction n as [n IHn] using lt_wf_ind.
289	  intros m.
290	  induction m as [m IHm] using lt_wf_ind.
291	  exact (H n m
292	           (fun n' m' Hlt => IHn n' Hlt m')
293	           (fun m' Hlt => IHm m' Hlt)).
294	Qed.

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

3	Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1.
4	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
5	Open Scope string_scope.
6	Open Scope nat_scope.
7	Open Scope tree_scope.

9	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
10	(* de Bruijn/quant helpers                                            *)
11	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
12	
13	Lemma quant_S : forall d t, quant (S d) t = quant d (Quant t).
14	Proof. intros d t. reflexivity. Qed.
15	
16	Lemma quant_Quant : forall d t, quant d (Quant t) = Quant (quant d t).
17	Proof.
18	  induction d as [|d IH]; intro t; simpl.
19	  - reflexivity.
20	  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
21	Qed.
22	
23	Lemma quant_mono : forall d A B, subtype A B -> subtype (quant d A) (quant d B).
24	Proof.
25	  induction d as [|d IH]; intros A B H; simpl.
26	  - exact H.
27	  - apply IH. apply sub_quant. exact H.
28	Qed.
29	
30	(* subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) *)
31	Lemma quant_lift_intro : forall d a,
32	  subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
33	Proof.
34	  intros d a.
35	  change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
36	  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
37	Qed.
38	
39	(* subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a, used for the reverse direction *)
40	Lemma quant_lift_elim_one : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
41	Proof.
42	  exact AgentB.subtype_quant_lift_elim.
43	Qed.
44	
45	(* subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a *)
46	Lemma quant_lift_elim_onek : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a.
47	Proof.
48	  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
49	  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
50	  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
51	Qed.
52	
53	(* subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a) *)
54	Lemma quant_lift_elim : forall d a,
55	  subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
56	Proof.
57	  intros d a.
58	  change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
59	  apply quant_mono. apply quant_lift_elim_one.
60	Qed.
61	
62	(* (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) is below (quant d (Fork a b)) *)
63	Lemma quant_fork_inv : forall d a b,
64	  subtype (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) (quant d (Fork a b)).
65	Proof.
66	  induction d as [|d IH]; intros a b; simpl.
67	  - apply sub_zero.
68	  - rewrite !quant_Quant.
69	    eapply sub_trans.
70	    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))).
71	    + apply sub_quant.
72	      simpl. eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)).
73	      * apply sub_fork.
74	        -- eapply sub_trans.
75	           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
76	           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
77	        -- eapply sub_trans.
78	           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
79	           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
80	      * apply IH.
81	Qed.
82	
83	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
84	(* The Good predicate.                                                *)
85	(*   Good d x (Stem y)      = subtype x (quant d y)                    *)
86	(*   Good d x (Funty a r)   = subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) *)
87	(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
88	(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)
89	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

91	Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
92	  match T with
93	  | Var _ => False
94	  | Leaf => False
95	  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
96	  | Fork _ _ => False
97	  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
98	  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
99	  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
100	  end.

102	(* The two algebraic obligations, isolated.  The leafy hypothesis         *)
103	(* (subtype Leaf x) is kept because it is available in the applications  *)
104	(* and is needed for the Quant/lift corner cases.                        *)
105	Definition Good_lift_obligation : Prop :=
106	  forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> Good d x T ->
107	    Good d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).
108	
109	Definition Good_inst_obligation : Prop :=
110	  forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> Good (S d) x T ->
111	    Good d x (subst T u).

126	    | uty1 uty2 Hs

128	    | vty1 vty2 Hs

132	    | uty vty
133	    | ty u
134	    | ty
135	    | uty
136	    | uty vty
137	    | uty vty
138	    | uty vty wty
139	    | uty vty wty
140	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
141	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
142	    | k uty vty
143	    | ty uty Hcov
144	    | ty
145	    | uty vty
146	    | uty vty
147	    | uty vty wty ];
148	    intros d x Hleaf HP; simpl in *.
149	  - (* zero *) exact HP.
150	  - (* trans *) eauto.
151	  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
152	    + exact HP.
153	    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
154	  - (* fork *) destruct HP.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import Size AgentB NF.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Reachable-head invariant for a Fork source.                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* RF is true on the heads that can be reached from a Fork source:    *)
(* Fork and Funty, or a type whose Asf/Quant spine ends in one of     *)
(* them.  Leaf, Stem and Var are unreachable.                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k n, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k n HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (n := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* recursion *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* tree *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bfff *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma RF_fork : forall C X, RF (Fork C X).
Proof. intros. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype :
  forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof. intros. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply RF_fork. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_leaf : forall S, RF S -> S = Leaf -> False.
Proof. intros S HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_stem : forall S Y, RF S -> S = Stem Y -> False.
Proof. intros S Y HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_var : forall S i, RF S -> S = Var i -> False.
Proof. intros S i HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Status of L3_leaf.                                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* L3_leaf : forall C X a r, subtype Leaf C ->                        *)
(*            subtype (Fork C X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.          *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* RF above eliminates all atomic H branches whose source is Leaf,    *)
(* Stem or Var.  The remaining cut-elimination problem is the          *)
(* interaction of sub_trans on the two derivations.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The size-only measure proposed for the cut-elimination cannot       *)
(* handle both trans cases with the suggested recursive pairs.  With  *)
(* szs_trans sizes n = n1 + n2 + 1:                                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  H = szs_trans H1 H2:                                              *)
(*    K' = szs_trans K H1 has size nK + n1 + 1, H' = H2 has size n2.  *)
(*    The sum nK' + n2 equals nK + nH, and n2 < nH.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  K = szs_trans K1 K2:                                              *)
(*    K' = K1 has size nK1, H' = szs_trans K2 H has size nK2+nH+1.    *)
(*    The sum nK1 + (nK2+nH+1) also equals nK + nH, but the second    *)
(*    component increases.                                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Thus the two recursive calls transfer weight between K and H in    *)
(* opposite directions along the same line nK+nH = const.  No        *)
(* lexicographic order on the size pair alone can decrease for both.  *)
(* A refined measure (or a source-sensitive invariant) is required.   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The exact first blocked atomic subgoal is, in the fork_leaf case   *)
(* with K ending in szs_fork:                                         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*   leafy : subtype Leaf C                                           *)
(*   K1    : subtype_size C Leaf n1                                   *)
(*   K2    : subtype_size X u n2                                      *)
(*   goal  : subtype X u                                              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* which is immediate from K2.  The blocked variant is K ending in    *)
(* szs_trans: one must compose K2 with the fork_leaf target and then  *)
(* recover subtype X u, which is exactly the cut-elimination step     *)
(* above.                                                             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Print Assumptions RF_mono.
Print Assumptions RF_of_fork_subtype.
EOF

  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'

(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.

(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)

(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.

Qed.

Proof.

Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.

(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)

  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.

(* then sub_lift.  We record both facts explicitly; they are also a    *)
(* warning that any finite model omitting the `sub_lift` edge          *)
(* `ty <: Quant (lift 1 ty)` (the direction used here) will report a   *)
(* spurious failure of L2 on this instance.                           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma subtype_quant_leaf_leaf : subtype (Quant Leaf) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply (sub_inst Leaf (Var 0)).
  - vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma L2_premise_instance :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)).
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + eapply sub_trans
        with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)))).
      * apply sub_lift.
      * vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
  - apply sub_dist.
Qed.

(* The conclusion of L2 on that instance is itself derivable.         *)
Lemma L2_instance_conclusion :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_fork.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * exact subtype_quant_leaf_leaf.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans
      with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))).
    + apply sub_lift.
    + vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* If L2 is assumed, the two facts above are consistent; this records  *)
(* that the instance provides no disproof of L2.                       *)
Lemma naive_L2_instance_consistent
  (L2 : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                      subtype (Fork X a) r)
  : subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.
  exact (L2 Leaf (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))
           L2_premise_instance).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule. *)
Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma9 uty9 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)); HF : derive (Node@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| gamma4 uty HS | ]; subst.
  (* HS : Leaf <= Funty u3 u2 ; HI : derive x u3 ;
     HD : y : u1 ; HB : z : u *)
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ; HF : derive ((Node@w)@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HJ : Node : Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HK : w : u4 ; HI : x : u5 *)
  inversion HB as [| gamma7 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HS2? naming; HS3 : Leaf <= u (third Node type) *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z) u ; invert it *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| gamma8 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HI : x : u5 ; HM : z : u3 *)
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z1 @ z2) u *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  inversion HN as [| gamma9 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HO : z1 : u6 ; HM : z2 : u7 *)
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_skeleton :

  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype x (quant d Y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'

Lemma quant_mono : forall d a b, subtype a b -> subtype (quant d a) (quant d b).
Proof.
  induction d; intros a b H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IHd. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_intro : forall d a, subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a. change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

Lemma Q_elim : forall d a, subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a. change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
  apply quant_mono. apply subtype_quant_lift_elim.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* de Bruijn/quant helpers                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_S : forall d t, quant (S d) t = quant d (Quant t).
Proof. intros d t. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma quant_Quant : forall d t, quant d (Quant t) = Quant (quant d t).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intro t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma quant_mono : forall d A B, subtype A B -> subtype (quant d A) (quant d B).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros A B H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) *)
Lemma quant_lift_intro : forall d a,
  subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a, used for the reverse direction *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_one : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  exact AgentB.subtype_quant_lift_elim.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_onek : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a.
Proof.
  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a) *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim : forall d a,
  subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
  apply quant_mono. apply quant_lift_elim_one.
Qed.

(* (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) is below (quant d (Fork a b)) *)
Lemma quant_fork_inv : forall d a b,
  subtype (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) (quant d (Fork a b)).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros a b; simpl.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - rewrite !quant_Quant.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))).
    + apply sub_quant.
      simpl. eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)).
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
      * apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Good predicate.                                                *)
(*   Good d x (Stem y)      = subtype x (quant d y)                    *)
(*   Good d x (Funty a r)   = subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) *)
(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

(* The two algebraic obligations, isolated.  The leafy hypothesis         *)
(* (subtype Leaf x) is kept because it is available in the applications  *)
(* and is needed for the Quant/lift corner cases.                        *)
Definition Good_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> Good d x T ->
    Good d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

Definition Good_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> Good (S d) x T ->
    Good d x (subst T u).

Lemma Good_mono
  (Hlift : Good_lift_obligation)
  (Hinst : Good_inst_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype Leaf x -> subtype T U ->
      Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hleaf Hsub.
  revert d x Hleaf.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
