Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Invariant: a lift-indexed source projection.  The index d counts  *)
(* the Quant binders traversed.  The substitution closure uses the    *)
(* cutoff k together with a side condition k <= d; this is the form   *)
(* needed by sub_inst (k = 0) and preserved by nested Quant.          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1) by lia.
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against   *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Substituting at cutoff k (k <= d) inside lift (S d) X undoes one
   lift, yielding lift d X. *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d ->
    subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
  forall T d j X,
    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitution closure: GoodStem (S d) X T ->                        *)
(*                       GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k),  k <= d.    *)
(* The side condition is preserved by the Quant case, which shifts    *)
(* both k and d by one.  sub_inst is the instance k = 0.              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_subst_gen :
  forall T d X u k,
    k <= d ->
    GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d X u k Hk HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    eapply sub_trans with
      (ty2 := subst_rec (Fork (lift (S d) X) T1) u k).
    + change (subtype (Fork (lift_rec X 0 d) (subst_rec T1 u k))
                      (subst_rec (Fork (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) T1) u k)).
      simpl.
      rewrite (l2_subst_lift_S_eq X u d k Hk).
      apply sub_zero.
    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    eapply sub_trans with
      (ty2 := subst_rec (lift (S d) X) u k).
    + change (subtype (lift_rec X 0 d)
                      (subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k)).
      rewrite (l2_subst_lift_S_eq X u d k Hk).
      apply sub_zero.
    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hk|exact HG].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Monotonicity of GoodStem along subtype.                            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d X, GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem d X U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H; intros d X HG; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HG.
  - (* trans *) apply (IHsubtype2 d X). apply (IHsubtype1 d X). exact HG.
  - (* stem *) exact (sub_trans _ _ _ HG H).
  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* asf *) apply (IHsubtype d X). exact HG.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (lift d X) uty1).
    + apply (sub_fork (lift d X) (lift d X) uty2 uty1 (sub_zero _) H).
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HG | exact H0].
  - (* quant *) apply (IHsubtype (S d) X). exact HG.
  - (* quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (lift d X))).
    + apply sub_lift.
    + rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* dist *) apply (l2_dist d X uty vty). exact HG.
  - (* inst *)
    change (GoodStem d X (subst_rec ty u 0)).
    apply (GoodStem_subst_gen ty d X u 0); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* lift *)
    change (GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
    apply (GoodStem_lift_gen ty d 0 X); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    apply (sub_fork (lift d X) uty vty vty HG (sub_zero _)).
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HG. cbn in HG. destruct HG.
  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Main theorem.                                                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma l2_lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros k; simpl.
  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
    destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl; reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma l2_lift_zero : forall X, lift 0 X = X.
Proof. intro X. unfold lift. apply l2_lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.

Lemma GoodStem_initial : forall X, GoodStem 0 X (Stem X).
Proof.
  intro X. simpl. rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma L2_literal :
  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  pose proof (GoodStem_mono (Stem X) (Funty a r) H 0 X
                (GoodStem_initial X)) as HG.
  simpl in HG. rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG. exact HG.
Qed.

Print Assumptions L2_literal.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.
...

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Monotonicity of GoodStem along subtype.                            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d X, GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem d X U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H; intros d X HG; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HG.
  - (* trans *) apply (IHsubtype2 d X). apply (IHsubtype1 d X). exact HG.
  - (* stem *) exact (sub_trans _ _ _ HG H).
  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* asf *) apply (IHsubtype d X). exact HG.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (lift d X) uty1).
    + apply (sub_fork (lift d X) (lift d X) uty2 uty1 (sub_zero _) H).
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HG | exact H0].
  - (* quant *) apply (IHsubtype (S d) X). exact HG.
  - (* quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (lift d X))).
    + apply sub_lift.
    + rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* dist *) apply (l2_dist d X uty vty). exact HG.
  - (* inst *)
    change (GoodStem d X (subst_rec ty u 0)).
    apply (GoodStem_subst_gen ty d X u 0); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* lift *)
    change (GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
    apply (GoodStem_lift_gen ty d 0 X); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    apply (sub_fork (lift d X) uty vty vty HG (sub_zero _)).
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HG. cbn in HG. destruct HG.
  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Main theorem.                                                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* lift 0 X = X (the `test` inside relocate is stuck on a variable,   *)
(* so this needs a small induction).                                  *)
Lemma l2_lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros k; simpl.
  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
    destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl; reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma l2_lift_zero : forall X, lift 0 X = X.
Proof. intro X. unfold lift. apply l2_lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.

Lemma GoodStem_initial : forall X, GoodStem 0 X (Stem X).
Proof.
  intro X. simpl. rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma L2_literal :
  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  pose proof (GoodStem_mono (Stem X) (Funty a r) H 0 X
                (GoodStem_initial X)) as HG.
  simpl in HG. rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG. exact HG.
Qed.

Print Assumptions L2_literal.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty HS | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [gamma4 x0 uty2 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty2 HS2 | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.

(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

27	Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
28	  match T with
29	  | Var i => Var i
30	  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
31	  | Funty _ r => r
32	  | Leaf => Leaf
33	  | Stem u => u
34	  | Fork _ v => v

39	Lemma extr_lift_rec :
40	  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
41	Proof.
42	  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
43	  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
44	  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
45	  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
46	  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.

57	(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
58	(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
59	(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)

62	Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
63	  match T with
64	  | Var _ => False
65	  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
66	  | Funty _ _ => True
67	  | Leaf => False
68	  | Stem _ => False
69	  | Fork u _ => R u
70	  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
71	  end.

73	Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
74	Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.

77	  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
78	Proof.
79	  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
80	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
81	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
82	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
83	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
84	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.

90	  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
91	Proof.

93	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
94	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
95	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
96	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
97	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.

103	(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)

105	(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
106	Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
107	  forall T u k,
108	    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
109	Proof.

122	  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
123	Proof.
124	  intros T U H.
125	  induction H as
126	    [ ty
127	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
128	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
129	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
130	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
131	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
132	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
133	    | u
134	    | u v
135	    | u
136	    | u v
137	    | ty u
138	    | ty
139	    | uty
140	    | uty vty
141	    | uty vty
142	    | uty vty wty
143	    | uty vty wty
144	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
145	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
146	    | k uty vty
147	    | ty uty Hcov
148	    | ty
149	    | uty vty
150	    | uty vty
151	    | uty vty wty ];

153	  - (* zero *) exact HR.
154	  - (* trans *) eauto.
155	  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
156	  - (* fork *) eapply R_mono; eauto.
157	  - (* asf *) eauto.
158	  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
159	  - (* quant *) eauto.
160	  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
161	  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.
162	  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
163	  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
164	  - (* inst *) apply ReachFork_subst_rec with (u := u) (k := 0). exact HR.
165	  - (* lift *) apply ReachFork_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
166	  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
167	  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.

170	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
171	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
172	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.

174	  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
175	  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
176	  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
177	  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
178	  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.

253	(* now only bookkeeping: the invariant proof is independent of them.   *)

256	Lemma L3_literal_aux :
257	  forall p : {n : nat & nat},
258	    (forall S a r X nH nK,
259	        subtype_size S (Funty a r) nH ->
260	        subtype_size (Fork Leaf X) S nK ->
261	        p = existT (fun _ : nat => nat) (nK + nH + 1) nH ->

265	  pose proof (subtype_size_sound _ _ _ HK) as HKsub.
266	  pose proof (subtype_size_sound _ _ _ HH) as HHsub.
267	  pose proof (ReachFork_fork_leaf X) as HR.
268	  pose proof (extr_mono_reach _ _ HKsub HR) as HX.
269	  pose proof (ReachFork_mono _ _ HKsub HR) as HS.
270	  pose proof (extr_mono_reach _ _ HHsub HS) as Hr.
271	  eapply sub_trans.
272	  - exact HX.
273	  - exact Hr.
274	Qed.

276	Lemma L3_literal :

281	  exact (L3_literal_aux
282	           (existT (fun _ : nat => nat) (1 + nH + 1) nH)
283	           (Fork Leaf X) a r X nH 1 HnH (szs_zero (Fork Leaf X)) eq_refl).
284	Qed.

85	(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
86	(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
87	(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                    *)
88	(* ================================================================== *)
89	
90	Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
91	  forall T d j X,
92	    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
93	Proof.
94	  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
95	  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
96	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
97	  - (* Funty *)
98	    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
99	    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
100	    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
101	    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
102	    exact Hlift.
103	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
104	  - (* Stem *)
105	    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
106	    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
107	    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
108	    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
109	    exact Hlift.
110	  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
111	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
112	Qed.
113	
114	(* ================================================================== *)
115	(* Substitution closure:                                              *)
116	(*   k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).  *)
117	(* The condition k <= d is propagated by the Quant case (both become  *)
118	(* S k and S d), and is exactly what makes the pure lift/subst        *)
119	(* identity hold.                                                     *)
120	(* ================================================================== *)
121	
122	Lemma GoodStem_subst_gen :
123	  forall T d X u k,
124	    k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).
125	Proof.
126	  induction T; intros d X u k Hk HG; simpl in *.
127	  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
128	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (d := S d) (k := S k); [lia|exact HG].
129	  - (* Funty *)
130	    eapply sub_trans with
131	      (ty2 := subst_rec (Fork (lift (S d) X) T1) u k).
132	    + change (subtype (Fork (lift_rec X 0 d) (subst_rec T1 u k))
133	                      (subst_rec (Fork (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) T1) u k)).
134	      simpl.
135	      rewrite l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen by lia.
136	      apply sub_zero.
137	    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
138	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
139	  - (* Stem *)
140	    eapply sub_trans with
141	      (ty2 := subst_rec (lift (S d) X) u k).
142	    + change (subtype (lift_rec X 0 d)
143	                      (subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k)).
144	      rewrite l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen by lia.
145	      apply sub_zero.
146	    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
147	  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
148	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (d := d) (k := k); [exact Hk|exact HG].
149	Qed.
150	
151	(* ================================================================== *)
152	(* Monotonicity of GoodStem along subtype.                            *)
153	(* ================================================================== *)
154	
155	Lemma GoodStem_mono :
156	  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d X, GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem d X U.
157	Proof.
158	  intros T U H.
159	  induction H; intros d X HG; simpl in *.
160	  - (* zero *) exact HG.
161	  - (* trans *) apply (IHsubtype2 d X). apply (IHsubtype1 d X). exact HG.
162	  - (* stem *) exact (sub_trans _ _ _ HG H).
163	  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
164	  - (* asf *) apply (IHsubtype d X). exact HG.
165	  - (* funty *)
166	    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (lift d X) uty1).
167	    + apply (sub_fork (lift d X) (lift d X) uty2 uty1 (sub_zero _) H).
168	    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HG | exact H0].
169	  - (* quant *) apply (IHsubtype (S d) X). exact HG.
170	  - (* quant_stem *)
171	    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (lift d X))).
172	    + apply sub_lift.
173	    + rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. apply sub_quant. exact HG.
174	  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
175	  - (* quant_asf *) exact HG.
176	  - (* dist *) apply (l2_dist d X uty vty). exact HG.
177	  - (* inst *)
178	    change (GoodStem d X (subst_rec ty u 0)).
179	    apply (GoodStem_subst_gen ty d X u 0); [lia|exact HG].
180	  - (* lift *)
181	    change (GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
182	    apply (GoodStem_lift_gen ty d 0 X); [lia|exact HG].
183	  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
184	  - (* stem_fun *)
185	    apply (sub_fork (lift d X) uty vty vty HG (sub_zero _)).
186	  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
187	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
188	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
189	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
190	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
191	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HG. cbn in HG. destruct HG.
192	  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
193	  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
194	  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
195	  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
196	  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.
197	Qed.
198	
199	(* ================================================================== *)
200	(* Main theorem.                                                      *)
201	(* ================================================================== *)
202	
203	(* lift 0 X = X (the `test` inside relocate is stuck on a variable,   *)
204	(* so this needs a small induction).                                  *)
205	Lemma l2_lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
206	Proof.
207	  induction x; intros k; simpl.
208	  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
209	    destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl; reflexivity.
210	  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHx.
211	  - (* Funty *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
212	  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
213	  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
214	  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
215	  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
216	Qed.
217	
218	Lemma l2_lift_zero : forall X, lift 0 X = X.
219	Proof. intro X. unfold lift. apply l2_lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.
220	
221	Lemma GoodStem_initial : forall X, GoodStem 0 X (Stem X).
222	Proof.
223	  intro X. simpl. rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero.
224	Qed.

226	Lemma L2_literal :
227	  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
228	Proof.
229	  intros X a r H.
230	  pose proof (GoodStem_mono (Stem X) (Funty a r) H 0 X
231	                (GoodStem_initial X)) as HG.
232	  simpl in HG. rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG. exact HG.
233	Qed.

9	(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
10	(*                                                                    *)
11	(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
12	(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
13	(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
14	(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
15	(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
16	(*                                                                    *)
17	(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
18	(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
19	(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
20	(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
21	(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
22	(* ================================================================== *)
23	
24	(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
25	(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
26	(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
27	Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
28	  match T with
29	  | Var i => Var i
30	  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
31	  | Funty _ r => r
32	  | Leaf => Leaf
33	  | Stem u => u
34	  | Fork _ v => v
35	  | Asf T' => extr T'
36	  end.
37	
38	(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
39	Lemma extr_lift_rec :
40	  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
41	Proof.
42	  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
43	  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
44	  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
45	  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
46	  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
47	  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
48	  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
49	  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
50	Qed.
51	
52	(* ================================================================== *)
53	(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
54	(*                                                                    *)
55	(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
56	(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
57	(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
58	(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
59	(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
60	(* ================================================================== *)
61	
62	Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
63	  match T with
64	  | Var _ => False
65	  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
66	  | Funty _ _ => True
67	  | Leaf => False
68	  | Stem _ => False
69	  | Fork u _ => R u
70	  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
71	  end.
72	
73	Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
74	Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.
75	
76	Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
77	  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
78	Proof.
79	  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
80	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
81	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
82	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
83	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
84	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
85	  - (* Fork *) apply R_subst_rec. exact HR.
86	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
87	Qed.

89	Lemma ReachFork_lift_rec :
90	  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
91	Proof.
92	  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
93	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
94	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
95	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
96	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
97	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
98	  - (* Fork *) apply R_lift_rec. exact HR.
99	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
100	Qed.

102	(* On the ReachFork fragment, extr commutes with substitution with    *)
103	(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)
104	(* e.g. extr (Fork A B) = B, and substituting in the discarded first  *)
105	(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
106	Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
107	  forall T u k,
108	    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
109	Proof.

111	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
112	  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHT. exact HR.
113	  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
114	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
115	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
116	  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
117	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
118	Qed.

122	  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
123	Proof.

125	  induction H as
126	    [ ty
127	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
128	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
129	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
130	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
131	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
132	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
133	    | u
134	    | u v
135	    | u
136	    | u v
137	    | ty u
138	    | ty
139	    | uty
140	    | uty vty
141	    | uty vty
142	    | uty vty wty
143	    | uty vty wty

147	    | ty uty Hcov
148	    | ty
149	    | uty vty
150	    | uty vty

154	  - (* trans *) eauto.
155	  - (* stem *) destruct HR.

157	  - (* asf *) eauto.

161	  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.

163	  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.

167	  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
168	  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
169	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
170	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
171	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
172	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
173	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
174	  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
175	  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
176	  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
177	  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
178	  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
179	Qed.

183	(* ================================================================== *)

185	Lemma extr_mono_reach :
186	  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> subtype (extr T) (extr U).
187	Proof.

189	  induction H as
190	    [ ty
191	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
192	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
193	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
194	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
195	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
196	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
197	    | u
198	    | u v
199	    | u
200	    | u v
201	    | ty u
202	    | ty
203	    | uty
204	    | uty vty
205	    | uty vty
206	    | uty vty wty
207	    | uty vty wty
208	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
209	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
210	    | k uty vty
211	    | ty uty Hcov
212	    | ty
213	    | uty vty
214	    | uty vty
215	    | uty vty wty ];

218	  - (* trans *) eauto using sub_trans, ReachFork_mono.
219	  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
220	  - (* fork *) assumption.

222	  - (* funty *) assumption.

238	  - (* fork_leaf *) apply sub_zero.
239	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
240	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
241	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
242	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
243	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
244	  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
245	  - (* to_asf *) apply sub_zero.
246	  - (* from_asf *) apply sub_zero.
247	  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.

256	Lemma L3_literal_aux :
257	  forall p : {n : nat & nat},
258	    (forall S a r X nH nK,
259	        subtype_size S (Funty a r) nH ->
260	        subtype_size (Fork Leaf X) S nK ->

8	(* A size-annotated version of the subtype relation, used for well-founded
9	   recursion on pairs of derivations.  It mirrors subtypes.v exactly. *)
10	Inductive subtype_size : dtype -> dtype -> nat -> Prop :=
11	| szs_zero : forall ty, subtype_size ty ty 1
12	| szs_trans : forall a b c n m,
13	    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size b c m ->
14	    subtype_size a c (n + m + 1)
15	| szs_stem : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
16	    subtype_size (Stem a) (Stem b) (S n)
17	| szs_fork : forall a b c d n m,
18	    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size c d m ->
19	    subtype_size (Fork a c) (Fork b d) (n + m + 1)
20	| szs_asf : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
21	    subtype_size (Asf a) (Asf b) (S n)
22	| szs_funty : forall a b c d n m,
23	    subtype_size b a n -> subtype_size c d m ->
24	    subtype_size (Funty a c) (Funty b d) (n + m + 1)
25	| szs_quant : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
26	    subtype_size (Quant a) (Quant b) (S n)
27	| szs_quant_stem : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Stem u)) (Stem (Quant u)) 1
28	| szs_quant_fork : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Fork u v)) (Fork (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
29	| szs_quant_asf : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Asf u)) (Asf (Quant u)) 1
30	| szs_dist : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Funty u v)) (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
31	| szs_inst : forall ty u, subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) 1
32	| szs_lift : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) 1
33	| szs_leaf_fun : forall u, subtype_size Leaf (Funty u (Stem u)) 1
34	| szs_stem_fun : forall u v, subtype_size (Stem u) (Funty v (Fork u v)) 1
35	| szs_fork_leaf : forall u v, subtype_size (Fork Leaf u) (Funty v u) 1
36	| szs_fork_stem : forall u v w,
37	    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) (Funty u w) 1
38	| szs_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w,
39	    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) w) (Funty Leaf u) 1
40	| szs_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w,
41	    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) (Funty (Stem v1) v2) 1
42	| szs_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3,
43	    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) (Funty (Fork w1 w2) w3) 1
44	| szs_recursion : forall k u v,
45	    subtype_size omega2_ty
46	      (Funty omega2_ty
47	        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
48	               (quant k (Funty u v)))) 1
49	| szs_tree : forall ty uty,
50	    covariant ty ->
51	    subtype_size
52	      (Fork
53	         (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
54	               (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
55	         (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
56	               (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
57	      (Funty uty (subst ty uty)) 1
58	| szs_to_asf : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Asf ty) 1
59	| szs_from_asf : forall u v, subtype_size (Asf (Funty u v)) (Funty u v) 1
60	| szs_bffs : forall u v,
61	    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug u)) (Asf v)) (Asf (Fork (Stem u) v)) 1
62	| szs_bfff : forall u v w,
63	    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Asf v)) (bfff_aug w)) (Asf (Fork (Fork u v) w)) 1.
64	
65	Lemma subtype_size_sound : forall S T n, subtype_size S T n -> subtype S T.
66	Proof.
67	  intros S T n H. induction H; eauto using subtype.
68	Qed.
69	
70	Lemma subtype_has_size : forall S T, subtype S T -> exists n, subtype_size S T n.
71	Proof.
72	  intros S T H. induction H.
73	  - exists 1. apply szs_zero.
74	  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
75	    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_trans; eauto.
76	  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_stem. exact Hs.
77	  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
78	    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_fork; eauto.
79	  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_asf. exact Hs.
80	  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
81	    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_funty; eauto.
82	  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_quant. exact Hs.
83	  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_stem.
84	  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_fork.
85	  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_asf.
86	  - exists 1. apply szs_dist.
87	  - exists 1. apply szs_inst.
88	  - exists 1. apply szs_lift.
89	  - exists 1. apply szs_leaf_fun.
90	  - exists 1. apply szs_stem_fun.
91	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_leaf.
92	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_stem.
93	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_leaf.
94	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_stem.
95	  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_fork.
96	  - exists 1. apply szs_recursion.
97	  - exists 1. eapply szs_tree; eauto.
98	  - exists 1. apply szs_to_asf.
99	  - exists 1. apply szs_from_asf.
100	  - exists 1. apply szs_bffs.
101	  - exists 1. apply szs_bfff.
102	Qed.

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
2	Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
3	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
4	Open Scope string_scope.
5	Open Scope nat_scope.
6	Open Scope tree_scope.
7	
8	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
9	(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
10	(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
11	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
12	
13	Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
14	  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
15	Proof.
16	  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
17	  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
18	  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
19	    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
20	  - apply derive_node.
21	    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
22	  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
23	    + apply IHHd1.
24	      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
25	    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
26	Qed.
27	
28	Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
29	  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
30	Proof.
31	  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
32	  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
33	Qed.
34	
35	Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
36	  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
37	Proof.
38	  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
39	  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
40	Qed.
41	
42	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
43	(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
44	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
45	
46	Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
47	  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
48	Proof.
49	  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
50	  - (* Var n *)
51	    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
52	    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
53	      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
54	      f_equal; lia.
55	    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
56	      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
57	      reflexivity.
58	  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
59	  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
60	  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
61	  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
62	  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
63	  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
64	Qed.
65	
66	Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
67	  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
68	Proof.
69	  induction a; intros u; simpl.
70	  - (* Var n *)
71	    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
72	    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
73	      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
74	      f_equal; lia.
75	    + lia.
76	  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
77	  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
78	  - reflexivity.
79	  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
80	  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
81	  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
82	Qed.
83	
84	Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
85	Proof.
86	  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
87	  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0.
88	Qed.

90	(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
91	Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
92	  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
93	Proof.
94	  intros a.
95	  eapply sub_trans.
96	  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
97	  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
98	Qed.
99	
100	Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
101	  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
102	Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.
103	
104	(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
105	Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
106	  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
107	Proof.
108	  intros a b H.
109	  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
110	Qed.
111	
112	Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
113	  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
114	Proof.
115	  intros a b H.
116	  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
117	Qed.
118	
119	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
120	(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
121	(*                                                                    *)
122	(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
123	(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
124	(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
125	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
126	
127	Lemma k_head_case
128	  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
129	      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
130	      subtype Leaf a ->
131	      subtype b d)
132	  : forall gamma y z ty,
133	      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
134	Proof.
135	  intros gamma y z ty H.
136	  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
137	  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
138	  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
139	  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
140	  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
141	  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
142	  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
143	     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
144	  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
145	  eapply inv; eauto.
146	Qed.
147	
148	(* ================================================================== *)
149	(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
150	(*                                                                    *)
151	(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
152	(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
153	(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
154	(* ================================================================== *)
155	
156	Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
157	| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
158	| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
159	| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
160	| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
161	| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
162	    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
163	    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
164	| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
165	    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
166	    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
167	| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
168	    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
169	    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
170	| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
171	    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
172	    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
173	| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
174	    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
175	| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
176	    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
177	| app_recursion : forall k u v,
178	    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
179	        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
180	               (quant k (Funty u v)))
181	| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
182	    App (Fork
183	           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
184	                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
185	           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
186	        uty (subst ty uty)
187	| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
188	| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.
189	
190	(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)
191	
192	Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
193	Proof.
194	  intros S a r H.
195	  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
196	  revert a r ET.
197	  induction H as
198	    [ ty
199	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
200	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
201	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
202	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
203	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
204	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
205	    | uty
206	    | uty vty
207	    | uty
208	    | uty vty
209	    | ty u
210	    | ty
211	    | uty
212	    | uty vty
213	    | uty vty
214	    | uty vty wty
215	    | uty vty wty
216	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
217	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
218	    | k uty vty
219	    | ty uty Hcov
220	    | ty
221	    | uty vty
222	    | uty vty
223	    | uty vty wty ];
224	    intros a0 r0 ET.
225	  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
226	  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
227	  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
228	  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
229	  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
230	  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
231	  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
232	  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
233	  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
234	  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
235	  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
236	  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
237	  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
238	  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
239	  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
240	  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
241	  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
242	    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
243	  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
244	    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
245	  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
246	    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
247	  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
248	    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
249	  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
250	  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
251	  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
252	  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
253	  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
254	  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
255	Qed.

259	Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
260	Proof.
261	  intros S a r H. induction H.
262	  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
263	    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
264	    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
265	  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
266	    + apply sub_stem_fun.
267	    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
268	  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
269	  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
270	    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
271	    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
272	  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
273	    + apply sub_fork_stem.
274	    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
275	  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
276	    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
277	    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
278	  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
279	    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
280	    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
281	  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
282	    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
283	    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
284	  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
285	  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
286	  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
287	  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
288	  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
289	  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
290	Qed.

293	(* 5. Target-only predicate architecture (coordinator's plan).        *)
294	(*                                                                    *)
295	(* P_leaf is defined by structural recursion on the TARGET type:      *)
296	(*   Funty a r  |-> subtype (Stem a) r                               *)
297	(*   Leaf       |-> True                                              *)
298	(*   Asf T      |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
299	(*   Quant T    |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
300	(*   Stem/Fork/Var |-> False                                          *)
301	(*                                                                    *)
302	(* All monotonicity cases of P_leaf along subtype are structural      *)
303	(* except three shape obligations, isolated as hypotheses below.      *)
304	(* The dist obligation is now discharged unconditionally in Section   *)
305	(* 10 (subtype_stem_quant_dist); only Hlift and Hinst remain.         *)
306	(* ================================================================== *)
307	
308	Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=
309	  match T with
310	  | Var _ => False
311	  | Leaf => True
312	  | Stem _ => False
313	  | Fork _ _ => False
314	  | Asf T' => P_leaf T'
315	  | Quant T' => P_leaf T'
316	  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
317	  end.

323	  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
324	  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
325	Proof.
326	  intros T U H.
327	  induction H as
328	    [ ty
329	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
330	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
331	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
332	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
333	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
334	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
335	    | u
336	    | u v
337	    | u
338	    | u v
339	    | ty u
340	    | ty
341	    | uty
342	    | uty vty
343	    | uty vty
344	    | uty vty wty
345	    | uty vty wty
346	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
347	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
348	    | k uty vty
349	    | ty uty Hcov
350	    | ty
351	    | uty vty
352	    | uty vty
353	    | uty vty wty ];
354	    intros HP; simpl in *.
355	  - (* zero *) exact HP.
356	  - (* trans *) eauto.
357	  - (* stem *) destruct HP.
358	  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
359	  - (* asf *) eauto.
360	  - (* funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_trans; [ apply sub_stem; exact Hs1 | exact HP ] | exact H ].
361	  - (* quant *) eauto.

366	  - (* inst *) apply Hinst. exact HP.

370	  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
371	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
372	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
373	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
374	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
375	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. destruct HP.
376	  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
377	  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
378	  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
379	  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
380	  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.

464	(* 6. A structural "head/safety" invariant Q that is unconditionally   *)
465	(*    monotone along subtype and stable under substitution and lift.   *)
466	(*                                                                    *)
467	(* Q forbids Fork at the head and recursively under Quant, and forbids *)
468	(* Var.  This is exactly the guard needed for the substitution lemma:  *)
469	(* the rules with Fork sources (sub_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,        *)
470	(* sub_bfff) and sub_recursion become vacuous, while all other rules   *)
471	(* preserve Q.                                                         *)

475	  match T with
476	  | Var _ => False
477	  | Leaf => True
478	  | Stem _ => True
479	  | Fork _ _ => False
480	  | Asf _ => True
481	  | Funty _ _ => True
482	  | Quant T' => Q T'
483	  end.

569	(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
570	(*                                                                    *)
571	(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
572	(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
573	(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
574	(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
575	(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)

579	  match T with
580	  | Var _ => False
581	  | Leaf => True
582	  | Stem _ => False
583	  | Fork _ _ => False
584	  | Asf T' => R T'
585	  | Quant T' => R T'
586	  | Funty _ _ => True

699	(* 8. Strong soundness of App for a Leaf-reachable source.             *)
700	(*                                                                    *)
701	(* All Stem/Fork/recursion/tree source cases are eliminated by the      *)
702	(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
703	(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
704	(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
705	(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
706	(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
707	(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
708	(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
709	(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
710	(* ================================================================== *)
711	
712	Lemma app_strong_leaf
713	  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
714	  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
715	                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
716	  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
717	Proof.
718	  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
719	  revert Hleaf.
720	  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
721	  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
722	  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
723	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
724	  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
725	    eapply sub_trans.
726	    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
727	    + eapply sub_trans.
728	      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
729	      * exact H2.
730	  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
731	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
732	  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
733	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
734	  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
735	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
736	  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
737	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
738	  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
739	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
740	  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
741	    apply L1.
742	    eapply sub_trans.
743	    + exact Hleaf0.
744	    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
745	  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
746	    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
747	  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
748	    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
749	  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
750	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
751	  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
752	    apply L1.
753	    eapply sub_trans.
754	    + exact Hleaf0.
755	    + apply sub_from_asf.
756	  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
757	    apply IH.
758	    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
759	  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
760	Qed.

11	Lemma app_strong_leaf
12	  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
13	  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
14	                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
15	  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
16	Proof.
17	  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
18	  revert Hleaf.
19	  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
20	  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
21	  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
22	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
23	  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
24	    eapply sub_trans.
25	    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
26	    + eapply sub_trans.
27	      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
28	      * exact H2.
29	  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
30	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
31	  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
32	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
33	  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
34	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.

37	  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
38	    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
39	  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
40	    apply L1.
41	    eapply sub_trans.
42	    + exact Hleaf0.
43	    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
44	  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma inv_k :
  forall a b c d,
    subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
    subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Proof.
  intros a b c d H Ha.
  apply (L3_leaf a b c d Ha).
  apply (L2_literal a b (Funty c d)).
  apply (L1 a (Funty b (Funty c d))).
  exact H.
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_k.
====
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule. *)
Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma9 uty9 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)); HF : derive (Node@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| gamma4 uty HS | ]; subst.
  (* HS : Leaf <= Funty u3 u2 ; HI : derive x u3 ;
     HD : y : u1 ; HB : z : u *)
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ; HF : derive ((Node@w)@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HJ : Node : Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HK : w : u4 ; HI : x : u5 *)
  inversion HB as [| gamma7 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HS2? naming; HS3 : Leaf <= u (third Node type) *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z) u ; invert it *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| gamma8 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HI : x : u5 ; HM : z : u3 *)
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z1 @ z2) u *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  inversion HN as [| gamma9 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HO : z1 : u6 ; HM : z2 : u7 *)
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_skeleton :
  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros IK IS IL IST IF gamma M ty D.
  induction D; intros N HR.
