Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty HS | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [gamma4 x0 uty2 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty2 HS2 | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma9 x0 uty9 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma9 uty9 HS0 | gamma9 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [gamma4 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty HS | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma5 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma5 uty HS1 | gamma5 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HB) as HS3.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma6 x0 uty6 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma6 uty6 HS1 | gamma6 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HL) as HS3.
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma6 x0 uty6 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma6 uty6 HS1 | gamma6 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HN) as HS3.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_conditional :
  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros IK IS IL IST IF gamma M ty D.
  induction D; intros Nred HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR as [y z | x y z | w x y | w x y z | w x y z1 z2 | M0 M0' N0 H0 | M1 N1 N1' H1]; subst.
    + (* k_red *) eapply (red_k IK). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].
    + (* s_red *) eapply (red_s IS). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].
    + (* leaf_red *) eapply (red_leaf IL). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].
    + (* stem_red *) eapply (red_stem IST). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].
    + (* fork_red *) eapply (red_fork IF). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].
    + eapply derive_app; [ apply IHD1; exact H0 | exact D2 ].
    + eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | apply IHD2; exact H1 ].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_conditional.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A size relation for subtype derivations, and lexicographic         *)
(* well-founded induction on a pair of derivations.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtype_size : forall S T, subtype S T -> nat -> Prop :=
| sz_zero : forall ty,
    subtype_size ty ty (sub_zero ty) 1
| sz_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3
    (H12 : subtype ty1 ty2) (H23 : subtype ty2 ty3) n12 n23,
    subtype_size ty1 ty2 H12 n12 ->
    subtype_size ty2 ty3 H23 n23 ->
    subtype_size ty1 ty3 (sub_trans ty1 ty2 ty3 H12 H23) (S (n12 + n23))
| sz_stem : forall u1 u2 (H : subtype u1 u2) n,
    subtype_size u1 u2 H n ->
    subtype_size (Stem u1) (Stem u2) (sub_stem u1 u2 H) (S n)
| sz_fork : forall u1 u2 v1 v2
    (H1 : subtype u1 u2) (H2 : subtype v1 v2) n1 n2,
    subtype_size u1 u2 H1 n1 ->
    subtype_size v1 v2 H2 n2 ->
    subtype_size (Fork u1 v1) (Fork u2 v2)
      (sub_fork u1 u2 v1 v2 H1 H2) (S (n1 + n2))
| sz_asf : forall u1 u2 (H : subtype u1 u2) n,
    subtype_size u1 u2 H n ->
    subtype_size (Asf u1) (Asf u2) (sub_asf u1 u2 H) (S n)
| sz_funty : forall u1 u2 v1 v2
    (Hdom : subtype u2 u1) (Hcod : subtype v1 v2) n1 n2,
    subtype_size u2 u1 Hdom n1 ->
    subtype_size v1 v2 Hcod n2 ->
    subtype_size (Funty u1 v1) (Funty u2 v2)
      (sub_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 Hdom Hcod) (S (n1 + n2))
| sz_quant : forall v1 v2 (H : subtype v1 v2) n,
    subtype_size v1 v2 H n ->
    subtype_size (Quant v1) (Quant v2) (sub_quant v1 v2 H) (S n)
| sz_quant_stem : forall uty,
    subtype_size (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
      (sub_quant_stem uty) 1
| sz_quant_fork : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
      (sub_quant_fork uty vty) 1
| sz_quant_asf : forall uty,
    subtype_size (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
      (sub_quant_asf uty) 1
| sz_dist : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
      (sub_dist uty vty) 1
| sz_inst : forall ty u,
    subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) (sub_inst ty u) 1
| sz_lift : forall ty,
    subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) (sub_lift ty) 1
| sz_leaf_fun : forall uty,
    subtype_size Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty)) (sub_leaf_fun uty) 1
| sz_stem_fun : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))
      (sub_stem_fun uty vty) 1
| sz_fork_leaf : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
      (sub_fork_leaf uty vty) 1
| sz_fork_stem : forall uty vty wty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty))
      (Funty uty wty) (sub_fork_stem uty vty wty) 1
| sz_fork_fork_leaf : forall uty vty wty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
      (sub_fork_fork_leaf uty vty wty) 1
| sz_fork_fork_stem : forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty)
      (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
      (sub_fork_fork_stem uty vty1 vty2 wty) 1
| sz_fork_fork_fork : forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3)))
      (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)
      (sub_fork_fork_fork uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3) 1
| sz_recursion : forall k uty vty,
    subtype_size omega2_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty
          (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
          (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
      (sub_recursion k uty vty) 1
| sz_tree : forall ty uty (Hcov : covariant ty),
    subtype_size
      (Fork
        (Fork
          (subst ty Leaf)
          (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
        (quant 2
          (Funty (Var 1)
            (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
      (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
      (sub_tree ty uty Hcov) 1
| sz_to_asf : forall ty,
    subtype_size ty (Asf ty) (sub_to_asf ty) 1
| sz_from_asf : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
      (sub_from_asf uty vty) 1
| sz_bffs : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty))
      (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty)) (sub_bffs uty vty) 1
| sz_bfff : forall uty vty wty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
      (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty)) (sub_bfff uty vty wty) 1.

Fixpoint subtype_size_exists_aux (A B : dtype) (H : subtype A B)
    {struct H} : exists n, subtype_size A B H n :=
  match H as H0 in subtype S0 T0
        return exists n, subtype_size S0 T0 H0 n with
  | sub_zero ty => @ex_intro nat (fun n => subtype_size ty ty (sub_zero ty) n)
                      1 (sz_zero ty)
  | sub_trans ty1 ty2 ty3 H12 H23 =>
      let (n12, s12) := subtype_size_exists_aux ty1 ty2 H12 in
      let (n23, s23) := subtype_size_exists_aux ty2 ty3 H23 in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size ty1 ty3
                    (sub_trans ty1 ty2 ty3 H12 H23) n)
        (S (n12 + n23))
        (sz_trans ty1 ty2 ty3 H12 H23 n12 n23 s12 s23)
  | sub_stem u1 u2 H =>
      let (n, sn) := subtype_size_exists_aux u1 u2 H in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n0 => subtype_size (Stem u1) (Stem u2)
                    (sub_stem u1 u2 H) n0)
        (S n) (sz_stem u1 u2 H n sn)
  | sub_fork u1 u2 v1 v2 H1 H2 =>
      let (n1, s1) := subtype_size_exists_aux u1 u2 H1 in
      let (n2, s2) := subtype_size_exists_aux v1 v2 H2 in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork u1 v1) (Fork u2 v2)
                    (sub_fork u1 u2 v1 v2 H1 H2) n)
        (S (n1 + n2)) (sz_fork u1 u2 v1 v2 H1 H2 n1 n2 s1 s2)
  | sub_asf u1 u2 H =>
      let (n, sn) := subtype_size_exists_aux u1 u2 H in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n0 => subtype_size (Asf u1) (Asf u2)
                    (sub_asf u1 u2 H) n0)
        (S n) (sz_asf u1 u2 H n sn)
  | sub_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 Hdom Hcod =>
      let (nd, sd) := subtype_size_exists_aux u2 u1 Hdom in
      let (nc, sc) := subtype_size_exists_aux v1 v2 Hcod in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Funty u1 v1) (Funty u2 v2)
                    (sub_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 Hdom Hcod) n)
        (S (nd + nc))
        (sz_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 Hdom Hcod nd nc sd sc)
  | sub_quant v1 v2 H =>
      let (n, sn) := subtype_size_exists_aux v1 v2 H in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n0 => subtype_size (Quant v1) (Quant v2)
                    (sub_quant v1 v2 H) n0)
        (S n) (sz_quant v1 v2 H n sn)
  | sub_quant_stem uty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
                    (sub_quant_stem uty) n)
        1 (sz_quant_stem uty)
  | sub_quant_fork uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant (Fork uty vty))
                    (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
                    (sub_quant_fork uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_quant_fork uty vty)
  | sub_quant_asf uty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
                    (sub_quant_asf uty) n)
        1 (sz_quant_asf uty)
  | sub_dist uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant (Funty uty vty))
                    (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
                    (sub_dist uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_dist uty vty)
  | sub_inst ty u =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
                    (sub_inst ty u) n)
        1 (sz_inst ty u)
  | sub_lift ty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))
                    (sub_lift ty) n)
        1 (sz_lift ty)
  | sub_leaf_fun uty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
                    (sub_leaf_fun uty) n)
        1 (sz_leaf_fun uty)
  | sub_stem_fun uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))
                    (sub_stem_fun uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_stem_fun uty vty)
  | sub_fork_leaf uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
                    (sub_fork_leaf uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_fork_leaf uty vty)
  | sub_fork_stem uty vty wty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size
                    (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty))
                    (Funty uty wty) (sub_fork_stem uty vty wty) n)
        1 (sz_fork_stem uty vty wty)
  | sub_fork_fork_leaf uty vty wty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
                    (sub_fork_fork_leaf uty vty wty) n)
        1 (sz_fork_fork_leaf uty vty wty)
  | sub_fork_fork_stem uty vty1 vty2 wty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty)
                    (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
                    (sub_fork_fork_stem uty vty1 vty2 wty) n)
        1 (sz_fork_fork_stem uty vty1 vty2 wty)
  | sub_fork_fork_fork uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3 =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size
                    (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3)))
                    (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)
                    (sub_fork_fork_fork uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3) n)
        1 (sz_fork_fork_fork uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3)
  | sub_recursion k uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size omega2_ty
                    (Funty omega2_ty
                      (Funty
                        (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                               (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                        (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
                    (sub_recursion k uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_recursion k uty vty)
  | sub_tree ty uty Hcov =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size
                    (Fork
                      (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                        (quant 1
                          (Funty (Var 0)
                            (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
                      (quant 2
                        (Funty (Var 1)
                          (Funty (Var 0)
                            (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2)
                                   (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
                    (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
                    (sub_tree ty uty Hcov) n)
        1 (sz_tree ty uty Hcov)
  | sub_to_asf ty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size ty (Asf ty) (sub_to_asf ty) n)
        1 (sz_to_asf ty)
  | sub_from_asf uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
                    (sub_from_asf uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_from_asf uty vty)
  | sub_bffs uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty))
                    (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty)) (sub_bffs uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_bffs uty vty)
  | sub_bfff uty vty wty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
                    (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty))
                    (sub_bfff uty vty wty) n)
        1 (sz_bfff uty vty wty)
  end.

Lemma subtype_size_exists :
  forall S T (H : subtype S T), exists n, subtype_size S T H n.
Proof. intros. apply subtype_size_exists_aux. Qed.

Lemma nat_lex_rect (P : nat -> nat -> Prop)
  (H : forall n m,
      (forall n' m', n' < n -> P n' m') ->
      (forall m', m' < m -> P n m') ->
      P n m) :
  forall n m, P n m.
Proof.
  intros n.
  induction n as [n IHn] using lt_wf_ind.
  intros m.
  induction m as [m IHm] using lt_wf_ind.
  exact (H n m
           (fun n' m' Hlt => IHn n' Hlt m')
           (fun m' Hlt => IHm m' Hlt)).
Qed.

Print Assumptions subtype_size_exists.

=== AgentA_GoodC.v
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* GoodC: the coordinator's substitution-closure repair.               *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Difference from the proposal: the Funty case also keeps the base    *)
(* conjunct subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r).  The base        *)
(* conjunct is needed for the proposed L2 reduction: the forall k u    *)
(* closure alone does not contain the instance k = 0, u = anything     *)
(* with subst_rec a u 0 = a (there is no uniform such u).              *)
(* Keeping the base conjunct is harmless for the monotonicity cases.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodC (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Funty a r =>
      subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) /\
      (forall k u,
          subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst_rec a u k)))
                  (quant d (subst_rec r u k)))
  | Asf T' => GoodC d x T'
  | Quant T' => GoodC (S d) x T'
  end.

Definition GoodC_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, GoodC (S d) x T -> GoodC d x (subst T u).

(* Direction obstruction for the Funty case of the obligation above.
   The source gives, at the base instance k = 0 and after unfolding
   quant (S d) a = quant d (Quant a),

     subtype (Fork x (quant d (Quant a))) (quant d (Quant r)) .

   The target base demands

     subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst a u))) (quant d (subst r u)) .

   The only available comparison of the inner arguments is
   [sub_inst] : Quant a <: subst a u.  It makes the target source
   (subst a u) LARGER than the source source (Quant a), so the source
   hypothesis concerns a smaller left argument and does not imply the
   target.  The all-k closure has exactly the same orientation for
   every k (with subst_rec a u k in place of a).  Thus the Funty part
   of GoodC_inst_obligation is not discharged by subst_subst_gen; it
   remains a genuine obligation. *)

Definition GoodC_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, GoodC d x T -> GoodC d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

(* The sub_stem_fun case is NOT derivable from the all-k Funty closure.
   It is isolated here as a third obligation; a forced instance below
   shows why it is problematic. *)
Definition GoodC_stem_fun_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x uty vty,
    GoodC d x (Stem uty) -> GoodC d x (Funty vty (Fork uty vty)).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural monotonicity.  Every case except sub_inst, sub_lift and  *)
(* sub_stem_fun is discharged outright.  Those three are the isolated  *)
(* obligations below; the sub_stem_fun obligation is in fact false.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodC_mono
  (Hinst : GoodC_inst_obligation)
  (Hlift : GoodC_lift_obligation)
  (Hstemfun : GoodC_stem_fun_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype T U -> GoodC d x T -> GoodC d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hsub.
  revert d x.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *)
    destruct HP as [Hbase Hclos]. split.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- apply sub_fork.
           ++ apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
        -- exact Hbase.
      * apply quant_mono. exact Hsub1.
    + intros k u.
      eapply sub_trans.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- apply sub_fork.
           ++ apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply quant_mono. apply (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ Hs1 u k).
        -- apply Hclos.
      * apply quant_mono. apply (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ Hsub1 u k).
  - (* quant *) apply IHHs. exact HP.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *)
    destruct HP as [Hbase Hclos]. split.
    + change (subtype (Fork x (quant (S d) uty)) (quant (S d) vty)).
      exact Hbase.
    + intros k u.
      change (subtype (Fork x (quant (S d) (subst_rec uty u (S k))))
                       (quant (S d) (subst_rec vty u (S k)))).
      apply Hclos.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    apply Hstemfun. exact HP.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. cbn in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Base facts and the L2 reduction.                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodC_stem_self : forall x, GoodC 0 x (Stem x).
Proof. intro x. simpl. apply sub_zero. Qed.

Lemma L2_of_GoodC
  (Hinst : GoodC_inst_obligation)
  (Hlift : GoodC_lift_obligation)
  (Hstemfun : GoodC_stem_fun_obligation)
  : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  pose proof (GoodC_mono Hinst Hlift Hstemfun 0 X (Stem X) (Funty a r) H
                (GoodC_stem_self X)) as [Hbase _].
  exact Hbase.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The sub_stem_fun obligation is false for this GoodC.                *)
(* Taking x = uty = Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0)), vty = Leaf, it      *)
(* forces the closure instance k = 0, u = Leaf:                        *)
(*   Fork (Funty Var0 (Stem Var0)) Leaf <:                             *)
(*   Fork (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)) Leaf.                               *)
(* The direct comparison of first components would need              *)
(* Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf) <: Funty Var0 (Stem Var0), whose domain     *)
(* by sub_funty contravariance is Leaf <: Var 0; no rule derives it.  *)
(* This is a structural argument, not a Coq non-derivability theorem; *)
(* what is formalized below is that the obligation forces this exact  *)
(* instance.  Note that x is leafy: sub_leaf_fun gives               *)
(* Leaf <: Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0)), so the leafy hypothesis     *)
(* does not exclude this instance.                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodC_stem_fun_forced_leafy :
  subtype Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0))).
Proof.
  apply sub_leaf_fun.
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_stem_fun_would_force :
  GoodC_stem_fun_obligation ->
  subtype (Fork (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0))) Leaf)
          (Fork (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)) Leaf).
Proof.
  intro Hsf.
  pose proof (Hsf 0 (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0)))
                 (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0))) Leaf
                 (sub_zero (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0)))))
    as [_ Hclos].
  specialize (Hclos 0 Leaf).
  vm_compute in Hclos.
  exact Hclos.
Qed.

Print Assumptions GoodC_mono.
Print Assumptions GoodC_stem_fun_forced_leafy.
Print Assumptions GoodC_stem_fun_would_force.
Print Assumptions L2_of_GoodC.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Status of the two algebraic obligations used by Good_mono.          *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Good_inst_obligation is FALSE as stated: below is a closed true     *)
(* premise whose forced conclusion is not derivable (model check; see  *)
(* AgentB_Good_counter.v).  Good_lift_obligation is NOT refuted by the *)
(* natural 2-Quant instance: its forced conclusion is derivable.  It   *)
(* remains open.  AgentA_Good.v itself stays sound: both obligations   *)
(* occur there only as hypotheses of Good_mono.                        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Closed computation facts.                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma hlift_subst_compute_1 :
  lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf))
  = Funty (Var 1) (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_funty_leaf_leaf : lift 1 (Funty Leaf Leaf) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hlift_subst_compute_2 :
  subst (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)) (Var 0)
  = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_var0_leaf : subst (Var 0) Leaf = Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A true premise of Good_inst_obligation.                            *)
(* d = 0, x = Leaf, T = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf), u = Var 0.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma good_inst_counter_premise :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0)))
          (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * rewrite <- subst_var0_leaf. apply sub_inst.
    + rewrite <- lift_funty_leaf_leaf.
      apply sub_lift.
Qed.

Lemma good_inst_counter_premise_Good :
  Good 1 Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  simpl. exact good_inst_counter_premise.
Qed.

(* What Good_inst_obligation would force from that premise. *)
Lemma good_inst_would_force :
  Good_inst_obligation ->
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Var 0)) (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof.
  intro Hinst.
  unfold Good_inst_obligation in Hinst.
  change (Good 0 Leaf
            (Funty (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))
                   (subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0)))).
  apply Hinst with (x := Leaf) (d := 0)
                   (T := Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)) (u := Var 0).
  - apply sub_zero.
  - exact good_inst_counter_premise_Good.
Qed.

(* The forced conclusion is not derivable (closure model: 0 paths for
   Fork Leaf (Var 0) <: Funty Leaf Leaf; any path would have to use
   sub_fork_leaf and then a subtype var 0 <: Leaf, which cannot exist).
   Hence Good_inst_obligation is false. *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A true premise of Good_lift_obligation.                            *)
(* d = 1, x = Leaf, T = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf).              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma good_lift_counter_premise_Good :
  Good 1 Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof. exact good_inst_counter_premise_Good. Qed.

(* What Good_lift_obligation would force from that premise. *)
Lemma good_lift_would_force :
  Good_lift_obligation ->
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Quant (Var 1))))
          (Quant (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  intro Hlift.
  unfold Good_lift_obligation in Hlift.
  change (Good 1 Leaf
            (Quant (lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf))))).
  apply Hlift with (x := Leaf) (d := 1).
  - apply sub_zero.
  - exact good_lift_counter_premise_Good.
Qed.

(* Shape check: the goal above is literally the conclusion of the
   obligation on this instance. *)
Lemma good_lift_goal_shape :
  Good 1 Leaf (Quant (lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf))))
  = subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Quant (Var 1))))
            (Quant (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

(* IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the forced conclusion of the lift obligation
   on this instance IS derivable.  A twice-quantified free variable can
   be collapsed to Leaf by sub_inst at level 1 and then at level 0.
   Hence this instance is NOT a counterexample to Good_lift. *)

Lemma subst_quant_var1_leaf : subst (Quant (Var 1)) Leaf = Quant Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_leaf_leaf2 : subst Leaf Leaf = Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_funtyLL : lift 1 (Funty Leaf Leaf) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_quant_funtyLL :
  lift 1 (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)) = Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma QQVar1_leaf : subtype (Quant (Quant (Var 1))) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant Leaf).
  - rewrite <- subst_quant_var1_leaf. apply sub_inst.
  - rewrite <- subst_leaf_leaf2. apply sub_inst.
Qed.

Lemma good_lift_counter_goal_derivable :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Quant (Var 1))))
          (Quant (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork Leaf Leaf).
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + exact QQVar1_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf Leaf).
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
      * rewrite <- lift_funtyLL. apply sub_lift.
      * rewrite <- lift_quant_funtyLL. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* Consequently our earlier quick reading of this instance as a
   counterexample was wrong; Good_lift_obligation remains OPEN. *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Vindication of the earlier L2 concern: the Quant-headed codomain   *)
(* instance IS derivable.  Any claim that L2 fails on this instance   *)
(* was wrong: sub_lift + sub_quant + sub_fork + sub_inst prove it.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_var0_inst_self : subtype (Quant (Var 0)) (Var 0).
Proof.
  change (subtype (Quant (Var 0)) (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))).
  apply sub_inst.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_quant_body :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Fork Leaf (Var 0)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_fork.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - apply quant_var0_inst_self.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_into_quant :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_quant.
    change (subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
    apply fork_quant_quant_body.
Qed.

Lemma L2_quant_codomain_premise :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant (Var 0)) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Funty (Var 0) (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (Stem Leaf)).
    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem Leaf).
    + apply sub_quant. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply sub_dist.
Qed.

Lemma L2_would_give_derivable_conclusion :
  (forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                 subtype (Fork X a) r) ->
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
Proof.
  intro L2.
  exact (L2 Leaf (Quant (Var 0)) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))
           L2_quant_codomain_premise).
Qed.

Print Assumptions good_inst_would_force.
Print Assumptions good_lift_would_force.
Print Assumptions fork_quant_into_quant.
Print Assumptions L2_would_give_derivable_conclusion.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.

(* Does the proposed general L2
     forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r
   hold?  The following is a concrete premise instance obtained by
   stem_fun, a funty covariance step, sub_lift and sub_dist. *)

Lemma stem_leaf_funty_depth2 :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma funty_lift_depth2 :
  subtype (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))
          (Quant (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))).

  change (subtype (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))

  - eapply sub_trans.
    + exact stem_leaf_funty_depth2.
    + exact funty_lift_depth2.
  - eapply sub_dist.

  (L2 : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                      subtype (Fork X a) r) :

=== AgentB_Good_counter.v
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A COUNTEREXAMPLE TO AgentA_Good.Good_inst_obligation.              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Take d = 0, x = Leaf, T = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf),        *)
(* u = Var 0.  Then Good (S d) x T holds:                             *)
(*   subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).   *)
(* Its derivation is proved below in Coq.                             *)
(* But the required conclusion would be                              *)
(*   Good 0 Leaf (Funty (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))                       *)
(*                       (subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0)))           *)
(* = subtype (Fork Leaf (Var 0)) (Funty Leaf Leaf),                   *)
(* because subst (Var 0) (Var 0) = Var 0 and                        *)
(* subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0) = Funty Leaf Leaf.                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The latter is NOT derivable.  I checked it in a closure model of  *)
(* the subtype rules at size 6 over Var 0 and Var 1 (10560 types):   *)
(* Fork Leaf (Var 0) has no path to Funty Leaf Leaf, while the above  *)
(* premise is reachable.  The only subtype rules omitted from that     *)
(* model are those whose source has a Stem/Fork in its first          *)
(* component (sub_fork_stem, sub_fork_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,     *)
(* sub_bfff, sub_recursion); none of these sources is reachable from  *)
(* Fork Leaf (Var 0), because this would require Leaf <: Stem or      *)
(* Leaf <: Fork, which is false (AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem/fork).  *)
(* The model reports exactly 0 reachable source types of the omitted  *)
(* rules from the seed.                                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Thus the obligation as stated is false; it needs a corrected       *)
(* variant.  The premise proof below is closed and compiles.          *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Possible repair: add reachability to Good, e.g. keep the conjunct  *)
(* subtype (Stem x) T (or the reachability appropriate to the use).   *)
(* The model shows the counterexample state is then unreachable:      *)
(* Stem Leaf <: Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf) is false.  Whether    *)
(* the reachability-restricted Hinst is provable is a separate        *)
(* obligation and is NOT claimed here.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_var0_var0 : subst (Var 0) (Var 0) = Var 0.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_leaf_leaf : subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_var0_leaf : subst (Var 0) Leaf = Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_funty_leaf_leaf : lift 1 (Funty Leaf Leaf) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma good_inst_counter_premise :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0)))
          (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * rewrite <- subst_var0_leaf.
        apply sub_inst.
    + rewrite <- lift_funty_leaf_leaf.
      apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* The premise in Good form, exactly as required by Hinst. *)
Lemma good_inst_counter_premise_Good :
  Good 1 Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  simpl. exact good_inst_counter_premise.
Qed.

(* The conclusion Hinst would demand, simplified. *)
Lemma good_inst_counter_conclusion_shape :
  Good 0 Leaf
       (Funty (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))

(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 5. Target-only predicate architecture (coordinator's plan).        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf is defined by structural recursion on the TARGET type:      *)
(*   Funty a r  |-> subtype (Stem a) r                               *)
(*   Leaf       |-> True                                              *)
(*   Asf T      |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
(*   Quant T    |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
(*   Stem/Fork/Var |-> False                                          *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* All monotonicity cases of P_leaf along subtype are structural      *)
(* except three shape obligations, isolated as hypotheses below.      *)
(* The dist obligation is now discharged unconditionally in Section   *)
(* 10 (subtype_stem_quant_dist); only Hlift and Hinst remain.         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
From Triage Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* Scratch exploration: App strong soundness for a Leaf-reachable source,
   assuming the L1 inversion and the corresponding quant/dist target fact. *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.
===
(*                                                                    *)
(* All Stem/Fork/recursion/tree source cases are eliminated by the      *)
(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :
  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_funty_fork :
  forall a b Y Z, subtype (Funty a b) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a b Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Funty a b) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 10. Discharging the dist obligation of P_leaf unconditionally.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) is definitionally subtype (Stem u) v;   *)
(* the dist target is subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant v).  The        *)
(* following closed lemma supplies exactly that, so the Hdist         *)
(* hypothesis of P_leaf_mono is no longer needed.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => P_leaf T'
  | Quant T' => P_leaf T'
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  end.

Lemma P_leaf_mono
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_trans; [ apply sub_stem; exact Hs1 | exact HP ] | exact H ].
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) apply Hdist. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst. exact HP.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift. exact HP.
  - (* leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

(* L1: from a subtype Leaf (Funty a r) obtain subtype (Stem a) r.      *)
(* This is the target inversion used by k_head_case.                  *)

Lemma P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> P_leaf T.
Proof.
  intros T H.
  remember Leaf as S eqn:ES.
  revert ES.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros ES.
  - (* zero *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* trans *) subst. eapply P_leaf_mono; eauto.
  - (* stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* funty *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* quant_asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* dist *) discriminate ES.
  - (* inst *) discriminate ES.
  - (* lift *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* leaf_fun *) simpl. apply sub_zero.
  - (* stem_fun *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_leaf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) discriminate ES.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) discriminate ES.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in ES. discriminate ES.
  - (* tree *) discriminate ES.
  - (* to_asf *) subst. simpl. exact Logic.I.
  - (* from_asf *) discriminate ES.
  - (* bffs *) discriminate ES.
  - (* bfff *) discriminate ES.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H.
  exact (P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype Hdist Hlift Hinst (Funty a r) H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 6. A structural "head/safety" invariant Q that is unconditionally   *)
(*    monotone along subtype and stable under substitution and lift.   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Q forbids Fork at the head and recursively under Quant, and forbids *)
(* Var.  This is exactly the guard needed for the substitution lemma:  *)
(* the rules with Fork sources (sub_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,        *)
(* sub_bfff) and sub_recursion become vacuous, while all other rules   *)
(* preserve Q.                                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint Q (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => True
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => Q T'
  end.

Lemma Q_subst_rec : forall T u k, Q T -> Q (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_lift_rec : forall T k n, Q T -> Q (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> Q T -> Q U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HQ.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply Q_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HQ.
  - (* lift *) apply Q_lift_rec with (k := 0) (n := 1). exact HQ.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HQ. cbn in HQ. destruct HQ.
  - (* tree *) destruct HQ.
  - (* to_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HQ.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HQ.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_var : forall i, subtype Leaf (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros i H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.
  unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 8. Strong soundness of App for a Leaf-reachable source.             *)
(*                                                                    *)

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
2	Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
3	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
4	Open Scope string_scope.
5	Open Scope nat_scope.
6	Open Scope tree_scope.
7	
8	(* ================================================================== *)
9	(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
10	(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
11	(*                                                                    *)
12	(* Invariant: a lift-indexed source projection.  The index d counts  *)
13	(* the Quant binders traversed.  The substitution closure uses the    *)
14	(* cutoff k together with a side condition k <= d; this is the form   *)
15	(* needed by sub_inst (k = 0) and preserved by nested Quant.          *)
16	(* ================================================================== *)
17	
18	Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
19	  match T with
20	  | Var _ => False
21	  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
22	  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
23	  | Leaf => False
24	  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
25	  | Fork _ _ => False
26	  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
27	  end.
28	
29	(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
30	Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
31	Proof.
32	  intros X d. unfold lift.
33	  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1) by lia.
34	  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
35	Qed.
36	
37	(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
38	Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
39	Proof.
40	  intro u.
41	  eapply sub_trans.
42	  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
43	  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
44	Qed.
45	
46	(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
47	(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
48	(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against   *)
49	(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
50	Lemma l2_dist :
51	  forall d X u v,
52	    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
53	    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
54	Proof.
55	  intros d X u v H.
56	  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
57	  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
58	                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
59	  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
60	  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
61	  eapply sub_trans with
62	    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
63	  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
64	                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
65	    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
66	      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
67	    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
68	  - exact H3.
69	Qed.
70	
71	(* Substituting at cutoff k (k <= d) inside lift (S d) X undoes one
72	   lift, yielding lift d X. *)
73	Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq :
74	  forall X u d k,
75	    k <= d ->
76	    subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
77	Proof.
78	  intros X u d k Hk.
79	  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
80	  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
81	  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
82	  exact H.
83	Qed.
84	
85	(* ================================================================== *)
86	(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
87	(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
88	(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                   *)
89	(* ================================================================== *)
90	
91	Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
92	  forall T d j X,
93	    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
94	Proof.
95	  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
96	  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
97	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
98	  - (* Funty *)
99	    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
100	    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
101	    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
102	    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
103	    exact Hlift.
104	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
105	  - (* Stem *)
106	    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
107	    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
108	    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
109	    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
110	    exact Hlift.
111	  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
112	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
113	Qed.
114	
115	(* ================================================================== *)
116	(* Substitution closure: GoodStem (S d) X T ->                        *)
117	(*                       GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k),  k <= d.    *)
118	(* The side condition is preserved by the Quant case, which shifts    *)
119	(* both k and d by one.  sub_inst is the instance k = 0.              *)
120	(* ================================================================== *)
121	
122	Lemma GoodStem_subst_gen :
123	  forall T d X u k,
124	    k <= d ->
125	    GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).
126	Proof.
127	  induction T; intros d X u k Hk HG; simpl in *.
128	  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
129	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
130	  - (* Funty *)
131	    eapply sub_trans with
132	      (ty2 := subst_rec (Fork (lift (S d) X) T1) u k).
133	    + change (subtype (Fork (lift_rec X 0 d) (subst_rec T1 u k))
134	                      (subst_rec (Fork (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) T1) u k)).
135	      simpl.
136	      rewrite (l2_subst_lift_S_eq X u d k Hk).
137	      apply sub_zero.
138	    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
139	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
140	  - (* Stem *)
141	    eapply sub_trans with
142	      (ty2 := subst_rec (lift (S d) X) u k).
143	    + change (subtype (lift_rec X 0 d)
144	                      (subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k)).
145	      rewrite (l2_subst_lift_S_eq X u d k Hk).
146	      apply sub_zero.
147	    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
148	  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
149	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hk|exact HG].
150	Qed.
151	
152	(* ================================================================== *)
153	(* Monotonicity of GoodStem along subtype.                            *)
154	(* ================================================================== *)
155	
156	Lemma GoodStem_mono :
157	  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d X, GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem d X U.
158	Proof.
159	  intros T U H.
160	  induction H; intros d X HG; simpl in *.
161	  - (* zero *) exact HG.
162	  - (* trans *) apply (IHsubtype2 d X). apply (IHsubtype1 d X). exact HG.
163	  - (* stem *) exact (sub_trans _ _ _ HG H).
164	  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
165	  - (* asf *) apply (IHsubtype d X). exact HG.
166	  - (* funty *)
167	    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (lift d X) uty1).
168	    + apply (sub_fork (lift d X) (lift d X) uty2 uty1 (sub_zero _) H).
169	    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HG | exact H0].
170	  - (* quant *) apply (IHsubtype (S d) X). exact HG.
171	  - (* quant_stem *)
172	    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (lift d X))).
173	    + apply sub_lift.
174	    + rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. apply sub_quant. exact HG.
175	  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
176	  - (* quant_asf *) exact HG.
177	  - (* dist *) apply (l2_dist d X uty vty). exact HG.
178	  - (* inst *)
179	    change (GoodStem d X (subst_rec ty u 0)).
180	    apply (GoodStem_subst_gen ty d X u 0); [lia|exact HG].
181	  - (* lift *)
182	    change (GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
183	    apply (GoodStem_lift_gen ty d 0 X); [lia|exact HG].
184	  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
185	  - (* stem_fun *)
186	    apply (sub_fork (lift d X) uty vty vty HG (sub_zero _)).
187	  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
188	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
189	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
190	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
191	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
192	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HG. cbn in HG. destruct HG.
193	  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
194	  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
195	  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
196	  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
197	  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.
198	Qed.
199	
200	(* ================================================================== *)
201	(* Main theorem.                                                      *)
202	(* ================================================================== *)
203	
204	Lemma l2_lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
205	Proof.
206	  induction x; intros k; simpl.
207	  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
208	    destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl; reflexivity.
209	  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHx.
210	  - (* Funty *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
211	  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
212	  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
213	  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
214	  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
215	Qed.
216	
217	Lemma l2_lift_zero : forall X, lift 0 X = X.
218	Proof. intro X. unfold lift. apply l2_lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.
219	
220	Lemma GoodStem_initial : forall X, GoodStem 0 X (Stem X).
221	Proof.
222	  intro X. simpl. rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero.
223	Qed.
224	
225	Lemma L2_literal :
226	  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
227	Proof.
228	  intros X a r H.
229	  pose proof (GoodStem_mono (Stem X) (Funty a r) H 0 X
230	                (GoodStem_initial X)) as HG.
231	  simpl in HG. rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG. exact HG.
232	Qed.
233

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.
