Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->

| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->

| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Inductive derive: list (string * dtype) -> Tree -> dtype -> Prop :=
| derive_ref : forall gamma x uty ty, get x gamma = Some uty -> subtype uty ty -> derive gamma (Ref x) ty
| derive_node : forall gamma uty, subtype Leaf uty -> derive gamma Node uty
| derive_app: forall gamma M N ty u, derive gamma M (Funty u ty) -> derive gamma N u -> derive gamma (M@N) ty

Require Import Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes String.

Open Scope string_scope.

Declare Scope tree_scope.
Global Open Scope tree_scope.

Inductive Tree:  Set :=
  | Ref : string -> Tree
  | Node : Tree
  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)
                 then S1 (star x M1) @ (star x M2)
                 else K@ (M1 @ M2)
  end.

Notation "\" := star : tree_scope.

Definition wait2 M N x :=  S1 (S1 (S1 (K @ M) @ (K @ N)) @ (K @ x)) @ I.

Definition omega21 := K @ (△ @ (△ @ I)).

Definition omega22 :=  \ "w" (\ "f" (wait2 (Ref "w") (Ref "w") (Ref "f"))).

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A concrete counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.
   The term (((Node @ Node) @ Node) @ (Node @ Node)) is a k-redex.
   It has type Stem Leaf, but its reduct Node has no such type. *)

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △).

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dK.
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dKy :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma dKy_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dKy.
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dKy_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma stem_subst_subtype : forall (x y u : dtype) (k : nat),
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k).
Proof.
  intros x y u k H.
  change (subtype (subst_rec (Stem x) u k) (subst_rec y u k)).
  apply AgentC.subst_rec_subtype. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma stem_lift_subtype_one : forall (x y : dtype) (j : nat),
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (lift_rec x j 1)) (lift_rec y j 1).
Proof.
  intros x y j H.
  change (subtype (lift_rec (Stem x) j 1) (lift_rec y j 1)).
  apply AgentD.lift_rec_subtype. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  apply L1_of_specialized_stem_facts.
  - exact stem_subst_subtype.
  - exact stem_lift_subtype_one.
Qed.

Print Assumptions L1.
===
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_quant_dist : forall x y,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).
Proof.
  intros x y H.
  assert (HQ : subtype (Quant (lift_rec x 1 1)) x).
  { eapply sub_trans.
    - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
    - unfold subst. rewrite subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero. }
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem (Quant x)).
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_quant. eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_stem. exact HQ.
      * exact H.
    + apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* P_leaf_mono with the dist case supplied by the closed lemma above. *)
Lemma P_leaf_mono_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  apply P_leaf_mono.
  - intros u v HP. simpl in HP. simpl.
    apply subtype_stem_quant_dist. exact HP.
  - exact Hlift.
  - exact Hinst.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H.
  exact (P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype
           (fun u v HP => subtype_stem_quant_dist u v HP)
           Hlift Hinst (Funty a r) H).
Qed.

(* Lift obligation of P_leaf, specialized to lifting by exactly one.     *)
(* The hypothesis is exactly the n = 1 instance of the specialized lift *)
(* fact for Stem sources.                                              *)
Lemma P_leaf_lift_one
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall T k, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift1. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

(* Assembly of L1 from the two remaining specialized facts only.       *)
(* Hsub must be the generalized statement at EVERY substitution level k, *)
(* because P_leaf recurses through Quant and substitution under a       *)
(* Quant increments the level.  Hlift only needs its k-parametric,      *)
(* n = 1 instance.                                                     *)
Lemma L1_of_specialized_stem_facts
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  apply L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst.
  - intros T HP. exact (P_leaf_lift_one Hlift1 T 0 HP).
  - intros T u HP.
    exact (specialized_subst_implies_P_inst Hsub T u 0 HP).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 11. An important test instance for the source-Stem strong fact.     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The intended statement is                                          *)
(*   L2 : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->               *)
(*                      subtype (Fork X a) r.                         *)
(* The instance below reaches a quantified codomain through           *)
(* sub_lift and sub_dist, so it is a natural stress test for any       *)
(* target-shape-insensitive predicate.  It is NOT a counterexample:   *)
(* the required conclusion is derivable, using                          *)
(*   Quant Leaf <: Leaf            (sub_inst with ty := Leaf)         *)
(* to shrink the second component of the Fork, then sub_fork_leaf,    *)
(* then sub_lift.  We record both facts explicitly; they are also a    *)
(* warning that any finite model omitting the `sub_lift` edge          *)
(* `ty <: Quant (lift 1 ty)` (the direction used here) will report a   *)
(* spurious failure of L2 on this instance.                           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma subtype_quant_leaf_leaf : subtype (Quant Leaf) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply (sub_inst Leaf (Var 0)).
  - vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma L2_premise_instance :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)).
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + eapply sub_trans
        with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)))).
      * apply sub_lift.
      * vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
  - apply sub_dist.
Qed.

(* The conclusion of L2 on that instance is itself derivable.         *)
Lemma L2_instance_conclusion :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_fork.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * exact subtype_quant_leaf_leaf.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans
      with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))).
    + apply sub_lift.
    + vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* If L2 is assumed, the two facts above are consistent; this records  *)
(* that the instance provides no disproof of L2.                       *)
Lemma naive_L2_instance_consistent
  (L2 : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                      subtype (Fork X a) r)
  : subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.
  exact (L2 Leaf (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))
           L2_premise_instance).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A size-annotated version of the subtype relation, used for well-founded
   recursion on pairs of derivations.  It mirrors subtypes.v exactly. *)
Inductive subtype_size : dtype -> dtype -> nat -> Prop :=
| szs_zero : forall ty, subtype_size ty ty 1
| szs_trans : forall a b c n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size b c m ->
    subtype_size a c (n + m + 1)
| szs_stem : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Stem a) (Stem b) (S n)
| szs_fork : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Fork a c) (Fork b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_asf : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Asf a) (Asf b) (S n)
| szs_funty : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size b a n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Funty a c) (Funty b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_quant : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Quant a) (Quant b) (S n)
| szs_quant_stem : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Stem u)) (Stem (Quant u)) 1
| szs_quant_fork : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Fork u v)) (Fork (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_quant_asf : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Asf u)) (Asf (Quant u)) 1
| szs_dist : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Funty u v)) (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_inst : forall ty u, subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) 1
| szs_lift : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) 1
| szs_leaf_fun : forall u, subtype_size Leaf (Funty u (Stem u)) 1
| szs_stem_fun : forall u v, subtype_size (Stem u) (Funty v (Fork u v)) 1
| szs_fork_leaf : forall u v, subtype_size (Fork Leaf u) (Funty v u) 1
| szs_fork_stem : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) (Funty u w) 1
| szs_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) w) (Funty Leaf u) 1
| szs_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) (Funty (Stem v1) v2) 1
| szs_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) (Funty (Fork w1 w2) w3) 1
| szs_recursion : forall k u v,
    subtype_size omega2_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))) 1
| szs_tree : forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype_size
      (Fork
         (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
               (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
         (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
               (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
      (Funty uty (subst ty uty)) 1
| szs_to_asf : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Asf ty) 1
| szs_from_asf : forall u v, subtype_size (Asf (Funty u v)) (Funty u v) 1
| szs_bffs : forall u v,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug u)) (Asf v)) (Asf (Fork (Stem u) v)) 1
| szs_bfff : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Asf v)) (bfff_aug w)) (Asf (Fork (Fork u v) w)) 1.

Lemma subtype_size_sound : forall S T n, subtype_size S T n -> subtype S T.
Proof.
  intros S T n H. induction H; eauto using subtype.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_has_size : forall S T, subtype S T -> exists n, subtype_size S T n.
Proof.
  intros S T H. induction H.
  - exists 1. apply szs_zero.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_trans; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_stem. exact Hs.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_fork; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_asf. exact Hs.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_funty; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_quant. exact Hs.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_fork.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_dist.
  - exists 1. apply szs_inst.
  - exists 1. apply szs_lift.
  - exists 1. apply szs_leaf_fun.
  - exists 1. apply szs_stem_fun.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_leaf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_leaf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_fork.
  - exists 1. apply szs_recursion.
  - exists 1. eapply szs_tree; eauto.
  - exists 1. apply szs_to_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_from_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_bffs.
  - exists 1. apply szs_bfff.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof.
  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0.
Qed.

(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.

  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.

  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
---R---
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_var : forall i, subtype Leaf (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros i H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.
  unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import Size AgentB NF.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Reachable-head invariant for a Fork source.                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* RF is true on the heads that can be reached from a Fork source:    *)
(* Fork and Funty, or a type whose Asf/Quant spine ends in one of     *)
(* them.  Leaf, Stem and Var are unreachable.                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k mm HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* recursion *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* tree *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bfff *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma RF_fork : forall C X, RF (Fork C X).
Proof. intros. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype :
  forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof. intros. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply RF_fork. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_leaf : forall S, RF S -> S = Leaf -> False.
Proof. intros S HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_stem : forall S Y, RF S -> S = Stem Y -> False.
Proof. intros S Y HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_var : forall S i, RF S -> S = Var i -> False.
Proof. intros S i HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Exact unproved interfaces isolated by the analysis.                *)
(* These are stated as Prop-valued definitions, not axioms/theorems,  *)
(* so this file remains closed and constructive.                        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* The general Fork inversion with leafy first component (the statement
   requested after L3_leaf).  There are two projections; the first is
   the "leafy first component" part, the second is the codomain part. *)
Definition Fork_first_inversion_leafy : Prop :=
  forall C X A B,
    subtype Leaf C ->
    subtype (Fork C X) (Fork A B) ->
    subtype C A.

Definition Fork_second_inversion : Prop :=
  forall C X A B,
    subtype (Fork C X) (Fork A B) ->
    subtype X B.

(* Reach-to-Quant form needed by the szs_quant_fork/szs_inst branches of
   the Fork inversion. *)
Definition Fork_quant_inversion_leafy : Prop :=
  forall C X A B,
    subtype Leaf C ->
    subtype (Fork C X) (Quant (Fork A B)) ->
    subtype C (Quant A).

Definition Fork_quant_second_inversion : Prop :=
  forall C X A B,
    subtype (Fork C X) (Quant (Fork A B)) ->
    subtype X (Quant B).

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Status of L3_leaf.                                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* L3_leaf : forall C X a r, subtype Leaf C ->                        *)
(*            subtype (Fork C X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.          *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* RF above eliminates all atomic H branches whose source is Leaf,    *)
(* Stem or Var.  The remaining cut-elimination problem is the          *)
(* interaction of sub_trans on the two derivations.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The size-only measure proposed for the cut-elimination cannot       *)
(* handle both trans cases with the suggested recursive pairs.  With  *)
(* szs_trans sizes n = n1 + n2 + 1:                                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  H = szs_trans H1 H2:                                              *)
(*    K' = szs_trans K H1 has size nK + n1 + 1, H' = H2 has size n2.  *)
(*    The sum nK' + n2 equals nK + nH, and n2 < nH.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  K = szs_trans K1 K2:                                              *)
(*    K' = K1 has size nK1, H' = szs_trans K2 H has size nK2+nH+1.    *)
(*    The sum nK1 + (nK2+nH+1) also equals nK + nH, but the second    *)
(*    component increases.                                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Thus the two recursive calls transfer weight between K and H in    *)
(* opposite directions along the same line nK+nH = const.  No        *)
(* lexicographic order on the size pair alone can decrease for both.  *)
(* A refined measure (or a source-sensitive invariant) is required.   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A second, independent obstruction appears in the atomic pair      *)
(* table for L3_leaf.  RF shows that the H-source S of               *)
(* H : subtype S (Funty a r) is never Leaf/Stem/Var, so the only      *)
(* surviving atomic H rules with a Funty target are:                  *)
(*   szs_zero, szs_funty, szs_dist, szs_inst,                         *)
(*   szs_fork_leaf, szs_fork_stem, szs_fork_fork_*, szs_recursion,    *)
(*   szs_tree, szs_from_asf.                                          *)
(* The fork_leaf branch reduces to the Fork second inverse            *)
(*   K : subtype (Fork C X) (Fork Leaf u) |- subtype X u,             *)
(* and the szs_quant_fork/szs_inst branches reduce to the Quant fork  *)
(* inverses                                                           *)
(*   K : subtype (Fork C X) (Quant (Fork A B))                        *)
(*   |- subtype X (Quant B)   and   subtype C (Quant A).              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The exact atomic blocked subgoal, after dependent destruction of   *)
(* K = szs_fork and inversion of the target Fork, is                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*   leafy : subtype Leaf C                                           *)
(*   KC    : subtype_size C A' n1                                     *)
(*   KX    : subtype_size X B' n2                                     *)
(*   HB    : subtype B' B                                             *)
(*   goal  : subtype X B                                              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* which is immediate by transitivity from KX and HB.  The genuinely  *)
(* blocked case is the preceding K = szs_trans decomposition, where    *)
(* one must prove subtype X B from                                  *)
(*   fork_second_inversion on the reach K1 and the trans target K2;    *)
(* the size pair transfers weight between K1 and K2 in opposite       *)
(* directions, so the atomic table is complete but the cut step is     *)
(* not discharged by the size-pair measure.                           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Print Assumptions RF_mono.
Print Assumptions RF_of_fork_subtype.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* de Bruijn/quant helpers                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_S : forall d t, quant (S d) t = quant d (Quant t).
Proof. intros d t. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma quant_Quant : forall d t, quant d (Quant t) = Quant (quant d t).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intro t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma quant_mono : forall d A B, subtype A B -> subtype (quant d A) (quant d B).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros A B H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) *)
Lemma quant_lift_intro : forall d a,
  subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a, used for the reverse direction *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_one : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  exact AgentB.subtype_quant_lift_elim.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_onek : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a.
Proof.
  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a) *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim : forall d a,
  subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
  apply quant_mono. apply quant_lift_elim_one.
Qed.

(* (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) is below (quant d (Fork a b)) *)
Lemma quant_fork_inv : forall d a b,
  subtype (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) (quant d (Fork a b)).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros a b; simpl.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - rewrite !quant_Quant.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))).
    + apply sub_quant.
      simpl. eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)).
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
      * apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Good predicate.                                                *)
(*   Good d x (Stem y)      = subtype x (quant d y)                    *)
(*   Good d x (Funty a r)   = subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) *)
(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

(* The two algebraic obligations, isolated.  The leafy hypothesis         *)
(* (subtype Leaf x) is kept because it is available in the applications  *)
(* and is needed for the Quant/lift corner cases.                        *)
Definition Good_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> Good d x T ->
    Good d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

Definition Good_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> Good (S d) x T ->
    Good d x (subst T u).

Lemma Good_mono
  (Hlift : Good_lift_obligation)
  (Hinst : Good_inst_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype Leaf x -> subtype T U ->
      Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hleaf Hsub.
  revert d x Hleaf.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x Hleaf HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
      * exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hsub1.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * exact HP.
      * apply sub_zero.
    + apply quant_fork_inv.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. cbn in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

Print Assumptions Good_mono.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)

  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i

  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

  match bs with

  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB Size.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
  | Funty _ r => r
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork _ v => v
  | Asf T' => extr T'
  end.

(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
Lemma extr_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork u _ => R u
  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
  end.

Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_subst_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_lift_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* On the ReachFork fragment, extr commutes with substitution with    *)
(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)
(* e.g. extr (Fork A B) = B, and substituting in the discarded first  *)
(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
  forall T u k,
    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ReachFork is monotone along subtype. *)
Lemma ReachFork_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) eapply R_mono; eauto.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply ReachFork_subst_rec with (u := u) (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply ReachFork_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule. *)
Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma9 uty9 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)); HF : derive (Node@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| gamma4 uty HS | ]; subst.
  (* HS : Leaf <= Funty u3 u2 ; HI : derive x u3 ;
     HD : y : u1 ; HB : z : u *)
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ; HF : derive ((Node@w)@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma5 uty HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma6 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HJ : Node : Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HK : w : u4 ; HI : x : u5 *)
  inversion HB as [| gamma7 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HS2? naming; HS3 : Leaf <= u (third Node type) *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z) u ; invert it *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| gamma8 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HI : x : u5 ; HM : z : u3 *)
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty0 HS0 | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.
  inversion HK as [| gamma7 uty7 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ;
     HS1 : Leaf <= Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2) ; HB : derive (Node @ z1 @ z2) u *)
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  inversion HN as [| gamma9 uty3 HS3 | ]; subst.
  (* HO : z1 : u6 ; HM : z2 : u7 *)
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_skeleton :
  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros IK IS IL IST IF gamma M ty D.
  induction D; intros N HR.

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △).

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dK.
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dKy :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma dKy_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dKy.
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dKy_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* de Bruijn/quant helpers                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_S : forall d t, quant (S d) t = quant d (Quant t).
Proof. intros d t. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma quant_Quant : forall d t, quant d (Quant t) = Quant (quant d t).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intro t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma quant_mono : forall d A B, subtype A B -> subtype (quant d A) (quant d B).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros A B H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) *)
Lemma quant_lift_intro : forall d a,
  subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a, used for the reverse direction *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_one : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  exact AgentB.subtype_quant_lift_elim.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_onek : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a.
Proof.
  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a) *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim : forall d a,
  subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
  apply quant_mono. apply quant_lift_elim_one.
Qed.

(* (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) is below (quant d (Fork a b)) *)
Lemma quant_fork_inv : forall d a b,
  subtype (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) (quant d (Fork a b)).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros a b; simpl.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - rewrite !quant_Quant.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))).
    + apply sub_quant.
      simpl. eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)).
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
      * apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Good predicate.                                                *)
(*   Good d x (Stem y)      = subtype x (quant d y)                    *)
(*   Good d x (Funty a r)   = subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) *)
(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

(* The two algebraic obligations, isolated.  The leafy hypothesis         *)
(* (subtype Leaf x) is kept because it is available in the applications  *)
(* and is needed for the Quant/lift corner cases.                        *)
Definition Good_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> Good d x T ->
    Good d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

Definition Good_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> Good (S d) x T ->
    Good d x (subst T u).

Lemma Good_mono
  (Hlift : Good_lift_obligation)
  (Hinst : Good_inst_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype Leaf x -> subtype T U ->
      Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hleaf Hsub.
  revert d x Hleaf.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x Hleaf HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
      * exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hsub1.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * exact HP.
      * apply sub_zero.
    + apply quant_fork_inv.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. cbn in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

---
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A size relation for subtype derivations, and lexicographic         *)
(* well-founded induction on a pair of derivations.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtype_size : forall S T, subtype S T -> nat -> Prop :=
| sz_zero : forall ty,
    subtype_size ty ty (sub_zero ty) 1
| sz_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3
    (H12 : subtype ty1 ty2) (H23 : subtype ty2 ty3) n12 n23,
    subtype_size ty1 ty2 H12 n12 ->
    subtype_size ty2 ty3 H23 n23 ->
    subtype_size ty1 ty3 (sub_trans ty1 ty2 ty3 H12 H23) (S (n12 + n23))
| sz_stem : forall u1 u2 (H : subtype u1 u2) n,
    subtype_size u1 u2 H n ->
    subtype_size (Stem u1) (Stem u2) (sub_stem u1 u2 H) (S n)
| sz_fork : forall u1 u2 v1 v2
    (H1 : subtype u1 u2) (H2 : subtype v1 v2) n1 n2,
    subtype_size u1 u2 H1 n1 ->
    subtype_size v1 v2 H2 n2 ->
    subtype_size (Fork u1 v1) (Fork u2 v2)
      (sub_fork u1 u2 v1 v2 H1 H2) (S (n1 + n2))
| sz_asf : forall u1 u2 (H : subtype u1 u2) n,
    subtype_size u1 u2 H n ->
    subtype_size (Asf u1) (Asf u2) (sub_asf u1 u2 H) (S n)
| sz_funty : forall u1 u2 v1 v2
    (Hdom : subtype u2 u1) (Hcod : subtype v1 v2) n1 n2,
    subtype_size u2 u1 Hdom n1 ->
    subtype_size v1 v2 Hcod n2 ->
    subtype_size (Funty u1 v1) (Funty u2 v2)
      (sub_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 Hdom Hcod) (S (n1 + n2))
| sz_quant : forall v1 v2 (H : subtype v1 v2) n,
    subtype_size v1 v2 H n ->
    subtype_size (Quant v1) (Quant v2) (sub_quant v1 v2 H) (S n)
| sz_quant_stem : forall uty,
    subtype_size (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
      (sub_quant_stem uty) 1
| sz_quant_fork : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
      (sub_quant_fork uty vty) 1
| sz_quant_asf : forall uty,
    subtype_size (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
      (sub_quant_asf uty) 1
| sz_dist : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
      (sub_dist uty vty) 1
| sz_inst : forall ty u,
    subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) (sub_inst ty u) 1
| sz_lift : forall ty,
    subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) (sub_lift ty) 1
| sz_leaf_fun : forall uty,
    subtype_size Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty)) (sub_leaf_fun uty) 1
| sz_stem_fun : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))
      (sub_stem_fun uty vty) 1
| sz_fork_leaf : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
      (sub_fork_leaf uty vty) 1
| sz_fork_stem : forall uty vty wty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty))
      (Funty uty wty) (sub_fork_stem uty vty wty) 1
| sz_fork_fork_leaf : forall uty vty wty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
      (sub_fork_fork_leaf uty vty wty) 1
| sz_fork_fork_stem : forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty)
      (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
      (sub_fork_fork_stem uty vty1 vty2 wty) 1
| sz_fork_fork_fork : forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3)))
      (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)
      (sub_fork_fork_fork uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3) 1
| sz_recursion : forall k uty vty,
    subtype_size omega2_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty
          (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
          (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
      (sub_recursion k uty vty) 1
| sz_tree : forall ty uty (Hcov : covariant ty),
    subtype_size
      (Fork
        (Fork
          (subst ty Leaf)
          (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
        (quant 2
          (Funty (Var 1)
            (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
      (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
      (sub_tree ty uty Hcov) 1
| sz_to_asf : forall ty,
    subtype_size ty (Asf ty) (sub_to_asf ty) 1
| sz_from_asf : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
      (sub_from_asf uty vty) 1
| sz_bffs : forall uty vty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty))
      (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty)) (sub_bffs uty vty) 1
| sz_bfff : forall uty vty wty,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
      (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty)) (sub_bfff uty vty wty) 1.

Fixpoint subtype_size_exists_aux (A B : dtype) (H : subtype A B)
    {struct H} : exists n, subtype_size A B H n :=
  match H as H0 in subtype S0 T0
        return exists n, subtype_size S0 T0 H0 n with
  | sub_zero ty => @ex_intro nat (fun n => subtype_size ty ty (sub_zero ty) n)
                      1 (sz_zero ty)
  | sub_trans ty1 ty2 ty3 H12 H23 =>
      let (n12, s12) := subtype_size_exists_aux ty1 ty2 H12 in
      let (n23, s23) := subtype_size_exists_aux ty2 ty3 H23 in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size ty1 ty3
                    (sub_trans ty1 ty2 ty3 H12 H23) n)
        (S (n12 + n23))
        (sz_trans ty1 ty2 ty3 H12 H23 n12 n23 s12 s23)
  | sub_stem u1 u2 H =>
      let (n, sn) := subtype_size_exists_aux u1 u2 H in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n0 => subtype_size (Stem u1) (Stem u2)
                    (sub_stem u1 u2 H) n0)
        (S n) (sz_stem u1 u2 H n sn)
  | sub_fork u1 u2 v1 v2 H1 H2 =>
      let (n1, s1) := subtype_size_exists_aux u1 u2 H1 in
      let (n2, s2) := subtype_size_exists_aux v1 v2 H2 in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork u1 v1) (Fork u2 v2)
                    (sub_fork u1 u2 v1 v2 H1 H2) n)
        (S (n1 + n2)) (sz_fork u1 u2 v1 v2 H1 H2 n1 n2 s1 s2)
  | sub_asf u1 u2 H =>
      let (n, sn) := subtype_size_exists_aux u1 u2 H in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n0 => subtype_size (Asf u1) (Asf u2)
                    (sub_asf u1 u2 H) n0)
        (S n) (sz_asf u1 u2 H n sn)
  | sub_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 Hdom Hcod =>
      let (nd, sd) := subtype_size_exists_aux u2 u1 Hdom in
      let (nc, sc) := subtype_size_exists_aux v1 v2 Hcod in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Funty u1 v1) (Funty u2 v2)
                    (sub_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 Hdom Hcod) n)
        (S (nd + nc))
        (sz_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 Hdom Hcod nd nc sd sc)
  | sub_quant v1 v2 H =>
      let (n, sn) := subtype_size_exists_aux v1 v2 H in
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n0 => subtype_size (Quant v1) (Quant v2)
                    (sub_quant v1 v2 H) n0)
        (S n) (sz_quant v1 v2 H n sn)
  | sub_quant_stem uty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
                    (sub_quant_stem uty) n)
        1 (sz_quant_stem uty)
  | sub_quant_fork uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant (Fork uty vty))
                    (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
                    (sub_quant_fork uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_quant_fork uty vty)
  | sub_quant_asf uty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
                    (sub_quant_asf uty) n)
        1 (sz_quant_asf uty)
  | sub_dist uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant (Funty uty vty))
                    (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
                    (sub_dist uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_dist uty vty)
  | sub_inst ty u =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
                    (sub_inst ty u) n)
        1 (sz_inst ty u)
  | sub_lift ty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))
                    (sub_lift ty) n)
        1 (sz_lift ty)
  | sub_leaf_fun uty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
                    (sub_leaf_fun uty) n)
        1 (sz_leaf_fun uty)
  | sub_stem_fun uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))
                    (sub_stem_fun uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_stem_fun uty vty)
  | sub_fork_leaf uty vty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
                    (sub_fork_leaf uty vty) n)
        1 (sz_fork_leaf uty vty)
  | sub_fork_stem uty vty wty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size
                    (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty))
                    (Funty uty wty) (sub_fork_stem uty vty wty) n)
        1 (sz_fork_stem uty vty wty)
  | sub_fork_fork_leaf uty vty wty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
                    (sub_fork_fork_leaf uty vty wty) n)
        1 (sz_fork_fork_leaf uty vty wty)
  | sub_fork_fork_stem uty vty1 vty2 wty =>
      @ex_intro nat
        (fun n => subtype_size (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty)
                    (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
                    (sub_fork_fork_stem uty vty1 vty2 wty) n)
        1 (sz_fork_fork_stem uty vty1 vty2 wty)
