Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A closed counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.  The term is a
   leaf_red redex whose reduct is Node, and it is typable at Stem Leaf,
   a type that Node cannot have. *)

Definition M0 : Tree :=
  △ @ ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △) @ △.

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

(* Node : Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma node_fun2 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Node : Funty Leaf (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf))). *)
Lemma node_fun3 :
  subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Node @ Node : Stem Leaf. *)
Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The inner argument ((Node @ Node) @ Node) : Leaf. *)
Lemma dInner : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + apply derive_node. exact node_fun2.
    + apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Main typing derivation. *)
Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_app.
      * apply derive_node. exact node_fun3.
      * exact dInner.
    + exact dK.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply leaf_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as
    [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

       node_fun3 node_fun2 (sub_zero Leaf)) as Hbad.
  exact (AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem _ Hbad).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Pure term identity: substituting at a cutoff k <= d inside          *)
(* lift (S d) X undoes one lift.                                       *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d -> subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
  forall T d j X,
    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitution closure:                                              *)
(*   k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).  *)
(* The condition k <= d is propagated by the Quant case (both become  *)
(* S k and S d), and is exactly what makes the pure lift/subst        *)
(* identity hold.                                                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_subst_gen :
  forall T d X u k,
    k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d X u k Hk HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (d := S d) (k := S k); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    eapply sub_trans with
      (ty2 := subst_rec (Fork (lift (S d) X) T1) u k).
    + change (subtype (Fork (lift_rec X 0 d) (subst_rec T1 u k))
                      (subst_rec (Fork (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) T1) u k)).
      simpl.
      rewrite l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen by lia.
      apply sub_zero.
    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    eapply sub_trans with
      (ty2 := subst_rec (lift (S d) X) u k).
    + change (subtype (lift_rec X 0 d)
                      (subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k)).
      rewrite l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen by lia.
      apply sub_zero.
    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (d := d) (k := k); [exact Hk|exact HG].
Qed.

Require Import Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes String.

Open Scope string_scope.

Declare Scope tree_scope.
Global Open Scope tree_scope.

Inductive Tree:  Set :=
  | Ref : string -> Tree
  | Node : Tree
  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)
                 then S1 (star x M1) @ (star x M2)
                 else K@ (M1 @ M2)
  end.

Notation "\" := star : tree_scope.

Definition wait2 M N x :=  S1 (S1 (S1 (K @ M) @ (K @ N)) @ (K @ x)) @ I.

Definition omega21 := K @ (△ @ (△ @ I)).

Definition omega22 :=  \ "w" (\ "f" (wait2 (Ref "w") (Ref "w") (Ref "f"))).

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Invariant: a lift-indexed source projection.  The index d counts  *)
(* the Quant binders traversed.  The substitution closure uses the    *)
(* cutoff k together with a side condition k <= d; this is the form   *)
(* needed by sub_inst (k = 0) and preserved by nested Quant.          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1) by lia.
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against   *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Substituting at cutoff k (k <= d) inside lift (S d) X undoes one
   lift, yielding lift d X. *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d ->
    subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
  forall T d j X,
    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitution closure: GoodStem (S d) X T ->                        *)
(*                       GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k),  k <= d.    *)
(* The side condition is preserved by the Quant case, which shifts    *)
(* both k and d by one.  sub_inst is the instance k = 0.              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_subst_gen :
  forall T d X u k,
    k <= d ->
    GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d X u k Hk HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    eapply sub_trans with
      (ty2 := subst_rec (Fork (lift (S d) X) T1) u k).
    + change (subtype (Fork (lift_rec X 0 d) (subst_rec T1 u k))
                      (subst_rec (Fork (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) T1) u k)).
      simpl.
      rewrite (l2_subst_lift_S_eq X u d k Hk).
      apply sub_zero.
    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    eapply sub_trans with
      (ty2 := subst_rec (lift (S d) X) u k).
    + change (subtype (lift_rec X 0 d)
                      (subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k)).
      rewrite (l2_subst_lift_S_eq X u d k Hk).
      apply sub_zero.
    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hk|exact HG].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Monotonicity of GoodStem along subtype.                            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d X, GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem d X U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H; intros d X HG; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HG.
  - (* trans *) apply (IHsubtype2 d X). apply (IHsubtype1 d X). exact HG.
  - (* stem *) exact (sub_trans _ _ _ HG H).
  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* asf *) apply (IHsubtype d X). exact HG.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (lift d X) uty1).
    + apply (sub_fork (lift d X) (lift d X) uty2 uty1 (sub_zero _) H).
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HG | exact H0].
  - (* quant *) apply (IHsubtype (S d) X). exact HG.
  - (* quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (lift d X))).
    + apply sub_lift.
    + rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* dist *) apply (l2_dist d X uty vty). exact HG.
  - (* inst *)
    change (GoodStem d X (subst_rec ty u 0)).
    apply (GoodStem_subst_gen ty d X u 0); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* lift *)
    change (GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
    apply (GoodStem_lift_gen ty d 0 X); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    apply (sub_fork (lift d X) uty vty vty HG (sub_zero _)).
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HG. cbn in HG. destruct HG.
  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Main theorem.                                                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma l2_lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros k; simpl.
  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
    destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl; reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma l2_lift_zero : forall X, lift 0 X = X.
Proof. intro X. unfold lift. apply l2_lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.

Lemma GoodStem_initial : forall X, GoodStem 0 X (Stem X).
Proof.
  intro X. simpl. rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma L2_literal :
  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  pose proof (GoodStem_mono (Stem X) (Funty a r) H 0 X
                (GoodStem_initial X)) as HG.
  simpl in HG. rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG. exact HG.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,

  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [| gamma9 uty9 HS0 | ]; subst.
  (* HS0 : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)); HF : derive (Node@x) u2 *)
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| gamma4 uty HS | ]; subst.

  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.

  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [| gamma6 uty6 HS1 | ]; subst.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof.
  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0.
Qed.

(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_var : forall i, subtype Leaf (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros i H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.
  unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 8. Strong soundness of App for a Leaf-reachable source.             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* All Stem/Fork/recursion/tree source cases are eliminated by the      *)
(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :
  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_funty_fork :
  forall a b Y Z, subtype (Funty a b) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a b Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Funty a b) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 10. Discharging the dist obligation of P_leaf unconditionally.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) is definitionally subtype (Stem u) v;   *)
(* the dist target is subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant v).  The        *)
(* following closed lemma supplies exactly that, so the Hdist         *)
(* hypothesis of P_leaf_mono is no longer needed.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
2	
3	Require Import terms.
4	
5	Open Scope string_scope.
6	
7	Open Scope nat_scope.
8	
9	Open Scope tree_scope.
10	
11	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
12	
13	Inductive dtype : Set :=
14	  Var :  nat -> dtype
15	| Quant : dtype -> dtype
16	| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
17	| Leaf : dtype
18	| Stem : dtype -> dtype
19	| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
20	| Asf : dtype -> dtype
21	.
22	
23	Fixpoint  program_type p :=
24	  match p with
25	  | Node => Leaf
26	  | p1 @ p2 =>
27	    match program_type p1 with
28	      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
29	    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
30	    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
31	    end
32	  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
33	  end.
34	
35	Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
36	intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).
37	
38	Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
39	    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).
40	
41	Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
42	    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).
43	
44	Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
45	  match test k i with
46	     | left _ => n+i
47	     | _ => i
48	  end.
49	
50	Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.
51	
52	Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
53	  fun k n =>
54	  match L with
55	  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
56	  | Leaf => Leaf
57	  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
58	  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
59	  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
60	  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
61	  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
62	  end.
63	
64	Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.
65	
66	Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
67	  match compare k i with
68	
69	     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
70	     | inleft _ => lift k N
71	     | _ => Var i
72	  end.
73	
74	Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
75	  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
76	  match L with
77	  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
78	  | Leaf => Leaf
79	  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
80	  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
81	  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
82	  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
83	  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
84	  end.
85	
86	Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.
87	
88	Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
89	  match gamma with
90	  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
91	  | _ => None
92	  end.
93	
94	Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).
95	
96	Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.
97	
98	Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).
99	
100	Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
101	  match t with
102	  | Ref x => get x gamma
103	  | Node => Some Leaf
104	  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
105	  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
106	    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
107	    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
108	    | (_,_) => None
109	    end
110	  | _ => None
111	  end.
112	
113	Fixpoint quant n ty :=
114	  match n with
115	  | 0 => ty
116	  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
117	  end.
118	
119	Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
120	  match n with
121	  | 0 => ty
122	  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
123	  end.
124	
125	Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
126	  match bs with
127	    nil => ty
128	  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
129	  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
130	  end.
131	
132	Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
133	  match bs with
134	    nil => 0
135	  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
136	  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
137	  end.
138	
139	Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
140	  match n with
141	  | 0 => nil
142	  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
143	  end.
144	
145	Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=
146	
147	
148	  match ty with
149	  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
150	  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
151	  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
152	  | Leaf => true
153	  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
154	  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
155	  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
156	   end.

158	Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.

8	Inductive Tree:  Set :=

11	  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
12	.

31	| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')

36	  | Ref y => eqb x y
37	  | △ => false

43	  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
44	  | △ => K@ △
45	  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
2	Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
3	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
4	Open Scope string_scope.
5	Open Scope nat_scope.
6	Open Scope tree_scope.
7	
8	(* ================================================================== *)
9	(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
10	(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
11	(*                                                                    *)
12	(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
13	(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
14	(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
15	(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
16	(* ================================================================== *)
17	
18	Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
19	  match T with
20	  | Var _ => False
21	  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
22	  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
23	  | Leaf => False
24	  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
25	  | Fork _ _ => False
26	  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
27	  end.
28	
29	(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
30	Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
31	Proof.
32	  intros X d. unfold lift.
33	  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
34	  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
35	Qed.
36	
37	(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
38	Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
39	Proof.
40	  intro u.
41	  eapply sub_trans.
42	  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
43	  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
44	Qed.
45	
46	(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
47	(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
48	(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
49	(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
50	Lemma l2_dist :
51	  forall d X u v,
52	    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
53	    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
54	Proof.
55	  intros d X u v H.
56	  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
57	  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
58	                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
59	  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
60	  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
61	  eapply sub_trans with
62	    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
63	  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
64	                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
65	    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
66	      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
67	    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
68	  - exact H3.
69	Qed.
70	
71	(* Pure term identity: substituting at a cutoff k <= d inside          *)
72	(* lift (S d) X undoes one lift.                                       *)
73	Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen :
74	  forall X u d k,
75	    k <= d -> subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
76	Proof.
77	  intros X u d k Hk.
78	  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
79	  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
80	  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
81	  exact H.
82	Qed.
83	
84	(* ================================================================== *)
85	(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
86	(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
87	(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                    *)
88	(* ================================================================== *)
89	
90	Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
91	  forall T d j X,
92	    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
93	Proof.
94	  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
95	  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
96	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
97	  - (* Funty *)
98	    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
99	    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
100	    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
101	    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
102	    exact Hlift.
103	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
104	  - (* Stem *)
105	    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
106	    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
107	    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
108	    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
109	    exact Hlift.
110	  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
111	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
112	Qed.
113	
114	(* ================================================================== *)
115	(* Substitution closure:                                              *)
116	(*   k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).  *)
117	(* The condition k <= d is propagated by the Quant case (both become  *)
118	(* S k and S d), and is exactly what makes the pure lift/subst        *)
119	(* identity hold.                                                     *)
120	(* ================================================================== *)
121	
122	Lemma GoodStem_subst_gen :
123	  forall T d X u k,
124	    k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).
125	Proof.
126	  induction T; intros d X u k Hk HG; simpl in *.
127	  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
128	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (d := S d) (k := S k); [lia|exact HG].
129	  - (* Funty *)
130	    eapply sub_trans with
131	      (ty2 := subst_rec (Fork (lift (S d) X) T1) u k).
132	    + change (subtype (Fork (lift_rec X 0 d) (subst_rec T1 u k))
133	                      (subst_rec (Fork (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) T1) u k)).
134	      simpl.
135	      rewrite l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen by lia.
136	      apply sub_zero.
137	    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
138	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
139	  - (* Stem *)
140	    eapply sub_trans with
141	      (ty2 := subst_rec (lift (S d) X) u k).
142	    + change (subtype (lift_rec X 0 d)
143	                      (subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k)).
144	      rewrite l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen by lia.
145	      apply sub_zero.
146	    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
147	  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
148	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (d := d) (k := k); [exact Hk|exact HG].
149	Qed.
150	
151	(* ================================================================== *)
152	(* Monotonicity of GoodStem along subtype.                            *)
153	(* ================================================================== *)
154	
155	Lemma GoodStem_mono :
156	  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d X, GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem d X U.
157	Proof.
158	  intros T U H.
159	  induction H; intros d X HG; simpl in *.
160	  - (* zero *) exact HG.
161	  - (* trans *) apply (IHsubtype2 d X). apply (IHsubtype1 d X). exact HG.
162	  - (* stem *) exact (sub_trans _ _ _ HG H).
163	  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
164	  - (* asf *) apply (IHsubtype d X). exact HG.
165	  - (* funty *)
166	    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (lift d X) uty1).
167	    + apply (sub_fork (lift d X) (lift d X) uty2 uty1 (sub_zero _) H).
168	    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HG | exact H0].
169	  - (* quant *) apply (IHsubtype (S d) X). exact HG.
170	  - (* quant_stem *)
171	    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (lift d X))).
172	    + apply sub_lift.
173	    + rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. apply sub_quant. exact HG.
174	  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
175	  - (* quant_asf *) exact HG.
176	  - (* dist *) apply (l2_dist d X uty vty). exact HG.
177	  - (* inst *)
178	    change (GoodStem d X (subst_rec ty u 0)).
179	    apply (GoodStem_subst_gen ty d X u 0); [lia|exact HG].
180	  - (* lift *)
181	    change (GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
182	    apply (GoodStem_lift_gen ty d 0 X); [lia|exact HG].
183	  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
184	  - (* stem_fun *)
185	    apply (sub_fork (lift d X) uty vty vty HG (sub_zero _)).
186	  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
187	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
188	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
189	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
190	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
191	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HG. cbn in HG. destruct HG.
192	  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
193	  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
194	  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
195	  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
196	  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.
197	Qed.
198	
199	(* ================================================================== *)
200	(* Main theorem.                                                      *)
201	(* ================================================================== *)
202	
203	(* lift 0 X = X (the `test` inside relocate is stuck on a variable,   *)
204	(* so this needs a small induction).                                  *)
205	Lemma l2_lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
206	Proof.
207	  induction x; intros k; simpl.
208	  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
209	    destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl; reflexivity.
210	  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHx.
211	  - (* Funty *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
212	  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
213	  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
214	  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
215	  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
216	Qed.
217	
218	Lemma l2_lift_zero : forall X, lift 0 X = X.
219	Proof. intro X. unfold lift. apply l2_lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.
220	
221	Lemma GoodStem_initial : forall X, GoodStem 0 X (Stem X).
222	Proof.
223	  intro X. simpl. rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero.
224	Qed.
225	
226	Lemma L2_literal :
227	  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
228	Proof.
229	  intros X a r H.
230	  pose proof (GoodStem_mono (Stem X) (Funty a r) H 0 X
231	                (GoodStem_initial X)) as HG.
232	  simpl in HG. rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG. exact HG.
233	Qed.
234	
235	Print Assumptions L2_literal.
236

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
2	Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB Size.
3	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
4	Open Scope string_scope.
5	Open Scope nat_scope.
6	Open Scope tree_scope.
7	
8	(* ================================================================== *)
9	(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
10	(*                                                                    *)
11	(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
12	(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
13	(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
14	(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
15	(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
16	(*                                                                    *)
17	(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
18	(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
19	(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
20	(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
21	(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
22	(* ================================================================== *)
23	
24	(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
25	(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
26	(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
27	Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
28	  match T with
29	  | Var i => Var i
30	  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
31	  | Funty _ r => r
32	  | Leaf => Leaf
33	  | Stem u => u
34	  | Fork _ v => v
35	  | Asf T' => extr T'
36	  end.
37	
38	(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
39	Lemma extr_lift_rec :
40	  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
41	Proof.
42	  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
43	  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
44	  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
45	  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
46	  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
47	  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
48	  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
49	  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
50	Qed.
51	
52	(* ================================================================== *)
53	(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
54	(*                                                                    *)
55	(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
56	(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
57	(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
58	(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
59	(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
60	(* ================================================================== *)
61	
62	Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
63	  match T with
64	  | Var _ => False
65	  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
66	  | Funty _ _ => True
67	  | Leaf => False
68	  | Stem _ => False
69	  | Fork u _ => R u
70	  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
71	  end.
72	
73	Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
74	Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.
75	
76	Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
77	  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
78	Proof.
79	  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
80	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
81	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
82	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
83	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
84	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
85	  - (* Fork *) apply R_subst_rec. exact HR.
86	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
87	Qed.
88	
89	Lemma ReachFork_lift_rec :
90	  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
91	Proof.
92	  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
93	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
94	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
95	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
96	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
97	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
98	  - (* Fork *) apply R_lift_rec. exact HR.
99	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
100	Qed.
101	
102	(* On the ReachFork fragment, extr commutes with substitution with    *)
103	(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)
104	(* e.g. extr (Fork A B) = B, and substituting in the discarded first  *)
105	(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
106	Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
107	  forall T u k,
108	    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
109	Proof.
110	  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
111	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
112	  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHT. exact HR.
113	  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
114	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
115	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
116	  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
117	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
118	Qed.
119	
120	(* ReachFork is monotone along subtype. *)
121	Lemma ReachFork_mono :
122	  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
123	Proof.
124	  intros T U H.
125	  induction H as
126	    [ ty
127	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
128	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
129	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
130	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
131	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
132	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
133	    | u
134	    | u v
135	    | u
136	    | u v
137	    | ty u
138	    | ty
139	    | uty
140	    | uty vty
141	    | uty vty
142	    | uty vty wty
143	    | uty vty wty
144	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
145	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
146	    | k uty vty
147	    | ty uty Hcov
148	    | ty
149	    | uty vty
150	    | uty vty
151	    | uty vty wty ];
152	    intros HR; simpl in *.
153	  - (* zero *) exact HR.
154	  - (* trans *) eauto.
155	  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
156	  - (* fork *) eapply R_mono; eauto.
157	  - (* asf *) eauto.
158	  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
159	  - (* quant *) eauto.
160	  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
161	  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.
162	  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
163	  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
164	  - (* inst *) apply ReachFork_subst_rec with (u := u) (k := 0). exact HR.
165	  - (* lift *) apply ReachFork_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
166	  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
167	  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
168	  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
169	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
170	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
171	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
172	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
173	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
174	  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
175	  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
176	  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
177	  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
178	  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
179	Qed.
180	
181	(* ================================================================== *)
182	(* Main invariant: on ReachFork types, extr is monotone for subtype.   *)
183	(* ================================================================== *)
184	
185	Lemma extr_mono_reach :
186	  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> subtype (extr T) (extr U).
187	Proof.
188	  intros T U H.
189	  induction H as
190	    [ ty
191	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
192	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
193	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
194	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
195	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
196	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
197	    | u
198	    | u v
199	    | u
200	    | u v
201	    | ty u
202	    | ty
203	    | uty
204	    | uty vty
205	    | uty vty
206	    | uty vty wty
207	    | uty vty wty
208	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
209	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
210	    | k uty vty
211	    | ty uty Hcov
212	    | ty
213	    | uty vty
214	    | uty vty
215	    | uty vty wty ];
216	    intros HR; simpl in *.
217	  - (* zero *) apply sub_zero.
218	  - (* trans *) eauto using sub_trans, ReachFork_mono.
219	  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
220	  - (* fork *) assumption.
221	  - (* asf *) eauto.
222	  - (* funty *) assumption.
223	  - (* quant *) eauto using sub_quant.
224	  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
225	  - (* quant_fork *) apply sub_zero.
226	  - (* quant_asf *) apply sub_zero.
227	  - (* dist *) apply sub_zero.
228	  - (* inst *)
229	    unfold subst.
230	    rewrite (ReachFork_extr_subst_rec ty u 0 HR).
231	    apply sub_inst.
232	  - (* lift *)
233	    unfold lift.
234	    rewrite extr_lift_rec.
235	    apply sub_lift.
236	  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
237	  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
238	  - (* fork_leaf *) apply sub_zero.
239	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
240	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
241	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
242	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
243	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
244	  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
245	  - (* to_asf *) apply sub_zero.
246	  - (* from_asf *) apply sub_zero.
247	  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
248	  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
249	Qed.
250	
251	(* ================================================================== *)
252	(* The requested two-derivation statement.  The size arguments are     *)
253	(* now only bookkeeping: the invariant proof is independent of them.   *)
254	(* ================================================================== *)
255	
256	Lemma L3_literal_aux :
257	  forall p : {n : nat & nat},
258	    (forall S a r X nH nK,
259	        subtype_size S (Funty a r) nH ->
260	        subtype_size (Fork Leaf X) S nK ->
261	        p = existT (fun _ : nat => nat) (nK + nH + 1) nH ->
262	        subtype X r).
263	Proof.
264	  intros p S a r X nH nK HH HK Ep.
265	  pose proof (subtype_size_sound _ _ _ HK) as HKsub.
266	  pose proof (subtype_size_sound _ _ _ HH) as HHsub.
267	  pose proof (ReachFork_fork_leaf X) as HR.
268	  pose proof (extr_mono_reach _ _ HKsub HR) as HX.
269	  pose proof (ReachFork_mono _ _ HKsub HR) as HS.
270	  pose proof (extr_mono_reach _ _ HHsub HS) as Hr.
271	  eapply sub_trans.
272	  - exact HX.
273	  - exact Hr.
274	Qed.
275	
276	Lemma L3_literal :
277	  forall X a r, subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.
278	Proof.
279	  intros X a r H.
280	  destruct (subtype_has_size _ _ H) as [nH HnH].
281	  exact (L3_literal_aux
282	           (existT (fun _ : nat => nat) (1 + nH + 1) nH)
283	           (Fork Leaf X) a r X nH 1 HnH (szs_zero (Fork Leaf X)) eq_refl).
284	Qed.

286	Print Assumptions L3_literal.

288	(* General leafy Fork inversion, using the same ReachFork invariant. *)
289	Lemma L3_leaf :
290	  forall C X a r,
291	    subtype Leaf C -> subtype (Fork C X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.
292	Proof.
293	  intros C X a r HC H.
294	  pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype C HC) as HR.
295	  exact (extr_mono_reach (Fork C X) (Funty a r) H HR).
296	Qed.

158	    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->

162	    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
2	Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
3	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
4	Open Scope string_scope.
5	Open Scope nat_scope.
6	Open Scope tree_scope.
7	
8	(* ================================================================== *)
9	(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
10	(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
11	(*                                                                    *)
12	(* Invariant: a lift-indexed source projection.  The index d counts  *)
13	(* the Quant binders traversed.  The substitution closure uses the    *)
14	(* cutoff k together with a side condition k <= d; this is the form   *)
15	(* needed by sub_inst (k = 0) and preserved by nested Quant.          *)
16	(* ================================================================== *)
17	
18	Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
19	  match T with
20	  | Var _ => False
21	  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
22	  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
23	  | Leaf => False
24	  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
25	  | Fork _ _ => False
26	  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
27	  end.
28	
29	(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
30	Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
31	Proof.
32	  intros X d. unfold lift.
33	  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1) by lia.
34	  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
35	Qed.
36	
37	(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
38	Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
39	Proof.
40	  intro u.
41	  eapply sub_trans.
42	  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
43	  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
44	Qed.
45	
46	(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
47	(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
48	(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against   *)
49	(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
50	Lemma l2_dist :
51	  forall d X u v,
52	    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
53	    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
54	Proof.
55	  intros d X u v H.
56	  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
57	  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
58	                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
59	  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
60	  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
61	  eapply sub_trans with
62	    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
63	  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
64	                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
65	    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
66	      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
67	    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
68	  - exact H3.
69	Qed.
70	
71	(* Substituting at cutoff k (k <= d) inside lift (S d) X undoes one
72	   lift, yielding lift d X. *)
73	Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq :
74	  forall X u d k,
75	    k <= d ->
76	    subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
77	Proof.
78	  intros X u d k Hk.
79	  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
80	  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
81	  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
82	  exact H.
83	Qed.
84	
85	(* ================================================================== *)
86	(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
87	(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
88	(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                   *)
89	(* ================================================================== *)
90	
91	Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
92	  forall T d j X,
93	    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
94	Proof.
95	  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
96	  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
97	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
98	  - (* Funty *)
99	    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
100	    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
101	    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
102	    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
103	    exact Hlift.
104	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
105	  - (* Stem *)
106	    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
107	    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
108	    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
109	    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
110	    exact Hlift.
111	  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
112	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
113	Qed.
114	
115	(* ================================================================== *)
116	(* Substitution closure: GoodStem (S d) X T ->                        *)
117	(*                       GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k),  k <= d.    *)
118	(* The side condition is preserved by the Quant case, which shifts    *)
119	(* both k and d by one.  sub_inst is the instance k = 0.              *)
120	(* ================================================================== *)
121	
122	Lemma GoodStem_subst_gen :
123	  forall T d X u k,
124	    k <= d ->
125	    GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).
126	Proof.
127	  induction T; intros d X u k Hk HG; simpl in *.
128	  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
129	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
130	  - (* Funty *)
131	    eapply sub_trans with
132	      (ty2 := subst_rec (Fork (lift (S d) X) T1) u k).
133	    + change (subtype (Fork (lift_rec X 0 d) (subst_rec T1 u k))
134	                      (subst_rec (Fork (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) T1) u k)).
135	      simpl.
136	      rewrite (l2_subst_lift_S_eq X u d k Hk).
137	      apply sub_zero.
138	    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
139	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
140	  - (* Stem *)
141	    eapply sub_trans with
142	      (ty2 := subst_rec (lift (S d) X) u k).
143	    + change (subtype (lift_rec X 0 d)
144	                      (subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k)).
145	      rewrite (l2_subst_lift_S_eq X u d k Hk).
146	      apply sub_zero.
147	    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
148	  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
149	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hk|exact HG].
150	Qed.
151	
152	(* ================================================================== *)
153	(* Monotonicity of GoodStem along subtype.                            *)
154	(* ================================================================== *)
155	
156	Lemma GoodStem_mono :
157	  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d X, GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem d X U.
158	Proof.
159	  intros T U H.
160	  induction H; intros d X HG; simpl in *.
161	  - (* zero *) exact HG.
162	  - (* trans *) apply (IHsubtype2 d X). apply (IHsubtype1 d X). exact HG.
163	  - (* stem *) exact (sub_trans _ _ _ HG H).
164	  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
165	  - (* asf *) apply (IHsubtype d X). exact HG.
166	  - (* funty *)
167	    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (lift d X) uty1).
168	    + apply (sub_fork (lift d X) (lift d X) uty2 uty1 (sub_zero _) H).
169	    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HG | exact H0].
170	  - (* quant *) apply (IHsubtype (S d) X). exact HG.
171	  - (* quant_stem *)
172	    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (lift d X))).
173	    + apply sub_lift.
174	    + rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. apply sub_quant. exact HG.
175	  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
176	  - (* quant_asf *) exact HG.
177	  - (* dist *) apply (l2_dist d X uty vty). exact HG.
178	  - (* inst *)
179	    change (GoodStem d X (subst_rec ty u 0)).
180	    apply (GoodStem_subst_gen ty d X u 0); [lia|exact HG].
181	  - (* lift *)
182	    change (GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
183	    apply (GoodStem_lift_gen ty d 0 X); [lia|exact HG].
184	  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
185	  - (* stem_fun *)
186	    apply (sub_fork (lift d X) uty vty vty HG (sub_zero _)).
187	  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
188	  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
189	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
190	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
191	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
192	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HG. cbn in HG. destruct HG.
193	  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
194	  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
195	  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
196	  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
197	  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.
198	Qed.
199	
200	(* ================================================================== *)
201	(* Main theorem.                                                      *)
202	(* ================================================================== *)
203	
204	Lemma l2_lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
205	Proof.
206	  induction x; intros k; simpl.
207	  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
208	    destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl; reflexivity.
209	  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHx.
210	  - (* Funty *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
211	  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
212	  - (* Stem *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
213	  - (* Fork *) rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
214	  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
215	Qed.
216	
217	Lemma l2_lift_zero : forall X, lift 0 X = X.
218	Proof. intro X. unfold lift. apply l2_lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.
219	
220	Lemma GoodStem_initial : forall X, GoodStem 0 X (Stem X).
221	Proof.
222	  intro X. simpl. rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero.
223	Qed.
224	
225	Lemma L2_literal :
226	  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
227	Proof.
228	  intros X a r H.
229	  pose proof (GoodStem_mono (Stem X) (Funty a r) H 0 X
230	                (GoodStem_initial X)) as HG.
231	  simpl in HG. rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG. exact HG.
232	Qed.
233	
234	Print Assumptions L2_literal.

12	
13	Lemma quant_S : forall d t, quant (S d) t = quant d (Quant t).
14	Proof. intros d t. reflexivity. Qed.
15	
16	Lemma quant_Quant : forall d t, quant d (Quant t) = Quant (quant d t).
17	Proof.
18	  induction d as [|d IH]; intro t; simpl.
19	  - reflexivity.
20	  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
21	Qed.
22	
23	Lemma quant_mono : forall d A B, subtype A B -> subtype (quant d A) (quant d B).
24	Proof.
25	  induction d as [|d IH]; intros A B H; simpl.
26	  - exact H.
27	  - apply IH. apply sub_quant. exact H.
28	Qed.

30	(* subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) *)
31	Lemma quant_lift_intro : forall d a,
32	  subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
33	Proof.
34	  intros d a.
35	  change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
36	  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.

55	  subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
56	Proof.
57	  intros d a.
58	  change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
59	  apply quant_mono. apply quant_lift_elim_one.
60	Qed.
61	
62	(* (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) is below (quant d (Fork a b)) *)

64	  subtype (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) (quant d (Fork a b)).
65	Proof.
66	  induction d as [|d IH]; intros a b; simpl.
67	  - apply sub_zero.
68	  - rewrite !quant_Quant.

71	    + apply sub_quant.

76	           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.

79	           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.

84	(* The Good predicate.                                                *)
85	(*   Good d x (Stem y)      = subtype x (quant d y)                    *)
86	(*   Good d x (Funty a r)   = subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) *)
87	(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
88	(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)

93	  | Var _ => False
94	  | Leaf => False
95	  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
96	  | Fork _ _ => False

126	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
127	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
128	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
129	    | uty
130	    | uty vty
131	    | uty
132	    | uty vty
133	    | ty u
134	    | ty
135	    | uty
136	    | uty vty
137	    | uty vty
138	    | uty vty wty
139	    | uty vty wty
140	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
141	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
142	    | k uty vty
143	    | ty uty Hcov
144	    | ty
145	    | uty vty
146	    | uty vty
147	    | uty vty wty ];

151	  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
