153	    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
154	  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
155	  - (* asf *) eauto.
156	  - (* funty *)
157	    eapply sub_trans.
158	    + eapply sub_trans.
159	      * apply sub_fork.
160	        -- apply sub_zero.
161	        -- apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
162	      * exact HP.
163	    + apply quant_mono. exact Hsub1.

280	Lemma nat_lex_rect (P : nat -> nat -> Prop)
281	  (H : forall n m,
282	      (forall n' m', n' < n -> P n' m') ->
283	      (forall m', m' < m -> P n m') ->
284	      P n m) :
285	  forall n m, P n m.
286	Proof.
287	  intros n.
288	  induction n as [n IHn] using lt_wf_ind.
289	  intros m.
290	  induction m as [m IHm] using lt_wf_ind.
291	  exact (H n m
292	           (fun n' m' Hlt => IHn n' Hlt m')
293	           (fun m' Hlt => IHm m' Hlt)).
294	Qed.

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

9	(* ================================================================== *)
10	(* Reachable-head invariant for a Fork source.                        *)
11	(*                                                                    *)
12	(* RF is true on the heads that can be reached from a Fork source:    *)
13	(* Fork and Funty, or a type whose Asf/Quant spine ends in one of     *)
14	(* them.  Leaf, Stem and Var are unreachable.                         *)
15	(* ================================================================== *)
16	
17	Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
18	  match T with
19	  | Var _ => False
20	  | Leaf => False
21	  | Stem _ => False
22	  | Fork _ _ => True
23	  | Funty _ _ => True
24	  | Asf T' => RF T'
25	  | Quant T' => RF T'
26	  end.
27	
28	Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
29	Proof.
30	  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
31	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
32	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
33	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
34	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
35	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
36	  - (* Fork *) exact Logic.I.
37	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
38	Qed.
39	
40	Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
41	Proof.
42	  induction T; intros k mm HR; simpl in *.
43	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
44	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
45	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
46	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
47	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
48	  - (* Fork *) exact Logic.I.
49	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
50	Qed.
51	
52	Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
53	Proof.
54	  intros T U H.
55	  induction H as
56	    [ ty
57	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
58	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
59	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
60	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
61	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
62	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
63	    | uty
64	    | uty vty
65	    | uty
66	    | uty vty
67	    | ty u
68	    | ty
69	    | uty
70	    | uty vty
71	    | uty vty
72	    | uty vty wty
73	    | uty vty wty
74	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
75	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
76	    | k uty vty
77	    | ty uty Hcov
78	    | ty
79	    | uty vty
80	    | uty vty
81	    | uty vty wty ];
82	    intros HR; simpl in *.
83	  - (* zero *) exact HR.
84	  - (* trans *) eauto.
85	  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
86	  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
87	  - (* asf *) eauto.
88	  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
89	  - (* quant *) eauto.
90	  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
91	  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
92	  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.

99	  - (* fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
100	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
101	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
102	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exact Logic.I.
103	  - (* recursion *) exact Logic.I.
104	  - (* tree *) exact Logic.I.

133	(* The general Fork inversion with leafy first component (the statement
134	   requested after L3_leaf).  There are two projections; the first is
135	   the "leafy first component" part, the second is the codomain part. *)
136	Definition Fork_first_inversion_leafy : Prop :=
137	  forall C X A B,
138	    subtype Leaf C ->
139	    subtype (Fork C X) (Fork A B) ->
140	    subtype C A.

144	    subtype (Fork C X) (Fork A B) ->
145	    subtype X B.

148	   the Fork inversion. *)
149	Definition Fork_quant_inversion_leafy : Prop :=
150	  forall C X A B,
151	    subtype Leaf C ->
152	    subtype (Fork C X) (Quant (Fork A B)) ->
153	    subtype C (Quant A).
154	
155	Definition Fork_quant_second_inversion : Prop :=
156	  forall C X A B,
157	    subtype (Fork C X) (Quant (Fork A B)) ->
158	    subtype X (Quant B).

160	(* ================================================================== *)
161	(* Status of L3_leaf.                                                 *)
162	(*                                                                    *)
163	(* L3_leaf : forall C X a r, subtype Leaf C ->                        *)
164	(*            subtype (Fork C X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.          *)
165	(*                                                                    *)
166	(* RF above eliminates all atomic H branches whose source is Leaf,    *)
167	(* Stem or Var.  The remaining cut-elimination problem is the          *)
168	(* interaction of sub_trans on the two derivations.                   *)
169	(*                                                                    *)
170	(* The size-only measure proposed for the cut-elimination cannot       *)
171	(* handle both trans cases with the suggested recursive pairs.  With  *)
172	(* szs_trans sizes n = n1 + n2 + 1:                                   *)
173	(*                                                                    *)
174	(*  H = szs_trans H1 H2:                                              *)
175	(*    K' = szs_trans K H1 has size nK + n1 + 1, H' = H2 has size n2.  *)
176	(*    The sum nK' + n2 equals nK + nH, and n2 < nH.                   *)
177	(*                                                                    *)
178	(*  K = szs_trans K1 K2:                                              *)
179	(*    K' = K1 has size nK1, H' = szs_trans K2 H has size nK2+nH+1.    *)
180	(*    The sum nK1 + (nK2+nH+1) also equals nK + nH, but the second    *)
181	(*    component increases.                                            *)
182	(*                                                                    *)
183	(* Thus the two recursive calls transfer weight between K and H in    *)
184	(* opposite directions along the same line nK+nH = const.  No        *)
185	(* lexicographic order on the size pair alone can decrease for both.  *)
186	(* A refined measure (or a source-sensitive invariant) is required.   *)
187	(*                                                                    *)
188	(* A second, independent obstruction appears in the atomic pair      *)
189	(* table for L3_leaf.  RF shows that the H-source S of               *)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* forward reachability invariant RF *)
Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR. - apply IHT; exact HR. - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR. - destruct HR. - exact Logic.I. - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR. - apply IHT; exact HR. - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR. - destruct HR. - exact Logic.I. - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - exact HR.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply RF_subst_rec with (k:=0). exact HR.
  - apply RF_lift_rec with (k:=0) (m:=1). exact HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma RF_fork : forall C X, RF (Fork C X).
Proof. intros. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype : forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof. intros. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply RF_fork. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_leaf : forall D E, subtype (Fork D E) Leaf -> False.
Proof. intros D E H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E Leaf H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_stem : forall D E Y, subtype (Fork D E) (Stem Y) -> False.
Proof. intros D E Y H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Stem Y) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_var : forall D E i, subtype (Fork D E) (Var i) -> False.
Proof. intros D E i H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Var i) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

  subtype (Fork B A) (Funty C R) ->

Proof.

Abort.

Proof.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.

(* forward reachability invariant RF *)
Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR. - apply IHT; exact HR. - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR. - destruct HR. - exact Logic.I. - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR. - apply IHT; exact HR. - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR. - destruct HR. - exact Logic.I. - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - exact HR.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.

Proof. intros. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Open Scope string_scope.

(* A closed counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.  The term is a
   leaf_red redex whose reduct is Node, and it is typable at Stem Leaf,
   a type that Node cannot have. *)

Definition M0 : Tree :=
  △ @ ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △) @ △.

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

(* Node : Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma node_fun2 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Node : Funty Leaf (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf))). *)
Lemma node_fun3 :
  subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Node @ Node : Stem Leaf. *)
Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The inner argument ((Node @ Node) @ Node) : Leaf. *)
Lemma dInner : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + apply derive_node. exact node_fun2.
    + apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Main typing derivation. *)
Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_app.
      * apply derive_node. exact node_fun3.
      * exact dInner.
    + exact dK.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply leaf_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as
    [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

(* In particular the requested inversion lemma [inv_leaf] is refuted: its
   premises are exactly the three leaf facts proved above. *)
Lemma inv_leaf_is_false :
  ~ (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
       subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
       subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
       subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty).
Proof.
  intro Hin.
  pose proof
    (Hin Leaf (Stem Leaf) Leaf (Stem Leaf) Leaf Leaf
       node_fun3 node_fun2 (sub_zero Leaf)) as Hbad.
  exact (AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem _ Hbad).
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_leaf_is_false.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* de Bruijn/quant helpers                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_S : forall d t, quant (S d) t = quant d (Quant t).
Proof. intros d t. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma quant_Quant : forall d t, quant d (Quant t) = Quant (quant d t).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intro t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma quant_mono : forall d A B, subtype A B -> subtype (quant d A) (quant d B).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros A B H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply sub_quant. exact H.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) *)
Lemma quant_lift_intro : forall d a,
  subtype (quant d a) (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d a) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a)))).
  apply quant_mono. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a, used for the reverse direction *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_one : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  exact AgentB.subtype_quant_lift_elim.
Qed.

(* subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim_onek : forall a, subtype (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)) a.
Proof.
  intros a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a) *)
Lemma quant_lift_elim : forall d a,
  subtype (quant (S d) (lift 1 a)) (quant d a).
Proof.
  intros d a.
  change (subtype (quant d (Quant (lift 1 a))) (quant d a)).
  apply quant_mono. apply quant_lift_elim_one.
Qed.

(* (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) is below (quant d (Fork a b)) *)
Lemma quant_fork_inv : forall d a b,
  subtype (Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)) (quant d (Fork a b)).
Proof.
  induction d as [|d IH]; intros a b; simpl.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - rewrite !quant_Quant.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork (Quant (quant d a)) (Quant (quant d b))).
    + apply sub_quant.
      simpl. eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (quant d a) (quant d b)).
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
           ++ unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
      * apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Good predicate.                                                *)
(*   Good d x (Stem y)      = subtype x (quant d y)                    *)
(*   Good d x (Funty a r)   = subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) *)
(*   Good d x (Quant T)     = Good (S d) x T                          *)
(*   Good d x (Asf T)       = Good d x T                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => Good d x T'
  | Quant T' => Good (S d) x T'
  end.

(* The two algebraic obligations, isolated.  The leafy hypothesis         *)
(* (subtype Leaf x) is kept because it is available in the applications  *)
(* and is needed for the Quant/lift corner cases.                        *)
Definition Good_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> Good d x T ->
    Good d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

Definition Good_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> Good (S d) x T ->
    Good d x (subst T u).

Lemma Good_mono
  (Hlift : Good_lift_obligation)
  (Hinst : Good_inst_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype Leaf x -> subtype T U ->
      Good d x T -> Good d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hleaf Hsub.
  revert d x Hleaf.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x Hleaf HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
      * exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hsub1.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * exact HP.
      * apply sub_zero.
    + apply quant_fork_inv.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. cbn in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

Print Assumptions Good_mono.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Status of the two algebraic obligations used by Good_mono.          *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Good_inst_obligation is FALSE as stated: below is a closed true     *)
(* premise whose forced conclusion is not derivable (model check; see  *)
(* AgentB_Good_counter.v).  Good_lift_obligation is NOT refuted by the *)
(* natural 2-Quant instance: its forced conclusion is derivable.  It   *)
(* remains open.  AgentA_Good.v itself stays sound: both obligations   *)
(* occur there only as hypotheses of Good_mono.                        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Closed computation facts.                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma hlift_subst_compute_1 :
  lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf))
  = Funty (Var 1) (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_funty_leaf_leaf : lift 1 (Funty Leaf Leaf) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hlift_subst_compute_2 :
  subst (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)) (Var 0)
  = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_var0_leaf : subst (Var 0) Leaf = Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A true premise of Good_inst_obligation.                            *)
(* d = 0, x = Leaf, T = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf), u = Var 0.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma good_inst_counter_premise :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0)))
          (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * rewrite <- subst_var0_leaf. apply sub_inst.
    + rewrite <- lift_funty_leaf_leaf.
      apply sub_lift.
Qed.

Lemma good_inst_counter_premise_Good :
  Good 1 Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  simpl. exact good_inst_counter_premise.
Qed.

(* What Good_inst_obligation would force from that premise. *)
Lemma good_inst_would_force :
  Good_inst_obligation ->
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Var 0)) (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof.
  intro Hinst.
  unfold Good_inst_obligation in Hinst.
  change (Good 0 Leaf
            (Funty (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))
                   (subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0)))).
  apply Hinst with (x := Leaf) (d := 0)
                   (T := Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)) (u := Var 0).
  - apply sub_zero.
  - exact good_inst_counter_premise_Good.
Qed.

(* The forced conclusion is not derivable (closure model: 0 paths for
   Fork Leaf (Var 0) <: Funty Leaf Leaf; any path would have to use
   sub_fork_leaf and then a subtype var 0 <: Leaf, which cannot exist).
   Hence Good_inst_obligation is false. *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A true premise of Good_lift_obligation.                            *)
(* d = 1, x = Leaf, T = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf).              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma good_lift_counter_premise_Good :
  Good 1 Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof. exact good_inst_counter_premise_Good. Qed.

(* What Good_lift_obligation would force from that premise. *)
Lemma good_lift_would_force :
  Good_lift_obligation ->
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Quant (Var 1))))
          (Quant (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  intro Hlift.
  unfold Good_lift_obligation in Hlift.
  change (Good 1 Leaf
            (Quant (lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf))))).
  apply Hlift with (x := Leaf) (d := 1).
  - apply sub_zero.
  - exact good_lift_counter_premise_Good.
Qed.

(* Shape check: the goal above is literally the conclusion of the
   obligation on this instance. *)
Lemma good_lift_goal_shape :
  Good 1 Leaf (Quant (lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf))))
  = subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Quant (Var 1))))
            (Quant (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

(* IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the forced conclusion of the lift obligation
   on this instance IS derivable.  A twice-quantified free variable can
   be collapsed to Leaf by sub_inst at level 1 and then at level 0.
   Hence this instance is NOT a counterexample to Good_lift. *)

Lemma subst_quant_var1_leaf : subst (Quant (Var 1)) Leaf = Quant Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_leaf_leaf2 : subst Leaf Leaf = Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_funtyLL : lift 1 (Funty Leaf Leaf) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_quant_funtyLL :
  lift 1 (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)) = Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma QQVar1_leaf : subtype (Quant (Quant (Var 1))) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant Leaf).
  - rewrite <- subst_quant_var1_leaf. apply sub_inst.
  - rewrite <- subst_leaf_leaf2. apply sub_inst.
Qed.

Lemma good_lift_counter_goal_derivable :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Quant (Var 1))))
          (Quant (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork Leaf Leaf).
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + exact QQVar1_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf Leaf).
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
      * rewrite <- lift_funtyLL. apply sub_lift.
      * rewrite <- lift_quant_funtyLL. apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* Consequently our earlier quick reading of this instance as a
   counterexample was wrong; Good_lift_obligation remains OPEN. *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Vindication of the earlier L2 concern: the Quant-headed codomain   *)
(* instance IS derivable.  Any claim that L2 fails on this instance   *)
(* was wrong: sub_lift + sub_quant + sub_fork + sub_inst prove it.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_var0_inst_self : subtype (Quant (Var 0)) (Var 0).
Proof.
  change (subtype (Quant (Var 0)) (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))).
  apply sub_inst.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_quant_body :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Fork Leaf (Var 0)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_fork.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - apply quant_var0_inst_self.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_into_quant :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_quant.
    change (subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
    apply fork_quant_quant_body.
Qed.

Lemma L2_quant_codomain_premise :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant (Var 0)) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Funty (Var 0) (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (Stem Leaf)).
    + apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem Leaf).
    + apply sub_quant. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply sub_dist.
Qed.

Lemma L2_would_give_derivable_conclusion :
  (forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                 subtype (Fork X a) r) ->
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0))).
Proof.
  intro L2.
  exact (L2 Leaf (Quant (Var 0)) (Quant (Fork Leaf (Var 0)))
           L2_quant_codomain_premise).
Qed.

Print Assumptions good_inst_would_force.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The coordinator's substitution-closed predicate, without the extra  *)
(* base conjunct (so this is exactly the predicate tested in the      *)
(* finite closure model).                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint GoodC0 (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype x (quant d Y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r =>
      forall k u,
        subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst_rec a u k)))
                (quant d (subst_rec r u k))
  | Asf T' => GoodC0 d x T'
  | Quant T' => GoodC0 (S d) x T'
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Stem cases requested by the coordinator.                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Inst: x <: quant (S d) Y  ==>  x <: quant d (subst Y u).
   quant (S d) Y is definitionally quant d (Quant Y), and
   Quant Y <: subst Y u by sub_inst, so quant_mono finishes.         *)
Lemma GoodC0_stem_inst :
  forall d x Y u,
    GoodC0 (S d) x (Stem Y) ->
    GoodC0 d x (Stem (subst Y u)).
Proof.
  intros d x Y u H.
  simpl in *.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact H.
  - change (subtype (quant d (Quant Y)) (quant d (subst Y u))).
    apply quant_mono.
    apply sub_inst.
Qed.

(* Lift: x <: quant d Y  ==>  x <: quant (S d) (lift 1 Y).
   This is quant_lift_intro, proved from sub_lift and quant_mono.    *)
Lemma GoodC0_stem_lift :
  forall d x Y,
    GoodC0 d x (Stem Y) ->
    GoodC0 (S d) x (Stem (lift 1 Y)).
Proof.
  intros d x Y H.
  simpl in *.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact H.
  - change (subtype (quant d Y) (quant d (Quant (lift 1 Y)))).
    apply quant_mono.
    apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* The Stem monotonicity step, included for completeness.             *)
Lemma GoodC0_stem_mono :
  forall d x Y Y',
    subtype Y Y' ->
    GoodC0 d x (Stem Y) ->
    GoodC0 d x (Stem Y').
Proof.
  intros d x Y Y' Hsub HG.
  simpl in *.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact HG.
  - apply quant_mono. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* Note on the lift_rec 1 1 Quant subcase.  If the Quant has already
   been pushed inside GoodC0, lifting at cutoff 1 would require a
   subtype comparison between quant (S d) Y and
   quant (S (S d)) (lift_rec Y 1 1).  The only available lift rule has
   cutoff 0, so this shape is not proved here. *)

Check GoodC0_stem_inst.
Check GoodC0_stem_lift.
Check GoodC0_stem_mono.
Print Assumptions GoodC0_stem_inst.
Print Assumptions GoodC0_stem_lift.
Print Assumptions GoodC0_stem_mono.
=====

Fixpoint GoodM (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift_rec x 0 d) (quant d Y)
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Funty a r => subtype (Fork (lift_rec x 0 d) (quant d a)) (quant d r)
  | Asf T' => GoodM d x T'
  | Quant T' => GoodM (S d) x T'
  end.

Lemma lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros k; simpl.
  - unfold relocate. destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl; reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHx.
  - rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_rec_zero : forall x, lift_rec x 0 0 = x.
Proof. intro x. apply lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.

Lemma GoodM_base : forall x, GoodM 0 x (Stem x).
Proof. intro x. simpl. rewrite lift_rec_zero. apply sub_zero. Qed.

Lemma GoodM_lift_obl : forall d x T, subtype Leaf x -> GoodM d x T -> GoodM d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).
Proof. admit. Admitted.

Lemma GoodM_inst_obl : forall d x T u, subtype Leaf x -> GoodM (S d) x T -> GoodM d x (subst T u).
Proof. admit. Admitted.

Lemma GoodM_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d x, subtype Leaf x -> GoodM d x T -> GoodM d x U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | u1 u2 Hs
    | u1 u2 v1 v2 Hs1 Hs2
    | u1 u2 Hs
    | u1 u2 v1 v2 Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x Hleaf HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans; [ exact HP | apply quant_mono; exact Hs ].
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
      * exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact H.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) simpl in *. simpl.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + admit. (* lift_d x <: lift_{S d} x *)
    + exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) simpl in *. simpl.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * admit. (* lift_d x <: lift_{S d} x *)
      * apply sub_zero.
    + exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply GoodM_inst_obl; [ exact Hleaf | exact HP ].
  - (* lift *) apply GoodM_lift_obl; [ exact Hleaf | exact HP ].
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork.
      * exact HP.
      * apply sub_zero.
    + apply AgentA_Good.quant_fork_inv.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. cbn in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Admitted.

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)

    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.

    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.

    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :
  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_funty_fork :
  forall a b Y Z, subtype (Funty a b) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a b Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Funty a b) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 10. Discharging the dist obligation of P_leaf unconditionally.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) is definitionally subtype (Stem u) v;   *)
(* the dist target is subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant v).  The        *)
(* following closed lemma supplies exactly that, so the Hdist         *)
(* hypothesis of P_leaf_mono is no longer needed.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_quant_dist : forall x y,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).

(* 6. A structural "head/safety" invariant Q that is unconditionally   *)
(*    monotone along subtype and stable under substitution and lift.   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Q forbids Fork at the head and recursively under Quant, and forbids *)
(* Var.  This is exactly the guard needed for the substitution lemma:  *)
(* the rules with Fork sources (sub_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,        *)
(* sub_bfff) and sub_recursion become vacuous, while all other rules   *)
(* preserve Q.                                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint Q (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => True
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => Q T'
  end.

Lemma Q_subst_rec : forall T u k, Q T -> Q (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_lift_rec : forall T k n, Q T -> Q (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> Q T -> Q U.
Proof.

    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];

  - (* zero *) exact HQ.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply Q_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HQ.
  - (* lift *) apply Q_lift_rec with (k := 0) (n := 1). exact HQ.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.

(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A size-annotated version of the subtype relation, used for well-founded
   recursion on pairs of derivations.  It mirrors subtypes.v exactly. *)
Inductive subtype_size : dtype -> dtype -> nat -> Prop :=
| szs_zero : forall ty, subtype_size ty ty 1
| szs_trans : forall a b c n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size b c m ->
    subtype_size a c (n + m + 1)
| szs_stem : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Stem a) (Stem b) (S n)
| szs_fork : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Fork a c) (Fork b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_asf : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Asf a) (Asf b) (S n)
| szs_funty : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size b a n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Funty a c) (Funty b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_quant : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Quant a) (Quant b) (S n)
| szs_quant_stem : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Stem u)) (Stem (Quant u)) 1
| szs_quant_fork : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Fork u v)) (Fork (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_quant_asf : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Asf u)) (Asf (Quant u)) 1
| szs_dist : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Funty u v)) (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_inst : forall ty u, subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) 1
| szs_lift : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) 1
| szs_leaf_fun : forall u, subtype_size Leaf (Funty u (Stem u)) 1
| szs_stem_fun : forall u v, subtype_size (Stem u) (Funty v (Fork u v)) 1
| szs_fork_leaf : forall u v, subtype_size (Fork Leaf u) (Funty v u) 1
| szs_fork_stem : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) (Funty u w) 1
| szs_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) w) (Funty Leaf u) 1
| szs_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) (Funty (Stem v1) v2) 1
| szs_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) (Funty (Fork w1 w2) w3) 1
| szs_recursion : forall k u v,
    subtype_size omega2_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))) 1
| szs_tree : forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype_size
      (Fork
         (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
               (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
         (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
               (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
      (Funty uty (subst ty uty)) 1
| szs_to_asf : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Asf ty) 1
| szs_from_asf : forall u v, subtype_size (Asf (Funty u v)) (Funty u v) 1
| szs_bffs : forall u v,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug u)) (Asf v)) (Asf (Fork (Stem u) v)) 1
| szs_bfff : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Asf v)) (bfff_aug w)) (Asf (Fork (Fork u v) w)) 1.

Lemma subtype_size_sound : forall S T n, subtype_size S T n -> subtype S T.
Proof.
  intros S T n H. induction H; eauto using subtype.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_has_size : forall S T, subtype S T -> exists n, subtype_size S T n.
Proof.
  intros S T H. induction H.
  - exists 1. apply szs_zero.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_trans; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_stem. exact Hs.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_fork; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_asf. exact Hs.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_funty; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_quant. exact Hs.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_fork.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_dist.
  - exists 1. apply szs_inst.
  - exists 1. apply szs_lift.
  - exists 1. apply szs_leaf_fun.
  - exists 1. apply szs_stem_fun.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_leaf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_leaf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_fork.
  - exists 1. apply szs_recursion.
  - exists 1. eapply szs_tree; eauto.
  - exists 1. apply szs_to_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_from_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_bffs.
  - exists 1. apply szs_bfff.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB Size.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
  | Funty _ r => r
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork _ v => v
  | Asf T' => extr T'
  end.

(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
Lemma extr_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork u _ => R u
  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
  end.

Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_subst_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_lift_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* On the ReachFork fragment, extr commutes with substitution with    *)
(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)
(* e.g. extr (Fork A B) = B, and substituting in the discarded first  *)
(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
  forall T u k,
    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ReachFork is monotone along subtype. *)
Lemma ReachFork_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) eapply R_mono; eauto.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof.
  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0.
Qed.

(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(*   Asf T      |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
(*   Quant T    |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
(*   Stem/Fork/Var |-> False                                          *)

Lemma covariant_lift : forall ty j, covariant ty -> covariant (lift_rec ty (S j) 1).
Proof.
  intros. unfold covariant in *.
  rewrite (variant_lift ty true 0 (S j)) by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* ground types and omega2_ty                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint ground (ty : dtype) : Prop :=
  match ty with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem t => ground t
  | Fork t1 t2 => ground t1 /\ ground t2
  | Funty t1 t2 => ground t1 /\ ground t2
  | Quant t => ground t
  | Asf t => ground t
  end.

Lemma ground_lift : forall ty j, ground ty -> lift_rec ty j 1 = ty.
Proof.
  induction ty; intros j Hg; simpl in *.
  - destruct Hg.
  - f_equal. apply (IHty (S j) Hg).
  - destruct Hg as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHty1 j H1), (IHty2 j H2). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHty j Hg).
  - destruct Hg as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHty1 j H1), (IHty2 j H2). reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHty j Hg).
Qed.

Lemma program_type_ground : forall p, ground (program_type p).
Proof.
  induction p; simpl.
  - split; exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct (program_type p1) eqn:E.
    + split; exact Logic.I.
    + split; exact Logic.I.
    + split; exact Logic.I.
    + simpl in *. apply IHp2.
    + simpl in *. split. exact IHp1. apply IHp2.
    + split; exact Logic.I.
    + split; exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma lift_omega21_ty : forall j, lift_rec omega21_ty j 1 = omega21_ty.
Proof. intros. apply ground_lift. apply program_type_ground. Qed.

Lemma lift_omega22_ty : forall j, lift_rec omega22_ty j 1 = omega22_ty.
Proof. intros. apply ground_lift. apply program_type_ground. Qed.

Lemma lift_omega2_ty : forall j, lift_rec omega2_ty j 1 = omega2_ty.
Proof.
  intros. unfold omega2_ty. cbn [lift_rec].
  rewrite lift_omega21_ty, lift_omega22_ty. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_eager_ty : forall j, lift_rec eager_ty j 1 = eager_ty.
Proof. intros. unfold eager_ty. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_bfff_aug : forall uty j,
  lift_rec (bfff_aug uty) j 1 = bfff_aug (lift_rec uty j 1).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bfff_aug. cbn [lift_rec]. rewrite lift_eval_ty. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_bffs_aug : forall uty j,
  lift_rec (bffs_aug uty) j 1 = bffs_aug (lift_rec uty j 1).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bffs_aug. cbn [lift_rec].
  rewrite lift_eager_ty, lift_bfff_aug. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* lifting through quant                                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma quant_lift : forall k ty j,
  lift_rec (quant k ty) j 1 = quant k (lift_rec ty (j + k) 1).
Proof.
  induction k; intros ty j; simpl.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHk (Quant ty) j). cbn [lift_rec]. rewrite Nat.add_succ_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* the source shape of sub_tree                                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition tree_ty (ty : dtype) : dtype :=
  Fork
    (Fork
       (subst ty Leaf)
       (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
    (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
       (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))).

Lemma tree_ty_lift : forall ty j,
  lift_rec (tree_ty ty) j 1 = tree_ty (lift_rec ty (S j) 1).
Proof.
  intros. unfold tree_ty. simpl.
  rewrite (lift_subst ty Leaf j).
  rewrite (lift_subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0)) (S j)).
  rewrite (lift_subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)) (S (S j))).
  rewrite lift_lift_one1, lift_lift_one2, lift_fork_vars.
  simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* the main lifting-stability theorem                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma lift_rec_subtype : forall A B, subtype A B -> forall j,
  subtype (lift_rec A j 1) (lift_rec B j 1).
Proof.
  intros A B H. induction H; intros j.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - eapply sub_trans; [ exact (IHsubtype1 j) | exact (IHsubtype2 j) ].
  - apply sub_stem. exact (IHsubtype j).
  - apply sub_fork; [ exact (IHsubtype1 j) | exact (IHsubtype2 j) ].
  - apply sub_asf. exact (IHsubtype j).
  - apply sub_funty; [ exact (IHsubtype1 j) | exact (IHsubtype2 j) ].
  - apply sub_quant. exact (IHsubtype (S j)).
  - simpl. apply sub_quant_stem.
  - simpl. apply sub_quant_fork.
  - simpl. apply sub_quant_asf.
  - simpl. apply sub_dist.
  - simpl. rewrite lift_subst. apply sub_inst.
  - simpl. unfold lift. rewrite lift_lift_zero. apply sub_lift.
  - simpl. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - simpl. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - simpl. apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - simpl. apply sub_fork_stem.
  - simpl. apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
  - simpl. apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
  - simpl. apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
  - rewrite lift_omega2_ty. cbn [lift_rec].
    repeat rewrite quant_lift.
    apply (sub_recursion k (lift_rec uty (j + k) 1) (lift_rec vty (j + k) 1)).
  - change (subtype (lift_rec (tree_ty ty) j 1)
                    (lift_rec (Funty uty (subst ty uty)) j 1)).
    rewrite tree_ty_lift. cbn [lift_rec].
    rewrite lift_subst.
    apply (sub_tree (lift_rec ty (S j) 1) (lift_rec uty j 1)).
    apply covariant_lift. assumption.
  - simpl. apply sub_to_asf.
  - simpl. apply sub_from_asf.
  - cbn [lift_rec]. rewrite lift_bffs_aug. apply sub_bffs.
  - cbn [lift_rec]. rewrite lift_bfff_aug. apply sub_bfff.
Qed.

(* A specialized form that is often convenient when the source is a
   constructor application (the general lemma needs a [change] because
   [lift_rec] does not reduce on an evar). *)
Corollary lift_rec_subtype_stem : forall x y j,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (lift_rec x j 1)) (lift_rec y j 1).
Proof.
  intros. change (subtype (lift_rec (Stem x) j 1) (lift_rec y j 1)).
  apply lift_rec_subtype. assumption.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A concrete counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.
   The term (((Node @ Node) @ Node) @ (Node @ Node)) is a k-redex.
   It has type Stem Leaf, but its reduct Node has no such type. *)

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △).

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dK.
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dKy :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma dKy_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dKy.
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dKy_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentA_Good.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A COUNTEREXAMPLE TO AgentA_Good.Good_inst_obligation.              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Take d = 0, x = Leaf, T = Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf),        *)
(* u = Var 0.  Then Good (S d) x T holds:                             *)
(*   subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0))) (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).   *)
(* Its derivation is proved below in Coq.                             *)
(* But the required conclusion would be                              *)
(*   Good 0 Leaf (Funty (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))                       *)
(*                       (subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0)))           *)
(* = subtype (Fork Leaf (Var 0)) (Funty Leaf Leaf),                   *)
(* because subst (Var 0) (Var 0) = Var 0 and                        *)
(* subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0) = Funty Leaf Leaf.                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The latter is NOT derivable.  I checked it in a closure model of  *)
(* the subtype rules at size 6 over Var 0 and Var 1 (10560 types):   *)
(* Fork Leaf (Var 0) has no path to Funty Leaf Leaf, while the above  *)
(* premise is reachable.  The only subtype rules omitted from that     *)
(* model are those whose source has a Stem/Fork in its first          *)
(* component (sub_fork_stem, sub_fork_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,     *)
(* sub_bfff, sub_recursion); none of these sources is reachable from  *)
(* Fork Leaf (Var 0), because this would require Leaf <: Stem or      *)
(* Leaf <: Fork, which is false (AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem/fork).  *)
(* The model reports exactly 0 reachable source types of the omitted  *)
(* rules from the seed.                                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Thus the obligation as stated is false; it needs a corrected       *)
(* variant.  The premise proof below is closed and compiles.          *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Possible repair: add reachability to Good, e.g. keep the conjunct  *)
(* subtype (Stem x) T (or the reachability appropriate to the use).   *)
(* The model shows the counterexample state is then unreachable:      *)
(* Stem Leaf <: Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf) is false.  Whether    *)
(* the reachability-restricted Hinst is provable is a separate        *)
(* obligation and is NOT claimed here.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_var0_var0 : subst (Var 0) (Var 0) = Var 0.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_leaf_leaf : subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_var0_leaf : subst (Var 0) Leaf = Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_funty_leaf_leaf : lift 1 (Funty Leaf Leaf) = Funty Leaf Leaf.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma good_inst_counter_premise :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant (Var 0)))
          (Quant (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Quant (Var 0))).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * rewrite <- subst_var0_leaf.
        apply sub_inst.
    + rewrite <- lift_funty_leaf_leaf.
      apply sub_lift.
Qed.

(* The premise in Good form, exactly as required by Hinst. *)
Lemma good_inst_counter_premise_Good :
  Good 1 Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  simpl. exact good_inst_counter_premise.
Qed.

(* The conclusion Hinst would demand, simplified. *)
Lemma good_inst_counter_conclusion_shape :
  Good 0 Leaf
       (Funty (subst (Var 0) (Var 0))
              (subst (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Var 0)))
  = subtype (Fork Leaf (Var 0)) (Funty Leaf Leaf).
Proof.
  rewrite subst_var0_var0, subst_leaf_leaf. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* This is the negated conclusion; it is NOT proved in Coq here (it is

Lemma L2_literal_rev :
  forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
