(*     a Fork source against a Funty target.                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Fork (Stem A) B <: Funty u w, from the two curried pieces. *)
Lemma fork_stem_intro :
  forall A B u w v,
    subtype A (Funty u (Funty v w)) ->
    subtype B (Funty u v) ->
    subtype (Fork (Stem A) B) (Funty u w).
Proof.
  intros A B u w v HA HB.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)).
  - apply sub_fork; [apply sub_stem | exact HA | exact HB].
  - apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

(* Fork Leaf B <: Funty u w, provided B <: w. *)
Lemma fork_leaf_fun :
  forall B u w, subtype B w -> subtype (Fork Leaf B) (Funty u w).
Proof.
  intros B u w H.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u B).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 3.  The pair invariant.  R d A u1 X simultaneously remembers:      *)
(*       - the GoodStem projection of the first source component;     *)
(*       - the relation of the second source component to u1;         *)
(*     and, at a Funty target, it is exactly the inv_s conclusion.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) {struct X} : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork X1 X2 => GoodStem d A X1 /\ subtype (lift d u1) X2
  | Asf X' => R d A u1 X'
  | Quant X' => R (S d) A u1 X'
  | Funty u ty =>
      exists v,
        subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
        subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v)
  end.

Definition R_mono : Prop :=
  forall d A u1 X Y,
    subtype X Y -> R d A u1 X -> R d A u1 Y.

(* The only genuinely infinite-looking constructor.  The witness is a
   single concrete existential, independent of d, A and u1.           *)
Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4.  GoodStem_comp follows from monotonicity of R.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono :
  R_mono ->
  forall A B u1 u ty,
    GoodStem 0 A B ->
    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v,
      subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros HR A B u1 u ty H1 H2.
  specialize
    (HR 0 A u1 (Fork (lift 0 B) u1) (Funty u ty)).
  apply HR.
  - simpl. exact H2.
  - simpl. split.
    + rewrite <- l2_lift_zero. exact H1.
    + rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero.
  - (* the result R 0 A u1 (Funty u ty) normalises to the conclusion *)
    cbn [R].
    rewrite l2_lift_zero.
    rewrite l2_lift_zero.
    exact (fun H => H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 5.  inv_s follows from GoodStem_comp.                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp :
  (forall A B u1 u ty,
      GoodStem 0 A B ->
      GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
      exists v,
        subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
        subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v,
      subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros HC u2 u1 u ty u3 H0 H1.
  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
  pose proof (L1 u3 u2 H1) as Hs1.
  apply (HC u3 u2 u1 u ty).
  - exact (GoodStem_mono (Stem u3) u2 Hs1 0 u3 (GoodStem_initial u3)).
  - exact (GoodStem_mono (Stem u2) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) Hs0
                          0 u2 (GoodStem_initial u2)).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 6.  The RecSplit obligation discharges exactly the sub_recursion   *)
(*     branch of R_mono.                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma R_recursion_case :
  RecSplit ->
  forall d A u1 k uty vty,
    R d A u1 omega2_ty ->
    R d A u1
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty
          (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
          (quant k (Funty uty vty)))).
Proof.
  intros RS d A u1 k uty vty H.
  change (R d A u1 (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty)) in H.
  cbn [R] in H.
  cbn [GoodStem] in H.
  destruct H as [HA Hu1].
  destruct (RS k uty vty) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  cbn [R].
  exists v. split.
  - eapply sub_trans; [exact HA | exact Hv1].
  - eapply sub_trans; [exact Hu1 | exact Hv2].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 7.  Concrete first step of the blocked RecSplit obligation.        *)
(*     omega22_ty is a Fork (Stem A) B with B = Fork Leaf C; hence     *)
(*     its Funty target reduces to the single smaller goal             *)
(*        A <: Funty omega2_ty (Funty C V).                           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition omega22_left : dtype :=
  match omega22_ty with
  | Fork (Stem A) _ => A
  | _ => Leaf
  end.

Definition omega22_right : dtype :=
  match omega22_ty with
  | Fork _ B => B
  | _ => Leaf
  end.

Definition omega22_right_tail : dtype :=
  match omega22_right with
  | Fork Leaf C => C
  | _ => Leaf
  end.

Lemma omega22_shape :
  omega22_ty = Fork (Stem omega22_left) omega22_right.
Proof.
  unfold omega22_ty, omega22_left, omega22_right. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma omega22_right_shape :
  omega22_right = Fork Leaf omega22_right_tail.
Proof.
  unfold omega22_right, omega22_right_tail, omega22_ty. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma omega22_funty_step :
  forall V,
    subtype omega22_left (Funty omega2_ty (Funty omega22_right_tail V)) ->
    subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty V).
Proof.
  intros V HA.
  rewrite omega22_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro.
  - exact HA.
  - rewrite omega22_right_shape.
    apply fork_leaf_fun.
    apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 8.  Exact remaining obligations (reported, not postulated).        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  * RecSplit: the sub_recursion branch.  This is the only branch    *)
(*    whose witness cannot be guessed from the syntax of the rule;    *)
(*    the concrete first reduction of omega22_ty is                    *)
(*    omega22_funty_step above.                                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  * The sub_bffs branch of R_mono needs an Asf-inversion for the     *)
(*    pair component, because R(Asf X) keeps R X.  The precise goal is *)
(*    stated below as Bffs_branch.                                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Bffs_branch : Prop :=
  forall d A u1 uty vty,
    subtype (lift d A) (bffs_aug uty) ->
    subtype (lift d u1) (Asf vty) ->
    subtype (lift d A) uty /\ subtype (lift d u1) vty.

(* The bfff branch is vacuous for R: its first source component is a
   Fork, and R is False on the first component of a Fork. *)
Lemma R_bfff_vacuous :
  forall d A u1 uty vty wty,
    R d A u1 (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty)) -> False.
Proof. intros. cbn [R] in H. destruct H as [H _]. cbn [GoodStem] in H. exact H. Qed.

(* The recursion source has the GoodStem projection of Stem omega21. *)
Lemma R_omega2_unfold :
  forall d A u1,
    R d A u1 omega2_ty ->
    subtype (lift d A) omega21_ty /\ subtype (lift d u1) omega22_ty.
Proof.
  intros d A u1 H.
  change (R d A u1 (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty)) in H.
  cbn [R] in H. cbn [GoodStem] in H. exact H.
Qed.

Print Assumptions L2_iff.
Print Assumptions L2_literal_rev.
Print Assumptions L1_iff.
Print Assumptions GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono.
Print Assumptions inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp.
Print Assumptions R_recursion_case.
Print Assumptions omega22_funty_step.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The s-reduction head inversion statement is FALSE.                  *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The counterexample uses:                                            *)
(*   u2 = Stem Leaf                                                    *)
(*   u1 = Funty Leaf Leaf                                              *)
(*   u  = Leaf                                                         *)
(*   ty = Leaf                                                         *)
(*   u3 = Leaf                                                         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Both premises are derivable (proved below).  The conclusion would   *)
(* force, for some v,                                                    *)
(*   subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty v Leaf))                          *)
(* and, via L1 and L2_literal, that would force                         *)
(*   subtype (Fork Leaf v) Leaf,                                       *)
(* which is impossible because a Fork-source can never have Leaf as a  *)
(* target (the invariant RF below).                                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Invariant RF: every type reachable from a Fork source has head      *)
(* Fork or Funty (possibly under any number of Asf/Quant).  In         *)
(* particular Leaf, Stem and Var are unreachable.                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype : forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof.
  intros C X S H. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_leaf : forall C X, subtype (Fork C X) Leaf -> False.
Proof.
  intros C X H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype C X Leaf H) as HR.
  simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Closed derivation of the first premise, with the chosen values.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Leaf <: Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma leaf_funty2 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Stem (Stem Leaf) <: Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma stem_stem_leaf_funty2 :
  subtype (Stem (Stem Leaf))
          (Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf)
                   (Fork (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with
        (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)))
                     (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- apply sub_stem. exact leaf_funty2.
        -- apply sub_zero.
      * apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

(* H0 : Leaf <: Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) with
        u1 = Funty Leaf Leaf, u = Leaf, ty = Leaf. *)
Lemma inv_s_first_premise :
  subtype Leaf
          (Funty (Stem Leaf)
                 (Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Funty (Stem Leaf) (Stem (Stem Leaf))).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + exact stem_stem_leaf_funty2.
Qed.

(* H1 : Leaf <: Funty u3 u2 with u3 = Leaf, u2 = Stem Leaf. *)
Lemma inv_s_second_premise :
  subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  apply sub_leaf_fun.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The refutation.                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma no_conclusion_for_witness :
  forall v, ~ (subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty v Leaf)) /\
               subtype (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf v)).
Proof.
  intros v [Hconcl _].
  (* L1 turns the conclusion into Stem Leaf <: Funty v Leaf. *)
  pose proof (L1 Leaf (Funty v Leaf) Hconcl) as Hstem.
  (* L2_literal turns that into Fork Leaf v <: Leaf. *)
  pose proof (L2_literal Leaf v Leaf Hstem) as Hfork.
  exact (not_subtype_fork_leaf Leaf v Hfork).
Qed.

Theorem inv_s_is_false :
  ~ (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
       subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
       subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
       exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
                 subtype u1 (Funty u v)).
Proof.
  intro Hin.
  pose proof
    (Hin (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf) Leaf Leaf Leaf
         inv_s_first_premise inv_s_second_premise) as [v Hv].
  exact (no_conclusion_for_witness v Hv).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB Size.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
  | Funty _ r => r
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork _ v => v
  | Asf T' => extr T'
  end.

(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
Lemma extr_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork u _ => R u
  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
  end.

Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_subst_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_lift_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* On the ReachFork fragment, extr commutes with substitution with    *)
(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)
(* e.g. extr (Fork A B) = B, and substituting in the discarded first  *)
(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
  forall T u k,
    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ReachFork is monotone along subtype. *)
Lemma ReachFork_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) eapply R_mono; eauto.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply ReachFork_subst_rec with (u := u) (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply ReachFork_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Main invariant: on ReachFork types, extr is monotone for subtype.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma extr_mono_reach :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> subtype (extr T) (extr U).
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* trans *) eauto using sub_trans, ReachFork_mono.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) assumption.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 1.  The exact converse of L2_literal, hence an equivalence.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* L2_literal (AgentB_L2lit):                                         *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(* The converse is a direct instance of sub_stem_fun + sub_funty.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma L2_literal_rev :
  forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + exact H.
Qed.

Lemma L2_iff :
  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) <-> subtype (Fork X a) r.
Proof.
  intros X a r. split.
  - apply L2_literal.
  - apply L2_literal_rev.
Qed.

(* The "Leaf <- Funty" equivalence, from L1 and sub_leaf_fun. *)
Lemma L1_iff :
  forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) <-> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r. split.
  - apply L1.
  - intro H. eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2.  Two composition rules used by the canonical decomposition of   *)
(*     a Fork source against a Funty target.                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Fork (Stem A) B <: Funty u w, from the two curried pieces. *)
Lemma fork_stem_intro :
  forall A B u w v,
    subtype A (Funty u (Funty v w)) ->
    subtype B (Funty u v) ->
    subtype (Fork (Stem A) B) (Funty u w).
Proof.
  intros A B u w v HA HB.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)).
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_stem. exact HA.
    + exact HB.
  - apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

(* Fork Leaf B <: Funty u w, provided B <: w. *)
Lemma fork_leaf_fun :
  forall B u w, subtype B w -> subtype (Fork Leaf B) (Funty u w).
Proof.
  intros B u w H.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u B).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 3.  The pair invariant.  R d A u1 X simultaneously remembers:      *)
(*       - the GoodStem projection of the first source component;     *)
(*       - the relation of the second source component to u1;         *)
(*     and, at a Funty target, it is exactly the inv_s conclusion.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) {struct X} : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork X1 X2 => GoodStem d A X1 /\ subtype (lift d u1) X2
  | Asf X' => R d A u1 X'
  | Quant X' => R (S d) A u1 X'
  | Funty u ty =>
      exists v,
        subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
        subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v)
  end.

Definition R_mono : Prop :=
  forall d A u1 X Y,
    subtype X Y -> R d A u1 X -> R d A u1 Y.

(* The only genuinely infinite-looking constructor.  The witness is a
   single concrete existential, independent of d, A and u1.           *)
Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4.  GoodStem_comp follows from monotonicity of R.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono :
  R_mono ->
  forall A B u1 u ty,
    GoodStem 0 A B ->
    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v,
      subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).

  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.

1	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
2	Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
3	Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentB_L2lit.
4	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
5	Open Scope string_scope.
6	Open Scope nat_scope.
7	Open Scope tree_scope.
8	
9	(* ================================================================== *)
10	(* 1.  The exact converse of L2_literal, hence an equivalence.        *)
11	(*                                                                    *)
12	(* L2_literal (AgentB_L2lit):                                         *)
13	(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
14	(* The converse is a direct instance of sub_stem_fun + sub_funty.     *)
15	(* ================================================================== *)
16	
17	Lemma L2_literal_rev :
18	  forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r).
19	Proof.
20	  intros X a r H.
21	  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a)).
22	  - apply sub_stem_fun.
23	  - eapply sub_funty.
24	    + apply sub_zero.
25	    + exact H.
26	Qed.
27	
28	Lemma L2_iff :
29	  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) <-> subtype (Fork X a) r.
30	Proof.
31	  intros X a r. split.
32	  - apply L2_literal.
33	  - apply L2_literal_rev.
34	Qed.
35	
36	(* The "Leaf <- Funty" equivalence, from L1 and sub_leaf_fun. *)
37	Lemma L1_iff :
38	  forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) <-> subtype (Stem a) r.
39	Proof.
40	  intros a r. split.
41	  - apply L1.
42	  - intro H. eapply sub_trans.
43	    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
44	    + eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
45	Qed.
46	
47	(* ================================================================== *)
48	(* 2.  Two composition rules used by the canonical decomposition of   *)
49	(*     a Fork source against a Funty target.                          *)
50	(* ================================================================== *)
51	
52	(* Fork (Stem A) B <: Funty u w, from the two curried pieces. *)
53	Lemma fork_stem_intro :
54	  forall A B u w v,
55	    subtype A (Funty u (Funty v w)) ->
56	    subtype B (Funty u v) ->
57	    subtype (Fork (Stem A) B) (Funty u w).
58	Proof.
59	  intros A B u w v HA HB.
60	  eapply sub_trans with
61	    (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)).
62	  - apply sub_fork.
63	    + apply sub_stem. exact HA.
64	    + exact HB.
65	  - apply sub_fork_stem.
66	Qed.
67	
68	(* Fork Leaf B <: Funty u w, provided B <: w. *)
69	Lemma fork_leaf_fun :
70	  forall B u w, subtype B w -> subtype (Fork Leaf B) (Funty u w).
71	Proof.
72	  intros B u w H.
73	  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u B).
74	  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
75	  - eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
76	Qed.
77	
78	(* ================================================================== *)
79	(* 3.  The pair invariant.  R d A u1 X simultaneously remembers:      *)
80	(*       - the GoodStem projection of the first source component;     *)
81	(*       - the relation of the second source component to u1;         *)
82	(*     and, at a Funty target, it is exactly the inv_s conclusion.    *)
83	(* ================================================================== *)
84	
85	Fixpoint R (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) {struct X} : Prop :=
86	  match X with
87	  | Var _ => False
88	  | Leaf => False
89	  | Stem _ => False
90	  | Fork X1 X2 => GoodStem d A X1 /\ subtype (lift d u1) X2
91	  | Asf X' => R d A u1 X'
92	  | Quant X' => R (S d) A u1 X'
93	  | Funty u ty =>
94	      exists v,
95	        subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
96	        subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v)
97	  end.
98	
99	Definition R_mono : Prop :=
100	  forall d A u1 X Y,
101	    subtype X Y -> R d A u1 X -> R d A u1 Y.
102	
103	(* The only genuinely infinite-looking constructor.  The witness is a
104	   single concrete existential, independent of d, A and u1.           *)
105	Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
106	  forall k uty vty,
107	    exists v,
108	      subtype omega21_ty
109	        (Funty omega2_ty
110	          (Funty v
111	            (Funty
112	              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
113	              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
114	      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).
115	
116	(* ================================================================== *)
117	(* 4.  GoodStem_comp follows from monotonicity of R.                  *)
118	(* ================================================================== *)
119	
120	Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono :
121	  R_mono ->
122	  forall A B u1 u ty,
123	    GoodStem 0 A B ->
124	    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
125	    exists v,
126	      subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
127	      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
128	Proof.
129	  intros HR A B u1 u ty H1 H2.
130	  assert (Hres : R 0 A u1 (Funty u ty)).
131	  { apply (HR 0 A u1 (Fork (lift 0 B) u1) (Funty u ty)).
132	    - simpl. exact H2.
133	    - simpl. split.
134	      + rewrite l2_lift_zero. exact H1.
135	      + rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero. }
136	  cbn [R] in Hres.
137	  rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hres.
138	  rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hres.
139	  exact Hres.
140	Qed.
141	
142	(* ================================================================== *)
143	(* 5.  inv_s follows from GoodStem_comp.                              *)
144	(* ================================================================== *)
145	
146	Lemma inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp :
147	  (forall A B u1 u ty,
148	      GoodStem 0 A B ->
149	      GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
150	      exists v,
151	        subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
152	        subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
153	  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
154	    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
155	    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
156	    exists v,
157	      subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
158	      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
159	Proof.
160	  intros HC u2 u1 u ty u3 H0 H1.
161	  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
162	  pose proof (L1 u3 u2 H1) as Hs1.
163	  apply (HC u3 u2 u1 u ty).
164	  - exact (GoodStem_mono (Stem u3) u2 Hs1 0 u3 (GoodStem_initial u3)).
165	  - exact (GoodStem_mono (Stem u2) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) Hs0
166	                          0 u2 (GoodStem_initial u2)).
167	Qed.
168	
169	(* ================================================================== *)
170	(* 6.  The RecSplit obligation discharges exactly the sub_recursion   *)
171	(*     branch of R_mono.                                              *)
172	(* ================================================================== *)
173	
174	Lemma R_recursion_case :
175	  RecSplit ->
176	  forall d A u1 k uty vty,
177	    R d A u1 omega2_ty ->
178	    R d A u1
179	      (Funty omega2_ty
180	        (Funty
181	          (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
182	          (quant k (Funty uty vty)))).
183	Proof.
184	  intros RS d A u1 k uty vty H.
185	  change (R d A u1 (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty)) in H.
186	  cbn [R] in H.
187	  cbn [GoodStem] in H.
188	  destruct H as [HA Hu1].
189	  destruct (RS k uty vty) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
190	  cbn [R].
191	  exists v. split.
192	  - eapply sub_trans; [exact HA | exact Hv1].
193	  - eapply sub_trans; [exact Hu1 | exact Hv2].
194	Qed.
195	
196	(* ================================================================== *)
197	(* 7.  Concrete first step of the blocked RecSplit obligation.        *)
198	(*     omega22_ty is a Fork (Stem A) B with B = Fork Leaf C; hence     *)
199	(*     its Funty target reduces to the single smaller goal             *)
200	(*        A <: Funty omega2_ty (Funty C V).                           *)
201	(* ================================================================== *)
202	
203	Definition omega22_left : dtype :=
204	  match omega22_ty with
205	  | Fork (Stem A) _ => A
206	  | _ => Leaf
207	  end.
208	
209	Definition omega22_right : dtype :=
210	  match omega22_ty with
211	  | Fork _ B => B
212	  | _ => Leaf
213	  end.
214	
215	Definition omega22_right_tail : dtype :=
216	  match omega22_right with
217	  | Fork Leaf C => C
218	  | _ => Leaf
219	  end.
220	
221	Lemma omega22_shape :
222	  omega22_ty = Fork (Stem omega22_left) omega22_right.
223	Proof.
224	  unfold omega22_ty, omega22_left, omega22_right. cbn. reflexivity.
225	Qed.
226	
227	Lemma omega22_right_shape :
228	  omega22_right = Fork Leaf omega22_right_tail.
229	Proof.
230	  unfold omega22_right, omega22_right_tail, omega22_ty. cbn. reflexivity.
231	Qed.
232	
233	Lemma omega22_funty_step :
234	  forall V,
235	    subtype omega22_left (Funty omega2_ty (Funty omega22_right_tail V)) ->
236	    subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty V).
237	Proof.
238	  intros V HA.
239	  rewrite omega22_shape.
240	  eapply fork_stem_intro.
241	  - exact HA.
242	  - rewrite omega22_right_shape.
243	    apply fork_leaf_fun.
244	    apply sub_zero.
245	Qed.
246	
247	(* ================================================================== *)
248	(* 8.  Exact remaining obligations (reported, not postulated).        *)
249	(*                                                                    *)
250	(*  * RecSplit: the sub_recursion branch.  This is the only branch    *)
251	(*    whose witness cannot be guessed from the syntax of the rule;    *)
252	(*    the concrete first reduction of omega22_ty is                    *)
253	(*    omega22_funty_step above.                                        *)
254	(*                                                                    *)
255	(*  * The sub_bffs branch of R_mono needs an Asf-inversion for the     *)
256	(*    pair component, because R(Asf X) keeps R X.  The precise goal is *)
257	(*    stated below as Bffs_branch.                                     *)
258	(* ================================================================== *)
259	
260	Definition Bffs_branch : Prop :=
261	  forall d A u1 uty vty,
262	    subtype (lift d A) (bffs_aug uty) ->
263	    subtype (lift d u1) (Asf vty) ->
264	    subtype (lift d A) uty /\ subtype (lift d u1) vty.
265	
266	(* The bfff branch is vacuous for R: its first source component is a
267	   Fork, and R is False on the first component of a Fork. *)
268	Lemma R_bfff_vacuous :
269	  forall d A u1 uty vty wty,
270	    R d A u1 (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty)) -> False.
271	Proof. intros. cbn [R] in H. destruct H as [H _]. cbn [GoodStem] in H. exact H. Qed.
272	
273	(* The recursion source has the GoodStem projection of Stem omega21. *)
274	Lemma R_omega2_unfold :
275	  forall d A u1,
276	    R d A u1 omega2_ty ->
277	    subtype (lift d A) omega21_ty /\ subtype (lift d u1) omega22_ty.
278	Proof.
279	  intros d A u1 H.
280	  change (R d A u1 (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty)) in H.
281	  cbn [R] in H. cbn [GoodStem] in H. exact H.
282	Qed.
283	
284	Print Assumptions L2_iff.
285	Print Assumptions L2_literal_rev.
286	Print Assumptions L1_iff.
287	Print Assumptions GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono.
288	Print Assumptions inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp.
289	Print Assumptions R_recursion_case.
290	Print Assumptions omega22_funty_step.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Pure term identity: substituting at a cutoff k <= d inside          *)
(* lift (S d) X undoes one lift.                                       *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d -> subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
  forall T d j X,
    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitution closure:                                              *)
(*   k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).  *)
(* The condition k <= d is propagated by the Quant case (both become  *)
(* S k and S d), and is exactly what makes the pure lift/subst        *)
(* identity hold.                                                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_subst_gen :
  forall T d X u k,
    k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d X u k Hk HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (d := S d) (k := S k); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    eapply sub_trans with
      (ty2 := subst_rec (Fork (lift (S d) X) T1) u k).
    + change (subtype (Fork (lift_rec X 0 d) (subst_rec T1 u k))
                      (subst_rec (Fork (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) T1) u k)).
      simpl.
      rewrite l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen by lia.
      apply sub_zero.
    + exact (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ HG u k).
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    eapply sub_trans with

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_leaf_subtype : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> R T.
Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_var : forall i, subtype Leaf (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros i H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.
  unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

(* Monotonicity of GoodStem along subtype.                            *)

Lemma GoodStem_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> forall d X, GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem d X U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H; intros d X HG; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HG.
  - (* trans *) apply (IHsubtype2 d X). apply (IHsubtype1 d X). exact HG.
  - (* stem *) exact (sub_trans _ _ _ HG H).
  - (* fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* asf *) apply (IHsubtype d X). exact HG.
  - (* funty *)
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork (lift d X) uty1).
    + apply (sub_fork (lift d X) (lift d X) uty2 uty1 (sub_zero _) H).
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HG | exact H0].
  - (* quant *) apply (IHsubtype (S d) X). exact HG.
  - (* quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (lift d X))).
    + apply sub_lift.
    + rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* dist *) apply (l2_dist d X uty vty). exact HG.
  - (* inst *)
    change (GoodStem d X (subst_rec ty u 0)).
    apply (GoodStem_subst_gen ty d X u 0); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* lift *)
    change (GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
    apply (GoodStem_lift_gen ty d 0 X); [lia|exact HG].
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HG.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    apply (sub_fork (lift d X) uty vty vty HG (sub_zero _)).
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HG.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HG. cbn in HG. destruct HG.
  - (* tree *) destruct HG.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HG.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HG.
Qed.

Lemma l2_lift_rec_zero_gen : forall x k, lift_rec x k 0 = x.
Proof.

  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma l2_lift_zero : forall X, lift 0 X = X.
Proof. intro X. unfold lift. apply l2_lift_rec_zero_gen. Qed.

Lemma GoodStem_initial : forall X, GoodStem 0 X (Stem X).
Proof.

Qed.

  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
Proof.

  pose proof (GoodStem_mono (Stem X) (Funty a r) H 0 X
                (GoodStem_initial X)) as HG.
  simpl in HG. rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG. exact HG.
Qed.

---
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import Size AgentB NF.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Reachable-head invariant for a Fork source.                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* RF is true on the heads that can be reached from a Fork source:    *)
(* Fork and Funty, or a type whose Asf/Quant spine ends in one of     *)
(* them.  Leaf, Stem and Var are unreachable.                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k mm HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* recursion *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* tree *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bfff *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma RF_fork : forall C X, RF (Fork C X).
Proof. intros. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype :
  forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof. intros. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply RF_fork. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_leaf : forall S, RF S -> S = Leaf -> False.
Proof. intros S HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_stem : forall S Y, RF S -> S = Stem Y -> False.
Proof. intros S Y HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

Lemma RF_not_var : forall S i, RF S -> S = Var i -> False.
Proof. intros S i HR E. subst S. simpl in HR. exact HR. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Exact unproved interfaces isolated by the analysis.                *)
(* These are stated as Prop-valued definitions, not axioms/theorems,  *)
(* so this file remains closed and constructive.                        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* The general Fork inversion with leafy first component (the statement
   requested after L3_leaf).  There are two projections; the first is
   the "leafy first component" part, the second is the codomain part. *)
Definition Fork_first_inversion_leafy : Prop :=
  forall C X A B,
    subtype Leaf C ->
    subtype (Fork C X) (Fork A B) ->
    subtype C A.

Definition Fork_second_inversion : Prop :=
  forall C X A B,
    subtype (Fork C X) (Fork A B) ->
    subtype X B.

(* Reach-to-Quant form needed by the szs_quant_fork/szs_inst branches of
   the Fork inversion. *)
Definition Fork_quant_inversion_leafy : Prop :=
  forall C X A B,
    subtype Leaf C ->
    subtype (Fork C X) (Quant (Fork A B)) ->
    subtype C (Quant A).

Definition Fork_quant_second_inversion : Prop :=
  forall C X A B,
    subtype (Fork C X) (Quant (Fork A B)) ->
    subtype X (Quant B).

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Status of L3_leaf.                                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* L3_leaf : forall C X a r, subtype Leaf C ->                        *)
(*            subtype (Fork C X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.          *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* RF above eliminates all atomic H branches whose source is Leaf,    *)
(* Stem or Var.  The remaining cut-elimination problem is the          *)
(* interaction of sub_trans on the two derivations.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The size-only measure proposed for the cut-elimination cannot       *)
(* handle both trans cases with the suggested recursive pairs.  With  *)
(* szs_trans sizes n = n1 + n2 + 1:                                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  H = szs_trans H1 H2:                                              *)
(*    K' = szs_trans K H1 has size nK + n1 + 1, H' = H2 has size n2.  *)
(*    The sum nK' + n2 equals nK + nH, and n2 < nH.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  K = szs_trans K1 K2:                                              *)
(*    K' = K1 has size nK1, H' = szs_trans K2 H has size nK2+nH+1.    *)
(*    The sum nK1 + (nK2+nH+1) also equals nK + nH, but the second    *)
(*    component increases.                                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Thus the two recursive calls transfer weight between K and H in    *)
(* opposite directions along the same line nK+nH = const.  No        *)
(* lexicographic order on the size pair alone can decrease for both.  *)
(* A refined measure (or a source-sensitive invariant) is required.   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A second, independent obstruction appears in the atomic pair      *)
(* table for L3_leaf.  RF shows that the H-source S of               *)
(* H : subtype S (Funty a r) is never Leaf/Stem/Var, so the only      *)
(* surviving atomic H rules with a Funty target are:                  *)
(*   szs_zero, szs_funty, szs_dist, szs_inst,                         *)
(*   szs_fork_leaf, szs_fork_stem, szs_fork_fork_*, szs_recursion,    *)
(*   szs_tree, szs_from_asf.                                          *)
(* The fork_leaf branch reduces to the Fork second inverse            *)
(*   K : subtype (Fork C X) (Fork Leaf u) |- subtype X u,             *)
(* and the szs_quant_fork/szs_inst branches reduce to the Quant fork  *)
(* inverses                                                           *)
(*   K : subtype (Fork C X) (Quant (Fork A B))                        *)
(*   |- subtype X (Quant B)   and   subtype C (Quant A).              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The exact atomic blocked subgoal, after dependent destruction of   *)
(* K = szs_fork and inversion of the target Fork, is                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*   leafy : subtype Leaf C                                           *)
(*   KC    : subtype_size C A' n1                                     *)
(*   KX    : subtype_size X B' n2                                     *)
(*   HB    : subtype B' B                                             *)
(*   goal  : subtype X B                                              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* which is immediate by transitivity from KX and HB.  The genuinely  *)
(* blocked case is the preceding K = szs_trans decomposition, where    *)
(* one must prove subtype X B from                                  *)
(*   fork_second_inversion on the reach K1 and the trans target K2;    *)
(* the size pair transfers weight between K1 and K2 in opposite       *)
(* directions, so the atomic table is complete but the cut step is     *)
(* not discharged by the size-pair measure.                           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Print Assumptions RF_mono.
Print Assumptions RF_of_fork_subtype.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* GoodC: the coordinator's substitution-closure repair.               *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Difference from the proposal: the Funty case also keeps the base    *)
(* conjunct subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r).  The base        *)

(* Keeping the base conjunct is harmless for the monotonicity cases.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodC (d : nat) (x T : dtype) : Prop :=

  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Stem y => subtype x (quant d y)
  | Funty a r =>
      subtype (Fork x (quant d a)) (quant d r) /\
      (forall k u,
          subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst_rec a u k)))
                  (quant d (subst_rec r u k)))
  | Asf T' => GoodC d x T'
  | Quant T' => GoodC (S d) x T'
  end.

Definition GoodC_inst_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T u, GoodC (S d) x T -> GoodC d x (subst T u).

(* Direction obstruction for the Funty case of the obligation above.
   The source gives, at the base instance k = 0 and after unfolding
   quant (S d) a = quant d (Quant a),

     subtype (Fork x (quant d (Quant a))) (quant d (Quant r)) .

   The target base demands

     subtype (Fork x (quant d (subst a u))) (quant d (subst r u)) .

   The only available comparison of the inner arguments is
   [sub_inst] : Quant a <: subst a u.  It makes the target source
   (subst a u) LARGER than the source source (Quant a), so the source
   hypothesis concerns a smaller left argument and does not imply the
   target.  The all-k closure has exactly the same orientation for
   every k (with subst_rec a u k in place of a).  Thus the Funty part
   of GoodC_inst_obligation is not discharged by subst_subst_gen; it
   remains a genuine obligation. *)

Definition GoodC_lift_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x T, GoodC d x T -> GoodC d x (Quant (lift 1 T)).

(* The sub_stem_fun case is NOT derivable from the all-k Funty closure.
   It is isolated here as a third obligation; a forced instance below
   shows why it is problematic. *)
Definition GoodC_stem_fun_obligation : Prop :=
  forall d x uty vty,
    GoodC d x (Stem uty) -> GoodC d x (Funty vty (Fork uty vty)).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural monotonicity.  Every case except sub_inst, sub_lift and  *)
(* sub_stem_fun is discharged outright.  Those three are the isolated  *)
(* obligations below; the sub_stem_fun obligation is in fact false.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodC_mono
  (Hinst : GoodC_inst_obligation)
  (Hlift : GoodC_lift_obligation)
  (Hstemfun : GoodC_stem_fun_obligation)
  : forall d x T U, subtype T U -> GoodC d x T -> GoodC d x U.
Proof.
  intros d x T U Hsub.
  revert d x.
  induction Hsub as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros d x HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + exact HP.
    + apply quant_mono. exact Hs.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *)
    destruct HP as [Hbase Hclos]. split.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- apply sub_fork.
           ++ apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply quant_mono. exact Hs1.
        -- exact Hbase.
      * apply quant_mono. exact Hsub1.
    + intros k u.
      eapply sub_trans.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- apply sub_fork.
           ++ apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply quant_mono. apply (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ Hs1 u k).
        -- apply Hclos.
      * apply quant_mono. apply (AgentC.subst_rec_subtype _ _ Hsub1 u k).
  - (* quant *) apply IHHs. exact HP.
  - (* quant_stem *) rewrite <- quant_S. exact HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *)
    destruct HP as [Hbase Hclos]. split.
    + change (subtype (Fork x (quant (S d) uty)) (quant (S d) vty)).
      exact Hbase.
    + intros k u.
      change (subtype (Fork x (quant (S d) (subst_rec uty u (S k))))
                       (quant (S d) (subst_rec vty u (S k)))).
      apply Hclos.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift with (x := x) (d := d); assumption.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* stem_fun *)
    apply Hstemfun. exact HP.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HP. cbn in HP. destruct HP.
  - (* tree *) destruct HP.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* from_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HP.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HP.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Base facts and the L2 reduction.                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodC_stem_self : forall x, GoodC 0 x (Stem x).
Proof. intro x. simpl. apply sub_zero. Qed.

Lemma L2_of_GoodC
  (Hinst : GoodC_inst_obligation)
  (Hlift : GoodC_lift_obligation)
  (Hstemfun : GoodC_stem_fun_obligation)
  : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  pose proof (GoodC_mono Hinst Hlift Hstemfun 0 X (Stem X) (Funty a r) H
                (GoodC_stem_self X)) as [Hbase _].
  exact Hbase.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The sub_stem_fun obligation is false for this GoodC.                *)
(* Taking x = uty = Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0)), vty = Leaf, it      *)
(* forces the closure instance k = 0, u = Leaf:                        *)
(*   Fork (Funty Var0 (Stem Var0)) Leaf <:                             *)
(*   Fork (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)) Leaf.                               *)
(* The direct comparison of first components would need              *)
(* Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf) <: Funty Var0 (Stem Var0), whose domain     *)
(* by sub_funty contravariance is Leaf <: Var 0; no rule derives it.  *)
(* This is a structural argument, not a Coq non-derivability theorem; *)
(* what is formalized below is that the obligation forces this exact  *)
(* instance.  Note that x is leafy: sub_leaf_fun gives               *)
(* Leaf <: Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0)), so the leafy hypothesis     *)
(* does not exclude this instance.                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodC_stem_fun_forced_leafy :
  subtype Leaf (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0))).
Proof.
  apply sub_leaf_fun.
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_stem_fun_would_force :
  GoodC_stem_fun_obligation ->
  subtype (Fork (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0))) Leaf)
          (Fork (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)) Leaf).
Proof.
  intro Hsf.
  pose proof (Hsf 0 (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0)))
                 (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0))) Leaf
                 (sub_zero (Funty (Var 0) (Stem (Var 0)))))
    as [_ Hclos].
  specialize (Hclos 0 Leaf).
  vm_compute in Hclos.
  exact Hclos.
Qed.

Print Assumptions GoodC_stem_fun_forced_leafy.
