Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty HS | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [gamma4 x0 uty2 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty2 HS2 | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma9 x0 uty9 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma9 uty9 HS0 | gamma9 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [gamma4 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty HS | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  destruct (inv_s u2 u1 u ty u3 HS0 HS) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  eapply derive_app.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    * exact HB.
  + eapply derive_app.
    * eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | exact Hv2 ].
    * exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma red_leaf : forall gamma w x y ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ Node) ty ->
  derive gamma w ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma3 M3 N3 t3 u3 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma5 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma5 uty HS1 | gamma5 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HB) as HS3.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HK | ].
  eapply inv_leaf; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_stem : forall gamma w x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z)) ty ->
  derive gamma (x @ z) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma6 x0 uty6 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma6 uty6 HS1 | gamma6 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HL) as HS3.
  edestruct inv_stem as [v [Hv1 Hv2]]; eauto.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HI | exact Hv1 ].
    + exact HM.
  - exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma red_fork : forall gamma w x y z1 z2 ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ ((Node @ w) @ x)) @ y) @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) ty ->
  derive gamma ((y @ z1) @ z2) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma w x y z1 z2 ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty0 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty0 HS0 | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| | gamma4 M4 N4 t4 u4 HG HI]; subst.
  inversion HG as [| | gamma5 M5 N5 t5 u5 HJ HK]; subst.
  inversion HJ as [gamma6 x0 uty6 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma6 uty6 HS1 | gamma6 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HB as [| | gamma7 M7 N7 t7 u7 HL HM]; subst.
  inversion HL as [| | gamma8 M8 N8 t8 u8 HN HO]; subst.
  pose proof (node_subtype _ _ HN) as HS3.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
      eapply inv_fork; eauto.
    + exact HO.
  - exact HM.
Qed.

End Facts.

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_conditional :
  (forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros IK IS IL IST IF gamma M ty D.
  induction D; intros Nred HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR.
  - inversion HR as [y z | x y z | w x y | w x y z | w x y z1 z2 | M0 M0' N0 H0 | M1 N1 N1' H1]; subst.
    + (* k_red *) eapply (red_k IK). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].
    + (* s_red *) eapply (red_s IS). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].
    + (* leaf_red *) eapply (red_leaf IL). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].
    + (* stem_red *) eapply (red_stem IST). eapply derive_app; [ exact D1 | exact D2 ].

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->

  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.

  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.

    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.

    apply L1.

(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.

  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* 9.  Revised SEMANTIC invariant.  R_mono above is false (its        *)
(*     sub_bffs branch is the false Bffs_branch), so the structural   *)
(*     invariant cannot be repaired by a local change of the Asf      *)
(*     case alone.  The following invariant quantifies over all Funty *)
(*     supertypes instead of matching on X.  Its monotonicity is      *)
(*     then fully unconditional (SemR_mono), and the only remaining   *)
(*     obligation is SemComp: GoodStem 0 A B -> SemR 0 A u1 B.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* subtype is stable under an arbitrary lift. *)
Lemma lift_n_subtype :
  forall X Y, subtype X Y -> forall d, subtype (lift d X) (lift d Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y H. induction d as [| d IH].
  - rewrite l2_lift_zero, l2_lift_zero. exact H.
  - rewrite <- (l2_lift_lift_S X d), <- (l2_lift_lift_S Y d).
    apply (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ IH 0).
Qed.

(* For all Funty supertypes T <: Funty u ty of X, the pair (A,u1) must
   split at the same intermediate v. *)
Definition SemR (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) : Prop :=
  forall u ty,
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (lift d u1)) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v,
      subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v).

(* Unconditional monotonicity: no case analysis, no Bffs_branch. *)
Lemma SemR_mono :
  forall d A u1 X Y, subtype X Y -> SemR d A u1 X -> SemR d A u1 Y.
Proof.
  intros d A u1 X Y Hsub HR u ty Hfun.
  unfold SemR in HR.
  apply HR.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply lift_n_subtype. exact Hsub.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - exact Hfun.
Qed.

(* The single honest residual obligation of the semantic route. *)
Definition SemComp : Prop :=
  forall A B u1, GoodStem 0 A B -> SemR 0 A u1 B.

(* GoodStem_comp now follows from SemComp alone. *)
Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_SemComp :
  SemComp ->
  forall A B u1 u ty,
    GoodStem 0 A B ->
    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros SC A B u1 u ty H1 H2.
  unfold SemComp in SC.
  cbn [GoodStem] in H2.
  rewrite <- (l2_lift_zero u1) in H2.
  pose proof (SC A B u1 H1) as HR.
  unfold SemR in HR.
  destruct (HR u ty H2) as [v [HA Hu]].
  exists v. split.
  - rewrite l2_lift_zero in HA. exact HA.
  - rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hu. exact Hu.
Qed.

(* Hence inv_s follows from the single obligation SemComp. *)
Lemma inv_s_of_SemComp :
  SemComp ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intro SC.
  exact (inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp (GoodStem_comp_of_SemComp SC)).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.

Definition omega22_ty := program_type omega22.

Definition omega2_ty := (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty).

Definition eval_ty := quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Asf (Var 0))).

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                          subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| sub_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| sub_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| sub_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| sub_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)

| sub_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subtype omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| sub_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
| sub_to_asf: forall ty, subtype ty (Asf ty)
| sub_from_asf: forall uty vty, subtype (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
| sub_bffs: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty)) (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty))
| sub_bfff : forall uty vty wty, subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
                                         (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty))
.

Consequently `R_mono` is false, and `GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono` / `inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp` are vacuous conditional results, not a viable reduction. I replaced it with a semantic, Funty-supertype-quantified invariant, whose monotonicity is unconditional:

```coq
Definition SemR (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) : Prop :=
  forall u ty,
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (lift d u1)) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v,
      subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v).

Definition SemComp : Prop :=
  forall A B u1, GoodStem 0 A B -> SemR 0 A u1 B.
```

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 1. Forward reachability of the head.                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A subtype of a Fork source has head Fork or Funty (or an Asf/Quant  *)
(* spine ending in one of them); it is never Leaf, Stem or Var.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - exact HR.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma RF_fork : forall C X, RF (Fork C X).
Proof. intros. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype : forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof. intros. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply RF_fork. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_leaf : forall D E, subtype (Fork D E) Leaf -> False.
Proof. intros D E H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E Leaf H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_stem : forall D E Y, subtype (Fork D E) (Stem Y) -> False.
Proof. intros D E Y H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Stem Y) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_var : forall D E i, subtype (Fork D E) (Var i) -> False.
Proof. intros D E i H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Var i) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2. Fork-strict reachability and the left projection.                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* FRK T holds when T is a Fork, or a Quant spine ending in a Fork.    *)
(* This is exactly the target class for which the left projection lp    *)
(* is monotone.  Asf targets are deliberately excluded: the bffs/bfff   *)
(* rules make lp monotonicity false there (lp (bffs_aug u) is not a     *)
(* subtype of u).                                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint FRK (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => FRK T'
  | _ => False
  end.

(* The left projection.  Funty is mapped to its domain; this choice is
   irrelevant because Funty targets never satisfy FRK. *)
Fixpoint lp (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (lp T')
  | Funty a _ => a
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork u _ => u
  | Asf T' => lp T'
  end.

(* Under RF, substitution and lifting preserve FRK exactly. *)
Lemma FRK_subst_rec_RF : forall T u k, RF T -> (FRK (subst_rec T u k) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) tauto.
  - (* Asf *) tauto.
Qed.

Lemma FRK_lift_rec_RF : forall T k m, RF T -> (FRK (lift_rec T k m) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
  - tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
Qed.

(* lp commutes with substitution and lifting on the RF fragment. *)
Lemma lp_subst_rec_RF :
  forall T u k, RF T -> lp (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (lp T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma lp_lift_rec_RF :
  forall T k m, RF T -> lp (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (lp T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* Backward preservation of FRK along a subtype derivation from an RF
   source.  This is the key closure property needed for the transitivity
   case of lp monotonicity. *)
Lemma FRK_back_RF :
  forall S T, subtype S T -> RF S -> FRK T -> FRK S.
Proof.
  intros S T H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR HF; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HF.
  - (* trans *)
    pose proof (RF_mono _ _ H1 HR) as HRM.
    pose proof (IHH2 HRM HF) as HFM.
    exact (IHH1 HR HFM).
  - (* stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* funty *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant *) apply IHHs; assumption.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* dist *) destruct HF.
  - (* inst *)
    apply (proj1 (FRK_subst_rec_RF ty u 0 HR)). exact HF.
  - (* lift *)
    apply (proj1 (FRK_lift_rec_RF ty 0 1 HR)). exact HF.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HF.
  - (* recursion *) destruct HF.
  - (* tree *) destruct HF.
  - (* to_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* from_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HF.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HF.
Qed.

(* lp is monotone on the RF/FRK fragment. *)
Lemma lp_mono_RF_FRK :
  forall S T, subtype S T -> RF S -> FRK T -> subtype (lp S) (lp T).
Proof.
  intros S T H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR HF; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* trans *)
    pose proof (RF_mono _ _ H1 HR) as HRM.
    pose proof (FRK_back_RF _ _ H2 HRM HF) as HFM.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply IHH1; assumption.
    + apply IHH2; assumption.
  - (* stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork *) exact Hs1.
  - (* asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* funty *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant *) apply sub_quant. apply IHHs; assumption.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant_fork *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* quant_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* dist *) destruct HF.
  - (* inst *)
    rewrite (lp_subst_rec_RF ty u 0 HR).
    apply sub_inst.
  - (* lift *)
    rewrite (lp_lift_rec_RF ty 0 1 HR).
    apply sub_lift.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HF.
  - (* recursion *) destruct HF.
  - (* tree *) destruct HF.
  - (* to_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* from_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HF.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HF.
Qed.

(* The left projection of a subtype between Forks. *)
Lemma fork_left : forall D E A B,
  subtype (Fork D E) (Fork A B) -> subtype D A.
Proof.
  intros D E A B H.
  exact (lp_mono_RF_FRK (Fork D E) (Fork A B) H Logic.I Logic.I).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 1. Forward reachability of the head.                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A subtype of a Fork source has head Fork or Funty (or an Asf/Quant  *)
(* spine ending in one of them); it is never Leaf, Stem or Var.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - exact HR.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma RF_fork : forall C X, RF (Fork C X).
Proof. intros. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype : forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof. intros. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply RF_fork. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_leaf : forall D E, subtype (Fork D E) Leaf -> False.
Proof. intros D E H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E Leaf H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_stem : forall D E Y, subtype (Fork D E) (Stem Y) -> False.
Proof. intros D E Y H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Stem Y) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_var : forall D E i, subtype (Fork D E) (Var i) -> False.
Proof. intros D E i H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Var i) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2. Fork-strict reachability and the left projection.                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* FRK T holds when T is a Fork, or a Quant spine ending in a Fork.    *)
(* This is exactly the target class for which the left projection lp    *)
(* is monotone.  Asf targets are deliberately excluded: the bffs/bfff   *)
...
  - (* inst *)
    unfold subst.
    rewrite (lp_subst_rec_RF ty u 0 HR).
    apply sub_inst.
  - (* lift *)
    unfold lift.
    rewrite (lp_lift_rec_RF ty 0 1 HR).
    apply sub_lift.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HF.
  - (* recursion *) destruct HF.
  - (* tree *) destruct HF.
  - (* to_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* from_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HF.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HF.
Qed.

(* The left projection of a subtype between Forks. *)
Lemma fork_left : forall D E A B,
  subtype (Fork D E) (Fork A B) -> subtype D A.
Proof.
  intros D E A B H.
  exact (lp_mono_RF_FRK (Fork D E) (Fork A B) H Logic.I Logic.I).
Qed.

Print Assumptions fork_left.

  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) <-> subtype (Fork X a) r.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The s-reduction head inversion statement is FALSE.                  *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The counterexample uses:                                            *)
(*   u2 = Stem Leaf                                                    *)
(*   u1 = Funty Leaf Leaf                                              *)

(*   subtype (Fork Leaf v) Leaf,                                       *)

(* target (the invariant RF below).                                    *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Invariant RF: every type reachable from a Fork source has head      *)
(* Fork or Funty (possibly under any number of Asf/Quant).  In         *)
(* particular Leaf, Stem and Var are unreachable.                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs

    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];

  - (* trans *) eauto.

  - (* asf *) eauto.

  - (* quant *) eauto.

  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Definition A0 : dtype := Fork (Stem (Stem Leaf)) (Stem Leaf).

Lemma omega21_shape : omega21_ty = Fork Leaf (Stem (Stem A0)).
Proof.
  unfold omega21_ty, omega21, A0. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition W2 (W : dtype) : dtype := Funty W W.
Definition W3 (W : dtype) : dtype := Funty (W2 W) W.

Lemma A0_funty : forall W, subtype A0 (Funty (W2 W) (W2 W)).
Proof.
  intros W.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Fork
              (Stem (Funty (W2 W) (Funty (Fork Leaf (W2 W)) (W2 W))))
              (Funty (W2 W) (Fork Leaf (W2 W)))).
  - unfold A0.
    apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_stem.
      eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (W2 W) (Fork Leaf (W2 W))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

Lemma RecSplit_H1 : forall (W : dtype),
  subtype omega21_ty
    (Funty omega2_ty (Funty (W3 W) (W3 W))).
Proof.
  intros W.
  rewrite omega21_shape.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty omega2_ty (Stem (Stem A0))).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with
        (ty2 := Funty (W3 W) (Fork (Stem A0) (W3 W))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- unfold W3, W2.
           eapply sub_trans with
             (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty (Funty W W) (Funty W W)))
                          (Funty (Funty W W) W)).
           ++ apply sub_fork.
              ** apply sub_stem. apply A0_funty.
              ** apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

Definition STF : Prop :=
  forall Y u1 u ty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem Y) u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v, subtype Y (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

Definition inv_s_core : Prop :=
  forall X u1 u ty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

Lemma inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit : inv_s_core -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HC k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  pose proof
    (app_sound
       (app_stem (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
          (sub_recursion k uty vty))) as Hdouble.
  exact (HC omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W) Hdouble).
Qed.

Lemma STF_implies_RecSplit : STF -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HS k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  exact (HS omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W)
           (sub_recursion k uty vty)).
Qed.

Print Assumptions RecSplit_H1.
Print Assumptions inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit.
Print Assumptions STF_implies_RecSplit.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.
Variable inv_k : forall a b c d, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.
Variable inv_s : forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* Concrete shapes of the omega22 pieces. *)
Eval vm_compute in omega21_ty.
Eval vm_compute in omega22_left.
Eval vm_compute in omega22_right_tail.

(* Size (node count) of omega22_left, for orientation. *)
Fixpoint dsize (T : dtype) : nat :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => 1
  | Quant T' => S (dsize T')
  | Funty a b => S (dsize a + dsize b)
  | Leaf => 1
  | Stem T' => S (dsize T')
  | Fork a b => S (dsize a + dsize b)
  | Asf T' => S (dsize T')
  end.

Eval vm_compute in dsize omega21_ty.
Eval vm_compute in dsize omega22_left.
Eval vm_compute in dsize omega22_right_tail.

  inv_s_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

  intros IC u2 u1 u ty u3 h0 h1.
  apply (IC u3 u1 u ty).
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Stem u2).
  - apply sub_stem. apply (L1 u3 u2). exact h1.
  - apply (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))). exact h0.

(*    <: Funty omega22 (Fork (Stem omega21) omega22)   (sub_stem_fun) *)

  forall k uty vty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem omega21_ty))

        (Funty omega2_ty

            (quant k (Funty uty vty))))).

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The coordinator's proposed double-Stem core.                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition inv_s_core : Prop :=
  forall X u1 u ty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

(* Step 1: inv_s follows from inv_s_core (the intended reduction). *)
Lemma inv_s_of_inv_s_core :
  inv_s_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros IC u2 u1 u ty u3 h0 h1.
  apply (IC u3 u1 u ty).
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Stem u2).
  - apply sub_stem. apply (L1 u3 u2). exact h1.
  - apply (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))). exact h0.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Step 2: inv_s_core still entails RecSplit.                         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The sub_recursion rule is not reached through the SOURCE           *)
(* Stem (Stem X); it is reached through the codomain of the Funty:    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  Stem (Stem omega21)                                               *)
(*    <: Funty omega22 (Fork (Stem omega21) omega22)   (sub_stem_fun) *)
(*    <: Funty omega22 (Funty omega2_ty (Funty q q -> q))            *)
(*                                   (sub_funty + sub_recursion)      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instantiating inv_s_core at X = omega21_ty, u1 = omega22_ty,        *)
(* u = omega2_ty, ty = Funty (Funty q q) q then yields exactly        *)
(* RecSplit.  Hence inv_s_core is at least as strong as RecSplit.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma inv_s_core_premise :
  forall k uty vty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem omega21_ty))
      (Funty omega22_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty
            (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                   (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
            (quant k (Funty uty vty))))).
Proof.
  intros k uty vty.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Funty omega22_ty (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + change (subtype omega2_ty
                (Funty omega2_ty
                  (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                           (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))).
      exact (sub_recursion k uty vty).
Qed.

Lemma inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit : inv_s_core -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros IC k uty vty.
  unfold RecSplit.
  destruct (IC omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty
              (Funty
                (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                       (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (inv_s_core_premise k uty vty)) as [v [HA Hu]].
  exists v. split; assumption.
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Definition A0 : dtype := Fork (Stem (Stem Leaf)) (Stem Leaf).

Lemma omega21_shape : omega21_ty = Fork Leaf (Stem (Stem A0)).
Proof.
  unfold omega21_ty, omega21, A0. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition W2 (W : dtype) : dtype := Funty W W.
Definition W3 (W : dtype) : dtype := Funty (W2 W) W.

Lemma A0_funty : forall W, subtype A0 (Funty (W2 W) (W2 W)).
Proof.
  intros W.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Fork
              (Stem (Funty (W2 W) (Funty (Fork Leaf (W2 W)) (W2 W))))
              (Funty (W2 W) (Fork Leaf (W2 W)))).
  - unfold A0.
    apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_stem.
      eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (W2 W) (Fork Leaf (W2 W))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

Lemma RecSplit_H1 : forall (W : dtype),
  subtype omega21_ty
    (Funty omega2_ty (Funty (W3 W) (W3 W))).
Proof.
  intros W.
  rewrite omega21_shape.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty omega2_ty (Stem (Stem A0))).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with
        (ty2 := Funty (W3 W) (Fork (Stem A0) (W3 W))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- unfold W3, W2.
           eapply sub_trans with
             (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty (Funty W W) (Funty W W)))
                          (Funty (Funty W W) W)).
           ++ apply sub_fork.
              ** apply sub_stem. apply A0_funty.
              ** apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

Definition STF : Prop :=
  forall Y u1 u ty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem Y) u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v, subtype Y (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

Definition inv_s_core : Prop :=
  forall X u1 u ty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

Lemma inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit : inv_s_core -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HC k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  pose proof
    (app_sound (Stem (Stem omega21_ty)) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
       (app_stem (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
          (sub_recursion k uty vty))) as Hdouble.
  exact (HC omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W) Hdouble).
Qed.

Lemma STF_implies_RecSplit : STF -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HS k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  exact (HS omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W)
           (sub_recursion k uty vty)).
Qed.

Print Assumptions RecSplit_H1.
Print Assumptions inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit.
Print Assumptions STF_implies_RecSplit.

(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The coordinator's proposed double-Stem core.                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition inv_s_core : Prop :=
  forall X u1 u ty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

(* Step 1: inv_s follows from inv_s_core (the intended reduction). *)
Lemma inv_s_of_inv_s_core :
  inv_s_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros IC u2 u1 u ty u3 h0 h1.
  apply (IC u3 u1 u ty).
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Stem u2).
  - apply sub_stem. apply (L1 u3 u2). exact h1.
  - apply (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))). exact h0.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2. Fork-strict reachability and the left projection.                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* FRK T holds when T is a Fork, or a Quant spine ending in a Fork.    *)
(* This is exactly the target class for which the left projection lp    *)
(* is monotone.  Asf targets are deliberately excluded: the bffs/bfff   *)
(* rules make lp monotonicity false there (lp (bffs_aug u) is not a     *)
(* subtype of u).                                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint FRK (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => FRK T'
  | _ => False
  end.

(* The left projection.  Funty is mapped to its domain; this choice is
   irrelevant because Funty targets never satisfy FRK. *)
Fixpoint lp (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (lp T')
  | Funty a _ => a
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork u _ => u
  | Asf T' => lp T'
  end.

(* Under RF, substitution and lifting preserve FRK exactly. *)
Lemma FRK_subst_rec_RF : forall T u k, RF T -> (FRK (subst_rec T u k) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) tauto.
  - (* Asf *) tauto.
Qed.

Lemma FRK_lift_rec_RF : forall T k m, RF T -> (FRK (lift_rec T k m) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
  - tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
Qed.

(* lp commutes with substitution and lifting on the RF fragment. *)
Lemma lp_subst_rec_RF :
  forall T u k, RF T -> lp (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (lp T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma lp_lift_rec_RF :
  forall T k m, RF T -> lp (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (lp T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.

(* forward reachability invariant RF *)
Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR. - apply IHT; exact HR. - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR. - destruct HR. - exact Logic.I. - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR. - apply IHT; exact HR. - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR. - destruct HR. - exact Logic.I. - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - exact HR.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply RF_subst_rec with (k:=0). exact HR.
  - apply RF_lift_rec with (k:=0) (m:=1). exact HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.

Definition omega22_left : dtype :=
  match omega22_ty with
  | Fork (Stem A) _ => A
  | _ => Leaf
  end.

Definition omega22_right : dtype :=
  match omega22_ty with
  | Fork _ B => B
  | _ => Leaf
  end.

Definition omega22_right_tail : dtype :=
  match omega22_right with
  | Fork Leaf C => C
  | _ => Leaf
  end.

Lemma omega22_shape :
  omega22_ty = Fork (Stem omega22_left) omega22_right.
Proof.
  unfold omega22_ty, omega22_left, omega22_right. cbn. reflexivity.

  omega22_right = Fork Leaf omega22_right_tail.
Proof.

    subtype omega22_left (Funty omega2_ty (Funty omega22_right_tail V)) ->
    subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty V).

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Ltac solve_sub :=
  first [ apply sub_zero
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype Leaf (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Stem a));
                      [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_stem_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a));
                      [ apply sub_stem_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Funty ?X ?Y) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              eapply sub_funty; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Fork Leaf ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a X);
                      [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Fork (Stem ?Y) ?Z) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              evar (w : dtype);
              assert (HZ : subtype Z (Funty a w)) by solve_sub;
              eapply sub_trans with
                (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty a (Funty w C))) (Funty a w));
              [ eapply sub_fork; [ apply sub_stem; solve_sub | exact HZ ]
              | apply sub_fork_stem ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Stem ?Y) =>
              apply sub_stem; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Fork ?X1 ?X2) (Fork ?Y1 ?Y2) =>
              eapply sub_fork; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Asf ?X) (Asf ?Y) =>
              apply sub_asf; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Quant ?X) (Quant ?Y) =>
              apply sub_quant; solve_sub
          | |- subtype ?X ?Y =>
              first [ apply sub_zero
                    | eapply sub_trans; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ] ]
          end ].

(* Does omega22_ty have ANY Funty supertype? *)
Lemma omega22_funty_exists :
  exists r, subtype omega22_ty (Funty Leaf r).
Proof.
  eexists.
  solve_sub.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)

                      [ apply sub_leaf_fun

                      [ apply sub_stem_fun

          | |- subtype (Fork Leaf ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_fork_leaf

                      [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Fork (Stem ?Y) ?Z) (Funty ?a ?C) =>

              let w := fresh "w" in

              destruct Hex as [w HZ];

              | apply sub_fork_stem ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Stem ?Y) =>
              apply sub_stem; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Fork ?X1 ?X2) (Fork ?Y1 ?Y2) =>
              eapply sub_fork; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Asf ?X) (Asf ?Y) =>
              apply sub_asf; solve_sub

              apply sub_quant; solve_sub

Fixpoint funty_chain (args : list dtype) (r : dtype) : dtype :=
  match args with
  | nil => r
  | cons a rest => Funty a (funty_chain rest r)
  end.

Fixpoint cod (fuel : nat) (A : dtype) (args : list dtype) {struct fuel} : option dtype :=
  match fuel with
  | O => None
  | S f =>
      match args with
      | nil => Some A
      | cons a rest =>
          match A with

          | Stem X => cod f (Fork X a) rest
          | Funty _ _ => None
          | Fork Leaf X => cod f X rest
          | Fork (Stem Y) Z =>
              match cod f Z (cons a nil) with
              | Some c => cod f Y (cons a (cons c rest))
              | None => None
              end
          | _ => None
          end
      end
  end.

  forall fuel A args r,
    cod fuel A args = Some r ->
    subtype A (funty_chain args r).

  - cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
  - destruct args as [| a rest].

              first [ apply sub_leaf_fun

                      [ apply sub_leaf_fun

          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_stem_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a));
                      [ apply sub_stem_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_dbg ] ] ]

          | |- subtype (Fork Leaf ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>

                      [ apply sub_fork_leaf

          | |- subtype (Fork ?X1 ?X2) (Fork ?Y1 ?Y2) =>

Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Definition W20 : dtype := Funty q0 q0.
Definition G0 : dtype := Funty W20 q0.
Definition R_v := cod 200 r22 (W20 :: nil).
Definition Rv := match R_v with Some r => r | None => Leaf end.

Definition fstT (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with Fork a _ => a | Stem a => a | Funty a _ => a
  | Quant a => a | Asf a => a | _ => T end.
Definition sndT (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with Fork _ b => b | _ => T end.

Ltac desc T :=
  match T with
  | Funty _ _ => idtac "  Funty"
  | Fork Leaf _ => idtac "  ForkLeaf"
  | Fork (Stem _) _ => idtac "  ForkStem"
  | Fork (Fork _ _) _ => idtac "  ForkFork"
  | Stem _ => idtac "  Stem"
  | Leaf => idtac "  Leaf"
  | Var _ => idtac "  Var"
  | Quant _ => idtac "  Quant"
  | Asf _ => idtac "  Asf"
  | _ => idtac "  OTHER"
  end.

Ltac solve_dbg :=
  first [ apply sub_zero
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype Leaf (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Stem a));
                      [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_dbg ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_stem_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a));
                      [ apply sub_stem_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_dbg ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Funty ?X ?Y) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              eapply sub_funty; [ solve_dbg | solve_dbg ]
          | |- subtype (Fork Leaf ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a X);
                      [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_dbg ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Fork (Stem ?Y) ?Z) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              let Hex := fresh "Hex" in
              let HZ := fresh "HZ" in
              let w := fresh "w" in
              assert (Hex : exists w : dtype, subtype Z (Funty a w));
              [ eexists; solve_dbg
              | destruct Hex as [w HZ];
                eapply sub_trans with
                  (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty a (Funty w C))) (Funty a w));
                [ eapply sub_fork; [ apply sub_stem; solve_dbg | exact HZ ]
                | apply sub_fork_stem ] ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Stem ?Y) =>
              apply sub_stem; solve_dbg
          | |- subtype (Fork ?X1 ?X2) (Fork ?Y1 ?Y2) =>
              eapply sub_fork; [ solve_dbg | solve_dbg ]
          | |- subtype (Asf ?X) (Asf ?Y) =>
              apply sub_asf; solve_dbg
          | |- subtype (Quant ?X) (Quant ?Y) =>
              apply sub_quant; solve_dbg
          end
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype ?A ?T =>
              idtac "BLOCKED subtype A/T/fstA/fstT:";
              desc A; desc T; desc (fstT A); desc (fstT T);
              admit
          | |- ?G => idtac "BLOCKED other"; admit
          end ].

Lemma Rv_sub_q0 : subtype Rv q0.
Proof.
  unfold q0.
  unfold Rv, R_v.
  cbn.
  solve_dbg.
Admitted.

Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Definition q0 : dtype := Funty Leaf Leaf.
Definition W20 : dtype := Funty q0 q0.
Definition G0 : dtype := Funty W20 q0.

Ltac show_goal :=
  match goal with
  | |- ?G => idtac "GOAL:" G

Ltac solve_sub :=
  first [ apply sub_zero
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype omega2_ty ?T => unfold omega2_ty; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega21_ty ?T => unfold omega21_ty; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega22_ty ?T => unfold omega22_ty, omega22; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega22 ?T => unfold omega22; cbn; solve_sub
          end
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype Leaf (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Stem a));
                      [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_stem_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a));
                      [ apply sub_stem_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Funty ?X ?Y) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              eapply sub_funty; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Fork Leaf ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a X);
                      [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Fork (Stem ?Y) ?Z) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              let Hex := fresh "Hex" in
              let HZ := fresh "HZ" in
              let w := fresh "w" in
              assert (Hex : exists w : dtype, subtype Z (Funty a w))
                by (eexists; solve_sub);
              destruct Hex as [w HZ];
              eapply sub_trans with
                (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty a (Funty w C))) (Funty a w));
              [ eapply sub_fork; [ apply sub_stem; solve_sub | exact HZ ]
              | apply sub_fork_stem ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Stem ?Y) =>
              apply sub_stem; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Fork ?X1 ?X2) (Fork ?Y1 ?Y2) =>
              eapply sub_fork; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Asf ?X) (Asf ?Y) =>
              apply sub_asf; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Quant ?X) (Quant ?Y) =>
              apply sub_quant; solve_sub
          end ].

Lemma h2_G0 : subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty G0).
Proof.
  unfold G0, W20, q0.
  solve_sub.
Qed.

Print Assumptions h2_G0.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.

  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB Size.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
  pose proof (extr_mono_reach _ _ HHsub HS) as Hr.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact HX.
  - exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma L3_literal :
  forall X a r, subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  destruct (subtype_has_size _ _ H) as [nH HnH].

           (Fork Leaf X) a r X nH 1 HnH (szs_zero (Fork Leaf X)) eq_refl).
Qed.

(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :
  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).

  forall a b Y Z, subtype (Funty a b) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a b Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Funty a b) Y Z Logic.I H).
