Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof.
  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0.
Qed.

(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The k head case, isolated.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We show that the whole k case follows from ONE subtype-inversion   *)
(* fact (the "leaf pairing" inversion below).  This is the precise    *)
(* semantic content that a syntactic proof must supply.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma k_head_case
  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
      subtype Leaf a ->
      subtype b d)
  : forall gamma y z ty,
      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.

  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 5. Target-only predicate architecture (coordinator's plan).        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf is defined by structural recursion on the TARGET type:      *)
(*   Funty a r  |-> subtype (Stem a) r                               *)
(*   Leaf       |-> True                                              *)
(*   Asf T      |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
(*   Quant T    |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
(*   Stem/Fork/Var |-> False                                          *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* All monotonicity cases of P_leaf along subtype are structural      *)
(* except three shape obligations, isolated as hypotheses below.      *)
(* The dist obligation is now discharged unconditionally in Section   *)
(* 10 (subtype_stem_quant_dist); only Hlift and Hinst remain.         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => P_leaf T'
  | Quant T' => P_leaf T'
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
  end.

Lemma P_leaf_mono
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HP; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HP.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ eapply sub_trans; [ apply sub_stem; exact Hs1 | exact HP ] | exact H ].
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HP.
  - (* dist *) apply Hdist. exact HP.
  - (* inst *) apply Hinst. exact HP.
  - (* lift *) apply Hlift. exact HP.
  - (* leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HP.

(* 6. A structural "head/safety" invariant Q that is unconditionally   *)
(*    monotone along subtype and stable under substitution and lift.   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Q forbids Fork at the head and recursively under Quant, and forbids *)
(* Var.  This is exactly the guard needed for the substitution lemma:  *)
(* the rules with Fork sources (sub_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,        *)
(* sub_bfff) and sub_recursion become vacuous, while all other rules   *)
(* preserve Q.                                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint Q (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => True
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => Q T'
  end.

Lemma Q_subst_rec : forall T u k, Q T -> Q (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_lift_rec : forall T k n, Q T -> Q (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.

Qed.

(* 4.  GoodStem_comp follows from monotonicity of R.                  *)

Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono :
  R_mono ->
  forall A B u1 u ty,
    GoodStem 0 A B ->
    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v,
      subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros HR A B u1 u ty H1 H2.
  assert (Hres : R 0 A u1 (Funty u ty)).
  { apply (HR 0 A u1 (Fork (lift 0 B) u1) (Funty u ty)).
    - simpl. exact H2.
    - simpl. split.
      + rewrite l2_lift_zero. exact H1.
      + rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero. }
  cbn [R] in Hres.
  rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hres.
  rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Lemma GoodStem_comp_implies_RecSplit :

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Pure term identity: substituting at a cutoff k <= d inside          *)
(* lift (S d) X undoes one lift.                                       *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d -> subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
  forall T d j X,
    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitution closure:                                              *)
(*   k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).  *)
(* The condition k <= d is propagated by the Quant case (both become  *)
(* S k and S d), and is exactly what makes the pure lift/subst        *)
(* identity hold.                                                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint funty_chain (args : list dtype) (r : dtype) : dtype :=
  match args with
  | nil => r
  | cons a rest => Funty a (funty_chain rest r)
  end.

Fixpoint cod (fuel : nat) (A : dtype) (args : list dtype) {struct fuel} : option dtype :=
  match fuel with
  | O => None
  | S f =>
      match args with
      | nil => Some A
      | cons a rest =>
          match A with
          | Var _ => None
          | Quant _ => None
          | Funty _ _ => None
          | Leaf => cod f (Stem a) rest
          | Stem X => cod f (Fork X a) rest
          | Fork Leaf X => cod f X rest
          | Fork (Stem Y) Z =>
              match cod f Z (cons a nil) with
              | Some c => cod f Y (cons a (cons c rest))
              | None => None
              end
          | Fork _ _ => None
          | Asf _ => None
          end
      end
  end.

Lemma cod_sound :
  forall fuel A args r,
    cod fuel A args = Some r ->
    subtype A (funty_chain args r).
Proof.
  induction fuel as [| f IH]; intros A args r H.

  - destruct args as [| a rest].
    + cbn [cod] in H. cbn [funty_chain]. inversion H; subst. apply sub_zero.

      * cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
      * cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
      * cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
      * cbn [cod] in H. cbn [funty_chain].
        pose proof (IH (Stem a) rest r H) as HI.

        -- apply sub_leaf_fun.

      * cbn [cod] in H. cbn [funty_chain].

        eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a)).
        -- apply sub_stem_fun.
        -- eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | exact HI ].
      * destruct F1 as [n1|Q1|G1 G2| |Y|G1 G2|A1].
        -- cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
        -- cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
        -- cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
        -- cbn [cod] in H. cbn [funty_chain].
           pose proof (IH F2 rest r H) as HI.
           eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a F2).
           ++ apply sub_fork_leaf.
           ++ eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | exact HI ].
        -- cbn [cod] in H.
           destruct (cod f F2 (a :: nil)) as [c|] eqn:Ec in H.
           ++ pose proof (IH F2 (a :: nil) c Ec) as HZ.
              pose proof (IH Y (a :: c :: rest) r H) as HY.
              cbn [funty_chain] in HY. cbn [funty_chain].
              eapply sub_trans with

              ** eapply sub_fork.
                 --- apply sub_stem. exact HY.
                 --- exact HZ.
              ** apply sub_fork_stem.
           ++ discriminate H.
        -- cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
        -- cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
      * cbn [cod] in H. discriminate.
Qed.

Inductive Tree:  Set :=
  | Ref : string -> Tree
  | Node : Tree
  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)

  end.

Notation "\" := star : tree_scope.

Definition wait2 M N x :=  S1 (S1 (S1 (K @ M) @ (K @ N)) @ (K @ x)) @ I.

Definition omega21 := K @ (△ @ (△ @ I)).

(* 8. Strong soundness of App for a Leaf-reachable source.             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* All Stem/Fork/recursion/tree source cases are eliminated by the      *)
(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).
  - (* app_leaf *) intros a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0. exact Hsub.
  - (* app_stem *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_funty *) intros X0 Y0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply L1. exact Hleaf0.
      * exact H2.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) intros X0 a0 r0 Hsub Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_stem *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) intros u0 v0 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) intros u0 v1 v2 w0 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) intros u0 v0 w1 w2 w3 a0 r0 H1 H2 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) intros ty0 u0 a0 r0 H Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply Hdist. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_recursion *) intros k0 u0 v0 Hleaf0.
    exfalso. apply not_subtype_leaf_omega2. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_tree *) intros ty0 uty0 Hcov Hleaf0.
    exfalso. eapply not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hleaf0.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) intros X0 Y0 Hleaf0.
    apply L1.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + exact Hleaf0.
    + apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) intros S0 T0 a0 r0 Hsub HA0 IH Hleaf0.
    apply IH.
    eapply sub_trans; [ exact Hleaf0 | exact Hsub ].
  - (* final App T a r *) exact HA.
Qed.

(* 9. Exact reduction of the two de Bruijn obligations of P_leaf.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Hinst of P_leaf_mono follows from the generalized specialized       *)
(* substitution fact for Stem sources; Hlift follows from the          *)
(* generalized specialized lift fact.  These are the precise           *)
(* remaining algebraic obligations, isolated from all subtyping logic. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma specialized_subst_implies_P_inst
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  : forall T u k, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u0 k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.

match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
  | Funty _ r => r
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork _ v => v
  | Asf T' => extr T'
  end.

(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
Lemma extr_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork u _ => R u
  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
  end.

Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_subst_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_lift_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* On the ReachFork fragment, extr commutes with substitution with    *)
(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)
(* e.g. extr (Fork A B) = B, and substituting in the discarded first  *)
(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
  forall T u k,
    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ReachFork is monotone along subtype. *)
Lemma ReachFork_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) eapply R_mono; eauto.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply ReachFork_subst_rec with (u := u) (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply ReachFork_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

  - (* from_asf *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The s-reduction head inversion statement is FALSE.                  *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The counterexample uses:                                            *)
(*   u2 = Stem Leaf                                                    *)
(*   u1 = Funty Leaf Leaf                                              *)
(*   u  = Leaf                                                         *)
(*   ty = Leaf                                                         *)
(*   u3 = Leaf                                                         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Both premises are derivable (proved below).  The conclusion would   *)
(* force, for some v,                                                    *)
(*   subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty v Leaf))                          *)
(* and, via L1 and L2_literal, that would force                         *)
(*   subtype (Fork Leaf v) Leaf,                                       *)
(* which is impossible because a Fork-source can never have Leaf as a  *)
(* target (the invariant RF below).                                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Invariant RF: every type reachable from a Fork source has head      *)
(* Fork or Funty (possibly under any number of Asf/Quant).  In         *)
(* particular Leaf, Stem and Var are unreachable.                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* recursion *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* tree *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bfff *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype : forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof.
  intros C X S H. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_leaf : forall C X, subtype (Fork C X) Leaf -> False.
Proof.
  intros C X H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype C X Leaf H) as HR.
  simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Closed derivation of the first premise, with the chosen values.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Leaf <: Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma leaf_funty2 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Stem (Stem Leaf) <: Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma stem_stem_leaf_funty2 :
  subtype (Stem (Stem Leaf))
          (Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf)
                   (Fork (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with
        (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)))
                     (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_fork.
        -- apply sub_stem. exact leaf_funty2.
        -- apply sub_zero.
      * apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

(* H0 : Leaf <: Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) with
        u1 = Funty Leaf Leaf, u = Leaf, ty = Leaf. *)
Lemma inv_s_first_premise :
  subtype Leaf
          (Funty (Stem Leaf)
                 (Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Funty (Stem Leaf) (Stem (Stem Leaf))).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + exact stem_stem_leaf_funty2.
Qed.

(* H1 : Leaf <: Funty u3 u2 with u3 = Leaf, u2 = Stem Leaf. *)
Lemma inv_s_second_premise :
  subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  apply sub_leaf_fun.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The refutation.                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma no_conclusion_for_witness :
  forall v, ~ (subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty v Leaf)) /\
               subtype (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf v)).
Proof.
  intros v [Hconcl _].
  (* L1 turns the conclusion into Stem Leaf <: Funty v Leaf. *)
  pose proof (L1 Leaf (Funty v Leaf) Hconcl) as Hstem.
  (* L2_literal turns that into Fork Leaf v <: Leaf. *)
  pose proof (L2_literal Leaf v Leaf Hstem) as Hfork.
  exact (not_subtype_fork_leaf Leaf v Hfork).
Qed.

Theorem inv_s_is_false :
  ~ (forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
       subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
       subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
       exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
                 subtype u1 (Funty u v)).
Proof.
  intro Hin.
  pose proof
    (Hin (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf Leaf) Leaf Leaf Leaf
         inv_s_first_premise inv_s_second_premise) as [v Hv].
  exact (no_conclusion_for_witness v Hv).
Qed.

Definition inv_fork_core : Prop :=
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,

    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
  pose proof (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty) Hs0) as Hf.
  pose proof (L1 u4 (Funty u5 u2) H1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (L2_literal u4 u5 u2 Hs1) as HG.

  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
  pose proof (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty) Hs0) as Hf.
  pose proof (L1 u4 (Funty u5 u2) H1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (L2_literal u4 u5 u2 Hs1) as HG.
  exact (HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 Hf HG H2).

Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

    subtype omega22_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty

    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

  forall Y u1 u ty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem Y) u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v, subtype Y (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

   subtype (Fork (Stem omega21) omega22) ..., which is sub_recursion. *)
Lemma inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit : inv_s_core -> RecSplit.
Proof.

  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  pose proof
    (app_sound (Stem (Stem omega21_ty)) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
       (app_stem (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
          (sub_recursion k uty vty))) as Hdouble.
  exact (HC omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W) Hdouble).
Qed.

Lemma STF_implies_RecSplit : STF -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HS k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  exact (HS omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W)
           (sub_recursion k uty vty)).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A closed counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.  The term is a
   leaf_red redex whose reduct is Node, and it is typable at Stem Leaf,
   a type that Node cannot have. *)

Definition M0 : Tree :=
  △ @ ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △) @ △.

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

(* Node : Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma node_fun2 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Node : Funty Leaf (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf))). *)
Lemma node_fun3 :
  subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Node @ Node : Stem Leaf. *)
Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The inner argument ((Node @ Node) @ Node) : Leaf. *)
Lemma dInner : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + apply derive_node. exact node_fun2.
    + apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Main typing derivation. *)
Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_app.
      * apply derive_node. exact node_fun3.
      * exact dInner.
    + exact dK.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply leaf_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as
    [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

(* In particular the requested inversion lemma [inv_leaf] is refuted: its
   premises are exactly the three leaf facts proved above. *)
Lemma inv_leaf_is_false :
  ~ (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
       subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
       subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
       subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty).
Proof.
  intro Hin.
  pose proof
    (Hin Leaf (Stem Leaf) Leaf (Stem Leaf) Leaf Leaf
       node_fun3 node_fun2 (sub_zero Leaf)) as Hbad.
  exact (AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem _ Hbad).
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_leaf_is_false.
====
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Require Import Zprobe.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma H0_bad :
  subtype (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Funty (Fork Leaf Leaf) Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma H3_bad : subtype (Fork Leaf Leaf) (Fork Leaf Leaf).
Proof. apply sub_zero. Qed.

Lemma concl_bad_false : ~ subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (L1 Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf) H) as H1.
  simpl in H1.
  pose proof (L2_literal Leaf Leaf Leaf H1) as H2.
  exact (not_subtype_fork_leaf Leaf Leaf H2).
Qed.

(* SC with u2=Leaf, u1=Leaf, u=Fork Leaf Leaf, ty=Leaf,
   u6=Leaf, u7=Leaf would give the false conclusion. *)
Lemma SC_is_false :
  ~ (forall u2 u1 u ty u6 u7,
       subtype (Stem u2) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
       subtype (Fork u6 u7) u ->
       subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))).
Proof.
  intro SC.
  pose proof (SC Leaf Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf) Leaf Leaf Leaf H0_bad H3_bad) as Hb.
  exact (concl_bad_false Hb).
Qed.

Print Assumptions SC_is_false.

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.

  - destruct HR.

  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.

  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.

(* 1. Forward reachability of the head.                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A subtype of a Fork source has head Fork or Funty (or an Asf/Quant  *)
(* spine ending in one of them); it is never Leaf, Stem or Var.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2

    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - exact HR.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.

Proof. intros. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Proof. intros. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply RF_fork. Qed.

Proof. intros D E H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E Leaf H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Proof. intros D E Y H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Stem Y) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_var : forall D E i, subtype (Fork D E) (Var i) -> False.
Proof. intros D E i H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Var i) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2. Fork-strict reachability and the left projection.                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* FRK T holds when T is a Fork, or a Quant spine ending in a Fork.    *)
(* This is exactly the target class for which the left projection lp    *)
(* is monotone.  Asf targets are deliberately excluded: the bffs/bfff   *)
(* rules make lp monotonicity false there (lp (bffs_aug u) is not a     *)
(* subtype of u).                                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint FRK (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => FRK T'
  | _ => False
  end.

(* The left projection.  Funty is mapped to its domain; this choice is
   irrelevant because Funty targets never satisfy FRK. *)
Fixpoint lp (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (lp T')
  | Funty a _ => a
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork u _ => u
  | Asf T' => lp T'
  end.

(* Under RF, substitution and lifting preserve FRK exactly. *)
Lemma FRK_subst_rec_RF : forall T u k, RF T -> (FRK (subst_rec T u k) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) tauto.
  - (* Asf *) tauto.
Qed.

Lemma FRK_lift_rec_RF : forall T k m, RF T -> (FRK (lift_rec T k m) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
  - tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
Qed.

  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)

    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=

  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1

  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Variable subst_stem : forall (x y : dtype) (u : dtype) (k : nat),

Lemma PL_subst_rec : forall T u k, PL T -> PL (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply subst_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.

  - (* Var *) exfalso; exact HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply lift_stem. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact HP.
  - (* Fork *) exact HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.

  - contradiction.

  - (* from_asf *) assumption.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1. apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Inversion facts, one per head reduction rule.  They are left as
   explicit hypotheses here: their subtype-only proofs are the remaining
   mathematical content, isolated from the term-rewriting assembly. *)
Lemma node_subtype : forall gamma ty, derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section Facts.

                        subtype Leaf a -> subtype b d.

    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Variable inv_leaf : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty.
Variable inv_stem : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Variable inv_fork : forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma red_k : forall gamma y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
  inversion HE as [gamma3 x0 uty ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma3 uty HS | gamma3 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  inversion HF as [gamma4 x0 uty2 ty0 Hget0 Hsub0 | gamma4 uty2 HS2 | gamma4 M0 N0 ty0 u0 HM0 HN0]; subst.
  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
  eapply inv_k; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma red_s : forall gamma x y z ty,
  derive gamma (((Node @ (Node @ x)) @ y) @ z) ty ->
  derive gamma ((x @ z) @ (y @ z)) ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma x y z ty H.
  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Pure term identity: substituting at a cutoff k <= d inside          *)
(* lift (S d) X undoes one lift.                                       *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d -> subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen
        AgentB_recsplit_second.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Parametric version of the omega22 Funty derivation.                *)
(* For EVERY first argument u there is a second argument V(u) with     *)
(* omega22_ty <: Funty u V(u).  In particular u = omega2_ty.          *)
(* This proves the second conjunct of RecSplit.                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition FB (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork Leaf u.
Definition FS (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (Stem (FB u)) (FB u).
Definition w3p (u : dtype) : dtype := Stem (FS u).
Definition w2p (u : dtype) : dtype := Stem (w3p u).
Definition w1p (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork Leaf (w2p u).
Definition w0p (u : dtype) : dtype := Stem (w1p u).
Definition v3p (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (w0p u) T6.
Definition v2p (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (Stem F0) (v3p u).
Definition v1p (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (Stem F0) (v2p u).
Definition v0p (u : dtype) : dtype := Stem (v1p u).
Definition wp (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (v0p u) tail.

Lemma T7p : forall u, subtype T7 (Funty u u).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite T7_shape. rewrite N_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := FB u).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u (FB u)).
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * unfold FB. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_zero.
  - unfold FB. apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma Mp : forall u, subtype M (Funty u (Funty u (FB u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite M_shape. unfold FB.
  apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma T6p : forall u, subtype T6 (Funty u (FB u)).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite T6_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := u).
  - apply Mp.
  - apply T7p.
Qed.

Lemma T5p : forall u, subtype T5 (Funty u T6).
Proof. intro u. rewrite T5_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_zero. Qed.

Lemma B2p : forall u, subtype B2 (Funty u (FB u)).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite B2_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := u).
  - apply Mp.
  - apply T7p.
Qed.

Lemma B1p : forall u, subtype B1 (Funty u (Stem (FB u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite B1_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := FB u).
  - rewrite F0_shape. unfold FB.
    apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply B2p.
Qed.

Lemma BIG5p :
  forall u,
    subtype BIG5 (Funty u (Funty (FB u) (FS u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite BIG5_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := Stem (FB u)).
  - rewrite F0_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun.
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (Stem (FB u)) (Stem (Stem (FB u)))).
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * unfold FS. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply B1p.
Qed.

Lemma S5p : forall u, subtype S5 (Funty u (FS u)).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite S5_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := FB u).
  - apply BIG5p.
  - apply T6p.
Qed.

Lemma S4p : forall u, subtype S4 (Funty u (Stem (FS u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite S4_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := FS u).
  - rewrite F0_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply S5p.
Qed.

Lemma S3p : forall u, subtype S3 (Funty u (Stem (Stem (FS u)))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite S3_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := Stem (FS u)).
  - rewrite F0_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply S4p.
Qed.

Lemma S2p :
  forall u, subtype S2 (Funty u (Fork Leaf (Stem (Stem (FS u))))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite S2_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := Stem (Stem (FS u))).
  - rewrite M_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply S3p.
Qed.

Lemma S1p :
  forall u, subtype S1 (Funty u (Stem (Fork Leaf (Stem (Stem (FS u)))))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite S1_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := w1p u).
  - rewrite F0_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. unfold w1p. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply S2p.
Qed.

Lemma L4p :
  forall u, subtype L4 (Funty u (Funty T6 (Fork (w0p u) T6))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite L4_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := w0p u).
  - rewrite F0_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun.
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (w0p u) (Stem (w0p u))).
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * unfold v3p. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply S1p.
Qed.

Lemma T4p : forall u, subtype T4 (Funty u (Fork (w0p u) T6)).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite T4_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := T6).
  - apply L4p.
  - apply T5p.
Qed.

Lemma T3p :
  forall u, subtype T3 (Funty u (Fork (Stem F0) (Fork (w0p u) T6))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite T3_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := v3p u).
  - rewrite L2_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply T4p.
Qed.

Lemma T2p :
  forall u, subtype T2 (Funty u (Fork (Stem F0) (Fork (Stem F0) (Fork (w0p u) T6)))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite T2_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := v2p u).
  - rewrite L2_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply T3p.
Qed.

Lemma T1p : forall u, subtype T1 (Funty u (Stem (v1p u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite T1_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := v1p u).
  - rewrite F0_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply T2p.
Qed.

Lemma omega22_left_funtyp :
  forall u, subtype omega22_left (Funty u (Funty tail (wp u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite omega22_left_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := v0p u).
  - rewrite F0_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun.
    eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (v0p u) (Stem (v0p u))).
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * unfold wp. apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply T1p.
Qed.

Lemma omega22_right_funtyp :
  forall u, subtype omega22_right (Funty u tail).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite omega22_right_shape'.

Definition lcomp (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with Fork (Stem A) _ => A | _ => Leaf end.
Definition rcomp (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with Fork _ B => B | _ => Leaf end.

Definition F0 : dtype := lcomp omega22_left.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.

(* RF: every type reachable from a Fork source has head Fork or Funty,
   possibly under Asf/Quant.  In particular Fork cannot reach Stem. *)
Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];

  - (* zero *) exact HR.

  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.

  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.

  - (* bfff *) exact Logic.I.

Proof.

Fixpoint cod (fuel : nat) (A : dtype) (args : list dtype) {struct fuel} : option dtype :=

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Definition A0 : dtype := Fork (Stem (Stem Leaf)) (Stem Leaf).

Lemma omega21_shape : omega21_ty = Fork Leaf (Stem (Stem A0)).
Proof.
  unfold omega21_ty, omega21, A0. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition W2 (W : dtype) : dtype := Funty W W.
Definition W3 (W : dtype) : dtype := Funty (W2 W) W.

Lemma A0_funty : forall W, subtype A0 (Funty (W2 W) (W2 W)).
Proof.
  intros W.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Fork
              (Stem (Funty (W2 W) (Funty (Fork Leaf (W2 W)) (W2 W))))
              (Funty (W2 W) (Fork Leaf (W2 W)))).
  - unfold A0.
    apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_stem.
      eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (W2 W) (Fork Leaf (W2 W))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

Lemma RecSplit_H1 : forall (W : dtype),
  subtype omega21_ty
    (Funty omega2_ty (Funty (W3 W) (W3 W))).
Proof.
  intros W.
  rewrite omega21_shape.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty omega2_ty (Stem (Stem A0))).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with
        (ty2 := Funty (W3 W) (Fork (Stem A0) (W3 W))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- unfold W3, W2.
           eapply sub_trans with
             (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty (Funty W W) (Funty W W)))
                          (Funty (Funty W W) W)).
           ++ apply sub_fork.
              ** apply sub_stem. apply A0_funty.
              ** apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

Definition STF : Prop :=
  forall Y u1 u ty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem Y) u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v, subtype Y (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

Definition inv_s_core : Prop :=
  forall X u1 u ty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

Lemma inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit : inv_s_core -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HC k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  pose proof
    (app_sound (Stem (Stem omega21_ty)) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
       (app_stem (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
          (sub_recursion k uty vty))) as Hdouble.
  exact (HC omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W) Hdouble).
Qed.

Lemma STF_implies_RecSplit : STF -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HS k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  exact (HS omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W)
           (sub_recursion k uty vty)).
Qed.

Fixpoint R (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) {struct X} : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork X1 X2 => GoodStem d A X1 /\ subtype (lift d u1) X2
  | Asf X' => R d A u1 X'
  | Quant X' => R (S d) A u1 X'
  | Funty u ty =>

        subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
        subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v)
  end.

Definition R_mono : Prop :=

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.

  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).

  - exact Logic.I.

  - destruct HR.

Definition inv_fork_core : Prop :=
