  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
  pose proof (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty) Hs0) as Hf.
  pose proof (L1 u4 (Funty u5 u2) H1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (L2_literal u4 u5 u2 Hs1) as HG.
  pose proof (L1 u6 (Funty u7 u) H2) as Hs2.
  pose proof (L2_literal u6 u7 u Hs2) as HH.
  exact (HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7 Hf HG HH).
Qed.

Definition inv_leaf_core : Prop :=
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype (Fork u2 u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    subtype (Fork u4 u5) u2 ->
    subtype Leaf u ->
    subtype u4 ty.

Proof.

  pose proof (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty) Hs0) as Hf.
  pose proof (L1 u4 (Funty u5 u2) H1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (L2_literal u4 u5 u2 Hs1) as HG.
  exact (HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 Hf HG H2).
Qed.

Definition inv_stem_core : Prop :=
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype (Fork u2 u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    subtype (Fork u4 u5) u2 ->
    subtype (Stem u3) u ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.

Lemma inv_stem_of_core : inv_stem_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentB_L2lit L3_impl Integration1 AgentC_invrest.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Set Printing Width 140.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 1. The leaf-pairing inversion is CLOSED.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* inv_k is exactly the one subtype-inversion fact consumed by        *)
(* AgentB.k_head_case.  It follows from the three closed "literal"     *)
(* inversions:                                                         *)
(*   L1         : Leaf <= Funty a r      -> Stem a <= r               *)
(*   L2_literal : Stem X <= Funty a r    -> Fork X a <= r             *)
(*   L3_leaf    : Leaf <= C -> Fork C X <= Funty a r -> X <= r        *)
(* There are no axioms, admits or extra hypotheses.                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma inv_k_closed :
  forall a b c d : dtype,
    subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
    subtype Leaf a ->
    subtype b d.
Proof.
  intros a b c d H Ha.
  apply (L3_leaf a b c d Ha).
  apply (L2_literal a b (Funty c d)).
  apply (L1 a (Funty b (Funty c d))).
  exact H.
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_k_closed.

(* The k-reduction head case, fully closed. *)
Lemma k_head_case_closed :
  forall gamma y z ty,
    derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty ->
    derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  exact (AgentB.k_head_case inv_k_closed).
Qed.

Print Assumptions k_head_case_closed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2. What STF buys.                                                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* STF (the Fork(Stem Y) vs Funty inversion) is the single central     *)
(* inversion from AgentC_invrest.  We record three closed consequences *)
(* used in the strategy analysis.                                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* 2a. STF implies the double-Stem inversion inv_s used by the        *)
(* conditional assembly (Task_merged.v / AgentA_assembly.v).           *)

Lemma inv_s_of_STF : STF ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros HS u2 u1 u ty u3 H1 H2.
  apply (HS u3 u1 u ty).
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork u2 u1).
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply (L1 u3 u2). exact H2.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - apply (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty)).
    apply (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))).
    exact H1.
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_s_of_STF.

(* 2b. STF bounds the left component of any Funty supertype of A0.    *)
(* This is the "A0-funty bound" used to compare witnesses when one     *)
(* pushes RecSplit witnesses upwards.                                  *)

Lemma A0_bound_of_STF : STF ->
  forall U W, subtype A0 (Funty U W) -> subtype U W.
Proof.
  intros HS U W H.
  destruct (HS (Stem Leaf) (Stem Leaf) U W H) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  apply (L3_literal U v W).
  apply (L2_literal Leaf U (Funty v W)).
  exact Hv1.
Qed.

Print Assumptions A0_bound_of_STF.

(* 2c. The second half of RecSplit with the canonical witness W3 q     *)
(* implies the full RecSplit (H1 is closed at that witness).          *)

Lemma RecSplit_of_H2_goal : RecSplit_H2_goal -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros H2 k uty vty.
  exists (W3 (quant k (Funty uty vty))).
  split.
  - apply RecSplit_H1.
  - apply H2.
Qed.

Print Assumptions RecSplit_of_H2_goal.

(* Consequently, proving the single uniform goal                       *)
(*   forall W, omega22_ty <= Funty omega2_ty (W3 W)                    *)
(* closes RecSplit.  This is the exact remaining subtype obligation.   *)

Lemma RecSplit_of_uniform_H2 :
  (forall W, subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))) -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros H2.
  apply RecSplit_of_H2_goal.
  intros k uty vty.
  apply H2.
Qed.

Print Assumptions RecSplit_of_uniform_H2.

Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* Counterexample to the two-hypothesis "inv_s" statement. *)

Definition u : dtype := Funty Leaf Leaf.
Definition v0 : dtype := Leaf.
Definition ty : dtype := Fork Leaf Leaf.
Definition X : dtype := Stem (Funty v0 (Funty Leaf ty)).
Definition u2c : dtype := Stem (Funty u (Funty v0 ty)).
Definition u1c : dtype := Funty u v0.
Definition u3c : dtype := Stem X.

Lemma h1c : subtype Leaf (Funty u2c (Funty u1c (Funty u ty))).
Proof.
  unfold u2c, u1c, u, v0, ty.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u2c (Stem u2c)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u1c (Fork u2c u1c)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

Lemma h2c : subtype Leaf (Funty u3c u2c).
Proof.
  unfold u3c, X, u2c, u, v0, ty.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Funty (Stem (Stem (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)))))
                 (Stem (Stem (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)))))).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with
        (ty2 := Stem (Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)))).
      * apply sub_stem.
        eapply sub_trans with
          (ty2 := Funty (Funty Leaf Leaf)
                         (Fork (Stem (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf))))
                               (Funty Leaf Leaf))).
        ++ apply sub_stem_fun.
        ++ eapply sub_funty.
           ** apply sub_zero.
           ** apply sub_fork_stem.
      * apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma conclusion_forces_u_ty :
  forall v, subtype u3c (Funty u (Funty v ty)) -> subtype u ty.
Proof.
  intros v Hc1.
  unfold u3c, X in Hc1.
  pose proof (L2_literal (Stem (Funty v0 (Funty Leaf ty))) u (Funty v ty) Hc1)
    as Hfork.
  exact (L3_literal u v ty Hfork).
Qed.

Lemma no_conclusion_for_witness :
  forall v,
    ~ (subtype u3c (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
       subtype u1c (Funty u v)).
Proof.
  intros v [Hc1 _].
  pose proof (conclusion_forces_u_ty v Hc1) as Hu.
  unfold u, ty in Hu.
  exact (not_subtype_funty_fork Leaf Leaf Leaf Leaf Hu).
Qed.

Theorem inv_s_is_false :
  ~ (forall a2 a1 a t a3,
       subtype Leaf (Funty a2 (Funty a1 (Funty a t))) ->
       subtype Leaf (Funty a3 a2) ->
       exists w, subtype a3 (Funty a (Funty w t)) /\
                 subtype a1 (Funty a w)).
Proof.
  intro Hin.
  pose proof (Hin u2c u1c u ty u3c h1c h2c) as [w Hw].
  exact (no_conclusion_for_witness w Hw).
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_s_is_false.

Print Assumptions fork_left.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 3. The reduction of the three head inversions to explicit cores.    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The core statements keep only the single Fork-vs-Funty piece that   *)
(* remains after L1/L2_literal (and L1 for inv_stem).  The reductions  *)
(* below are unconditional and closed.                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition inv_fork_core : Prop :=
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype (Fork u2 u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    subtype (Fork u4 u5) u2 ->
    subtype (Fork u6 u7) u ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).

Lemma inv_fork_of_core : inv_fork_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty)).
Proof.
  intros HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7 H0 H1 H2.
  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
  pose proof (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty) Hs0) as Hf.
  pose proof (L1 u4 (Funty u5 u2) H1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (L2_literal u4 u5 u2 Hs1) as HG.
  pose proof (L1 u6 (Funty u7 u) H2) as Hs2.
  pose proof (L2_literal u6 u7 u Hs2) as HH.
  exact (HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7 Hf HG HH).
Qed.

Definition inv_leaf_core : Prop :=
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype (Fork u2 u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    subtype (Fork u4 u5) u2 ->
    subtype Leaf u ->
    subtype u4 ty.

Lemma inv_leaf_of_core : inv_leaf_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u ->
    subtype u4 ty.
Proof.
  intros HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 H0 H1 H2.
  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
  pose proof (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty) Hs0) as Hf.
  pose proof (L1 u4 (Funty u5 u2) H1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (L2_literal u4 u5 u2 Hs1) as HG.
  exact (HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 Hf HG H2).
Qed.

Definition inv_stem_core : Prop :=
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype (Fork u2 u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    subtype (Fork u4 u5) u2 ->
    subtype (Stem u3) u ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.

Lemma inv_stem_of_core : inv_stem_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty.
Proof.
  intros HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3 H0 H1 H2.
  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
  pose proof (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty) Hs0) as Hf.
  pose proof (L1 u4 (Funty u5 u2) H1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (L2_literal u4 u5 u2 Hs1) as HG.
  pose proof (L1 u3 u H2) as Hs2.
  exact (HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3 Hf HG Hs2).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. RecSplit: the sub_recursion instance.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* RecSplit is exactly the first-conjunct obligation produced by the   *)
(* sub_recursion atomic rule in any inversion-based route.  We prove    *)
(* the H1 half unconditionally, with the explicit witness               *)
(*     v = W3 W = Funty (Funty W W) W.                                  *)
(* The H2 half is the exact remaining goal; it is NOT implied by the    *)
(* double-Stem inv_s_core reduction, because app_stem turns the         *)
(* double-Stem hypothesis into exactly the sub_recursion instance.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)
           ++ apply sub_fork.
              ** apply sub_stem. apply A0_funty.
              ** apply sub_zero.
           ++ apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

Definition RecSplit_H2_goal : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    subtype omega22_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (W3 (quant k (Funty uty vty)))).

Definition inv_s_core : Prop :=
  forall X u1 u ty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

Definition STF : Prop :=
  forall Y u1 u ty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem Y) u1) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v, subtype Y (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

(* Both proposed intermediate lemmas contain the sub_recursion instance:
   app_stem turns subtype (Stem (Stem omega21)) ... into exactly
   subtype (Fork (Stem omega21) omega22) ..., which is sub_recursion. *)
Lemma inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit : inv_s_core -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HC k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  pose proof
    (app_sound (Stem (Stem omega21_ty)) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
       (app_stem (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))
          (sub_recursion k uty vty))) as Hdouble.
  exact (HC omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W) Hdouble).
Qed.

Lemma STF_implies_RecSplit : STF -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros HS k uty vty.
  set (W := quant k (Funty uty vty)).
  exact (HS omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty (W3 W)
           (sub_recursion k uty vty)).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentB_L2lit L3_impl Integration1 AgentC_invrest.
Require Import AgentB_kclosed AgentA_assembly.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* The full assembly, with the k inversion DISCHARGED and the          *)
(* double-Stem inversion DERIVED FROM STF.                             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* What remains is exactly:                                            *)
(*   STF         (the Fork(Stem Y) vs Funty inversion),                *)
(*   inv_leaf,                                                         *)
(*   inv_stem,                                                         *)
(*   inv_fork.                                                         *)
(* All of the term-rewriting bookkeeping and the k case are closed.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_reduced :
  STF ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros HS IL IST IF.
  exact (reduction_preserves_typing_conditional
           inv_k_closed
           (inv_s_of_STF HS)
           IL IST IF).
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_reduced.

(* Variant with the three inversions presented in their "core" form,   *)
(* i.e. after the closed L1/L2_literal preprocessing.                  *)

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_reduced_core :
  STF ->
  inv_leaf_core ->
  inv_stem_core ->
  inv_fork_core ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros HS HL HST HF.
  apply reduction_preserves_typing_reduced; auto using inv_leaf_of_core,
    inv_stem_of_core, inv_fork_of_core.
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_reduced_core.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.

Definition omega22_ty := program_type omega22.

Definition omega2_ty := (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty).

Definition eval_ty := quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Asf (Var 0))).

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                          subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| sub_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| sub_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| sub_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| sub_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)

| sub_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subtype omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| sub_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
| sub_to_asf: forall ty, subtype ty (Asf ty)
| sub_from_asf: forall uty vty, subtype (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
| sub_bffs: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty)) (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty))
| sub_bfff : forall uty vty wty, subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
                                         (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty))
.

A semantic model does not give a shortcut here; it relocates the same obligations.

2. A logical-relations/reducibility model must validate all 26 subtype rules semantically. 172:Lemma T1p : forall u, subtype T1 (Funty u (Stem (v1p u))).
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen
        AgentB_recsplit_second.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Parametric version of the omega22 Funty derivation.                *)
(* For EVERY first argument u there is a second argument V(u) with     *)
(* omega22_ty <: Funty u V(u).  In particular u = omega2_ty.          *)
(* This proves the second conjunct of RecSplit.                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition FB (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork Leaf u.
Definition FS (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (Stem (FB u)) (FB u).
Definition w3p (u : dtype) : dtype := Stem (FS u).
Definition w2p (u : dtype) : dtype := Stem (w3p u).
Definition w1p (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork Leaf (w2p u).
Definition w0p (u : dtype) : dtype := Stem (w1p u).
Definition v3p (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (w0p u) T6.
Definition v2p (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (Stem F0) (v3p u).
Definition v1p (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (Stem F0) (v2p u).
Definition v0p (u : dtype) : dtype := Stem (v1p u).
Definition wp (u : dtype) : dtype := Fork (v0p u) tail.

Lemma T7p : forall u, subtype T7 (Funty u u).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite T7_shape. rewrite N_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := FB u).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u (FB u)).
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + eapply sub_funty.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * unfold FB. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_zero.
  - unfold FB. apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma Mp : forall u, subtype M (Funty u (Funty u (FB u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite M_shape. unfold FB.
  apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma T6p : forall u, subtype T6 (Funty u (FB u)).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite T6_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := u).
  - apply Mp.
  - apply T7p.
Qed.

Lemma T5p : forall u, subtype T5 (Funty u T6).
Proof. intro u. rewrite T5_shape. apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_zero. Qed.

Lemma B2p : forall u, subtype B2 (Funty u (FB u)).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite B2_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := u).
  - apply Mp.
  - apply T7p.
Qed.

Lemma B1p : forall u, subtype B1 (Funty u (Stem (FB u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite B1_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := FB u).
  - rewrite F0_shape. unfold FB.
    apply fork_leaf_fun. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply B2p.
Qed.

Lemma BIG5p :
  forall u,
    subtype BIG5 (Funty u (Funty (FB u) (FS u))).
Proof.
  intro u. rewrite BIG5_shape.
  eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := Stem (FB u)).

(* Generalized goal-directed subtype tactic.  Handles Funty targets by
   the three Fork source rules and the Leaf/Stem/Funty sources. *)
Ltac sf n :=
  match n with
  | O => fail
  | S ?m =>
    first
      [ apply sub_zero
      | (* Funty source *)
        match goal with
        | |- subtype (Funty ?A ?B) (Funty ?U ?T) =>
            eapply sub_funty; [ sf m | sf m ]
        end
      | (* target Funty cases *)
        match goal with
        | |- subtype ?S (Funty ?U ?T) =>

            [ (* Leaf source *)

              | Leaf =>

                    [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty U (Stem U));
                        [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                        | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | sf m ] ] ]
              | _ => fail
              end
            | (* Stem source *)
              match S with

                  first
                    [ apply sub_stem_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty U (Fork X U));
                        [ apply sub_stem_fun
                        | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | sf m ] ] ]
              | _ => fail
              end
            | (* Fork Leaf source *)
              match S with
              | Fork Leaf ?X =>

                    [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty U X);
                        [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                        | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | sf m ] ] ]
              | _ => fail
              end
            | (* Fork (Stem Y) Z source *)
              match S with
              | Fork (Stem ?Y) ?Z =>
                  first
                    [ (* direct: source matches rule exactly *)
                      match goal with
                      | |- subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty ?uu (Funty ?vv ?ww))) (Funty ?uu ?vv))
                                   (Funty ?uu ?ww) => apply sub_fork_stem
                      | _ => fail
                      end
                    | (* decompose with evar v *)
                      let v := fresh "v" in

                      assert (HZ : subtype Z (Funty U v));
                        [ subst v; sf m | ];
                      assert (HY : subtype Y (Funty U (Funty v T)));
                        [ subst v; sf m | ];
                      eapply sub_trans with
                        (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty U (Funty v T))) (Funty U v));
                        [ eapply sub_fork; [ apply sub_stem; exact HY | exact HZ ]
                        | apply sub_fork_stem ] ]
              | _ => fail
              end
            | (* Fork (Fork X Y) Z source, target first arg a Fork W1 W2 *)
              match S with
              | Fork (Fork ?X ?Y) ?Z =>
                  match U with
                  | Fork ?W1 ?W2 =>
                      (* need Z <: Funty W1 (Funty W2 T) *)
                      eapply sub_trans with
                        (ty2 := Fork (Fork X Y) (Funty W1 (Funty W2 T)));
                        [ eapply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | sf m ]
                        | change (subtype (Fork (Fork X Y) (Funty W1 (Funty W2 T)))
                                          (Funty (Fork W1 W2) T));
                          apply sub_fork_fork_fork ]
                  | _ => fail
                  end
              | _ => fail
              end
            | (* Fork (Fork X Y) Z source, target first arg Leaf *)
              match S with
              | Fork (Fork ?X ?Y) ?Z =>
                  match U with
                  | Leaf =>
                      eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf X);
                        [ change (subtype (Fork (Fork X Y) Z) (Funty Leaf X));
                          apply sub_fork_fork_leaf
                        | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | sf m ] ]
                  | _ => fail
                  end
              | _ => fail
              end
            | (* Fork (Fork X Y) Z source, target first arg Stem V1 *)
              match S with

                        | change (subtype (Fork (Fork X Y) Y) (Funty (Stem V1) T));
                          apply sub_fork_fork_stem ]
                  | _ => fail
                  end
              | _ => fail
              end
            ]
        end
      | (* non-Funty target structural *)
        match goal with
        | |- subtype ?S ?T =>
          first
            [ apply sub_zero
            | match S, T with
              | Stem ?A, Stem ?B => apply sub_stem; sf m
              | Fork ?A1 ?A2, Fork ?B1 ?B2 => eapply sub_fork; [ sf m | sf m ]
              | Asf ?A, Asf ?B => apply sub_asf; sf m
              | Quant ?A, Quant ?B => apply sub_quant; sf m
              | _ => fail
              end
            ]
        end
      ].

Proof. intros D E Y H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Stem Y) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_var : forall D E i, subtype (Fork D E) (Var i) -> False.
Proof. intros D E i H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype D E (Var i) H). simpl in H0. exact H0. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2. Fork-strict reachability and the left projection.                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* FRK T holds when T is a Fork, or a Quant spine ending in a Fork.    *)
(* This is exactly the target class for which the left projection lp    *)
(* is monotone.  Asf targets are deliberately excluded: the bffs/bfff   *)
(* rules make lp monotonicity false there (lp (bffs_aug u) is not a     *)
(* subtype of u).                                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint FRK (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => FRK T'
  | _ => False
  end.

(* The left projection.  Funty is mapped to its domain; this choice is
   irrelevant because Funty targets never satisfy FRK. *)
Fixpoint lp (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (lp T')
  | Funty a _ => a
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork u _ => u
  | Asf T' => lp T'
  end.

(* Under RF, substitution and lifting preserve FRK exactly. *)
Lemma FRK_subst_rec_RF : forall T u k, RF T -> (FRK (subst_rec T u k) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) tauto.
  - (* Asf *) tauto.
Qed.

Lemma FRK_lift_rec_RF : forall T k m, RF T -> (FRK (lift_rec T k m) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
  - tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
Qed.

(* lp commutes with substitution and lifting on the RF fragment. *)
Lemma lp_subst_rec_RF :
  forall T u k, RF T -> lp (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (lp T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma lp_lift_rec_RF :
  forall T k m, RF T -> lp (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (lp T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* Backward preservation of FRK along a subtype derivation from an RF
   source.  This is the key closure property needed for the transitivity
   case of lp monotonicity. *)
Lemma FRK_back_RF :
  forall S T, subtype S T -> RF S -> FRK T -> FRK S.
Proof.
  intros S T H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR HF; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HF.
  - (* trans *)
    match goal with
    | H1p : subtype ty1 ?M |- _ =>
        pose proof (RF_mono _ _ H1p HR) as HRM
    end.
    eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* funty *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant *) apply IHHs; assumption.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* dist *) destruct HF.
  - (* inst *)
    apply (proj1 (FRK_subst_rec_RF ty u 0 HR)). exact HF.
  - (* lift *)
    apply (proj1 (FRK_lift_rec_RF ty 0 1 HR)). exact HF.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HF.
  - (* recursion *) destruct HF.
  - (* tree *) destruct HF.
  - (* to_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* from_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HF.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HF.
Qed.

(* lp is monotone on the RF/FRK fragment. *)
Lemma lp_mono_RF_FRK :
  forall S T, subtype S T -> RF S -> FRK T -> subtype (lp S) (lp T).
Proof.
  intros S T H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR HF; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* trans *)
    match goal with
    | H1p : subtype ty1 ?M |- _ =>
        pose proof (RF_mono _ _ H1p HR) as HRM
    end.
    match goal with
    | H2p : subtype ?M ty3 |- _ =>
        pose proof (FRK_back_RF _ _ H2p HRM HF) as HFM
    end.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork *) exact Hs1.
  - (* asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* funty *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant *) apply sub_quant. apply IHHs; assumption.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant_fork *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* quant_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* dist *) destruct HF.
  - (* inst *)
    unfold subst.
    rewrite (lp_subst_rec_RF ty u 0 HR).
    apply sub_inst.
  - (* lift *)
    unfold lift.
    rewrite (lp_lift_rec_RF ty 0 1 HR).
    apply sub_lift.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HF.
  - (* recursion *) destruct HF.
  - (* tree *) destruct HF.
  - (* to_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* from_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HF.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HF.
Qed.

(* The left projection of a subtype between Forks. *)
Lemma fork_left : forall D E A B,
  subtype (Fork D E) (Fork A B) -> subtype D A.
Proof.
  intros D E A B H.
  exact (lp_mono_RF_FRK (Fork D E) (Fork A B) H Logic.I Logic.I).
Qed.

  | S f => match args with

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentB_L2lit L3_impl Integration1 AgentC_invrest.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Set Printing Width 140.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 1. The leaf-pairing inversion is CLOSED.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* inv_k is exactly the one subtype-inversion fact consumed by        *)
(* AgentB.k_head_case.  It follows from the three closed "literal"     *)
(* inversions:                                                         *)
(*   L1         : Leaf <= Funty a r      -> Stem a <= r               *)
(*   L2_literal : Stem X <= Funty a r    -> Fork X a <= r             *)
(*   L3_leaf    : Leaf <= C -> Fork C X <= Funty a r -> X <= r        *)
(* There are no axioms, admits or extra hypotheses.                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma inv_k_closed :
  forall a b c d : dtype,
    subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
    subtype Leaf a ->
    subtype b d.
Proof.
  intros a b c d H Ha.
  apply (L3_leaf a b c d Ha).
  apply (L2_literal a b (Funty c d)).
  apply (L1 a (Funty b (Funty c d))).
  exact H.
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_k_closed.

(* A pruning fact useful for the remaining inversions: a Leaf never     *)
(* subtypes a Funty whose codomain is a Fork.                          *)
Lemma not_subtype_leaf_funty_fork :
  forall a r s, subtype Leaf (Funty a (Fork r s)) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a r s H.
  apply (AgentB.not_subtype_stem_fork a r s).
  apply (L1 a (Fork r s)).
  exact H.
Qed.

Print Assumptions not_subtype_leaf_funty_fork.

(* The k-reduction head case, fully closed. *)
Lemma k_head_case_closed :
  forall gamma y z ty,
    derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty ->
    derive gamma y ty.
Proof.
  exact (AgentB.k_head_case inv_k_closed).
Qed.

Print Assumptions k_head_case_closed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2. What STF buys.                                                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* STF (the Fork(Stem Y) vs Funty inversion) is the single central     *)
(* inversion from AgentC_invrest.  We record three closed consequences *)
(* used in the strategy analysis.                                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* 2a. STF implies the double-Stem inversion inv_s used by the        *)
(* conditional assembly (Task_merged.v / AgentA_assembly.v).           *)

Lemma inv_s_of_STF : STF ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros HS u2 u1 u ty u3 H1 H2.
  apply (HS u3 u1 u ty).
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork u2 u1).
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply (L1 u3 u2). exact H2.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - apply (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty)).
    apply (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))).
    exact H1.
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_s_of_STF.

(* 2a'. In particular STF implies the exact double-Stem core used by     *)
(* AgentC_invrest.inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit.                          *)

Lemma inv_s_core_of_STF : STF -> inv_s_core.
Proof.
  intros HS X u1 u ty H.
  apply (HS X u1 u ty).
  apply (L2_literal (Stem X) u1 (Funty u ty)).
  exact H.
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_s_core_of_STF.

(* 2b. STF bounds the left component of any Funty supertype of A0.    *)
(* This is the "A0-funty bound" used to compare witnesses when one     *)
(* pushes RecSplit witnesses upwards.                                  *)

Lemma A0_bound_of_STF : STF ->
  forall U W, subtype A0 (Funty U W) -> subtype U W.
Proof.
  intros HS U W H.
  destruct (HS (Stem Leaf) (Stem Leaf) U W H) as [v [Hv1 Hv2]].
  apply (L3_literal U v W).
  apply (L2_literal Leaf U (Funty v W)).
  exact Hv1.
Qed.

Print Assumptions A0_bound_of_STF.

(* 2c. The second half of RecSplit with the canonical witness W3 q     *)
(* implies the full RecSplit (H1 is closed at that witness).          *)

Lemma RecSplit_of_H2_goal : RecSplit_H2_goal -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros H2 k uty vty.
  exists (W3 (quant k (Funty uty vty))).
  split.
  - apply RecSplit_H1.
  - apply H2.
Qed.

Print Assumptions RecSplit_of_H2_goal.

(* Consequently, proving the single uniform goal                       *)
(*   forall W, omega22_ty <= Funty omega2_ty (W3 W)                    *)
(* closes RecSplit.  This is the exact remaining subtype obligation.   *)

Lemma RecSplit_of_uniform_H2 :
  (forall W, subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3 W))) -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros H2.
  apply RecSplit_of_H2_goal.
  intros k uty vty.
  apply H2.
Qed.

Print Assumptions RecSplit_of_uniform_H2.
=====
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentB_L2lit L3_impl Integration1 AgentC_invrest.
Require Import AgentB_kclosed AgentA_assembly.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Set Printing Width 140.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The full assembly, with the k inversion DISCHARGED and the          *)
(* double-Stem inversion DERIVED FROM STF.                             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* What remains is exactly:                                            *)
(*   STF         (the Fork(Stem Y) vs Funty inversion),                *)
(*   inv_leaf,                                                         *)
(*   inv_stem,                                                         *)
(*   inv_fork.                                                         *)
(* All of the term-rewriting bookkeeping and the k case are closed.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_reduced :
  STF ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf u -> subtype u4 ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u) ->
    exists v, subtype u5 (Funty u3 v) /\ subtype v ty) ->
  (forall u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u4 (Funty u5 u2)) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u6 (Funty u7 u)) ->
    subtype u1 (Funty u6 (Funty u7 ty))) ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros HS IL IST IF.
  exact (reduction_preserves_typing_conditional
           inv_k_closed
           (inv_s_of_STF HS)
           IL IST IF).
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_reduced.

(* Variant with the three inversions presented in their "core" form,   *)
(* i.e. after the closed L1/L2_literal preprocessing.                  *)

Theorem reduction_preserves_typing_reduced_core :
  STF ->
  inv_leaf_core ->
  inv_stem_core ->
  inv_fork_core ->
  forall gamma M ty, derive gamma M ty -> forall N, t_red1 M N -> derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  intros HS HL HST HF.
  exact (reduction_preserves_typing_reduced HS
           (inv_leaf_of_core HL)
           (inv_stem_of_core HST)
           (inv_fork_of_core HF)).
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_reduced_core.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.

Definition omega22_ty := program_type omega22.

Definition omega2_ty := (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty).

Definition eval_ty := quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Asf (Var 0))).

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                          subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| sub_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| sub_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| sub_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| sub_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)

| sub_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subtype omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| sub_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.

13	Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
14	  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
15	Proof.
16	  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
17	  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
18	  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
19	    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
20	  - apply derive_node.
21	    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
22	  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
23	    + apply IHHd1.
24	      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
25	    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
26	Qed.

28	Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
29	  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
30	Proof.
31	  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
32	  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
33	Qed.

36	  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).

43	(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
44	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

46	Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
47	  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
48	Proof.
49	  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
50	  - (* Var n *)
51	    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
52	    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
53	      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
54	      f_equal; lia.
55	    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
56	      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
57	      reflexivity.
58	  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
59	  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
60	  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
61	  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
62	  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)

66	Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
67	  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.

72	    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.

92	  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.

106	  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.

127	Lemma k_head_case
128	  (inv : forall a b c d : dtype,
129	      subtype Leaf (Funty a (Funty b (Funty c d))) ->
130	      subtype Leaf a ->
131	      subtype b d)
132	  : forall gamma y z ty,
133	      derive gamma (((Node @ Node) @ y) @ z) ty -> derive gamma y ty.
134	Proof.
135	  intros gamma y z ty H.
136	  inversion H as [| | gamma0 M N t u HA HB]; subst.
137	  inversion HA as [| | gamma1 M1 N1 t1 u1 HC HD]; subst.
138	  inversion HC as [| | gamma2 M2 N2 t2 u2 HE HF]; subst.
139	  (* HE : Node : Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));  HF : Node : u2 *)
140	  inversion HE as [| gamma3 uty HS | ]; subst.
141	  inversion HF as [| gamma4 uty2 HS2 | ]; subst.
142	  (* HD : derive gamma y u1 ; HS : Leaf <= Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty));
143	     HS2 : Leaf <= u2 *)
144	  eapply derive_sub; [ exact HD | ].
145	  eapply inv; eauto.

148	(* ================================================================== *)
149	(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
150	(*                                                                    *)
151	(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
152	(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
153	(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
154	(* ================================================================== *)
155	
156	Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
157	| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
158	| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
159	| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
160	| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
161	| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
162	    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
163	    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
164	| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
165	    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
166	    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
167	| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
168	    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
169	    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
170	| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
171	    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
172	    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
173	| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
174	    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
175	| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
176	    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
177	| app_recursion : forall k u v,
178	    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
179	        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
180	               (quant k (Funty u v)))
181	| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
182	    App (Fork
183	           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
184	                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
185	           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
186	        uty (subst ty uty)
187	| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
188	| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.
189	
190	(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)
191	
192	Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
193	Proof.
194	  intros S a r H.
195	  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
196	  revert a r ET.
197	  induction H as
198	    [ ty
199	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
200	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
201	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
202	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
203	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
204	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
205	    | uty
206	    | uty vty
207	    | uty
208	    | uty vty
209	    | ty u
210	    | ty
211	    | uty
212	    | uty vty
213	    | uty vty
214	    | uty vty wty

217	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
218	    | k uty vty
219	    | ty uty Hcov
220	    | ty
221	    | uty vty
222	    | uty vty
223	    | uty vty wty ];
224	    intros a0 r0 ET.
225	  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
226	  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
227	  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
228	  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
229	  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
230	  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
231	  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
232	  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
233	  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
234	  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
235	  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
236	  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
237	  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
238	  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
239	  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
240	  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
241	  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.

249	  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
250	  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
251	  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
252	  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
253	  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
254	  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.

257	(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

259	Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).

261	  intros S a r H. induction H.
262	  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
263	    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
264	    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
265	  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
266	    + apply sub_stem_fun.
267	    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
268	  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
269	  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
270	    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
271	    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
272	  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
273	    + apply sub_fork_stem.

285	  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
286	  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
287	  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
288	  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
289	  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.

293	(* 5. Target-only predicate architecture (coordinator's plan).        *)
294	(*                                                                    *)
295	(* P_leaf is defined by structural recursion on the TARGET type:      *)
296	(*   Funty a r  |-> subtype (Stem a) r                               *)
297	(*   Leaf       |-> True                                              *)
298	(*   Asf T      |-> P_leaf T                                          *)
299	(*   Quant T    |-> P_leaf T                                          *)

301	(*                                                                    *)
302	(* All monotonicity cases of P_leaf along subtype are structural      *)
303	(* except three shape obligations, isolated as hypotheses below.      *)
304	(* The dist obligation is now discharged unconditionally in Section   *)
305	(* 10 (subtype_stem_quant_dist); only Hlift and Hinst remain.         *)
306	(* ================================================================== *)
307	
308	Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=
309	  match T with
310	  | Var _ => False
311	  | Leaf => True
312	  | Stem _ => False
313	  | Fork _ _ => False
314	  | Asf T' => P_leaf T'
315	  | Quant T' => P_leaf T'
316	  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r
317	  end.

320	  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
321	                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
322	  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
323	  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
324	  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.

329	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
330	    | uty1 uty2 Hs

332	    | uty1 uty2 Hs

334	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
335	    | u

337	    | u

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Typing is upward closed under subtyping.                        *)
(*    Used everywhere: a typed term can be given any supertype.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_sub : forall gamma M u ty,
  derive gamma M u -> subtype u ty -> derive gamma M ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma M u ty Hd. revert ty.
  induction Hd; intros ty' Hsub2.
  - apply derive_ref with uty; [ exact H | ].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply derive_node.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eapply derive_app with (u := u).
    + apply IHHd1.
      apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
    + apply IHHd2. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b c -> derive gamma M (Funty a b) -> derive gamma M (Funty a c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma derive_sub_funty_contra : forall gamma M a b c,
  subtype b a -> derive gamma M (Funty a c) -> derive gamma M (Funty b c).
Proof.
  intros. eapply derive_sub; eauto.
  apply sub_funty; [ assumption | apply sub_zero ].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. lift/subst algebra used by the quantifier rules.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall a k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a (S k) 1) u (S k) = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros k u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test (S k) n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare (S k) n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa (S k) u). reflexivity.     (* Quant *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Funty *)
  - reflexivity.                            (* Leaf *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Stem *)
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.        (* Fork *)
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.               (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall a u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) u 0 = a.
Proof.
  induction a; intros u; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h] eqn:Et; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var. simpl.
      destruct (compare 0 (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:Ec; simpl; try lia.
      f_equal; lia.
    + lia.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite (subst_rec_lift_rec_gen a 0 u). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_id : forall a u, subst (lift 1 a) u = a.
Proof.
  intros a u. unfold subst, lift.
  apply subst_rec_lift_rec_0.
Qed.

(* Quantifier introduction/elimination around lift. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_elim : forall a,
  subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) a.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - rewrite subst_lift_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_intro : forall a,
  subtype a (Quant (lift 1 a)).
Proof. intros a. apply sub_lift. Qed.

(* Equivalence of Quant (lift 1 a) and a, used to normalise chains. *)
Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_l : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype (Quant (lift 1 a)) b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ apply subtype_quant_lift_elim | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma subtype_quant_lift_iff_r : forall a b,
  subtype a b -> subtype a (Quant (lift 1 b)).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  eapply sub_trans; [ exact H | apply subtype_quant_lift_intro ].
Qed.

9	(* RF: every type reachable from a Fork source has head Fork or Funty,
10	   possibly under Asf/Quant.  In particular Fork cannot reach Stem. *)
11	Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
12	  match T with
13	  | Var _ => False
14	  | Leaf => False
15	  | Stem _ => False
16	  | Fork _ _ => True
17	  | Funty _ _ => True
18	  | Asf T' => RF T'
19	  | Quant T' => RF T'
20	  end.

22	Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
23	Proof.
24	  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
25	  - destruct HR.
26	  - apply IHT; exact HR.
27	  - exact Logic.I.
28	  - destruct HR.
29	  - destruct HR.
30	  - exact Logic.I.
31	  - apply IHT; exact HR.

50	    [ ty

54	    | uty1 uty2 Hs

57	    | u

65	    | uty vty
66	    | uty vty wty

RecSplit's q=quant k(F(U,V)). The k=0 base proof is parametric in U,V and uses q as a Funty. For k>0, q=Quant q_{k-1}. Perhaps we can prove RecSplit(q) by induction on k using the **sub_inst rule to reduce q to q_{k-1}**:
- C2 for q=Quant q': omega22 <: Funty omega2 V. If we have RecSplit at q' with witness V', can we get C2(V) for q by applying `sub_lift`/`sub_inst`? We might choose V = `subst V' (Var 0)` or `lift V'` such that the quant binder is handled. The lifting step q'->Quant q' with V' needs the problematic HF if using V=Quant V'. But using sub_inst, we can relate q=Quant q' to q' via `q <: subst q' u` for any u. For the *target* side, sub_inst is a source rule, not target; to prove S <: q we can use `S <: q'` and q'<:q? 338	Lemma SemR_mono :
339	  forall d A u1 X Y, subtype X Y -> SemR d A u1 X -> SemR d A u1 Y.
340	Proof.
341	  intros d A u1 X Y Hsub HR u ty Hfun.
342	  unfold SemR in HR.
343	  apply HR.
344	  eapply sub_trans.
345	  - apply sub_fork.
346	    + apply lift_n_subtype. exact Hsub.
347	    + apply sub_zero.
348	  - exact Hfun.
349	Qed.

351	(* The single honest residual obligation of the semantic route. *)
352	Definition SemComp : Prop :=
353	  forall A B u1, GoodStem 0 A B -> SemR 0 A u1 B.
354	
355	(* GoodStem_comp now follows from SemComp alone. *)
356	Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_SemComp :
357	  SemComp ->
358	  forall A B u1 u ty,
359	    GoodStem 0 A B ->
360	    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
361	    exists v, subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
362	Proof.
363	  intros SC A B u1 u ty H1 H2.
364	  unfold SemComp in SC.
365	  cbn [GoodStem] in H2.
366	  rewrite <- (l2_lift_zero u1) in H2.
367	  pose proof (SC A B u1 H1) as HR.
368	  unfold SemR in HR.
369	  destruct (HR u ty H2) as [v [HA Hu]].
370	  exists v. split.
371	  - rewrite l2_lift_zero in HA. exact HA.
372	  - rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hu. exact Hu.
373	Qed.

376	Lemma inv_s_of_SemComp :
377	  SemComp ->
378	  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
379	    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
380	    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
381	    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
382	Proof.
383	  intro SC.
384	  exact (inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp (GoodStem_comp_of_SemComp SC)).
385	Qed.

393	(* 10.  RecSplit is unavoidable for the GoodStem_comp / SemComp route. *)
394	(*                                                                    *)
395	(* The `B = Stem Y` case contains a second atomic rule besides         *)
396	(* sub_fork_stem: instantiating                                            *)
397	(*    B = Stem omega21_ty,  A = omega21_ty,  u1 = omega22_ty,         *)
398	(*    u = omega2_ty,  ty = Funty (Funty q q) q,  q = quant k (Funty uty vty) *)
399	(* the hypothesis GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) is *exactly*    *)
400	(* sub_recursion k uty vty, and the conclusion is exactly RecSplit.    *)
401	(* Hence every proof of GoodStem_comp (and a fortiori every proof of   *)
402	(* SemComp) already proves RecSplit.  In particular the proposed       *)
403	(* `only sub_fork_stem is atomic` case split is incomplete.            *)
404	(* ================================================================== *)

407	  (forall A B u1 u ty,
408	      GoodStem 0 A B ->
409	      GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
410	      exists v, subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
411	  RecSplit.

414	  unfold RecSplit.

416	                 (Funty omega22_ty
417	                   (Funty omega2_ty
418	                     (Funty

435	                (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
436	              (GoodStem_initial omega21_ty) H2) as [v [HA Hu]].

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Pure term identity: substituting at a cutoff k <= d inside          *)
(* lift (S d) X undoes one lift.                                       *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d -> subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.

Require Import Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes String.

Open Scope string_scope.

Declare Scope tree_scope.
Global Open Scope tree_scope.

Inductive Tree:  Set :=
  | Ref : string -> Tree
  | Node : Tree
  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)

Require Import terms types subtypes.

Open Scope nat_scope.

(* ---------- relocate helpers ---------- *)

Lemma relocate_ge : forall i k n, k <= i -> relocate i k n = n + i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; [reflexivity | exfalso; lia].
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lt : forall i k n, k > i -> relocate i k n = i.
Proof.
  intros i k n H. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [Hle | Hgt]; [exfalso; lia | reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift : forall i p k n,
  p <= i ->
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n Hp.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt]. (* p <= i, since not -> i < p *)
  - rewrite (relocate_ge i p k Hle); try reflexivity.
    rewrite (relocate_ge (k+i) (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_ge i p (k+n)) by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    rewrite relocate_lt by lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_same : forall i p k,
  p <= i -> relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) 0 = relocate i p k.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite relocate_lift_lift by lia. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift2 : forall i p k n,
  relocate (relocate i p k) (p + k) n = relocate i p (k + n).
Proof.
  intros i p k n.
  destruct (le_dec p i) as [Hle | Hlt].
  - rewrite (relocate_ge i p k Hle).
    rewrite (relocate_ge (k+i) (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_ge i p (k+n)) by lia.
    lia.
  - assert (Hi : i < p) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i p k Hi).
    rewrite (relocate_lt i (p+k) n) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i p (k+n)) by lia.
    reflexivity.

Lemma lift_lift_gen : forall a p k n,
  lift_rec (lift_rec a p k) (p + k) n = lift_rec a p (k + n).
Proof.
  induction a; intros; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_lift2.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa1, IHa2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHa. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_le_gen : forall a p K q d,

(* ---------- the augmented helper types ---------- *)

Lemma subst_rec_bfff_aug : forall uty N k,
  subst_rec (bfff_aug uty) N k = bfff_aug (subst_rec uty N k).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bfff_aug. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_bffs_aug : forall uty N k,
  subst_rec (bffs_aug uty) N k = bffs_aug (subst_rec uty N k).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bffs_aug. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* The composition identity in the form suggested for sub_inst. *)
Lemma subst_subst : forall a u N k,
  subst_rec (subst_rec a u 0) N k =
  subst_rec (subst_rec a N (S k)) (subst_rec u N k) 0.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (H := subst_subst_gen a u N k 0).
  rewrite Nat.add_0_r in H.
  replace (k + 1) with (S k) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* Lift/substitution commutation specializations used by sub_lift and sub_tree. *)
Lemma lift_subst_comm_01 : forall a N k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 0 1) N (S k) = lift_rec (subst_rec a N k) 0 1.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (H := lift_subst_comm_gen a N k 1 0 (le_0_n k)).
  replace (k + 1) with (S k) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_comm_11 : forall a N k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 1 1) N (S (S k)) =
  lift_rec (subst_rec a N (S k)) 1 1.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (H := lift_subst_comm_gen a N (S k) 1 1 (le_n_S 0 k (le_0_n k))).
  replace (S k + 1) with (S (S k)) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_comm_12 : forall a N k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec a 1 2) N (S (S (S k))) =
  lift_rec (subst_rec a N (S k)) 1 2.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (H := lift_subst_comm_gen a N (S k) 2 1 (le_n_S 0 k (le_0_n k))).
  replace (S k + 2) with (S (S (S k))) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* Covariance is preserved when the substitution level is positive. *)
Lemma covariant_subst : forall ty N k,
  covariant ty -> covariant (subst_rec ty N (S k)).
Proof.
  intros ty N k Hcov. unfold covariant in *.
  assert (H := variant_subst_pos ty true 0 N (S k) (le_n_S 0 k (le_0_n k))).
  replace (S k + 0) with (S k) in H by lia.
  rewrite H. exact Hcov.
Qed.

Lemma subst_rec_subtype : forall A B, subtype A B ->
  forall N k, subtype (subst_rec A N k) (subst_rec B N k).
Proof.
  intros A B H. induction H; intros N kk; simpl.
  - (* sub_zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply sub_trans; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_stem *) apply sub_stem; apply IHsubtype.
  - (* sub_fork *) eapply sub_fork; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_asf *) apply sub_asf; apply IHsubtype.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_funty; [apply IHsubtype1 | apply IHsubtype2].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply sub_quant; apply (IHsubtype N (S kk)).
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) apply sub_quant_stem.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) apply sub_quant_fork.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) apply sub_quant_asf.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    unfold subst.
    rewrite subst_subst.
    apply sub_inst.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    unfold lift.
    rewrite lift_subst_comm_01.
    apply sub_lift.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) apply sub_stem_fun.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) apply sub_fork_stem.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
  - (* sub_recursion *)
    replace (subst_rec (quant k (Funty uty vty)) N kk)
      with (quant k (subst_rec (Funty uty vty) N (kk + k)))
      by (symmetry; apply (subst_rec_quant k (Funty uty vty) N kk)).
    simpl.
    apply (sub_recursion k (subst_rec uty N (kk + k)) (subst_rec vty N (kk + k))).
  - (* sub_tree *)
    set (ty' := subst_rec ty N (S kk)).
    assert (Hcov' : covariant ty').
    { unfold ty'. apply covariant_subst. assumption. }
    assert (E1 : subst_rec (subst ty Leaf) N kk = subst ty' Leaf).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. simpl. reflexivity. }
    assert (E2 : subst_rec (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))) N (S kk)
                 = subst (lift_rec ty' 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. rewrite lift_subst_comm_11.
      simpl. reflexivity. }
    assert (E3 : subst_rec (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0))) N (S (S kk))
                 = subst (lift_rec ty' 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0))).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. rewrite lift_subst_comm_12.
      simpl. reflexivity. }
    assert (E4 : subst_rec (subst ty uty) N kk = subst ty' (subst_rec uty N kk)).
    { unfold subst. rewrite subst_subst. reflexivity. }
    rewrite E1, E2, E3, E4.
    apply (sub_tree ty' (subst_rec uty N kk) Hcov').
  - (* sub_to_asf *) apply sub_to_asf.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* sub_bffs *)
    apply (sub_bffs (subst_rec uty N kk) (subst_rec vty N kk)).
  - (* sub_bfff *)
    apply (sub_bfff (subst_rec uty N kk) (subst_rec vty N kk) (subst_rec wty N kk)).
Qed.

Corollary subst_stem_subtype : forall x y u,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (subst x u)) (subst y u).
Proof.
  intros x y u H.
  change (subtype (subst_rec (Stem x) u 0) (subst_rec y u 0)).
  apply subst_rec_subtype. exact H.
Qed.
