(* ================================================================== *)
(* 7. Negative/safety predicate R.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* R is P_leaf with the Funty case weakened to True.  This removes     *)
(* all three hard shape obligations of P_leaf: every monotonicity      *)
(* case, including sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift, is now unconditional.   *)
(* R therefore gives all the negative facts needed to eliminate the    *)
(* Stem/Fork-source branches of App strong soundness.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => R T'
  | Quant T' => R T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma R_subst_rec : forall T u k, R T -> R (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_lift_rec : forall T k m, R T -> R (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma R_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> R T -> R U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply R_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply R_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.

  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.

  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.

Proof.
  intros T H. exact (R_mono _ _ H Logic.I).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_stem : forall X, subtype Leaf (Stem X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros X H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR. simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_fork : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Fork X Y) -> False.
Proof.

Proof.

Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_leaf_omega2 : subtype Leaf omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype _ H) as HR.
  unfold omega2_ty in HR. cbn in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

(* 8. Strong soundness of App for a Leaf-reachable source.             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* All Stem/Fork/recursion/tree source cases are eliminated by the      *)
(* negative predicate R.  The remaining cases reduce exactly to:       *)
(*   (L1)    subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r            *)
(*   (Hdist) subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->                        *)
(*           subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y)                        *)
(* Both are target-inversion facts of exactly the kind the P_leaf      *)
(* architecture aims at; no further App-specific work is needed.       *)
(* (The core dist fact is proven in Section 10; the Leaf-premise form   *)
(* here additionally needs P_leaf for Leaf-reachable sources.)         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_strong_leaf
  (L1 : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r)
  (Hdist : forall X Y, subtype Leaf (Quant (Funty X Y)) ->
                        subtype (Stem (Quant X)) (Quant Y))
  : forall T a r, subtype Leaf T -> App T a r -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros T a r Hleaf HA.
  revert Hleaf.
  apply (App_ind (fun S a r => subtype Leaf S -> subtype (Stem a) r)).

9	(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
10	(*                                                                    *)
11	(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
12	(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
13	(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
14	(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
15	(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
16	(*                                                                    *)
17	(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
18	(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
19	(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
20	(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
21	(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
22	(* ================================================================== *)
23	
24	(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
25	(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
26	(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
27	Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
28	  match T with
29	  | Var i => Var i
30	  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
31	  | Funty _ r => r
32	  | Leaf => Leaf
33	  | Stem u => u
34	  | Fork _ v => v
35	  | Asf T' => extr T'
36	  end.
37	
38	(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
39	Lemma extr_lift_rec :
40	  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
41	Proof.
42	  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
43	  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
44	  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
45	  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
46	  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
47	  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
48	  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
49	  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
50	Qed.
51	
52	(* ================================================================== *)
53	(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
54	(*                                                                    *)
55	(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
56	(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
57	(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
58	(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
59	(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
60	(* ================================================================== *)
61	
62	Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
63	  match T with
64	  | Var _ => False
65	  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
66	  | Funty _ _ => True
67	  | Leaf => False
68	  | Stem _ => False
69	  | Fork u _ => R u
70	  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
71	  end.
72	
73	Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
74	Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.
75	
76	Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
77	  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
78	Proof.
79	  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
80	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
81	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
82	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
83	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
84	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
85	  - (* Fork *) apply R_subst_rec. exact HR.
86	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
87	Qed.
88	
89	Lemma ReachFork_lift_rec :
90	  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
91	Proof.
92	  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
93	  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
94	  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
95	  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
96	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
97	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
98	  - (* Fork *) apply R_lift_rec. exact HR.
99	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
100	Qed.
101	
102	(* On the ReachFork fragment, extr commutes with substitution with    *)
103	(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)
104	(* e.g. extr (Fork A B) = B, and substituting in the discarded first  *)
105	(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
106	Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
107	  forall T u k,
108	    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
109	Proof.

112	  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHT. exact HR.
113	  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
114	  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
115	  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
116	  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
117	  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
118	Qed.
119	
120	(* ReachFork is monotone along subtype. *)
121	Lemma ReachFork_mono :
122	  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
123	Proof.
124	  intros T U H.
125	  induction H as
126	    [ ty
127	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
128	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
129	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
130	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
131	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
132	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
133	    | u
134	    | u v
135	    | u
136	    | u v
137	    | ty u
138	    | ty
139	    | uty
140	    | uty vty
141	    | uty vty
142	    | uty vty wty
143	    | uty vty wty
144	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
145	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
146	    | k uty vty
147	    | ty uty Hcov
148	    | ty
149	    | uty vty
150	    | uty vty
151	    | uty vty wty ];
152	    intros HR; simpl in *.
153	  - (* zero *) exact HR.
154	  - (* trans *) eauto.
155	  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
156	  - (* fork *) eapply R_mono; eauto.
157	  - (* asf *) eauto.
158	  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
159	  - (* quant *) eauto.
160	  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
161	  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.
162	  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
163	  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
164	  - (* inst *) apply ReachFork_subst_rec with (u := u) (k := 0). exact HR.
165	  - (* lift *) apply ReachFork_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.

167	  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
168	  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.

170	  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
171	  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
172	  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
173	  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
174	  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
175	  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
176	  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
177	  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
178	  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
179	Qed.

182	(* Main invariant: on ReachFork types, extr is monotone for subtype.   *)
183	(* ================================================================== *)
184	
185	Lemma extr_mono_reach :
186	  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> subtype (extr T) (extr U).
187	Proof.
188	  intros T U H.
189	  induction H as
190	    [ ty
191	    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
192	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
193	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
194	    | uty1 uty2 Hs
195	    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
196	    | vty1 vty2 Hs
197	    | u
198	    | u v
199	    | u
200	    | u v
201	    | ty u
202	    | ty
203	    | uty
204	    | uty vty
205	    | uty vty
206	    | uty vty wty
207	    | uty vty wty
208	    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
209	    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
210	    | k uty vty
211	    | ty uty Hcov
212	    | ty
213	    | uty vty
214	    | uty vty
215	    | uty vty wty ];
216	    intros HR; simpl in *.
217	  - (* zero *) apply sub_zero.
218	  - (* trans *) eauto using sub_trans, ReachFork_mono.
219	  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
220	  - (* fork *) assumption.
221	  - (* asf *) eauto.
222	  - (* funty *) assumption.
223	  - (* quant *) eauto using sub_quant.
224	  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
225	  - (* quant_fork *) apply sub_zero.
226	  - (* quant_asf *) apply sub_zero.
227	  - (* dist *) apply sub_zero.
228	  - (* inst *)

231	    apply sub_inst.

237	  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
238	  - (* fork_leaf *) apply sub_zero.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Pure term identity: substituting at a cutoff k <= d inside          *)
(* lift (S d) X undoes one lift.                                       *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d -> subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lift closure: GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1) *)
(* for j <= d.  The index condition is exactly what the Quant case    *)
(* propagates (j becomes S j while d becomes S d).                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_lift_gen :
  forall T d j X,
    j <= d -> GoodStem d X T -> GoodStem (S d) X (lift_rec T j 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros d j X Hj HG; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HG.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT; [lia|exact HG].
  - (* Funty *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HG.
  - (* Stem *)
    pose proof (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ HG j) as Hlift.
    unfold lift in Hlift. simpl in Hlift.
    rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d j 1) in Hlift by lia.
    replace (d + 1) with (S d) in Hlift by lia.
    exact Hlift.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HG.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT; [exact Hj|exact HG].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitution closure:                                              *)
(*   k <= d -> GoodStem (S d) X T -> GoodStem d X (subst_rec T u k).  *)
(* The condition k <= d is propagated by the Quant case (both become  *)
(* S k and S d), and is exactly what makes the pure lift/subst        *)
(* identity hold.                                                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)
=== L3_impl ===
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB Size.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
  | Funty _ r => r
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork _ v => v
  | Asf T' => extr T'
  end.

(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
Lemma extr_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork u _ => R u
  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
  end.

Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen

Definition W3t (q:dtype) : dtype := Funty (Funty q q) q.

Ltac ss n :=
  match n with
  | O => fail
  | S ?m =>
    first
    [ apply sub_zero
    | (* source Leaf, target Funty *)
      match goal with
      | |- subtype Leaf (Funty ?a ?C) =>
          first [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Stem a));
                  [ apply sub_leaf_fun | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | ss m ] ] ]
      | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
          first [ apply sub_stem_fun
                | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a));
                  [ apply sub_stem_fun | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | ss m ] ] ]
      | |- subtype (Fork Leaf ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
          first [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a X);
                  [ apply sub_fork_leaf | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | ss m ] ] ]
      | |- subtype (Fork (Stem ?X) ?Y) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
          let w := fresh "w" in
          let Hw := fresh "Hw" in
          assert (Hw : exists w : dtype, subtype Y (Funty a w))
            by (eexists; ss m);
          destruct Hw as [w Hw];
          eapply fork_stem_intro with (v := w);
          [ ss m | exact Hw ]
      | |- subtype (Funty ?X ?Y) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
          eapply sub_funty; [ ss m | ss m ]
      | |- subtype (Asf (Funty ?X ?Y)) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
          apply sub_from_asf
      | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Stem ?Y) => apply sub_stem; ss m
      | |- subtype (Fork ?X1 ?X2) (Fork ?Y1 ?Y2) => eapply sub_fork; [ ss m | ss m ]
      | |- subtype (Asf ?X) (Asf ?Y) => apply sub_asf; ss m
      | |- subtype (Quant ?X) (Quant ?Y) => apply sub_quant; ss m
      | |- subtype (Quant (Stem ?X)) (Stem ?Y) => apply sub_quant_stem
      | |- subtype (Quant (Fork ?X ?Y)) (Fork ?Z ?W) => apply sub_quant_fork
      | |- subtype (Quant (Asf ?X)) (Asf ?Y) => apply sub_quant_asf
      | |- subtype (Quant (Funty ?X ?Y)) (Funty ?Z ?W) => apply sub_dist
      | |- subtype (Asf ?X) ?T => apply sub_to_asf
      | |- subtype ?X (Asf ?T) =>
          first [ apply sub_to_asf
                | match X with
                  | Asf _ => idtac
                  end ]
      | |- subtype ?X (Quant ?T) => apply sub_lift
      | |- subtype (Fork (Fork ?u ?v) ?w) (Funty Leaf ?u) => apply sub_fork_fork_leaf
      | |- subtype (Fork (Fork ?u (Funty ?v1 ?v2)) ?w) (Funty (Stem ?v1) ?v2) => apply sub_fork_fork_stem
      | |- subtype (Fork (Fork ?u ?v) (Funty ?w1 (Funty ?w2 ?w3))) (Funty (Fork ?w1 ?w2) ?w3) => apply sub_fork_fork_fork
      end ].

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen
        AgentB_recsplit_second AgentB_recsplit_second2.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Set Printing Width 140.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Definition W2g (W : dtype) : dtype := Funty W W.
Definition W3g (W : dtype) : dtype := Funty (W2g W) W.

Definition tag (T : dtype) : nat :=
  match T with Var _=>0 | Quant _=>1 | Funty _ _=>2 | Leaf=>3 | Stem _=>4 | Fork _ _=>5 | Asf _=>6 end.

Definition lc (T : dtype) : dtype := match T with Fork a _ => a | _ => Leaf end.
Definition rc (T : dtype) : dtype := match T with Fork _ b => b | _ => Leaf end.
Definition lf (T : dtype) : dtype := match T with Funty a _ => a | _ => Leaf end.
Definition rf (T : dtype) : dtype := match T with Funty _ b => b | _ => Leaf end.
Fixpoint dsize (T : dtype) : nat :=
  match T with Var _=>1 | Quant T'=>S (dsize T') | Funty a b=>S (dsize a+dsize b)
  | Leaf=>1 | Stem T'=>S (dsize T') | Fork a b=>S (dsize a+dsize b) | Asf T'=>S (dsize T') end.

Ltac show_tags :=
  match goal with
  | |- subtype ?S ?T =>
      let s := eval vm_compute in (tag S) in
      let t := eval vm_compute in (tag T) in
      let sl := eval vm_compute in (tag (lc S)) in
      let sr := eval vm_compute in (tag (rc S)) in
      let td := eval vm_compute in (tag (lf T)) in
      let tr := eval vm_compute in (tag (rf T)) in
      let trl := eval vm_compute in (tag (lc (rf T))) in
      let trr := eval vm_compute in (tag (rc (rf T))) in
      let trf1 := eval vm_compute in (tag (lf (rf T))) in
      let trf2 := eval vm_compute in (tag (rf (rf T))) in
      idtac "GOAL src/tgt tags" s t;
      idtac "GOAL lc/rc tags" sl sr;
      idtac "GOAL target dom/cod tags" td tr;
      idtac "GOAL target cod lc/rc tags" trl trr;
      idtac "GOAL target cod lf/rf tags" trf1 trf2
  end.

Ltac solve_sub :=
  first [ apply sub_zero
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype omega2_ty ?T => unfold omega2_ty; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega21_ty ?T => unfold omega21_ty; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega22_ty ?T => unfold omega22_ty, omega22; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega22 ?T => unfold omega22; cbn; solve_sub
          end
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype Leaf (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Stem a));
                      [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>

          | |- subtype (Funty ?X ?Y) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              eapply sub_funty; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Fork Leaf ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a X);
                      [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Fork (Stem ?Y) ?Z) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [
                let Hex := fresh "Hex" in
                let HZ := fresh "HZ" in
                let w := fresh "w" in
                assert (Hex : exists w : dtype, subtype Z (Funty a w))
                  by (eexists; solve_sub);
                destruct Hex as [w HZ];
                eapply sub_trans with
                  (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty a (Funty w C))) (Funty a w));
                [ eapply sub_fork; [ apply sub_stem; solve_sub | exact HZ ]
                | apply sub_fork_stem ]
              | let Hex := fresh "Hex" in
                let HY := fresh "HY" in
                let w := fresh "w" in
                assert (Hex : exists w : dtype,
                           subtype Y (Funty a (Funty w C)))
                  by (eexists; solve_sub);
                destruct Hex as [w HY];
                let HZ := fresh "HZ" in
                assert (HZ : subtype Z (Funty a w)) by solve_sub;
                eapply sub_trans with
                  (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty a (Funty w C))) (Funty a w));
                [ eapply sub_fork; [ apply sub_stem; exact HY | exact HZ ]
                | apply sub_fork_stem ] ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Stem ?Y) =>
              apply sub_stem; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Fork ?X1 ?X2) (Fork ?Y1 ?Y2) =>
              eapply sub_fork; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Asf ?X) (Asf ?Y) =>
              apply sub_asf; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Quant ?X) (Quant ?Y) =>
              apply sub_quant; solve_sub

  forall W, subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3g W)).

  try solve_sub.
  all: show_tags.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The coordinator's proposed double-Stem core.                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition inv_s_core : Prop :=
  forall X u1 u ty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

(* Step 1: inv_s follows from inv_s_core (the intended reduction). *)
Lemma inv_s_of_inv_s_core :
  inv_s_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros IC u2 u1 u ty u3 h0 h1.
  apply (IC u3 u1 u ty).
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Stem u2).
  - apply sub_stem. apply (L1 u3 u2). exact h1.
  - apply (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))). exact h0.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Step 2: inv_s_core still entails RecSplit.                         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The sub_recursion rule is not reached through the SOURCE           *)
(* Stem (Stem X); it is reached through the codomain of the Funty:    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  Stem (Stem omega21)                                               *)
(*    <: Funty omega22 (Fork (Stem omega21) omega22)   (sub_stem_fun) *)
(*    <: Funty omega22 (Funty omega2_ty (Funty q q -> q))            *)
(*                                   (sub_funty + sub_recursion)      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instantiating inv_s_core at X = omega21_ty, u1 = omega22_ty,        *)
(* u = omega2_ty, ty = Funty (Funty q q) q then yields exactly        *)
(* RecSplit.  Hence inv_s_core is at least as strong as RecSplit.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma inv_s_core_premise :
  forall k uty vty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem omega21_ty))
      (Funty omega22_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty
            (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                   (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
            (quant k (Funty uty vty))))).
Proof.
  intros k uty vty.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Funty omega22_ty (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + change (subtype omega2_ty
                (Funty omega2_ty
                  (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                           (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))).
      exact (sub_recursion k uty vty).
Qed.

Lemma inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit : inv_s_core -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros IC k uty vty.
  unfold RecSplit.
  destruct (IC omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty
              (Funty
                (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                       (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (inv_s_core_premise k uty vty)) as [v [HA Hu]].
  exists v. split; assumption.
Qed.

Print Assumptions inv_s_of_inv_s_core.
Print Assumptions inv_s_core_premise.
Print Assumptions inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit.

Observation: Out(A,B,X,Y,a,r) is *monotone in a and r* in the following direction: if subtype a' a and subtype r r', then Out(...,a,r) -> Out(...,a',r'). Check:
- stem: subtype (Stem Z) a' -> (Stem Z) a -> get v, Y<:Funty Z v, v<:r<:r'. ✓
- leaf: Leaf <: a' -> Leaf <: a. ✓
- fork: Fork U V <: a' -> Fork U V <: a. ✓

And Out is *monotone in S?* We want to prove: for all S, subtype (Fork A B) S -> forall a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> Out(A,B,X,Y,a,r).

Let's call G(S) := forall a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> Out(A,B,X,Y,a,r) (with A,B,X,Y fixed).

We can prove "forall S, subtype (Fork A B) S -> G(S)" by induction on the derivation of subtype (Fork A B) S. Cases:
- sub_zero: S=Fork A B. Need G(Fork A B): i.e., forall a r, subtype (Fork A B) (Funty a r) -> Out(...). This is exactly the core case analysis (atomic rules + trans decomposition). Hmm, but in our induction we're already handling the derivation; actually the starting derivation is exactly subtype (Fork A B) (Funty a r) (Hf), so G(Fork A B) is what we're proving by induction on Hf! That's circular if both are induction on the same derivation.

Let's restructure: Prove directly by induction on the derivation D : subtype (Fork A B) (Funty a r) the statement Out(A,B,X,Y,a,r) (for fixed X,Y with subtype (Fork X Y) A). This is the core (generalized to A,B,X,Y). In the sub_trans case D = trans H1 H2 with H1 : subtype (Fork A B) X and H2 : subtype X (Funty a r). We need Out for target (a,r). By IH on H2 (source X, target Funty a r), we'd need the theorem at source X, i.e., for all A' B' with subtype (Fork A' B') X and subpair... But our fixed A,B: we have subtype (Fork A B) X. So if the theorem statement is generalized over the lower-bound pair (A,B) and source S (any), we can apply IH on H2 with A'=A,B'=B. But is the theorem statement "forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> forall A B, subtype (Fork A B) S -> forall X Y, subtype (Fork X Y) A -> Out" proven by induction on the derivation of subtype S (Funty a r)? In the trans case, the derivation H2 : subtype X (Funty a r) is a subderivation, so IH applies with A,B (since subtype (Fork A B) X holds). 

So define:
Theorem T : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> forall A B, subtype (Fork A B) S -> forall X Y, subtype (Fork X Y) A -> Out(A,B,X,Y,a,r).
Prove by induction on the derivation of subtype S (Funty a r). Let's check cases:

Case sub_zero: S = Funty a r. Then subtype (Fork A B) (Funty a r) is Hpair := subtype (Fork A B) S (same). Need Out(A,B,X,Y,a,r) given subtype (Fork X Y) A and subtype (Fork A B) (Funty a r) and subpair. Hmm, but this case is the *hard core* again: S is Funty and we need the core! Wait, S = Funty a r, and Hpair : subtype (Fork A B) (Funty a r). We need Out. This is precisely the core with Hf=Hpair. So induction on subtype S (Funty a r) hits sub_zero where we need to solve the core directly — no progress. Unless in the sub_zero case, Hpair is the entire hypothesis and we still need to reason about it. So this induction isn't helpful; it just shifts.

Alternatively, induct on the *Hpair* derivation (subtype (Fork A B) S), with S = a/r from the target? Circular as noted.

Hmm. So the fundamental difficulty is the case where Hf is the last (top) hypothesis; we must do case analysis on its derivation. The trans case is where we need the invariant. The needed invariant is about the *intermediate source* X and its relation to the lower-bound pair. Our T above, when inducting on Hf's derivation, trans case: H1: subtype (Fork A B) X, H2 : subtype X (Funty a r); we want to apply T with S=X and Hpair=H1 — but T's induction was on the derivation H2 for the *same* target; we can apply T as a recursive call if we prove T by induction on the derivation of subtype S (Funty a r) — and here H2 is a strict subderivation of Hf? Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ △.
Definition T0 : dtype := Fork Leaf Leaf.

Lemma hsub0 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. exact hsub0.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK1 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) (Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK1.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H. inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_fork : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_fork. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma theorem_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △. split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_fork]].
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A closed counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.  The term is a
   leaf_red redex whose reduct is Node, and it is typable at Stem Leaf,
   a type that Node cannot have. *)

Definition M0 : Tree :=
  △ @ ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △) @ △.

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

(* Node : Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma node_fun2 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Node : Funty Leaf (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf))). *)
Lemma node_fun3 :
  subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

(* Node @ Node : Stem Leaf. *)
Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The inner argument ((Node @ Node) @ Node) : Leaf. *)
Lemma dInner : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + apply derive_node. exact node_fun2.
    + apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Main typing derivation. *)
Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_app.
      * apply derive_node. exact node_fun3.
      * exact dInner.
    + exact dK.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply leaf_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as
    [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.

(* The "Leaf <- Funty" equivalence, from L1 and sub_leaf_fun. *)
Lemma L1_iff :
  forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) <-> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r. split.
  - apply L1.
  - intro H. eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2.  Two composition rules used by the canonical decomposition of   *)
(*     a Fork source against a Funty target.                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Fork (Stem A) B <: Funty u w, from the two curried pieces. *)
Lemma fork_stem_intro :
  forall A B u w v,
    subtype A (Funty u (Funty v w)) ->
    subtype B (Funty u v) ->
    subtype (Fork (Stem A) B) (Funty u w).
Proof.
  intros A B u w v HA HB.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)).
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_stem. exact HA.
    + exact HB.
  - apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

(* Fork Leaf B <: Funty u w, provided B <: w. *)
Lemma fork_leaf_fun :
  forall B u w, subtype B w -> subtype (Fork Leaf B) (Funty u w).
Proof.
  intros B u w H.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u B).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 3.  The pair invariant.  Rpair d A u1 X simultaneously remembers:      *)
(*       - the GoodStem projection of the first source component;     *)
(*       - the relation of the second source component to u1;         *)
(*     and, at a Funty target, it is exactly the inv_s conclusion.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint Rpair (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) {struct X} : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork X1 X2 => GoodStem d A X1 /\ subtype (lift d u1) X2
  | Asf X' => Rpair d A u1 X'
  | Quant X' => Rpair (S d) A u1 X'
  | Funty u ty =>
      exists v,
        subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
        subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v)
  end.

Definition Rpair_mono : Prop :=
  forall d A u1 X Y,
    subtype X Y -> Rpair d A u1 X -> Rpair d A u1 Y.

(* WARNING: Rpair_mono is FALSE.  Its sub_bffs branch is exactly
   Bffs_branch below, which is false: take d = 0,
   A = bffs_aug uty, u1 = Asf (Asf (Asf Leaf)), vty = Asf (Asf Leaf).
   Then both hypotheses hold by sub_zero (lift 0 = identity), while the
   second conclusion is
     subtype (Asf (Asf (Asf Leaf))) (Asf (Asf Leaf)),
   which is not derivable: Asf does not decrease its nesting.  Hence the
   conditional GoodStem_comp_of_Rpair_mono below is vacuous, and this
   structural route is abandoned in favour of the semantic invariant
   SemR in Section 9. *)

(* The only genuinely infinite-looking constructor.  The witness is a
   single concrete existential, independent of d, A and u1.           *)
Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4.  GoodStem_comp follows from monotonicity of Rpair.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_Rpair_mono :
  Rpair_mono ->
  forall A B u1 u ty,
    GoodStem 0 A B ->
    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v,
      subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros HR A B u1 u ty H1 H2.
  assert (Hres : Rpair 0 A u1 (Funty u ty)).
  { apply (HR 0 A u1 (Fork (lift 0 B) u1) (Funty u ty)).

  pose proof (L1 u6 (Funty u7 u) H2) as Hs2.
  pose proof (L2_literal u6 u7 u Hs2) as HH.
  exact (HC u2 u1 u ty u4 u5 u6 u7 Hf HG HH).
Qed.

    subtype (Fork u2 u1) (Funty u ty) ->

  pose proof (L2_literal u2 u1 (Funty u ty) Hs0) as Hf.
  pose proof (L1 u4 (Funty u5 u2) H1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (L2_literal u4 u5 u2 Hs1) as HG.

(* 2. Fork-strict reachability and the left projection.                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* FRK T holds when T is a Fork, or a Quant spine ending in a Fork.    *)
(* This is exactly the target class for which the left projection lp    *)
(* is monotone.  Asf targets are deliberately excluded: the bffs/bfff   *)
(* rules make lp monotonicity false there (lp (bffs_aug u) is not a     *)
(* subtype of u).                                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint FRK (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => FRK T'
  | _ => False
  end.

(* The left projection.  Funty is mapped to its domain; this choice is
   irrelevant because Funty targets never satisfy FRK. *)
Fixpoint lp (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (lp T')
  | Funty a _ => a
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork u _ => u
  | Asf T' => lp T'
  end.

(* Under RF, substitution and lifting preserve FRK exactly. *)
Lemma FRK_subst_rec_RF : forall T u k, RF T -> (FRK (subst_rec T u k) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) tauto.
  - (* Asf *) tauto.
Qed.

Lemma FRK_lift_rec_RF : forall T k m, RF T -> (FRK (lift_rec T k m) <-> FRK T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
  - tauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
Qed.

(* lp commutes with substitution and lifting on the RF fragment. *)
Lemma lp_subst_rec_RF :
  forall T u k, RF T -> lp (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (lp T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma lp_lift_rec_RF :
  forall T k m, RF T -> lp (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (lp T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The coordinator's proposed double-Stem core.                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition inv_s_core : Prop :=
  forall X u1 u ty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem X)) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype X (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).

(* Step 1: inv_s follows from inv_s_core (the intended reduction). *)
Lemma inv_s_of_inv_s_core :
  inv_s_core ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros IC u2 u1 u ty u3 h0 h1.
  apply (IC u3 u1 u ty).
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Stem u2).
  - apply sub_stem. apply (L1 u3 u2). exact h1.
  - apply (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))). exact h0.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Step 2: inv_s_core still entails RecSplit.                         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The sub_recursion rule is not reached through the SOURCE           *)
(* Stem (Stem X); it is reached through the codomain of the Funty:    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  Stem (Stem omega21)                                               *)
(*    <: Funty omega22 (Fork (Stem omega21) omega22)   (sub_stem_fun) *)
(*    <: Funty omega22 (Funty omega2_ty (Funty q q -> q))            *)
(*                                   (sub_funty + sub_recursion)      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instantiating inv_s_core at X = omega21_ty, u1 = omega22_ty,        *)
(* u = omega2_ty, ty = Funty (Funty q q) q then yields exactly        *)
(* RecSplit.  Hence inv_s_core is at least as strong as RecSplit.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma inv_s_core_premise :
  forall k uty vty,
    subtype (Stem (Stem omega21_ty))
      (Funty omega22_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty
            (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                   (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
            (quant k (Funty uty vty))))).
Proof.
  intros k uty vty.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Funty omega22_ty (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + change (subtype omega2_ty
                (Funty omega2_ty
                  (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                           (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))).
      exact (sub_recursion k uty vty).
Qed.

Lemma inv_s_core_implies_RecSplit : inv_s_core -> RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros IC k uty vty.
  unfold RecSplit.
  destruct (IC omega21_ty omega22_ty omega2_ty
              (Funty
                (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                       (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (inv_s_core_premise k uty vty)) as [v [HA Hu]].
  exists v. split; assumption.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The s-reduction head inversion statement is FALSE.                  *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The counterexample uses:                                            *)
(*   u2 = Stem Leaf                                                    *)
(*   u1 = Funty Leaf Leaf                                              *)
(*   u  = Leaf                                                         *)
(*   ty = Leaf                                                         *)
(*   u3 = Leaf                                                         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Both premises are derivable (proved below).  The conclusion would   *)
(* force, for some v,                                                    *)
(*   subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty v Leaf))                          *)
(* and, via L1 and L2_literal, that would force                         *)
(*   subtype (Fork Leaf v) Leaf,                                       *)
(* which is impossible because a Fork-source can never have Leaf as a  *)
(* target (the invariant RF below).                                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Invariant RF: every type reachable from a Fork source has head      *)
(* Fork or Funty (possibly under any number of Asf/Quant).  In         *)
(* particular Leaf, Stem and Var are unreachable.                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply RF_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply RF_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* recursion *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* tree *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bfff *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma RF_of_fork_subtype : forall C X S, subtype (Fork C X) S -> RF S.
Proof.
  intros C X S H. apply (RF_mono _ _ H). apply Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_fork_leaf : forall C X, subtype (Fork C X) Leaf -> False.
Proof.
  intros C X H. pose proof (RF_of_fork_subtype C X Leaf H) as HR.
  simpl in HR. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Closed derivation of the first premise, with the chosen values.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Leaf <: Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf). *)
Lemma leaf_funty2 : subtype Leaf (Funty Leaf (Funty Leaf Leaf)).
Proof.

Lemma no_conclusion_for_witness :

Proof.

  pose proof (L1 Leaf (Funty v Leaf) Hconcl) as Hstem.
  (* L2_literal turns that into Fork Leaf v <: Leaf. *)
  pose proof (L2_literal Leaf v Leaf Hstem) as Hfork.

  | Node : Tree

.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)

| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

    subtype_size ty1 ty2 H12 n12 ->

| sz_fork : forall u1 u2 v1 v2

    subtype_size u1 u2 H n ->

    subtype_size v1 v2 Hcod n2 ->

| sz_stem_fun : forall uty vty,

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB Size.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L3 literal:  subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The originally suggested lexicographic measure on the two sizes     *)
(* (nK + nH + 1, nH) cannot terminate: with K ending in a transitivity *)
(* and H ending in a transitivity, the two possible recursive calls    *)
(* swap weight between K and H along the line nK + nH = const, and     *)
(* the two moves are inverse to one another.  (See AgentA_L3leaf.v.)   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Instead we use the source-sensitive invariant below.  It is the     *)
(* key refinement: for a type reachable from Fork Leaf X, the first    *)
(* component of every reachable Fork is Leaf-reachable, i.e. satisfies *)
(* AgentB.R.  On that fragment the right-projection extraction `extr`  *)
(* is monotone for subtype, which gives the result directly.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* The right-projection extraction.  For a function type it returns    *)
(* the codomain, for a fork the second component, and it commutes with *)
(* Asf and Quant.  This is the semantic "output" of a literal.         *)
Fixpoint extr (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (extr T')
  | Funty _ r => r
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem u => u
  | Fork _ v => v
  | Asf T' => extr T'
  end.

(* extr commutes with lifting. *)
Lemma extr_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, extr (lift_rec T k m) = lift_rec (extr T) k m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m; simpl.
  - (* Var *) reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Source-sensitive reachability invariant.                            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A type is reachable (from Fork Leaf X) only if it is Funty, or an  *)
(* Asf/Quant spine ending in Funty, or a Fork whose first component   *)
(* is itself reachable from Leaf (AgentB.R).  The latter condition     *)
(* excludes exactly the Fork(Stem ...) and Fork(Fork ...) sources of  *)
(* the problematic atomic rules.                                       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint ReachFork (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => ReachFork T'
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork u _ => R u
  | Asf T' => ReachFork T'
  end.

Lemma ReachFork_fork_leaf : forall X, ReachFork (Fork Leaf X).
Proof. intros X. simpl. exact Logic.I. Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_subst_rec :
  forall T u k, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_subst_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma ReachFork_lift_rec :
  forall T k m, ReachFork T -> ReachFork (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) apply R_lift_rec. exact HR.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* On the ReachFork fragment, extr commutes with substitution with    *)
(* the same substituted term.  (The unrestricted statement is false:  *)
(* e.g. extr (Fork A B) = B, and substituting in the discarded first  *)
(* component is irrelevant.)                                           *)
Lemma ReachFork_extr_subst_rec :
  forall T u k,
    ReachFork T -> extr (subst_rec T u k) = subst_rec (extr T) u k.
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HR.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply IHT. exact HR.
  - (* Funty *) reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* Fork *) reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HR.
Qed.

(* ReachFork is monotone along subtype. *)
Lemma ReachFork_mono :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> ReachFork U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HR.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) eapply R_mono; eauto.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) exact HR.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply ReachFork_subst_rec with (u := u) (k := 0). exact HR.
  - (* lift *) apply ReachFork_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HR.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) exact HR.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Main invariant: on ReachFork types, extr is monotone for subtype.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma extr_mono_reach :
  forall T U, subtype T U -> ReachFork T -> subtype (extr T) (extr U).
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* trans *) eauto using sub_trans, ReachFork_mono.
  - (* stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork *) assumption.
  - (* asf *) eauto.
  - (* funty *) assumption.
  - (* quant *) eauto using sub_quant.
  - (* quant_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* quant_fork *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* quant_asf *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* dist *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* inst *)
    unfold subst.
    rewrite (ReachFork_extr_subst_rec ty u 0 HR).
    apply sub_inst.
  - (* lift *)
    unfold lift.
    rewrite extr_lift_rec.
    apply sub_lift.
  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_leaf *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HR.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HR.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HR. simpl in HR. destruct HR.
  - (* tree *) destruct HR.
  - (* to_asf *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* from_asf *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HR.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HR.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The requested two-derivation statement.  The size arguments are     *)
(* now only bookkeeping: the invariant proof is independent of them.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma L3_literal_aux :
  forall p : {n : nat & nat},
    (forall S a r X nH nK,
        subtype_size S (Funty a r) nH ->
        subtype_size (Fork Leaf X) S nK ->
        p = existT (fun _ : nat => nat) (nK + nH + 1) nH ->
        subtype X r).
Proof.
  intros p S a r X nH nK HH HK Ep.
  pose proof (subtype_size_sound _ _ _ HK) as HKsub.
  pose proof (subtype_size_sound _ _ _ HH) as HHsub.
  pose proof (ReachFork_fork_leaf X) as HR.
  pose proof (extr_mono_reach _ _ HKsub HR) as HX.
  pose proof (ReachFork_mono _ _ HKsub HR) as HS.
  pose proof (extr_mono_reach _ _ HHsub HS) as Hr.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact HX.
  - exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma L3_literal :
  forall X a r, subtype (Fork Leaf X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  destruct (subtype_has_size _ _ H) as [nH HnH].
  exact (L3_literal_aux
           (existT (fun _ : nat => nat) (1 + nH + 1) nH)
           (Fork Leaf X) a r X nH 1 HnH (szs_zero (Fork Leaf X)) eq_refl).
Qed.

Print Assumptions L3_literal.

(* General leafy Fork inversion, using the same ReachFork invariant. *)
Lemma L3_leaf :
  forall C X a r,
    subtype Leaf C -> subtype (Fork C X) (Funty a r) -> subtype X r.
Proof.
  intros C X a r HC H.
  pose proof (R_of_leaf_subtype C HC) as HR.
  exact (extr_mono_reach (Fork C X) (Funty a r) H HR).
Qed.

Print Assumptions L3_leaf.

# Automated structural subtype proof method (used for RS_base)

1. Encode dtypes as Python terms (miniprolog.py / gen_coq_term.py).
2. Implement sound inversion rules for subtype goals:
   - L1_iff (Leaf vs Funty), L2_iff (Stem vs Funty), fork_leaf_fun
     (Fork Leaf X vs Funty), fork_stem_intro (Fork (Stem A) B vs Funty),
     sub_funty, sub_fork_fork_* with weakening, sub_zero, sub_recursion.
3. Backward search with logic variables and unification (mini-Prolog) finds
   a proof tree.  Treat universally quantified dtypes as opaque constants.
4. Emit a Coq proof term from the tree using lemma applications with `_`
   holes.  This is compact: the RS_base C2 proof tree (~114 steps) becomes a
   2.4 KB term.
5. Verify with `rocq compile -R . Triage`.

RS_base.v is the closed result:
  forall U V, RS (Funty U V) (W3 (Funty U V)),
where RS q V := omega21 <: Funty omega2 (Funty V (W3 q)) /\
                omega22 <: Funty omega2 V.

Generalizing `sub_recursion 0` to `sub_recursion k` for q=quant k(F) does NOT
typecheck: the tree uses q as a syntactic Funty at one fork_leaf node.
The quant case needs a separate argument.
=====
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

Definition q0 : dtype := Funty Leaf Leaf.
Definition W20 : dtype := Funty q0 q0.
Definition G0 : dtype := Funty W20 q0.

Ltac solve_sub :=
  first [ apply sub_zero
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype omega2_ty ?T => unfold omega2_ty; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega21_ty ?T => unfold omega21_ty; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega22_ty ?T => unfold omega22_ty, omega22; cbn; solve_sub
          | |- subtype omega22 ?T => unfold omega22; cbn; solve_sub
          end
        | match goal with
          | |- subtype Leaf (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Stem a));
                      [ apply sub_leaf_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_stem_fun
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a));
                      [ apply sub_stem_fun
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Funty ?X ?Y) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              eapply sub_funty; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Fork Leaf ?X) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              first [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                    | eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a X);
                      [ apply sub_fork_leaf
                      | eapply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | solve_sub ] ] ]
          | |- subtype (Fork (Stem ?Y) ?Z) (Funty ?a ?C) =>
              let Hex := fresh "Hex" in
              let HZ := fresh "HZ" in
              let w := fresh "w" in
              assert (Hex : exists w : dtype, subtype Z (Funty a w))
                by (eexists; solve_sub);
              destruct Hex as [w HZ];
              eapply sub_trans with
                (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty a (Funty w C))) (Funty a w));
              [ eapply sub_fork; [ apply sub_stem; solve_sub | exact HZ ]
              | apply sub_fork_stem ]
          | |- subtype (Stem ?X) (Stem ?Y) =>
              apply sub_stem; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Fork ?X1 ?X2) (Fork ?Y1 ?Y2) =>
              eapply sub_fork; [ solve_sub | solve_sub ]
          | |- subtype (Asf ?X) (Asf ?Y) =>
              apply sub_asf; solve_sub
          | |- subtype (Quant ?X) (Quant ?Y) =>
              apply sub_quant; solve_sub
          end ].

Ltac try_cand :=
  first [ solve_sub; idtac "OK"
        | idtac "FAIL" ].

(* Candidate 1: Asf G0 *)
Lemma cand_asf : subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (Asf G0)).
Proof.
  unfold G0, W20, q0.
  try_cand.
Abort.

(* Candidate 2: Fork Leaf q0 *)
Lemma cand_forkleaf : subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (Fork Leaf q0)).
Proof.
  unfold q0.
  try_cand.
Abort.

(* Candidate 3: canonical Fork subtype of G0, witness v' = q0 *)
Definition vfork : dtype := Fork (Stem (Funty W20 (Funty q0 q0))) (Funty W20 q0).
Lemma cand_vfork : subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty vfork).
Proof.
  unfold vfork, G0, W20, q0.
  try_cand.
Abort.

(* Candidate 4: Asf (Fork Leaf q0) *)
Lemma cand_asf_fork : subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (Asf (Fork Leaf q0))).
Proof.
  unfold q0.
  try_cand.
Abort.

(* Candidate 5: Funty W20 (Asf q0) *)
Lemma cand_funty_asf : subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (Funty W20 (Asf q0))).
Proof.
  unfold q0, W20.
  try_cand.
Abort.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.
Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 1.  The exact converse of L2_literal, hence an equivalence.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* L2_literal (AgentB_L2lit):                                         *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(* The converse is a direct instance of sub_stem_fun + sub_funty.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma L2_literal_rev :
  forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros X a r H.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty a (Fork X a)).
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + exact H.
Qed.

Lemma L2_iff :
  forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) <-> subtype (Fork X a) r.
Proof.
  intros X a r. split.
  - apply L2_literal.
  - apply L2_literal_rev.
Qed.

(* The "Leaf <- Funty" equivalence, from L1 and sub_leaf_fun. *)
Lemma L1_iff :
  forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) <-> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r. split.
  - apply L1.
  - intro H. eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 2.  Two composition rules used by the canonical decomposition of   *)
(*     a Fork source against a Funty target.                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Fork (Stem A) B <: Funty u w, from the two curried pieces. *)
Lemma fork_stem_intro :
  forall A B u w v,
    subtype A (Funty u (Funty v w)) ->
    subtype B (Funty u v) ->
    subtype (Fork (Stem A) B) (Funty u w).
Proof.
  intros A B u w v HA HB.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)).
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_stem. exact HA.
    + exact HB.
  - apply sub_fork_stem.
Qed.

(* Fork Leaf B <: Funty u w, provided B <: w. *)
Lemma fork_leaf_fun :
  forall B u w, subtype B w -> subtype (Fork Leaf B) (Funty u w).
Proof.
  intros B u w H.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty u B).
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_funty; [apply sub_zero | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 3.  The pair invariant.  R d A u1 X simultaneously remembers:      *)
(*       - the GoodStem projection of the first source component;     *)
(*       - the relation of the second source component to u1;         *)
(*     and, at a Funty target, it is exactly the inv_s conclusion.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint R (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) {struct X} : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork X1 X2 => GoodStem d A X1 /\ subtype (lift d u1) X2
  | Asf X' => R d A u1 X'
  | Quant X' => R (S d) A u1 X'
  | Funty u ty =>
      exists v,
        subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
        subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v)
  end.

Definition R_mono : Prop :=
  forall d A u1 X Y,
    subtype X Y -> R d A u1 X -> R d A u1 Y.

(* WARNING: R_mono is FALSE.  Its sub_bffs branch is exactly
   Bffs_branch below, which is false: take d = 0,
   A = bffs_aug uty, u1 = Asf (Asf (Asf Leaf)), vty = Asf (Asf Leaf).
   Then both hypotheses hold by sub_zero (lift 0 = identity), while the
   second conclusion is
     subtype (Asf (Asf (Asf Leaf))) (Asf (Asf Leaf)),
   which is not derivable: Asf does not decrease its nesting.  Hence the
   conditional GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono below is vacuous, and this
   structural route is abandoned in favour of the semantic invariant
   SemR in Section 9. *)

(* The only genuinely infinite-looking constructor.  The witness is a
   single concrete existential, independent of d, A and u1.           *)
Definition RecSplit : Prop :=
  forall k uty vty,
    exists v,
      subtype omega21_ty
        (Funty omega2_ty
          (Funty v
            (Funty
              (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
              (quant k (Funty uty vty))))) /\
      subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty v).

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4.  GoodStem_comp follows from monotonicity of R.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_R_mono :
  R_mono ->
  forall A B u1 u ty,
    GoodStem 0 A B ->
    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v,
      subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros HR A B u1 u ty H1 H2.
  assert (Hres : R 0 A u1 (Funty u ty)).
  { apply (HR 0 A u1 (Fork (lift 0 B) u1) (Funty u ty)).
    - simpl. exact H2.
    - simpl. split.
      + rewrite l2_lift_zero. exact H1.
      + rewrite l2_lift_zero. apply sub_zero. }
  cbn [R] in Hres.
  rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hres.
  rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 5.  inv_s follows from GoodStem_comp.                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp :
  (forall A B u1 u ty,
      GoodStem 0 A B ->
      GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
      exists v,
        subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
        subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v,
      subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros HC u2 u1 u ty u3 H0 H1.
  pose proof (L1 u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) H0) as Hs0.
  pose proof (L1 u3 u2 H1) as Hs1.
  apply (HC u3 u2 u1 u ty).
  - exact (GoodStem_mono (Stem u3) u2 Hs1 0 u3 (GoodStem_initial u3)).
  - exact (GoodStem_mono (Stem u2) (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) Hs0
                          0 u2 (GoodStem_initial u2)).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 6.  The RecSplit obligation discharges exactly the sub_recursion   *)
(*     branch of R_mono.                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma R_recursion_case :
  RecSplit ->
  forall d A u1 k uty vty,
    R d A u1 omega2_ty ->
    R d A u1
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty

(* subtype is stable under an arbitrary lift. *)
Lemma lift_n_subtype :
  forall X Y, subtype X Y -> forall d, subtype (lift d X) (lift d Y).
Proof.
