(* For all Funty supertypes T <: Funty u ty of X, the pair (A,u1) must
   split at the same intermediate v. *)
Definition SemR (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) : Prop :=
  forall u ty,
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (lift d u1)) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v,
      subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v).

(* Unconditional monotonicity: no case analysis, no Bffs_branch. *)
Lemma SemR_mono :
  forall d A u1 X Y, subtype X Y -> SemR d A u1 X -> SemR d A u1 Y.
Proof.
  intros d A u1 X Y Hsub HR u ty Hfun.
  unfold SemR in HR.
  apply HR.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply lift_n_subtype. exact Hsub.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - exact Hfun.
Qed.

  - rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hu. exact Hu.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L2_literal :                                                       *)
(*   subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) -> subtype (Fork X a) r.            *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The invariant is a lift-indexed "source projection": for a type T  *)
(* reachable from Stem X, the source component X is replaced by        *)
(* lift d X where d counts the Quant binders traversed.  On Stem/Funty *)
(* heads this yields exactly the data needed by the atomic rules.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint GoodStem (d : nat) (X T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Quant T' => GoodStem (S d) X T'
  | Funty b r => subtype (Fork (lift d X) b) r
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem Y => subtype (lift d X) Y
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => GoodStem d X T'
  end.

(* lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X. *)
Lemma l2_lift_lift_S : forall X d, lift 1 (lift d X) = lift (S d) X.
Proof.
  intros X d. unfold lift.
  rewrite (AgentC.lift_lift_le_gen X 0 d 0 1); [|lia|lia].
  replace (d + 1) with (S d) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1) <: u. *)
Lemma l2_quant_lift_elim : forall u, subtype (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u.
Proof.
  intro u.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
  - unfold subst. rewrite AgentB.subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* The central dist obligation.  With the lift index, the source is    *)
(* Fork (lift (S d) X) u, and the target Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)    *)
(* <: Quant v is obtained by cutting the source Quant binder against  *)
(* Quant (lift_rec u 1 1).                                            *)
Lemma l2_dist :
  forall d X u v,
    subtype (Fork (lift (S d) X) u) v ->
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) (Quant v).
Proof.
  intros d X u v H.
  pose proof (l2_quant_lift_elim u) as Hq.
  pose proof (sub_fork (lift (S d) X) (lift (S d) X)
                (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)) u (sub_zero _) Hq) as H1.
  pose proof (sub_trans _ _ _ H1 H) as H2.
  pose proof (sub_quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) v H2) as H3.
  eapply sub_trans with
    (ty2 := Quant (Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))).
  - assert (E : lift 1 (Fork (lift d X) (Quant u)) =
                Fork (lift (S d) X) (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))).
    { unfold lift at 1. simpl. fold (lift 1 (lift d X)).
      rewrite l2_lift_lift_S. reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- E. apply sub_lift.
  - exact H3.
Qed.

(* Pure term identity: substituting at a cutoff k <= d inside          *)
(* lift (S d) X undoes one lift.                                       *)
Lemma l2_subst_lift_S_eq_gen :
  forall X u d k,
    k <= d -> subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 (S d)) u k = lift_rec X 0 d.
Proof.
  intros X u d k Hk.
  pose proof (AgentC.subst_lift_succ_gen X u k (S d) 0 ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (k + 0) with k in H by lia.
  replace (S d - 1) with d in H by lia.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A size-annotated version of the subtype relation, used for well-founded
   recursion on pairs of derivations.  It mirrors subtypes.v exactly. *)
Inductive subtype_size : dtype -> dtype -> nat -> Prop :=
| szs_zero : forall ty, subtype_size ty ty 1
| szs_trans : forall a b c n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size b c m ->
    subtype_size a c (n + m + 1)
| szs_stem : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Stem a) (Stem b) (S n)
| szs_fork : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size a b n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Fork a c) (Fork b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_asf : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Asf a) (Asf b) (S n)
| szs_funty : forall a b c d n m,
    subtype_size b a n -> subtype_size c d m ->
    subtype_size (Funty a c) (Funty b d) (n + m + 1)
| szs_quant : forall a b n, subtype_size a b n ->
    subtype_size (Quant a) (Quant b) (S n)
| szs_quant_stem : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Stem u)) (Stem (Quant u)) 1
| szs_quant_fork : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Fork u v)) (Fork (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_quant_asf : forall u, subtype_size (Quant (Asf u)) (Asf (Quant u)) 1
| szs_dist : forall u v, subtype_size (Quant (Funty u v)) (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)) 1
| szs_inst : forall ty u, subtype_size (Quant ty) (subst ty u) 1
| szs_lift : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Quant (lift 1 ty)) 1
| szs_leaf_fun : forall u, subtype_size Leaf (Funty u (Stem u)) 1
| szs_stem_fun : forall u v, subtype_size (Stem u) (Funty v (Fork u v)) 1
| szs_fork_leaf : forall u v, subtype_size (Fork Leaf u) (Funty v u) 1
| szs_fork_stem : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) (Funty u w) 1
| szs_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) w) (Funty Leaf u) 1
| szs_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) (Funty (Stem v1) v2) 1
| szs_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) (Funty (Fork w1 w2) w3) 1
| szs_recursion : forall k u v,
    subtype_size omega2_ty
      (Funty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))) 1
| szs_tree : forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype_size
      (Fork
         (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
               (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
         (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
               (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
      (Funty uty (subst ty uty)) 1
| szs_to_asf : forall ty, subtype_size ty (Asf ty) 1
| szs_from_asf : forall u v, subtype_size (Asf (Funty u v)) (Funty u v) 1
| szs_bffs : forall u v,
    subtype_size (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug u)) (Asf v)) (Asf (Fork (Stem u) v)) 1
| szs_bfff : forall u v w,
    subtype_size (Fork (Fork u (Asf v)) (bfff_aug w)) (Asf (Fork (Fork u v) w)) 1.

Lemma subtype_size_sound : forall S T n, subtype_size S T n -> subtype S T.
Proof.
  intros S T n H. induction H; eauto using subtype.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_has_size : forall S T, subtype S T -> exists n, subtype_size S T n.
Proof.
  intros S T H. induction H.
  - exists 1. apply szs_zero.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_trans; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_stem. exact Hs.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_fork; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_asf. exact Hs.
  - destruct IHsubtype1 as [n1 Hs1]. destruct IHsubtype2 as [n2 Hs2].
    exists (n1 + n2 + 1). eapply szs_funty; eauto.
  - destruct IHsubtype as [n Hs]. exists (S n). apply szs_quant. exact Hs.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_fork.
  - exists 1. apply szs_quant_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_dist.
  - exists 1. apply szs_inst.
  - exists 1. apply szs_lift.
  - exists 1. apply szs_leaf_fun.
  - exists 1. apply szs_stem_fun.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_leaf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_leaf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_stem.
  - exists 1. apply szs_fork_fork_fork.
  - exists 1. apply szs_recursion.
  - exists 1. eapply szs_tree; eauto.
  - exists 1. apply szs_to_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_from_asf.
  - exists 1. apply szs_bffs.
  - exists 1. apply szs_bfff.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf
  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->
                       P_leaf (Funty (Quant u) (Quant v)))
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 6. A structural "head/safety" invariant Q that is unconditionally   *)
(*    monotone along subtype and stable under substitution and lift.   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Q forbids Fork at the head and recursively under Quant, and forbids *)
(* Var.  This is exactly the guard needed for the substitution lemma:  *)
(* the rules with Fork sources (sub_fork_*, sub_tree, sub_bffs,        *)
(* sub_bfff) and sub_recursion become vacuous, while all other rules   *)
(* preserve Q.                                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint Q (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => True
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant T' => Q T'
  end.

Lemma Q_subst_rec : forall T u k, Q T -> Q (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_lift_rec : forall T k n, Q T -> Q (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT. exact HQ.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* Asf *) exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma Q_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> Q T -> Q U.
Proof.
  intros T U H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HQ; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact HQ.
  - (* trans *) eauto.
  - (* stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) eauto.
  - (* quant_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) apply Q_subst_rec with (k := 0). exact HQ.
  - (* lift *) apply Q_lift_rec with (k := 0) (n := 1). exact HQ.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HQ.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HQ.
  - (* recursion *) unfold omega2_ty in HQ. cbn in HQ. destruct HQ.
  - (* tree *) destruct HQ.
  - (* to_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HQ.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HQ.
Qed.

  | Stem _ => False

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import AgentB AgentC AgentD Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit AgentB_invgen

Definition W3c (q:dtype) : dtype := Funty (Funty q q) q.

Lemma ground_Funty : forall U V, ground U -> ground V -> ground (Funty U V).
Proof. intros U V HU HV. simpl. split; assumption. Qed.

Lemma ground_Quant : forall q, ground q -> ground (Quant q).
Proof. intros q H. simpl. exact H. Qed.

Lemma ground_lift_one : forall q, ground q -> lift 1 q = q.
Proof. intros q H. unfold lift. apply ground_lift. exact H. Qed.

Lemma ground_quant_intro : forall q, ground q -> subtype q (Quant q).
Proof.
  intros q H.
  pose proof (sub_lift q) as Hs.
  rewrite (ground_lift_one q H) in Hs.
  exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma ground_quant_elim : forall q, ground q -> subtype (Quant q) q.
Proof.
  intros q H.
  pose proof (subtype_quant_lift_elim q) as Hs.
  rewrite (ground_lift_one q H) in Hs.
  exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma W3c_equiv : forall a b, subtype a b -> subtype b a ->
  subtype (W3c a) (W3c b).
Proof.
  intros a b Hab Hba. unfold W3c.
  eapply sub_funty.
  - eapply sub_funty; [ exact Hab | exact Hba ].
  - exact Hab.
Qed.

Lemma ground_quant_tower : forall k F, ground F ->
  subtype (quant k F) F /\ subtype F (quant k F).
Proof.
  induction k as [| k IH]; intros F Hg.
  - simpl. split; apply sub_zero.
  - simpl. (* quant (S k) F = quant k (Quant F) *)
    destruct (IH (Quant F) (ground_Quant F Hg)) as [H1 H2].
    split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [ exact H1 | apply ground_quant_elim; exact Hg ].
    + eapply sub_trans; [ apply ground_quant_intro; exact Hg | exact H2 ].
Qed.

(* The second RecSplit conjunct for a ground base type, all k. *)
Lemma RS_second_ground : forall U V k,
  ground U -> ground V ->
  subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3c (quant k (Funty U V)))).
Proof.
  intros U V k HU HV.
  pose proof (RS_base U V) as [_ H2].
  destruct (ground_quant_tower k (Funty U V) (ground_Funty U V HU HV))
    as [Hle Hge].
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + unfold W3c. apply (W3c_equiv (Funty U V) (quant k (Funty U V)) Hge Hle).
Qed.

(* Closed corollary: closed leaf-instantiated form for any ground base. *)
Lemma RS_second_ground_closed : forall U V k,
  ground U -> ground V -> forall uty vty,
  U = uty -> V = vty ->
  subtype omega22_ty (Funty omega2_ty (W3c (quant k (Funty uty vty)))).
Proof. intros U V k HU HV uty vty -> ->. apply RS_second_ground; assumption. Qed.

Print Assumptions RS_second_ground.

Print Assumptions W3c_equiv.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* A concrete counterexample to reduction_preserves_typing.
   The term (((Node @ Node) @ Node) @ (Node @ Node)) is a k-redex.
   It has type Stem Leaf, but its reduct Node has no such type. *)

Definition M0 : Tree := ((△ @ △) @ △) @ (△ @ △).

Definition T0 : dtype := Stem Leaf.

Lemma dK : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △) (Stem Leaf).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply derive_node. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma dK_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) (△ @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dK.
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Lemma dKy :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Fork Leaf (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dK_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma dKy_fun :
  derive (@nil (string*dtype)) ((△ @ △) @ △)
         (Funty (Stem Leaf) (Stem Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply derive_sub.
  - exact dKy.
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
Qed.

Lemma dM0 : derive (@nil (string*dtype)) M0 T0.
Proof.
  unfold M0, T0.
  eapply derive_app.
  - exact dKy_fun.
  - exact dK.
Qed.

Lemma redM0 : t_red1 M0 △.
Proof. unfold M0. apply k_red. Qed.

Lemma node_typing : forall gamma ty, derive gamma △ ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H.
  inversion H as [gamma0 x uty ty0 Hget Hsub | gamma0 uty Hsub | gamma0 M N ty0 u HM HN].
  - simpl in Hget. discriminate.
  - exact Hsub.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma not_derive_node_stem : ~ derive (@nil (string*dtype)) △ T0.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold T0 in H.
  pose proof (node_typing _ _ H) as Hs.
  eapply AgentB.not_subtype_leaf_stem. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma reduction_preserves_typing_is_false :
  exists gamma M ty N, derive gamma M ty /\ t_red1 M N /\ ~ derive gamma N ty.
Proof.
  exists (@nil (string*dtype)), M0, T0, △.
  split; [exact dM0 | split; [exact redM0 | exact not_derive_node_stem]].
Qed.

Print Assumptions reduction_preserves_typing_is_false.

  match T with Var _=>0 | Leaf=>1 | Stem _=>2 | Fork _ _=>3 | Funty _ _=>4 | Quant _=>5 | Asf _=>6 end.
Fixpoint deq (A B : dtype) {struct A} : bool :=
  match A,B with
  | Var i,Var j=>Nat.eqb i j | Quant a,Quant b=>deq a b | Funty a b,Funty c d=>andb (deq a c)(deq b d)

Good. Size.v subtype_size is indexed only by S T n (relation), easier for strong induction on n using `subtype_has_size` and `subtype_size_sound`. AgentA_Cut version also records the derivation, which gives access to the actual proof H and its subderivations. For our Tgen, we want to call the induction hypothesis on a *composed reachability derivation* trans Hreach D1, whose size is known to be < n. With Size.v's `subtype_size`, we can compute/estimate sizes, but we need the specific subtype derivation to instantiate the conclusion's source type? For T (the theorem), the conclusion Out depends only on a,r and lower parameters X,Y,B, not on the derivations. Great! The cores are pure. So strong induction on n with statement:

T_strong n := forall (a r:dtype), subtype_size (Fork (Fork X Y) B) (Funty a r) n -> Out.

But X,Y,B are parameters; we can keep them fixed in the section or quantify. For Tgen, the reachability source is Fork(Fork X Y) B and intermediate M; the size n should be of the *reachability* derivation. Define:

Tgen X Y B M n := forall (Hreach : subtype (Fork(Fork X Y) B) M) (a r), subtype M (Funty a r) -> (forall m, subtype_size (Fork(Fork X Y) B) M m -> m <= n?) -> Out.

Hmm, we need to relate derivation size. Simpler: work with subtype_size directly on the reachability derivation:

Tgen n M := (forall m, subtype_size (Fork(Fork X Y) B) M m -> m <= n) -> forall a r, subtype M (Funty a r) -> Out.

But in the recursion, when we build trans Hreach D1, we know a subtype_size witness for it: n_reach + n_D1 + 1. If the original bound is n0 (size of the original combined Hff), the new reachability size is ≤ n0 - (size of remaining target derivation) < n0. We can phrase the induction statement with an explicit subtype_size witness for the reachability derivation and a *bound* N such that the reachability size is ≤ N:

P(N, M, Hreach_size) := forall a r, subtype M (Funty a r) -> Out, under the hypothesis that the reachability derivation has subtype_size S0 M nreach with nreach ≤ N.

But the recursion on the *target* derivation D (subtype M (Funty a r)) also needs a measure to terminate. We can do a nested strong induction on the target size, given the reachability size. Let's define:

Q N_S M (w : subtype_size S0 M N_S) : forall a r (D : subtype M (Funty a r)) nD, subtype_size M (Funty a r) nD -> nD + N_S ≤ N_initial -> Out.

We do strong induction on N_initial (outer). For a given (S0,M,w) and target D:

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 4. The App inversion framework.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* App S a r is the "canonical" witness that S <= Funty a r.  Its     *)
(* constructors mirror exactly the atomic subtype rules whose target   *)
(* is a function type, plus a monotonicity (transitivity) rule.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive App : dtype -> dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| app_leaf : forall a r, subtype (Stem a) r -> App Leaf a r
| app_stem : forall X a r, subtype (Fork X a) r -> App (Stem X) a r
| app_funty : forall X Y a r, subtype a X -> subtype Y r -> App (Funty X Y) a r
| app_fork_leaf : forall X a r, subtype X r -> App (Fork Leaf X) a r
| app_fork_stem : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a u -> subtype w r ->
    App (Fork (Stem (Funty u (Funty v w))) (Funty u v)) a r
| app_fork_fork_leaf : forall u v w a r,
    subtype a Leaf -> subtype u r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_stem : forall u v1 v2 w a r,
    subtype a (Stem v1) -> subtype v2 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u (Funty v1 v2)) w) a r
| app_fork_fork_fork : forall u v w1 w2 w3 a r,
    subtype a (Fork w1 w2) -> subtype w3 r ->
    App (Fork (Fork u v) (Funty w1 (Funty w2 w3))) a r
| app_quant_inst : forall ty u a r,
    subst ty u = Funty a r -> App (Quant ty) a r
| app_quant_dist : forall X Y,
    App (Quant (Funty X Y)) (Quant X) (Quant Y)
| app_recursion : forall k u v,
    App omega2_ty omega2_ty
        (Funty (Funty (quant k (Funty u v)) (quant k (Funty u v)))
               (quant k (Funty u v)))
| app_tree : forall ty uty, covariant ty ->
    App (Fork
           (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
                 (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
           (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))
        uty (subst ty uty)
| app_asf_fun : forall X Y, App (Asf (Funty X Y)) X Y
| app_mono : forall S T a r, subtype S T -> App T a r -> App S a r.

(* Completeness: every subtype of a function type factors through App. *)

Lemma app_complete : forall S a r, subtype S (Funty a r) -> App S a r.
Proof.
  intros S a r H.
  remember (Funty a r) as T eqn:ET.
  revert a r ET.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros a0 r0 ET.
  - (* sub_zero *) rewrite ET. apply app_funty; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_trans *) eapply app_mono; [ exact H1 | eauto ].
  - (* sub_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_funty *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_funty; eauto.
  - (* sub_quant *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_dist *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_quant_dist.
  - (* sub_inst *) eapply app_quant_inst. exact ET.
  - (* sub_lift *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_stem. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_fork_leaf. apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_leaf; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_stem; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) inversion ET; subst.
    eapply app_fork_fork_fork; apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_recursion *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_recursion.
  - (* sub_tree *) inversion ET; subst. eapply app_tree; eauto.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) inversion ET; subst. apply app_asf_fun.
  - (* sub_bffs *) discriminate ET.
  - (* sub_bfff *) discriminate ET.
Qed.

(* Weak soundness: App is a sound certificate for the subtyping judgement. *)

Lemma app_sound : forall S a r, App S a r -> subtype S (Funty a r).
Proof.
  intros S a r H. induction H.
  - (* app_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_funty *) apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; [ apply sub_zero | assumption ].
  - (* app_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_leaf *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_stem *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_fork_fork_fork *) eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
    + apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - (* app_quant_inst *) rewrite <- H. apply sub_inst.
  - (* app_quant_dist *) apply sub_dist.
  - (* app_recursion *) apply sub_recursion.
  - (* app_tree *) apply sub_tree. assumption.
  - (* app_asf_fun *) apply sub_from_asf.
  - (* app_mono *) eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint P_leaf (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Asf T' => P_leaf T'
  | Quant T' => P_leaf T'
  | Funty a r => subtype (Stem a) r

  (Hdist : forall u v, P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) ->

  - (* Funty *) apply Hsub with (k := k). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k). exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma lift_stem_implies_P_lift
  (Hlift : forall x y k n,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k n)) (lift_rec y k n))
  : forall T k n, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k n).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT with (k := k) (n := m). exact HP.
Qed.

(* Concrete obstruction to the naive full substitution monotonicity of   *)
(* subtype: the sub_tree side condition covariant is NOT preserved under *)
(* substitution.  Hence a proof of substitution monotonicity cannot     *)
(* simply push substitution through sub_tree; any successful proof must  *)
(* exclude sub_tree sources (e.g. via a reachability Q-invariant).      *)

Lemma covariant_not_subst_stable :
  exists (ty : dtype) (u : dtype), covariant ty /\ ~ covariant (subst ty u).
Proof.
  exists (Quant (Funty Leaf (Var 1))), (Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intro H. unfold covariant in H. cbn in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* General negative facts from Q: a Q-source can never have a Fork target, *)
(* a Var target, or omega2_ty as target.  Useful for eliminating App       *)
(* branches with such target shapes.                                       *)

Lemma Q_not_fork : forall S Y Z, Q S -> subtype S (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S Y Z HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_var : forall S i, Q S -> subtype S (Var i) -> False.
Proof.
  intros S i HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H. simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Q_not_omega2 : forall S, Q S -> subtype S omega2_ty -> False.
Proof.
  intros S HQ Hsub.
  pose proof (Q_mono _ _ Hsub HQ) as H.
  unfold omega2_ty in H. cbn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_stem_fork :
  forall x Y Z, subtype (Stem x) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Stem x) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

Lemma not_subtype_funty_fork :
  forall a b Y Z, subtype (Funty a b) (Fork Y Z) -> False.
Proof.
  intros a b Y Z H. exact (Q_not_fork (Funty a b) Y Z Logic.I H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 10. Discharging the dist obligation of P_leaf unconditionally.      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* P_leaf (Quant (Funty u v)) is definitionally subtype (Stem u) v;   *)
(* the dist target is subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant v).  The        *)
(* following closed lemma supplies exactly that, so the Hdist         *)
(* hypothesis of P_leaf_mono is no longer needed.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma lift_Var_add : forall n m, lift n (Var m) = Var (n + m).
Proof.
  intros n m. unfold lift. simpl. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 m) as [h|h]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_S_id : forall x j,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x (S j) 1) (Var 0) j = x.
Proof.
  induction x; intros j; simpl.
  - (* Var n *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test (S j) n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j (S n)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare j n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt] eqn:C; simpl.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * rewrite lift_Var_add. f_equal. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHx.
  - (* Funty *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Leaf *) reflexivity.
  - (* Stem *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
  - (* Fork *) simpl. rewrite IHx1, IHx2. reflexivity.
  - (* Asf *) simpl. rewrite IHx. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_1_id : forall x,
  subst_rec (lift_rec x 1 1) (Var 0) 0 = x.
Proof. intros x. exact (subst_lift_S_id x 0). Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_quant_dist : forall x y,
  subtype (Stem x) y -> subtype (Stem (Quant x)) (Quant y).
Proof.
  intros x y H.
  assert (HQ : subtype (Quant (lift_rec x 1 1)) x).
  { eapply sub_trans.
    - apply sub_inst with (u := Var 0).
    - unfold subst. rewrite subst_lift_1_id. apply sub_zero. }
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift with (ty := Stem (Quant x)).
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_quant. eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_stem. exact HQ.
      * exact H.
    + apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* P_leaf_mono with the dist case supplied by the closed lemma above. *)
Lemma P_leaf_mono_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall T U, subtype T U -> P_leaf T -> P_leaf U.
Proof.
  apply P_leaf_mono.
  - intros u v HP. simpl in HP. simpl.
    apply subtype_stem_quant_dist. exact HP.
  - exact Hlift.
  - exact Hinst.
Qed.

Lemma L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst
  (Hlift : forall T, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (Quant (lift 1 T)))
  (Hinst : forall T u, P_leaf (Quant T) -> P_leaf (subst T u))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  intros a r H.
  exact (P_leaf_of_leaf_subtype
           (fun u v HP => subtype_stem_quant_dist u v HP)
           Hlift Hinst (Funty a r) H).
Qed.

(* Lift obligation of P_leaf, specialized to lifting by exactly one.     *)
(* The hypothesis is exactly the n = 1 instance of the specialized lift *)
(* fact for Stem sources.                                              *)
Lemma P_leaf_lift_one
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall T k, P_leaf T -> P_leaf (lift_rec T k 1).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k HP; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) destruct HP.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHT with (k := S k). exact HP.
  - (* Funty *) apply Hlift1. exact HP.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) destruct HP.
  - (* Fork *) destruct HP.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHT. exact HP.
Qed.

(* Assembly of L1 from the two remaining specialized facts only.       *)
(* Hsub must be the generalized statement at EVERY substitution level k, *)
(* because P_leaf recurses through Quant and substitution under a       *)
(* Quant increments the level.  Hlift only needs its k-parametric,      *)
(* n = 1 instance.                                                     *)
Lemma L1_of_specialized_stem_facts
  (Hsub : forall x y u k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (subst_rec x u k)) (subst_rec y u k))
  (Hlift1 : forall x y k,
      subtype (Stem x) y ->
      subtype (Stem (lift_rec x k 1)) (lift_rec y k 1))
  : forall a r, subtype Leaf (Funty a r) -> subtype (Stem a) r.
Proof.
  apply L1_of_P_leaf_lift_inst.
  - intros T HP. exact (P_leaf_lift_one Hlift1 T 0 HP).
  - intros T u HP.
    exact (specialized_subst_implies_P_inst Hsub T u 0 HP).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 11. An important test instance for the source-Stem strong fact.     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The intended statement is                                          *)
(*   L2 : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->               *)
(*                      subtype (Fork X a) r.                         *)
(* The instance below reaches a quantified codomain through           *)
(* sub_lift and sub_dist, so it is a natural stress test for any       *)
(* target-shape-insensitive predicate.  It is NOT a counterexample:   *)
(* the required conclusion is derivable, using                          *)
(*   Quant Leaf <: Leaf            (sub_inst with ty := Leaf)         *)
(* to shrink the second component of the Fork, then sub_fork_leaf,    *)
(* then sub_lift.  We record both facts explicitly; they are also a    *)
(* warning that any finite model omitting the `sub_lift` edge          *)
(* `ty <: Quant (lift 1 ty)` (the direction used here) will report a   *)
(* spurious failure of L2 on this instance.                           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma subtype_quant_leaf_leaf : subtype (Quant Leaf) Leaf.
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply (sub_inst Leaf (Var 0)).
  - vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma L2_premise_instance :
  subtype (Stem Leaf)
          (Funty (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)).
    + eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty Leaf (Fork Leaf Leaf)).
      * apply sub_stem_fun.
      * eapply sub_funty.
        -- apply sub_zero.
        -- apply sub_fork_leaf.
    + eapply sub_trans
        with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (Funty Leaf (Funty (Var 0) Leaf)))).
      * apply sub_lift.
      * vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
  - apply sub_dist.
Qed.

(* The conclusion of L2 on that instance is itself derivable.         *)
Lemma L2_instance_conclusion :
  subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.
  eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Funty (Var 0) Leaf).
  - eapply sub_trans with (ty2 := Fork Leaf Leaf).
    + eapply sub_fork.
      * apply sub_zero.
      * exact subtype_quant_leaf_leaf.
    + apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - eapply sub_trans
      with (ty2 := Quant (lift 1 (Funty (Var 0) Leaf))).
    + apply sub_lift.
    + vm_compute. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* If L2 is assumed, the two facts above are consistent; this records  *)
(* that the instance provides no disproof of L2.                       *)
Lemma naive_L2_instance_consistent
  (L2 : forall X a r, subtype (Stem X) (Funty a r) ->
                      subtype (Fork X a) r)
  : subtype (Fork Leaf (Quant Leaf)) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf)).
Proof.
  exact (L2 Leaf (Quant Leaf) (Quant (Funty (Var 1) Leaf))
           L2_premise_instance).
Qed.

Fixpoint rp (T : dtype) : dtype :=
  match T with
  | Var i => Var i
  | Quant T' => Quant (rp T')
  | Funty _ r => r

Lemma rp_subst_rec_RF :

Proof.

  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct HR.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT; [reflexivity | exact HR].
Qed.

Lemma rp_mono_RF_FRK :
  forall S T, subtype S T -> RF S -> FRK T -> subtype (rp S) (rp T).
Proof.
  intros S T H.
  induction H as
    [ ty
    | ty1 ty2 ty3 H1 H2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | uty1 uty2 Hs
    | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 Hs1 Hs2
    | vty1 vty2 Hs
    | u
    | u v
    | u
    | u v
    | ty u
    | ty
    | uty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty wty
    | uty vty1 vty2 wty
    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];
    intros HR HF; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* trans *)
    match goal with
    | H1p : subtype ty1 ?M |- _ =>
        pose proof (RF_mono _ _ H1p HR) as HRM
    end.
    match goal with
    | H2p : subtype ?M ty3 |- _ =>
        pose proof (FRK_back_RF _ _ H2p HRM HF) as HFM
    end.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork *) assumption.
  - (* asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* funty *) destruct HF.
  - (* quant *) apply sub_quant. apply IHHs; assumption.

  - (* leaf_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* stem_fun *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) destruct HF.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) destruct HF.
  - (* recursion *) destruct HF.
  - (* tree *) destruct HF.
  - (* to_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* from_asf *) destruct HF.
  - (* bffs *) destruct HF.
  - (* bfff *) destruct HF.
Qed.

(* The right projection of a subtype between Forks. *)
Lemma fork_right : forall D E A B,
  subtype (Fork D E) (Fork A B) -> subtype E B.
Proof.
  intros D E A B H.
  exact (rp_mono_RF_FRK (Fork D E) (Fork A B) H Logic.I Logic.I).
Qed.

Print Assumptions fork_right.

Proof.

  simpl in HG.
  rewrite l2_lift_zero in HG.
  exact HG.
Qed.

Print Assumptions stem_inv.

(* 8.  Exact remaining obligations (reported, not postulated).        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*  * RecSplit: the sub_recursion branch.  This is the only branch    *)
(*    whose witness cannot be guessed from the syntax of the rule;    *)

(*                                                                    *)
(*  * The sub_bffs branch of R_mono needs an Asf-inversion for the     *)
(*    pair component, because R(Asf X) keeps R X.  The precise goal is *)
(*    stated below as Bffs_branch.                                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* FALSE (see the warning above): the counterexample
     d = 0, A = bffs_aug uty, u1 = Asf (Asf (Asf Leaf)), vty = Asf (Asf Leaf)
   satisfies both hypotheses by sub_zero but forces the non-derivable
   subtype (Asf (Asf (Asf Leaf))) (Asf (Asf Leaf)).  It is recorded only
   to document exactly where the structural invariant fails. *)
Definition Bffs_branch : Prop :=
  forall d A u1 uty vty,
    subtype (lift d A) (bffs_aug uty) ->
    subtype (lift d u1) (Asf vty) ->
    subtype (lift d A) uty /\ subtype (lift d u1) vty.

(* The bfff branch is vacuous for R: its first source component is a
   Fork, and R is False on the first component of a Fork. *)
Lemma R_bfff_vacuous :
  forall d A u1 uty vty wty,
    R d A u1 (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty)) -> False.
Proof. intros. cbn [R] in H. destruct H as [H _]. cbn [GoodStem] in H. exact H. Qed.

(* The recursion source has the GoodStem projection of Stem omega21. *)
Lemma R_omega2_unfold :
  forall d A u1,
    R d A u1 omega2_ty ->
    subtype (lift d A) omega21_ty /\ subtype (lift d u1) omega22_ty.
Proof.
  intros d A u1 H.
  change (R d A u1 (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty)) in H.
  cbn [R] in H. cbn [GoodStem] in H. exact H.
Qed.

(* 9.  Revised SEMANTIC invariant.  R_mono above is false (its        *)
(*     sub_bffs branch is the false Bffs_branch), so the structural   *)
(*     invariant cannot be repaired by a local change of the Asf      *)
(*     case alone.  The following invariant quantifies over all Funty *)
(*     supertypes instead of matching on X.  Its monotonicity is      *)
(*     then fully unconditional (SemR_mono), and the only remaining   *)
(*     obligation is SemComp: GoodStem 0 A B -> SemR 0 A u1 B.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* subtype is stable under an arbitrary lift. *)
Lemma lift_n_subtype :
  forall X Y, subtype X Y -> forall d, subtype (lift d X) (lift d Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y H. induction d as [| d IH].
  - rewrite l2_lift_zero, l2_lift_zero. exact H.
  - rewrite <- (l2_lift_lift_S X d), <- (l2_lift_lift_S Y d).
    apply (AgentD.lift_rec_subtype _ _ IH 0).
Qed.

(* For all Funty supertypes T <: Funty u ty of X, the pair (A,u1) must
   split at the same intermediate v. *)
Definition SemR (d : nat) (A u1 X : dtype) : Prop :=
  forall u ty,
    subtype (Fork (lift d X) (lift d u1)) (Funty u ty) ->
    exists v,
      subtype (lift d A) (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\
      subtype (lift d u1) (Funty u v).

(* Unconditional monotonicity: no case analysis, no Bffs_branch. *)
Lemma SemR_mono :
  forall d A u1 X Y, subtype X Y -> SemR d A u1 X -> SemR d A u1 Y.
Proof.
  intros d A u1 X Y Hsub HR u ty Hfun.
  unfold SemR in HR.
  apply HR.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply lift_n_subtype. exact Hsub.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - exact Hfun.
Qed.

(* The single honest residual obligation of the semantic route. *)
Definition SemComp : Prop :=
  forall A B u1, GoodStem 0 A B -> SemR 0 A u1 B.

(* GoodStem_comp now follows from SemComp alone. *)
Lemma GoodStem_comp_of_SemComp :
  SemComp ->
  forall A B u1 u ty,
    GoodStem 0 A B ->
    GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
    exists v, subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intros SC A B u1 u ty H1 H2.
  unfold SemComp in SC.
  cbn [GoodStem] in H2.
  rewrite <- (l2_lift_zero u1) in H2.
  pose proof (SC A B u1 H1) as HR.
  unfold SemR in HR.
  destruct (HR u ty H2) as [v [HA Hu]].
  exists v. split.
  - rewrite l2_lift_zero in HA. exact HA.
  - rewrite l2_lift_zero in Hu. exact Hu.
Qed.

(* Hence inv_s follows from the single obligation SemComp. *)
Lemma inv_s_of_SemComp :
  SemComp ->
  forall u2 u1 u ty u3,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u2 (Funty u1 (Funty u ty))) ->
    subtype Leaf (Funty u3 u2) ->
    exists v, subtype u3 (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v).
Proof.
  intro SC.
  exact (inv_s_of_GoodStem_comp (GoodStem_comp_of_SemComp SC)).
Qed.

(* SemComp) already proves RecSplit.  In particular the proposed       *)
(* `only sub_fork_stem is atomic` case split is incomplete.            *)

Lemma GoodStem_comp_implies_RecSplit :
  (forall A B u1 u ty,
      GoodStem 0 A B ->
      GoodStem 0 B (Funty u1 (Funty u ty)) ->
      exists v, subtype A (Funty u (Funty v ty)) /\ subtype u1 (Funty u v)) ->
  RecSplit.
Proof.
  intros GC k uty vty.
  unfold RecSplit.
  assert (H2 : GoodStem 0 (Stem omega21_ty)
                 (Funty omega22_ty
                   (Funty omega2_ty
                     (Funty
                       (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                              (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                       (quant k (Funty uty vty)))))).
  { cbn [GoodStem].
    rewrite l2_lift_zero.
    change (subtype omega2_ty
              (Funty omega2_ty
                (Funty
                  (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty))
                         (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                  (quant k (Funty uty vty))))).
    exact (sub_recursion k uty vty). }

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive AgentB AgentC AgentD.
Require Import Integration1 L3_impl AgentB_L2lit.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Open Scope tree_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* 1. Forward reachability of the head.                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A subtype of a Fork source has head Fork or Funty (or an Asf/Quant  *)
(* spine ending in one of them); it is never Leaf, Stem or Var.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint RF (T : dtype) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf T' => RF T'
  | Quant T' => RF T'
  end.

Lemma RF_subst_rec : forall T u k, RF T -> RF (subst_rec T u k).
Proof.
  induction T; intros u k HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_lift_rec : forall T k m, RF T -> RF (lift_rec T k m).
Proof.
  induction T; intros k m HR; simpl in *.
  - destruct HR.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - destruct HR.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - apply IHT; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma RF_mono : forall T U, subtype T U -> RF T -> RF U.
Proof.

    | u v

    | uty vty wty

    | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
    | k uty vty
    | ty uty Hcov
    | ty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty
    | uty vty wty ];

  - exact HR.
  - eauto.
  - destruct HR.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.
  - exact Logic.I.
  - eauto.

  - exact HR.
